theorem agirseven_ollis_linear_realization_conjecture
    (y k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hyk : 2 * k < y) (ha : y ≤ a) :

signature.name: agirseven_ollis_linear_realization_conjecture
signature.statement:
theorem agirseven_ollis_linear_realization_conjecture
    (y k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hyk : 2 * k < y) (ha : y ≤ a) :
    HasLinearRealization (a + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a b c)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have finish : ∀ (a₀ : ℕ) (p : List ℕ), a₀ ≤ a →
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p →
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c)) →
      HasLinearRealization (a + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a b c) := by
    intro a₀ p ha₀ hp hend
    have hend' : IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c + 1 - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; exact hend
    have h := pad_ones (a₀ + b + c + 1) (a - a₀) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p
      (by omega) hp hend'
    have e1 : a₀ + b + c + 1 + (a - a₀) = a + b + c + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c + Multiset.replicate (a - a₀) 1 =
        prescribedLengths y k a b c := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, a = a₀ + d := ⟨a - a₀, by omega⟩
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Multiset.replicate_add]
      abel
    rw [e1, e2] at h
    exact h
  
  have eqB : ∀ a₀ b₀ c₀ t : ℕ, prescribedLengths y k a₀ b₀ c₀ +
      Multiset.replicate (t * (y - k)) (y - k) =
      prescribedLengths y k a₀ (b₀ + t * (y - k)) c₀ := by
    intro a₀ b₀ c₀ t
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  have eqC : ∀ a₀ b₀ c₀ t : ℕ, prescribedLengths y k a₀ b₀ c₀ +
      Multiset.replicate (t * y) y = prescribedLengths y k a₀ b₀ (c₀ + t * y) := by
    intro a₀ b₀ c₀ t
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  
  have botT : ∀ (p p₁ : List ℕ) (v₀ : ℕ), y - k + y ≤ v₀ →
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u + y < v₀ → w + y < v₀ → Adj p u w → Adj p₁ u w) →
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + y < v₀ → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p₁ x) →
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p → BotEndInv (y - k) p₁) ∧
      (BotPairInv (y - k) p → BotPairInv (y - k) p₁) := by
    intro p p₁ v₀ hv hA hE
    unfold BotEndInv BotPairInv
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, hpair, hev⟩
      refine ⟨hE 0 (by omega) h0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj1 hj2
        exact hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hpair j hj1 hj2)
      · intro he
        exact hE _ (by omega) (hev he)
    · rintro ⟨hev, hpair⟩
      refine ⟨hev, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      exact hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hpair j hj)
  
  have topT : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : List ℕ) (v₁ t : ℕ), y - k + y ≤ v₁ →
      (∀ u w : ℕ, y - k ≤ u → y - k ≤ w → Adj p₁ u w → Adj p₂ (u + t) (w + t)) →
      (∀ x : ℕ, y - k ≤ x → IsEnd p₁ x → IsEnd p₂ (x + t)) →
      (TopEndInv y v₁ p₁ → TopEndInv y (v₁ + t) p₂) ∧
      (TopPairInv y v₁ p₁ → TopPairInv y (v₁ + t) p₂) := by
    intro p₁ p₂ v₁ t hv hA hE
    unfold TopEndInv TopPairInv
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, hpair, hev⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h := hE _ (by omega) h0
        rw [show v₁ - 1 + t = v₁ + t - 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      · intro j hj1 hj2
        have h := hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hpair j hj1 hj2)
        rw [show v₁ - 2 * j + t = v₁ + t - 2 * j by omega,
          show v₁ - 1 - 2 * j + t = v₁ + t - 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact h
      · intro he
        have h := hE _ (by omega) (hev he)
        rw [show v₁ - y + t = v₁ + t - y by omega] at h
        exact h
    · rintro ⟨hev, hpair⟩
      refine ⟨hev, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      have h := hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hpair j hj)
      rw [show v₁ - 1 - 2 * j + t = v₁ + t - 1 - 2 * j by omega,
        show v₁ - 2 - 2 * j + t = v₁ + t - 2 - 2 * j by omega] at h
      exact h
  
  have decomp : ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 0 < ℓ → ∃ n₀ t : ℕ, n = n₀ + t * ℓ ∧
      ((n₀ < ℓ ∧ t = 0) ∨ (ℓ ≤ n₀ ∧ n₀ < 2 * ℓ)) := by
    intro n ℓ hℓ
    by_cases h : n < ℓ
    · exact ⟨n, 0, by simp, Or.inl ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
    · refine ⟨ℓ + (n - ℓ) % ℓ, (n - ℓ) / ℓ, ?_, Or.inr ⟨by omega, ?_⟩⟩
      · have := Nat.mod_add_div' (n - ℓ) ℓ
        omega
      · have := Nat.mod_lt (n - ℓ) hℓ
        omega
  obtain ⟨b₀, tb, rfl, hb⟩ := decomp b (y - k) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨c₀, tc, rfl, hc⟩ := decomp c y (by omega)
  rcases hb with ⟨hb1, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ <;> rcases hc with ⟨hc1, rfl⟩ | ⟨hc1, hc2⟩
  · 
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at finish ⊢
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, hend⟩ := base_D y k b₀ c₀ hk hyk hb1 hc1
    exact finish a₀ p (by omega) hp hend
  · 
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at finish ⊢
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, hTop, h3⟩ := base_B y k b₀ c₀ hk hyk hb1 hc1 hc2
    have ev : a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1 + tc * y = a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1 := by omega
    by_cases hTE : TopEndInv y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p
    · obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hTE₁, -, -⟩ :=
        grow_top_end_iter y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tc _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hTE
      rw [ev, eqC] at hp₁
      rw [ev] at hTE₁
      refine finish a₀ p₁ (by omega) hp₁ (Or.inr ?_)
      have h := hTE₁.1
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      exact h
    · have hTP : TopPairInv y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p := hTop.resolve_left hTE
      have h0 : IsEnd p 0 := h3.resolve_right hTE
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, -, hE₁⟩ :=
        grow_top_pair_iter y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tc _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hTP
      rw [ev, eqC] at hp₁
      exact finish a₀ p₁ (by omega) hp₁ (Or.inl (hE₁ 0 (by omega) h0))
  · 
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at finish ⊢
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, hBot, h3⟩ := base_C y k b₀ c₀ hk hyk hb1 hb2 hc1
    have ev : a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1 + tb * (y - k) = a₀ + (b₀ + tb * (y - k)) + c₀ + 1 := by
      omega
    by_cases hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p
    · obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hBE₂, -, -⟩ :=
        grow_bot_end_iter (y - k) (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tb _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hBE
      rw [ev, eqB] at hp₂
      exact finish a₀ p₂ (by omega) hp₂ (Or.inl hBE₂.1)
    · have hBP : BotPairInv (y - k) p := hBot.resolve_left hBE
      have hend : IsEnd p (a₀ + b₀ + c₀) := h3.resolve_right hBE
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, -, hE₂⟩ :=
        grow_bot_pair_iter (y - k) (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tb _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hBP
      rw [ev, eqB] at hp₂
      have h := hE₂ _ (by omega) hend
      rw [show a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + tb * (y - k) = a₀ + (b₀ + tb * (y - k)) + c₀ by omega] at h
      exact finish a₀ p₂ (by omega) hp₂ (Or.inr h)
  · 
    by_cases hpar : y % 2 = 1 ∧ k % 2 = 0
    · 
      obtain ⟨hy2, hk2⟩ := hpar
      obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, hTop, -⟩ :=
        base_B y k (b₀ - (y - k)) c₀ hk hyk (by omega) hc1 hc2
      have hTE : TopEndInv y (a₀ + (b₀ - (y - k)) + c₀ + 1) p := by
        rcases hTop with h | ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, -⟩
        · exact h
        · omega
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hTE₁, -, -⟩ :=
        grow_top_end_iter y _ tc _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hTE
      have hTm : TopEndInv (y - k) (a₀ + (b₀ - (y - k)) + c₀ + 1 + tc * y) p₁ := by
        refine ⟨hTE₁.1, fun j hj1 hj2 => hTE₁.2.1 j hj1 (by omega), ?_⟩
        rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
        omega
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hTE₂, -, -⟩ :=
        grow_top_end_iter (y - k) _ (tb + 1) _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ hTm
      have hm : (tb + 1) * (y - k) = tb * (y - k) + (y - k) := add_one_mul _ _
      have ev : a₀ + (b₀ - (y - k)) + c₀ + 1 + tc * y + (tb + 1) * (y - k) =
          a₀ + (b₀ + tb * (y - k)) + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1 := by
        rw [hm]; omega
      have hb' : b₀ - (y - k) + (tb + 1) * (y - k) = b₀ + tb * (y - k) := by
        rw [hm]; omega
      rw [ev, eqC, eqB, hb'] at hp₂
      rw [ev] at hTE₂
      have h := hTE₂.1
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      exact finish a₀ p₂ (by omega) hp₂ (Or.inr h)
    
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, hBot, hTop, h3⟩ := base_A_par y k b₀ c₀ hk hyk hpar hb1 hb2 hc1 hc2
    have ev : a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1 + tc * y = a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1 := by omega
    
    have step1 : ∃ p₁ : List ℕ,
        IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1)
          (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b₀ (c₀ + tc * y)) p₁ ∧
        (BotEndInv (y - k) p₁ ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p₁) ∧
        (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) p₁ ∨
          TopPairInv y (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) p₁) ∧
        (BotEndInv (y - k) p₁ ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) p₁) := by
      by_cases hTE : TopEndInv y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p
      · obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hTE₁, hA₁, hE₁⟩ :=
          grow_top_end_iter y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tc _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hTE
        have hT := botT p p₁ (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) (by omega) hA₁ hE₁
        rw [ev, eqC] at hp₁
        rw [ev] at hTE₁
        refine ⟨p₁, hp₁, ?_, Or.inl hTE₁, Or.inr hTE₁⟩
        rcases hBot with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (hT.1 h)
        · exact Or.inr (hT.2 h)
      · have hTP : TopPairInv y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p := hTop.resolve_left hTE
        have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p := h3.resolve_right hTE
        obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hTP₁, hA₁, hE₁⟩ :=
          grow_top_pair_iter y (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) tc _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hTP
        have hT := botT p p₁ (a₀ + b₀ + c₀ + 1) (by omega) hA₁ hE₁
        rw [ev, eqC] at hp₁
        rw [ev] at hTP₁
        exact ⟨p₁, hp₁, Or.inl (hT.1 hBE), Or.inr hTP₁, Or.inl (hT.1 hBE)⟩
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hBot₁, hTop₁, h3₁⟩ := step1
    
    have ev2 : a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1 + tb * (y - k) =
        a₀ + (b₀ + tb * (y - k)) + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1 := by omega
    by_cases hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₁
    · obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hBE₂, -, -⟩ :=
        grow_bot_end_iter (y - k) (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) tb _ p₁ (by omega)
          (by omega) hp₁ hBE
      rw [ev2, eqB] at hp₂
      exact finish a₀ p₂ (by omega) hp₂ (Or.inl hBE₂.1)
    · have hBP : BotPairInv (y - k) p₁ := hBot₁.resolve_left hBE
      have hTE : TopEndInv y (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) p₁ := h3₁.resolve_left hBE
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hA₂, hE₂⟩ :=
        grow_bot_pair_iter (y - k) (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) tb _ p₁ (by omega)
          (by omega) hp₁ hBP
      have hT := topT p₁ p₂ (a₀ + b₀ + (c₀ + tc * y) + 1) (tb * (y - k)) (by omega) hA₂ hE₂
      have hTE₂ := hT.1 hTE
      rw [ev2, eqB] at hp₂
      rw [ev2] at hTE₂
      have h := hTE₂.1
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      exact finish a₀ p₂ (by omega) hp₂ (Or.inr h)

subgoal_signatures.name: pad_ones
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v s : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (v - 1)) →
    HasLinearRealization (v + s) (L + Multiset.replicate s 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_top_end_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → TopEndInv ℓ v p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      TopEndInv ℓ (v + t * ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj p' u w) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_top_pair_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → TopPairInv ℓ v p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      TopPairInv ℓ (v + t * ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj p' u w) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_bot_end_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_bot_pair_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotPairInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotPairInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

subgoal_signatures.name: base_A
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y - k ≤ b → b < 2 * (y - k) → y ≤ c →
    c < 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p)

subgoal_signatures.name: base_B
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → b < y - k → y ≤ c → c < 2 * y →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p)

subgoal_signatures.name: base_C
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y - k ≤ b → b < 2 * (y - k) → c < y →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

subgoal_signatures.name: base_D
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → b < y - k → c < y →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c))

and_nodes.error_message: RETIRED BY REVIEW: SHAPE (minimal change): resubmit pad_ones, all four grow_*_iter lemmas (proved), base_B, base_C and base_D word for word so their nodes are reused. Change only base_A: add the hypothesis ¬(y % 2 = 1 ∧ k % 2 = 0). The current base_A is true but stronger than the root needs. In the y-odd/k-even (m odd) class it requires both exact windows, which is exactly where 7 base_A revisions failed, and base_A cannot drop that class inside its own subtree. I checked base_A findings ANCESTOR NOTE 5 by hand, and it removes the class at the root. For odd m ≤ y, TopEndInv y v p implies TopEndInv m v p (same end v-1, the m-pairs are a subset of the y-pairs, and Even m is false). So in glue case 4 with y odd and k even: apply base_B y k (b₀-m) c₀ (TopPairInv is impossible because y is odd, so TopEndInv y holds), then grow_top_end_iter with ℓ=y, t=tc, then that implication, then grow_top_end_iter with ℓ=m, t=tb+1 (2≤m≤v), then finish. The multiset works out because (b₀-m)+(tb+1)m = b₀+tb·m. I would approve these same 9 children with only base_A's hypothesis strengthened and this extra glue branch.

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_top_pair_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → TopPairInv ℓ v p →

proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
    intro x a t; rfl
  have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
  have s2 : ∀ p : List ℕ, edgeLengths (p.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths p := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b t' =>
        have e : (a :: b :: t').map (· + 1) = (a + 1) :: (b :: t').map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e' : (b :: t').map (· + 1) = (b + 1) :: t'.map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [e, e', s1, ← e', ih, s1]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring_nf
  have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
      edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
    intro l a b
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
      rfl
    | cons x l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
        have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) = edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons y l' =>
        have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
        have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
            edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
  have step : ∀ (w : ℕ) (M : Multiset ℕ) (q : List ℕ), 1 ≤ w → IsLinearRealization w M q →
      (IsEnd q 0 ∨ IsEnd q (w - 1)) →
      ∃ q', IsLinearRealization (w + 1) (M + {1}) q' ∧ (IsEnd q' 0 ∨ IsEnd q' w) := by
    intro w M q hw hqM hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hqM
    have hM1 : M + {1} = 1 ::ₘ M := by rw [add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
    have hperm0 : (0 :: q.map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (w + 1)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      exact (hq.map _).cons 0
    have hpermT : (q ++ [w]).Perm (List.range (w + 1)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      exact hq.append_right [w]
    unfold IsEnd at hend
    rcases hend with (h | h) | (h | h)
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inl (Or.inl rfl)⟩
      have e : (0 :: t).map (· + 1) = (0 + 1) :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
      have e2 := s2 (0 :: t)
      rw [e] at e2
      rw [e, s1, e2, hM, hM1]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨(t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0],
        ⟨(List.perm_append_singleton 0 _).trans hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inl (Or.inr (by simp))⟩
      have e : (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0] = t.map (· + 1) ++ [1, 0] := by simp
      have e2 : t.map (· + 1) ++ [1] = (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) := by simp
      rw [e, s3, e2, s2, hM]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨w :: (w - 1) :: t,
        ⟨(List.perm_append_singleton w _).symm.trans hpermT, ?_⟩, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
      rw [s1, hM, hM1, show ((w - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (w : ℤ) = -1 by omega]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨(t ++ [w - 1]) ++ [w], ⟨hpermT, ?_⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr (by simp))⟩
      rw [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, s3, hM,
        show (w : ℤ) - ((w - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 by omega]
      rfl
  intro v s L p hv hp hend
  have main : ∀ s, ∃ q, IsLinearRealization (v + s) (L + Multiset.replicate s 1) q ∧
      (IsEnd q 0 ∨ IsEnd q (v + s - 1)) := by
    intro s
    induction s with
    | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, by simpa using hend⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'e⟩ := step (v + n) _ q (by omega) hq hqe
      refine ⟨q', ?_, ?_⟩
      · have e : L + Multiset.replicate (n + 1) 1 = L + Multiset.replicate n 1 + {1} := by
          rw [Multiset.replicate_add, Multiset.replicate_one, add_assoc]
        rw [show v + (n + 1) = v + n + 1 by omega, e]
        exact hq'
      · rw [show v + (n + 1) - 1 = v + n by omega]
        exact hq'e
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -⟩ := main s
  exact ⟨q, hq⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have E_cons2 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have E_single : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  have E_split : ∀ (A : List ℕ) (y : ℕ) (m : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (A ++ y :: m) = edgeLengths (A ++ [y]) + edgeLengths (y :: m) := by
    intro A
    induction A with
    | nil =>
      intro y m
      show edgeLengths (y :: m) = edgeLengths [y] + edgeLengths (y :: m)
      rw [E_single, zero_add]
    | cons c A ih =>
      intro y m
      cases A with
      | nil =>
        show edgeLengths (c :: y :: m) = edgeLengths (c :: [y]) + edgeLengths (y :: m)
        rw [E_cons2, E_cons2, E_single, Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.singleton_add]
      | cons d A' =>
        show edgeLengths (c :: d :: (A' ++ y :: m)) =
          edgeLengths (c :: d :: (A' ++ [y])) + edgeLengths (y :: m)
        rw [E_cons2, E_cons2, Multiset.cons_add]
        congr 1
        exact ih y m
  have E_snoc : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (c z : ℕ), q.getLast? = some c →
      edgeLengths (q ++ [z]) = edgeLengths q + {Int.natAbs ((z : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))} := by
    intro q c z h
    obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rw [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, E_split, E_cons2, E_single, Multiset.cons_zero]
  have f_symm : ∀ a b : ℕ, Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) := by
    intro a b
    rw [← Int.natAbs_neg, neg_sub]
  have E_rev : ∀ p : List ℕ, edgeLengths p.reverse = edgeLengths p := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a s ih =>
      cases s with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b s' =>
        rw [List.reverse_cons, E_snoc _ b a (by simp), ih, E_cons2, f_symm, add_comm,
          Multiset.singleton_add]
  have dir_split : ∀ (A B s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), A ++ B = s ++ u :: w :: t →
      (∃ s' t', A = s' ++ u :: w :: t') ∨ (∃ s' t', B = s' ++ u :: w :: t') ∨
      (A.getLast? = some u ∧ B.head? = some w) := by
    intro A B s t u w h
    rcases List.append_eq_append_iff.mp h with ⟨a', _, hB⟩ | ⟨c', hA, hc⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a', t, hB⟩)
    · rcases c' with _ | ⟨c, _ | ⟨d, c''⟩⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨[], t, by simpa using hc.symm⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at hc
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by simp [hA], by simp⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at hc
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hc
        exact Or.inl ⟨s, c'', hA⟩
  have ins : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (y z : ℕ),
      ((l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂ : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) =
        (y + ℓ) ::ₘ (z + ℓ) ::ₘ ((l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂ : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) ∧
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂) + {ℓ} + {ℓ} ∧
      (l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂).head? ∧
      (l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂).getLast? ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ∀ s t : List ℕ, l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂ = s ++ u :: w :: t →
        (∃ s' t', l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂ = s' ++ u :: w :: t') ∨
        (u = y ∧ w = z)) := by
    intro ℓ l₁ l₂ y z
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_eq_coe, List.perm_iff_count]
      intro c
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · have hya : Int.natAbs (((y + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (y : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
        rw [show ((y + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (y : ℤ) = (ℓ : ℤ) by push_cast; ring]

      have hbz : Int.natAbs ((z : ℤ) - ((z + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
        rw [show (z : ℤ) - ((z + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) = -(ℓ : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, Int.natAbs_neg]

    · simp [List.head?_append]
    · simp [List.getLast?_append]
    · intro u w s t h

      · left
        refine ⟨s', t' ++ (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂, ?_⟩
        rw [show l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂ =
          (l₁ ++ [y]) ++ (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂ by simp, hA]
        simp
      · left
        refine ⟨l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: s', t', ?_⟩
        rw [hB]
        simp
      · right
        simp at hu hw
        exact ⟨hu.symm, hw.symm⟩
  have adj_symm : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    intro p u w h
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have adj_app : ∀ (l m : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj (l ++ m) u w := by
    intro l m u w h
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ m, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ m, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
  have adj_cons : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (z u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj (z :: l) u w := by
    intro l z u w h
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨z :: l₁, l₂, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    · exact ⟨z :: l₁, l₂, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
  have E_cons_head : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a z : ℕ), l.head? = some a →
      edgeLengths (z :: l) = Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (z : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths l := by
    intro l a z h
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rfl
  have hrange : ∀ v n : ℕ, List.range v ++ List.range' v n = List.range (v + n) := by
    intro v n
    rw [List.range_add, List.range'_eq_map_range]
  have orient : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
      IsEnd p x → ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization v L q ∧ q.getLast? = some x ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj q u w) ∧ (∀ z : ℕ, IsEnd p z → IsEnd q z) := by
    intro v L p x hp hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · refine ⟨p.reverse, ⟨(List.reverse_perm p).trans hp.1, (E_rev p).trans hp.2⟩,

        · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
        · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · intro z hz

        · exact Or.inr (by simpa using hz)
        · exact Or.inl (by simpa using hz)
    · exact ⟨p, hp, hx, fun _ _ h => h, fun _ h => h⟩
  have lift : ∀ (ℓ v r : ℕ) (q : List ℕ), 2 * r + 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
      (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ r → Adj q (v - 2 * j) (v - 1 - 2 * j)) →
      ∃ q' : List ℕ, (q' : Multiset ℕ) =
          (q : Multiset ℕ) + ↑(List.range' (v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r) (2 * r)) ∧
        edgeLengths q' = edgeLengths q + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) ℓ ∧
        q'.head? = q.head? ∧ q'.getLast? = q.getLast? ∧
        (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ r → Adj q' (v - 2 * j + ℓ) (v - 1 - 2 * j + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ u w, u + 2 * r + 1 < v → Adj q u w → Adj q' u w) := by
    intro ℓ v r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro q _ _ _
      exact ⟨q, by simp, by simp, rfl, rfl, fun j h1 h2 => by exfalso; omega, fun _ _ _ h => h⟩

      intro q h1 hv hpairs
      obtain ⟨q₁, hM, hE, hh, hl, hP, hF⟩ :=
        ih q (by omega) hv (fun j hj1 hj2 => hpairs j hj1 (by omega))
      have hx : Adj q₁ (v - 2 * (r + 1)) (v - 1 - 2 * (r + 1)) :=
        hF _ _ (by omega) (hpairs (r + 1) (by omega) le_rfl)
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, y, z, rfl, hyz⟩ : ∃ l₁ l₂ y z, q₁ = l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂ ∧
          ((y = v - 2 * (r + 1) ∧ z = v - 1 - 2 * (r + 1)) ∨
            (y = v - 1 - 2 * (r + 1) ∧ z = v - 2 * (r + 1))) := by
        obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := hx
        · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, _, _, h, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, _, _, h, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨iM, iE, ih', il, iA⟩ := ins ℓ l₁ l₂ y z
      have iAdj : ∀ u w, Adj (l₁ ++ y :: z :: l₂) u w →
          Adj (l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂) u w ∨
          (u = y ∧ w = z) ∨ (u = z ∧ w = y) := by
        intro u w ⟨s, t, h⟩
        rcases h with h | h
        · rcases iA u w s t h with ⟨s', t', h'⟩ | h'
          · exact Or.inl ⟨s', t', Or.inl h'⟩
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
        · rcases iA w u s t h with ⟨s', t', h'⟩ | h'
          · exact Or.inl ⟨s', t', Or.inr h'⟩
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h'.2, h'.1⟩)
      have hnew : Adj (l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂) (y + ℓ) (z + ℓ) :=
        ⟨l₁ ++ [y], z :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
      refine ⟨l₁ ++ y :: (y + ℓ) :: (z + ℓ) :: z :: l₂, ?_, ?_, ih'.trans hh, il.trans hl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [iM, hM, show 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 by ring, List.range'_succ, List.range'_succ,
          ← Multiset.cons_coe, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.add_cons, Multiset.add_cons,
          show v + ℓ - 1 - (2 * r + 1 + 1) + 1 + 1 = v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r by omega]
        rcases hyz with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · rw [show y + ℓ = v + ℓ - 1 - (2 * r + 1 + 1) + 1 by omega,
            show z + ℓ = v + ℓ - 1 - (2 * r + 1 + 1) by omega, Multiset.cons_swap]
        · rw [show z + ℓ = v + ℓ - 1 - (2 * r + 1 + 1) + 1 by omega,
            show y + ℓ = v + ℓ - 1 - (2 * r + 1 + 1) by omega]
      · rw [iE, hE, show 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 by ring, Multiset.replicate_succ,
          Multiset.replicate_succ]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · intro j hj1 hj2
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 1) with hj | hj
        · rcases iAdj _ _ (hP j hj1 (by omega)) with h | h | h
          · exact h
          · exfalso; rcases hyz with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> omega
          · exfalso; rcases hyz with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> omega
        · obtain rfl : j = r + 1 := by omega
          rcases hyz with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          · exact hnew
          · exact adj_symm _ _ _ hnew
      · intro u w hu h
        rcases iAdj _ _ (hF u w (by omega) h) with h' | h' | h'
        · exact h'
        · exfalso; rcases hyz with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> omega
        · exfalso; rcases hyz with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> omega
  have step : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 2 ≤ ℓ → ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), ℓ ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → TopEndInv ℓ v p →
      ∃ p', IsLinearRealization (v + ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ) p' ∧
      TopEndInv ℓ (v + ℓ) p' ∧ (∀ u w, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj p' u w) ∧
      (∀ x, x + ℓ < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x) := by
    intro ℓ hℓ v L p hv hp hT
    obtain ⟨hlast, hpairs, heven⟩ := hT
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hql, hA, hEn⟩ := orient v L p (v - 1) hp hlast
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, ℓ = 2 * r + 1 ∨ ℓ = 2 * r + 2 := by
      obtain ⟨n, hn | hn⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' ℓ
      · exact ⟨n - 1, Or.inr (by omega)⟩
      · exact ⟨n, Or.inl hn⟩
    obtain ⟨q₁, hM₁, hE₁, hh₁, hl₁, hP₁, hF₁⟩ := lift ℓ v r q (by omega) hv
      (fun j hj1 hj2 => hA _ _ (hpairs j hj1 (by omega)))
    have hl₁' : q₁.getLast? = some (v - 1) := hl₁.trans hql
    have hE₂ := E_snoc q₁ (v - 1) (v + ℓ - 1) hl₁'
    have hf : Int.natAbs (((v + ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
      rw [show ((v + ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ℓ : ℤ) by omega]
      exact Int.natAbs_natCast ℓ
    rw [hf, hE₁, hq.2] at hE₂
    have hperm₁ : q₁.Perm (List.range v ++ List.range' (v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r) (2 * r)) := by
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, ← Multiset.coe_add, hM₁, Multiset.coe_eq_coe.mpr hq.1]
    have hlast₂ : (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]).getLast? = some (v + ℓ - 1) := by simp
    have hpairs₂ : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ →
        Adj (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]) (v + ℓ - 2 * j) (v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * j) := by
      intro j hj1 hj2
      have h := hP₁ j hj1 (by omega)
      rw [show v + ℓ - 2 * j = v - 2 * j + ℓ by omega,
        show v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * j = v - 1 - 2 * j + ℓ by omega]
      exact adj_app _ _ _ _ h
    have hfar₂ : ∀ u w, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]) u w :=
      fun u w hu _ h => adj_app _ _ _ _ (hF₁ u w (by omega) (hA u w h))
    rcases hr with hr | hr
    · refine ⟨q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨Or.inr hlast₂, hpairs₂, ?_⟩, hfar₂, ?_⟩
      · show (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]).Perm (List.range (v + ℓ))
        have e : List.range v ++ List.range' (v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r) (2 * r) ++ [v + ℓ - 1] =
            List.range (v + ℓ) := by
          rw [show v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r = v by omega, List.append_assoc,
            show v + ℓ - 1 = v + 1 * (2 * r) by omega, ← List.range'_concat, hrange,
            show v + (2 * r + 1) = v + ℓ by omega]
        rw [← e]
        exact hperm₁.append_right _
      · rw [hE₂, add_assoc, ← Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
          show 2 * r + 1 = ℓ by omega]
      · intro he
        rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
        omega
      · intro x hx h
        rcases hEn x h with h' | h'
        · left
          simp [List.head?_append, hh₁, h']
        · exfalso
          rw [hql] at h'
          simp at h'
          omega
    · have hhead : q.head? = some (v - ℓ) := by
        rcases hEn _ (heven ⟨r + 1, by omega⟩) with h | h
        · exact h
        · rw [hql] at h
          simp at h
          omega
      have hh₂ : (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]).head? = some (v - ℓ) := by
        simp [List.head?_append, hh₁, hhead]
      have hE₃ := E_cons_head _ _ v hh₂
      have hf' : Int.natAbs (((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
        rw [show ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ) = -(ℓ : ℤ) by omega, Int.natAbs_neg]
        exact Int.natAbs_natCast ℓ
      rw [hf', hE₂] at hE₃
      refine ⟨v :: (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1]), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨Or.inr ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (v :: (q₁ ++ [v + ℓ - 1])).Perm (List.range (v + ℓ))
        have e : List.range v ++ (v :: (List.range' (v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r) (2 * r) ++ [v + ℓ - 1])) =
            List.range (v + ℓ) := by
          rw [show v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * r = v + 1 by omega,
            show v + ℓ - 1 = v + 1 + 1 * (2 * r) by omega, ← List.range'_concat,
            ← List.range'_succ, hrange, show v + (2 * r + 1 + 1) = v + ℓ by omega]
        rw [← e]
        refine ((hperm₁.append_right _).cons v).trans ?_
        rw [List.append_assoc]
        exact List.perm_middle.symm
      · rw [hE₃, show Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ = Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 1 + 1) ℓ by
          rw [show 2 * r + 1 + 1 = ℓ by omega], Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.replicate_succ]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · rw [← List.cons_append, List.getLast?_append]
        rfl
      · intro j hj1 hj2
        exact adj_cons _ _ _ _ (hpairs₂ j hj1 hj2)
      · intro _
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        exact Or.inl rfl
      · intro u w hu hw h
        exact adj_cons _ _ _ _ (hfar₂ u w hu hw h)
      · intro x hx h
        exfalso
        rcases hEn x h with h' | h'
        · rw [hhead] at h'
          simp at h'
          omega
        · rw [hql] at h'
          simp at h'
          omega
  intro ℓ v t L p hℓ hv hp hT
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, by simpa using hT, fun _ _ _ _ h => h, fun _ _ h => h⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hT₁, hA₁, hE₁⟩ := ih
    have hvn : ℓ ≤ v + n * ℓ := le_trans hv (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hT₂, hA₂, hE₂⟩ := step ℓ hℓ (v + n * ℓ) _ p₁ hvn hp₁ hT₁
    have e1 : v + (n + 1) * ℓ = v + n * ℓ + ℓ := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, add_assoc]
    have e2 : L + Multiset.replicate ((n + 1) * ℓ) ℓ =
        L + Multiset.replicate (n * ℓ) ℓ + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ := by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul, Multiset.replicate_add, add_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
    refine ⟨p₂, hp₂, hT₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u w hu hw h
      exact hA₂ u w (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hw (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (hA₁ u w hu hw h)
    · intro x hx h
      exact hE₂ x (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (hE₁ x hx h)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → TopPairInv ℓ v p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      TopPairInv ℓ (v + t * ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj p' u w) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

signature.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →

    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      TopPairInv ℓ (v + t * ℓ) p' ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ v t L p h2 hv hp hT
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
      (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  
  have hs1base : ∀ (l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ),
      edgeLengths (x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (x :: x' :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
    intro l₂ x x'
    rw [hU, hU, hU, hU]
    have a1 : Int.natAbs (((x + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    have a2 : Int.natAbs (((x' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((x + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        Int.natAbs ((x' : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) := by omega
    have a3 : Int.natAbs ((x' : ℤ) - ((x' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    rw [a1, a2, a3]
    rw [show Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ = ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0 from rfl, Multiset.cons_add,
      Multiset.add_cons, Multiset.add_cons, add_zero, Multiset.cons_swap ℓ (Int.natAbs _)]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ),
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x'
    induction l₁ with
    | nil => exact hs1base l₂ x x'
    | cons c l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c x, hU c x, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons d l' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c d, hU c d, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have hO : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ),
      m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ = l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂ → ¬(u = x ∧ w = x') →
      ∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂ := by
    intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w h hne
    rw [List.append_eq_append_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨as, rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨bs, rfl, h2⟩
    · rcases as with _ | ⟨a₁, _ | ⟨a₂, as'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact absurd ⟨h2.1, h2.2.1⟩ hne
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨m₁, a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨m₁, as' ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
    · rcases bs with _ | ⟨b₁, _ | ⟨b₂, bs'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact absurd ⟨h2.1.symm, h2.2.1.symm⟩ hne
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨l₁ ++ [x, a, b], m₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: bs', m₂, by simp⟩
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) u w →
      ¬ (u = x ∧ w = x') → ¬ (u = x' ∧ w = x) → Adj (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) u w := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x' a b u w hA h1 h2
    obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := hA
    · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w hm.symm h1
      exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
    · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b w u hm.symm (fun h => h2 ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
  
  have hs3 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b z : ℕ), IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) z →
      IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) z := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x' a b z h
    have e1 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).head? := by
      cases l₁ <;> simp
    have e2 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).getLast? := by
      simp only [List.getLast?_append_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
    unfold IsEnd at *
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact h
  
  have hs4 : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), Adj q x x' → ∃ q' : List ℕ,
      q'.Perm ((x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: q) ∧
      edgeLengths q' = edgeLengths q + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      Adj q' (x + ℓ) (x' + ℓ) ∧
      (∀ u w, Adj q u w → ¬(u = x ∧ w = x') → ¬(u = x' ∧ w = x) → Adj q' u w) ∧
      (∀ z, IsEnd q z → IsEnd q' z) := by
    intro q x x' hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · refine ⟨l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ x x',
        ⟨l₁ ++ [x], x' :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩,
        fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ x x' _ _ u w h1 h2 h3,
        fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ x x' _ _ z hz⟩
      have e : l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂ =
          (l₁ ++ [x]) ++ (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂ := by simp
      have e' : l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [x]) ++ x' :: l₂ := by simp
      rw [e, e']
      exact List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)
    · refine ⟨l₁ ++ x' :: (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ x' x,
        ⟨l₁ ++ [x'], x :: l₂, Or.inr (by simp)⟩,
        fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ x' x _ _ u w h1 h3 h2,
        fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ x' x _ _ z hz⟩
      have e : l₁ ++ x' :: (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂ =
          (l₁ ++ [x']) ++ (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂ := by simp
      have e' : l₁ ++ x' :: x :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [x']) ++ x :: l₂ := by simp
      rw [e, e']
      exact (List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)).trans
        (List.Perm.swap _ _ _)
  
  have row : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p →
      TopPairInv ℓ v p → ∃ q, IsLinearRealization (v + ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ) q ∧
      TopPairInv ℓ (v + ℓ) q ∧ (∀ u w, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj q u w) ∧
      (∀ z, IsEnd p z → IsEnd q z) := by
    intro v L p hv hp hT
    unfold IsLinearRealization IsVertexPerm at hp
    unfold TopPairInv at hT
    unfold IsLinearRealization IsVertexPerm TopPairInv
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hT.1
    have key : ∀ i, i ≤ h → ∃ q : List ℕ, q.Nodup ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ q ↔ (z < v ∨ (v + ℓ - 2 * i ≤ z ∧ z < v + ℓ))) ∧
        edgeLengths q = L + Multiset.replicate (2 * i) ℓ ∧
        (∀ j, i ≤ j → j < h → Adj q (v - 1 - 2 * j) (v - 2 - 2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ j, j < i → Adj q (v - 1 - 2 * j + ℓ) (v - 2 - 2 * j + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ u w, u + ℓ < v → w + ℓ < v → Adj p u w → Adj q u w) ∧
        (∀ z, IsEnd p z → IsEnd q z) := by
      intro i
      induction i with
      | zero =>
        intro _
        refine ⟨p, hp.1.nodup_iff.mpr List.nodup_range, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
          fun u w _ _ h => h, fun z h => h⟩
        · intro z
          rw [hp.1.mem_iff, List.mem_range]
          omega
        · rw [hp.2]
          simp
        · intro j _ hj
          exact hT.2 j (by omega)
        · intro j hj
          omega
      | succ i ih =>
        intro hi
        obtain ⟨q, hN, hM, hE, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := ih (by omega)
        obtain ⟨q', hP, hE', hc, hd, he⟩ :=
          hs4 q (v - 1 - 2 * i) (v - 2 - 2 * i) (h3 i le_rfl (by omega))
        refine ⟨q', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hP.nodup_iff, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, hN⟩
          · simp only [List.mem_cons, hM]
            omega
          · rw [hM]
            omega
        · intro z
          rw [hP.mem_iff, List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons, hM]
          omega
        · rw [hE', hE, add_assoc, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
            show 2 * i + 2 = 2 * (i + 1) by ring]
        · intro j hj1 hj2
          exact hd _ _ (h3 j (by omega) hj2) (by omega) (by omega)
        · intro j hj
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj | rfl
          · exact hd _ _ (h4 j hj) (by omega) (by omega)
          · exact hc
        · intro u w hu hw hA
          exact hd _ _ (h5 u w hu hw hA) (by omega) (by omega)
        · intro z hz
          exact he z (h6 z hz)
    obtain ⟨q, hN, hM, hE, -, h4, h5, h6⟩ := key h le_rfl
    refine ⟨q, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨hT.1, ?_⟩, h5, h6⟩
    · exact (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hN List.nodup_range).mpr
        (fun z => by rw [hM, List.mem_range]; omega)
    · rw [hE, show 2 * h = ℓ by omega]
    · intro j hj
      have := h4 j (by omega)
      rw [show v - 1 - 2 * j + ℓ = v + ℓ - 1 - 2 * j by omega,
        show v - 2 - 2 * j + ℓ = v + ℓ - 2 - 2 * j by omega] at this
      exact this
  
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨p, by simpa using hp, by simpa using hT, fun _ _ _ _ h => h, fun _ _ h => h⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hT₁, hA₁, hE₁⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hT₂, hA₂, hE₂⟩ :=
      row (v + t * ℓ) _ p₁ (le_trans hv (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) hp₁ hT₁
    have e1 : v + (t + 1) * ℓ = v + t * ℓ + ℓ := by ring
    have e2 : L + Multiset.replicate ((t + 1) * ℓ) ℓ =
        L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ := by
      rw [add_assoc, ← Multiset.replicate_add, add_one_mul]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact ⟨p₂, hp₂, hT₂,
      fun u w hu hw hA => hA₂ u w (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hw (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (hA₁ u w hu hw hA),
      fun x hx h => hE₂ x (hE₁ x hx h)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ v t L p hℓ hv hp hB
  
  have elcons : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (s : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: y :: s) =
      Int.natAbs ((y : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (y :: s) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have elsingle : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  
  have elsplit : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a : ℕ) (s : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (l ++ a :: s) = edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + edgeLengths (a :: s) := by
    intro l a s
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [elsingle]
    | cons x l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
        rw [elcons, elcons, elsingle, Multiset.cons_add, zero_add]
      | cons y l' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [elcons, elcons, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  have natAbs_symm : ∀ a b : ℕ, Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) = Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by
    intro a b
    rw [← Int.natAbs_neg, neg_sub]
  
  have elrev : ∀ p : List ℕ, edgeLengths p.reverse = edgeLengths p := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x s ih =>
      cases s with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons y s' =>
        have e : (x :: y :: s').reverse = s'.reverse ++ y :: [x] := by simp
        rw [e, elsplit, elcons]
        have e2 : s'.reverse ++ [y] = (y :: s').reverse := by simp
        rw [e2, ih, elcons, elsingle, natAbs_symm x y, Multiset.cons_zero,
          ← Multiset.singleton_add, add_comm]
  
  have shift : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p : List ℕ), edgeLengths (p.map (· + s)) = edgeLengths p ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (· + s)) (u + s) (w + s)) := by
    intro s p
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · induction p with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x t ih =>
        cases t with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons y s' =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [elcons, ih, elcons]
          congr 2
          push_cast
          ring
    · rintro u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + s), l₂.map (· + s), Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + s), l₂.map (· + s), Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
  
  have orient : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
      BotEndInv ℓ p → ∃ p₀ : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization v L p₀ ∧ BotEndInv ℓ p₀ ∧
        p₀.head? = some 0 ∧ (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj p₀ u w) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p₀ x) := by
    intro v L p hp hB
    rcases hB.1 with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨p, hp, hB, h0, fun _ _ h => h, fun _ h => h⟩
    · have hA : ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj p.reverse u w := by
        rintro u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
        · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
        · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      have hE : ∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p.reverse x := by
        intro x hx
        unfold IsEnd at hx ⊢
        rw [List.head?_reverse, List.getLast?_reverse]
        exact hx.symm
      refine ⟨p.reverse, ⟨(List.reverse_perm p).trans hp.1, by rw [elrev]; exact hp.2⟩,
        ⟨hE 0 hB.1, fun j h1 h2 => hA _ _ (hB.2.1 j h1 h2), fun he => hE _ (hB.2.2 he)⟩,
        by rw [List.head?_reverse]; exact h0, hA, hE⟩
  
  have natd : ∀ x y k : ℕ, x = y + k →
      Int.natAbs ((x : ℤ) - (y : ℤ)) = k ∧ Int.natAbs ((y : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) = k := by
    intro x y k h
    subst h
    constructor <;> simp
  
  have blockC : ∀ (a b c d x y : ℕ) (l₂ m₂ l₁ m₁ : List ℕ),
      l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ = m₁ ++ x :: y :: m₂ → ¬ (x = a ∧ y = b) →
      ∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂ = n₁ ++ x :: y :: n₂ := by
    intro a b c d x y l₂ m₂ l₁
    induction l₁ with
    | nil =>
      intro m₁ h hne
      cases m₁ with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        exact absurd ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm⟩ hne
      | cons z m₁' =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        exact ⟨a :: c :: d :: m₁', m₂, by simp [h.2]⟩
    | cons z l₁' ih =>
      intro m₁ h hne
      cases m₁ with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨hz, h⟩ := h
        cases l₁' with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          exact ⟨[], c :: d :: b :: l₂, by simp [hz, h.1]⟩
        | cons h' l₁'' =>
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          exact ⟨[], l₁'' ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂, by simp [hz, h.1]⟩
      | cons z' m₁' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := ih m₁' h.2 hne
        exact ⟨z :: n₁, n₂, by rw [List.cons_append, hn, List.cons_append]⟩
  
  have block : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b c d : ℕ),
      Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = 1 → Int.natAbs ((c : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = ℓ →
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = 1 → Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (d : ℤ)) = ℓ →
      (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂).Perm ((l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) ++ [c, d]) ∧
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) + (ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0) ∧
      (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂).head? ∧
      (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂).getLast? ∧
      Adj (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂) c d ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u ≠ a → u ≠ b → Adj (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) u w →
        Adj (l₁ ++ a :: c :: d :: b :: l₂) u w) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ a b c d h1 h2 h3 h4
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.append_assoc]
      apply List.Perm.append_left
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      apply List.Perm.cons
      exact (List.perm_append_comm : List.Perm ([c, d] ++ (b :: l₂)) ((b :: l₂) ++ [c, d]))
    · rw [elsplit l₁ a (c :: d :: b :: l₂), elsplit l₁ a (b :: l₂), elcons, elcons, elcons,
        elcons, h1, h2, h3, h4]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · cases l₁ <;> rfl
    · simp [List.getLast?_append, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
    · exact ⟨l₁ ++ [a], b :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · rintro u w hua hub ⟨m₁, m₂, h | h⟩
      · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := blockC a b c d u w l₂ m₂ l₁ m₁ h (fun hh => hua hh.1)
        exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
      · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := blockC a b c d w u l₂ m₂ l₁ m₁ h (fun hh => hub hh.2)
        exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
  
  have insPairs : ∀ (q : List ℕ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ → Adj q (2 * j - 1 + ℓ) (2 * j + ℓ)) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ (ℓ - 1) / 2 → ∃ r : List ℕ,
        r.Perm (q ++ (List.range (2 * n)).map (· + 1)) ∧
        edgeLengths r = edgeLengths q + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) ℓ ∧
        r.head? = q.head? ∧ r.getLast? = q.getLast? ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → Adj r (2 * j - 1) (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, n < j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ → Adj r (2 * j - 1 + ℓ) (2 * j + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, 2 * ℓ ≤ u → Adj q u w → Adj r u w) := by
    intro q hq n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      refine ⟨q, by simp, by simp, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, fun _ _ _ h => h⟩
      · intro j h1 h2; omega
      · intro j _ h2; exact hq j (by omega) h2
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨r, P1, P2, P3, P3', P4, P5, P6⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hA := P5 (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) - 1 + ℓ = 2 * n + 1 + ℓ by omega,
        show 2 * (n + 1) + ℓ = 2 * n + 2 + ℓ by omega] at hA
      have hstep : ∃ r' : List ℕ, r'.Perm (r ++ [2 * n + 1, 2 * n + 2]) ∧
          edgeLengths r' = edgeLengths r + (ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0) ∧
          r'.head? = r.head? ∧ r'.getLast? = r.getLast? ∧ Adj r' (2 * n + 1) (2 * n + 2) ∧
          (∀ u w : ℕ, u ≠ 2 * n + 1 + ℓ → u ≠ 2 * n + 2 + ℓ → Adj r u w → Adj r' u w) := by
        obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := hA
        · obtain ⟨Q1, Q2, Q3, Q3', Q4, Q5⟩ :=
            block l₁ l₂ (2 * n + 1 + ℓ) (2 * n + 2 + ℓ) (2 * n + 1) (2 * n + 2)
              (natd _ _ 1 (by omega)).1 (natd _ _ ℓ (by omega)).2
              (natd _ _ 1 (by omega)).1 (natd _ _ ℓ (by omega)).1
          rw [← h] at Q1 Q2 Q3 Q3' Q5
          exact ⟨_, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q3', Q4, Q5⟩
        · obtain ⟨Q1, Q2, Q3, Q3', Q4, Q5⟩ :=
            block l₁ l₂ (2 * n + 2 + ℓ) (2 * n + 1 + ℓ) (2 * n + 2) (2 * n + 1)
              (natd _ _ 1 (by omega)).2 (natd _ _ ℓ (by omega)).2
              (natd _ _ 1 (by omega)).2 (natd _ _ ℓ (by omega)).1
          rw [← h] at Q1 Q2 Q3 Q3' Q5
          refine ⟨_, Q1.trans (List.Perm.append_left r (List.Perm.swap _ _ _)), Q2, Q3, Q3', ?_,
            fun u w h1 h2 hA => Q5 u w h2 h1 hA⟩
          obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := Q4
          · exact ⟨m₁, m₂, Or.inr hm⟩
          · exact ⟨m₁, m₂, Or.inl hm⟩
      obtain ⟨r', Q1, Q2, Q3, Q3', Q4, Q5⟩ := hstep
      have hrange : (List.range (2 * (n + 1))).map (· + 1) =
          (List.range (2 * n)).map (· + 1) ++ [2 * n + 1, 2 * n + 2] := by
        rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
        simp
      refine ⟨r', ?_, ?_, Q3.trans P3, Q3'.trans P3', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hrange, ← List.append_assoc]
        exact Q1.trans (P1.append_right _)
      · rw [Q2, P2, show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring, Multiset.replicate_succ,
          Multiset.replicate_succ]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · intro j h1 h2
        by_cases hj : j ≤ n
        · exact Q5 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (P4 j h1 hj)
        · have hj' : j = n + 1 := by omega
          subst hj'
          rw [show 2 * (n + 1) - 1 = 2 * n + 1 by omega, show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by omega]
          exact Q4
      · intro j h1 h2
        exact Q5 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (P5 j (by omega) h2)
      · intro u w hu hA
        exact Q5 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (P6 u w hu hA)
  
  have hEL0 : ∀ X : List ℕ, X.head? = some ℓ → edgeLengths (0 :: X) = ℓ ::ₘ edgeLengths X := by
    intro X hX
    cases X with
    | nil => simp at hX
    | cons z X' =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hX
      rw [elcons, hX]
      simp
  have lift0 : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), Adj X a b → Adj (0 :: X) a b := by
    rintro X a b ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨0 :: l₁, l₂, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    · exact ⟨0 :: l₁, l₂, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
  have lift1 : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (a b c : ℕ), Adj X a b → Adj (0 :: (X ++ [c])) a b := by
    rintro X a b c ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨0 :: l₁, l₂ ++ [c], Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    · exact ⟨0 :: l₁, l₂ ++ [c], Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
  
  have step : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p →
      BotEndInv ℓ p →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ) p' ∧
        BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + ℓ) (w + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + ℓ)) := by
    intro v L p hv hp hB
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hB₀, hh₀, hA₀, hE₀⟩ := orient v L p hp hB
    have hsh := shift ℓ p₀
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4, hr5, -, hr6⟩ := insPairs (p₀.map (· + ℓ)) (by
      intro j hj1 hj2
      exact hsh.2 _ _ (hB₀.2.1 j hj1 hj2)) ((ℓ - 1) / 2) le_rfl
    have hr2' : edgeLengths r = L + Multiset.replicate (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2)) ℓ := by
      rw [hr2, hsh.1, hp₀.2]
    have hr3' : r.head? = some ℓ := by rw [hr3, List.head?_map, hh₀]; simp
    have hr4' : ∀ x : ℕ, p₀.getLast? = some x → r.getLast? = some (x + ℓ) := by
      intro x hx; rw [hr4, List.getLast?_map, hx]; simp
    have hr5' : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ → Adj r (2 * j - 1) (2 * j) :=
      fun j h1 h2 => hr5 j h1 (by omega)
    have hfar : ∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p₀ u w → Adj r (u + ℓ) (w + ℓ) :=
      fun u w hu _ hA => hr6 _ _ (by omega) (hsh.2 _ _ hA)
    have hfun : (fun x : ℕ => x + ℓ) = (fun x => ℓ + x) := funext fun x => add_comm x ℓ
    have hM : (p₀.map (· + ℓ)).Perm ((List.range v).map (ℓ + ·)) := by
      rw [← hfun]; exact hp₀.1.map _
    have hrangeV : List.range (v + ℓ) = List.range ℓ ++ (List.range v).map (ℓ + ·) := by
      rw [add_comm, List.range_add]
    have h0S : List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1) =
        0 :: (List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2))).map (· + 1) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
    suffices H : ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ) p' ∧
        BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p₀ u w → Adj p' (u + ℓ) (w + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p₀ x → IsEnd p' (x + ℓ)) by
      obtain ⟨p', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := H
      exact ⟨p', h1, h2, fun u w hu hw hA => h3 u w hu hw (hA₀ u w hA),
        fun x hx hE => h4 x hx (hE₀ x hE)⟩
    by_cases he : Even ℓ
    · have hJ : 2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 2 = ℓ := by rw [Nat.even_iff] at he; omega
      have hlast0 : p₀.getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) := by
        rcases hB₀.2.2 he with h | h
        · rw [hh₀] at h; simp at h; omega
        · exact h
      have hlastr := hr4' _ hlast0
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ : ∃ r₀, r = r₀ ++ [ℓ - 1 + ℓ] := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp hlastr
      have hR : List.range ℓ =
          0 :: ((List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2))).map (· + 1) ++ [ℓ - 1]) := by
        have e : List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 + 1) =
            List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1) ++ [2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1] := List.range_succ
        rw [show 2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 + 1 = ℓ by omega, h0S,
          show 2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 = ℓ - 1 by omega] at e
        rw [e]; rfl
      have hELr : edgeLengths (r ++ [ℓ - 1]) = edgeLengths r + {ℓ} := by
        rw [hr₀, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, elsplit r₀ (ℓ - 1 + ℓ) [ℓ - 1],
          elcons, elsingle, (natd (ℓ - 1 + ℓ) (ℓ - 1) ℓ (by omega)).2]
        rfl
      have hlastp : (0 :: (r ++ [ℓ - 1])).getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) := by
        rw [← List.cons_append, List.getLast?_append]
        simp
      refine ⟨0 :: (r ++ [ℓ - 1]), ⟨?_, ?_⟩,
        ⟨Or.inl rfl, fun j h1 h2 => lift1 _ _ _ _ (hr5' j h1 h2), fun _ => Or.inr hlastp⟩,
        fun u w hu hw hA => lift1 _ _ _ _ (hfar u w hu hw hA), ?_⟩
      · unfold IsVertexPerm
        rw [hrangeV, hR, List.cons_append]
        apply List.Perm.cons
        have h1 := hr1.append_right [ℓ - 1]
        rw [List.append_assoc] at h1
        exact h1.trans (List.perm_append_comm.trans (hM.append_left _))
      · rw [hEL0 _ (by simp [hr3']), hELr, hr2']
        rw [show Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ = Multiset.replicate (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 + 1) ℓ by
          rw [show 2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 + 1 = ℓ by omega], Multiset.replicate_succ,
          Multiset.replicate_succ]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · intro x hx hE
        exfalso
        rcases hE with h | h
        · rw [hh₀] at h; simp at h; omega
        · rw [hlast0] at h; simp at h; omega
    · have hJ : 2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1 = ℓ := by rw [Nat.even_iff] at he; omega
      have hR : List.range ℓ = 0 :: (List.range (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2))).map (· + 1) := by
        rw [← h0S, hJ]
      refine ⟨0 :: r, ⟨?_, ?_⟩,
        ⟨Or.inl rfl, fun j h1 h2 => lift0 _ _ _ (hr5' j h1 h2), fun h => absurd h he⟩,
        fun u w hu hw hA => lift0 _ _ _ (hfar u w hu hw hA), ?_⟩
      · unfold IsVertexPerm
        rw [hrangeV, hR, List.cons_append]
        apply List.Perm.cons
        exact hr1.trans (List.perm_append_comm.trans (hM.append_left _))
      · rw [hEL0 _ hr3', hr2']
        rw [show Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ = Multiset.replicate (2 * ((ℓ - 1) / 2) + 1) ℓ by
          rw [hJ], Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.add_cons]
      · intro x hx hE
        rcases hE with h | h
        · exfalso; rw [hh₀] at h; simp at h; omega
        · right
          have h' := hr4' x h
          cases r with
          | nil => simp at h'
          | cons z r₁ =>
            rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]
            exact h'
  
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨p, by simpa using hp, hB, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u w _ _ hA; simpa using hA
    · intro x _ hE; simpa using hE
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨pt, hpt, hBt, hAt, hEt⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨p', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := step _ _ pt (by omega) hpt hBt
    refine ⟨p', ?_, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : v + (t + 1) * ℓ = v + t * ℓ + ℓ := by ring
      have e2 : L + Multiset.replicate ((t + 1) * ℓ) ℓ =
          L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ := by
        rw [add_mul, one_mul, Multiset.replicate_add, add_assoc]
      rw [e1, e2]; exact h1
    · intro u w hu hw hA
      have h := h3 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hAt u w hu hw hA)
      rwa [show u + t * ℓ + ℓ = u + (t + 1) * ℓ by ring,
        show w + t * ℓ + ℓ = w + (t + 1) * ℓ by ring] at h
    · intro x hx hE
      have h := h4 _ (by omega) (hEt x hx hE)
      rwa [show x + t * ℓ + ℓ = x + (t + 1) * ℓ by ring] at h

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotPairInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotPairInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (m : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: m) =
      Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: m) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  
  have hJ : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (m : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (l ++ x :: m) = edgeLengths (l ++ [x]) + edgeLengths (x :: m) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro x m; simp [edgeLengths]
    | cons a l ih =>
      intro x m
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        show edgeLengths (a :: x :: m) = edgeLengths [a, x] + edgeLengths (x :: m)
        simp [edgeLengths]
      | cons b l =>
        have := ih x m
        simp only [List.cons_append] at this ⊢
        rw [hC, hC, this, Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have hP : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (X Y A B u w : ℕ),
      l₁ ++ X :: Y :: l₂ = m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ → ¬(u = X ∧ w = Y) →
      ∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂ := by
    intro l₁
    induction l₁ with
    | nil =>
      intro l₂ m₁ m₂ X Y A B u w h hne
      rcases m₁ with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, m⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        exact absurd ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm⟩ hne
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        exact ⟨[X, A, B], m₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        exact ⟨X :: A :: B :: Y :: m, m₂, by simp⟩
    | cons a l ih =>
      intro l₂ m₁ m₂ X Y A B u w h hne
      rcases m₁ with _ | ⟨b, m⟩
      · rcases l with _ | ⟨b, l'⟩
        · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
          exact ⟨[], A :: B :: Y :: l₂, by simp⟩
        · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
          exact ⟨[], l' ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, h⟩ := h
        obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := ih l₂ m m₂ X Y A B u w h hne
        exact ⟨a :: n₁, n₂, by simp [hn]⟩
  
  have hEndIns : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (X Y A B x : ℕ), IsEnd (l₁ ++ X :: Y :: l₂) x →
      IsEnd (l₁ ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂) x := by
    intro l₁ l₂ X Y A B x h
    have hhead : (l₁ ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ X :: Y :: l₂).head? := by
      cases l₁ <;> simp
    have hlast : (l₁ ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ X :: Y :: l₂).getLast? := by
      rw [show l₁ ++ X :: A :: B :: Y :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [X, A, B]) ++ (Y :: l₂) by simp,
        show l₁ ++ X :: Y :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [X]) ++ (Y :: l₂) by simp,
        List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ (List.cons_ne_nil _ _),
        List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)]
    unfold IsEnd at h ⊢
    rw [hhead, hlast]
    exact h
  have hrep : ∀ d : ℕ, Multiset.replicate 2 d = {d} + {d} := by
    intro d
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Multiset.replicate_add, Multiset.replicate_one]
  
  have hIns : ∀ (r : List ℕ) (c d : ℕ), Adj r (c + d) (c + 1 + d) →
      ∃ r' : List ℕ, (r' : Multiset ℕ) = c ::ₘ (c + 1) ::ₘ (r : Multiset ℕ) ∧
        edgeLengths r' = edgeLengths r + Multiset.replicate 2 d ∧
        Adj r' c (c + 1) ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj r u w → (u < c + d ∨ c + 1 + d < u) → Adj r' u w) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd r x → IsEnd r' x) := by
    rintro r c d ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ <;> subst h
    · refine ⟨l₁ ++ (c + d) :: c :: (c + 1) :: (c + 1 + d) :: l₂, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · have k1 : Int.natAbs (((c : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + d : ℕ) : ℤ)) = d := by omega
        have k2 : Int.natAbs (((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
        have k3 : Int.natAbs (((c + 1 + d : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = d := by omega
        have k4 : Int.natAbs (((c + 1 + d : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + d : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
        rw [hJ l₁ (c + d) (c :: (c + 1) :: (c + 1 + d) :: l₂), hJ l₁ (c + d) ((c + 1 + d) :: l₂),
          hC, hC, hC, hC, k1, k2, k3, k4, hrep]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · exact ⟨l₁ ++ [c + d], (c + 1 + d) :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
      · rintro u w ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ hu
        · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hP l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ (c + d) (c + 1 + d) c (c + 1) u w hm (by omega)
          exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
        · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hP l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ (c + d) (c + 1 + d) c (c + 1) w u hm (by omega)
          exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact hEndIns l₁ l₂ _ _ _ _ x hx
    · refine ⟨l₁ ++ (c + 1 + d) :: (c + 1) :: c :: (c + d) :: l₂, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · have k1 : Int.natAbs (((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + 1 + d : ℕ) : ℤ)) = d := by omega
        have k2 : Int.natAbs (((c : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
        have k3 : Int.natAbs (((c + d : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c : ℕ) : ℤ)) = d := by omega
        have k4 : Int.natAbs (((c + d : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c + 1 + d : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
        rw [hJ l₁ (c + 1 + d) ((c + 1) :: c :: (c + d) :: l₂), hJ l₁ (c + 1 + d) ((c + d) :: l₂),
          hC, hC, hC, hC, k1, k2, k3, k4, hrep]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · exact ⟨l₁ ++ [c + 1 + d], (c + d) :: l₂, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
      · rintro u w ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ hu
        · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hP l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ (c + 1 + d) (c + d) (c + 1) c u w hm (by omega)
          exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
        · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hP l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ (c + 1 + d) (c + d) (c + 1) c w u hm (by omega)
          exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact hEndIns l₁ l₂ _ _ _ _ x hx
  
  have hShift : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (s : ℕ),
      edgeLengths (p.map (· + s)) = edgeLengths p ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (· + s)) (u + s) (w + s)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (· + s)) (x + s)) := by
    intro p s
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · induction p with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a m ih =>
        cases m with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons b m =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [hC, hC, ih]
          congr 1
          omega
    · rintro u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + s), l₂.map (· + s), Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + s), l₂.map (· + s), Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
    · rintro x (h | h)
      · left; simp [List.head?_map, h]
      · right; simp [List.getLast?_map, h]
  intro ℓ v t L p _ _ hp hbp
  
  have hFill : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), (∀ j : ℕ, j < n → Adj r (2 * j + ℓ) (2 * j + 1 + ℓ)) →
      ∃ r' : List ℕ, (r' : Multiset ℕ) = Multiset.range (2 * n) + (r : Multiset ℕ) ∧
        edgeLengths r' = edgeLengths r + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) ℓ ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, j < n → Adj r' (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, 2 * n + ℓ ≤ u → Adj r u w → Adj r' u w) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd r x → IsEnd r' x) := by
    intro n r
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      exact ⟨r, by simp, by simp, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
        fun _ _ _ h => h, fun _ h => h⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro H
      obtain ⟨r₁, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih (fun j hj => H j (by omega))
      obtain ⟨r₂, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5⟩ := hIns r₁ (2 * n) ℓ (h4 _ _ le_rfl (H n (by omega)))
      refine ⟨r₂, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [g1, h1, show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring, Multiset.range_succ,
          Multiset.range_succ]
        simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · rw [g2, h2, show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by ring, Multiset.replicate_add, add_assoc]
      · intro j hj
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj | rfl
        · exact g4 _ _ (h3 j hj) (Or.inl (by omega))
        · exact g3
      · intro u w hu h
        exact g4 _ _ (h4 u w (by omega) h) (Or.inr (by omega))
      · intro x h
        exact g5 x (h5 x h)
  
  have step : ∀ (V : ℕ) (M : Multiset ℕ) (q : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization V M q →
      BotPairInv ℓ q → ∃ q' : List ℕ,
        IsLinearRealization (V + ℓ) (M + Multiset.replicate ℓ ℓ) q' ∧ BotPairInv ℓ q' ∧
        (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj q u w → Adj q' (u + ℓ) (w + ℓ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd q x → IsEnd q' (x + ℓ)) := by
    rintro V M q ⟨hperm, hlen⟩ ⟨hev, hpair⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hev
    have hn' : ℓ = 2 * n := by omega
    obtain ⟨hE, hA, hEnd⟩ := hShift q ℓ
    obtain ⟨r', h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ :=
      hFill n (q.map (· + ℓ)) (fun j hj => hA _ _ (hpair j (by omega)))
    refine ⟨r', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, fun j hj => h3 j (by omega)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold IsVertexPerm
      have e1 : r'.Perm (List.range (2 * n) ++ q.map (· + ℓ)) := by
        rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h1, ← Multiset.coe_add, Multiset.coe_range]
      refine e1.trans ?_
      rw [← hn', add_comm V ℓ, List.range_add]
      refine List.Perm.append_left _ ?_
      have hf : (fun x => ℓ + x) = (· + ℓ) := funext fun x => add_comm ℓ x
      rw [hf]
      exact List.Perm.map _ hperm
    · rw [h2, hE, hlen, ← hn']
    · intro u w hu _ h
      exact h4 _ _ (by omega) (hA u w h)
    · intro x _ h
      exact h5 _ (hEnd x h)
  
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, hbp, fun u w _ _ h => by simpa using h,
      fun x _ h => by simpa using h⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hbp₁, hA₁, hE₁⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hbp₂, hA₂, hE₂⟩ := step _ _ p₁ hp₁ hbp₁
    have e : (t + 1) * ℓ = t * ℓ + ℓ := by ring
    refine ⟨p₂, ?_, hbp₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e, Multiset.replicate_add, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc]
      exact hp₂
    · intro u w hu hw h
      have := hA₂ _ _ (le_trans hu (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (le_trans hw (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
        (hA₁ u w hu hw h)
      rw [e, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc]
      exact this
    · intro x hx h
      have := hE₂ _ (le_trans hx (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (hE₁ x hx h)
      rw [e, ← add_assoc]
      exact this

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ v t L p h2 hv h2t hp hpairs
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
      (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  
  have hs1base : ∀ (l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ),
      edgeLengths (x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (x :: x' :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
    intro l₂ x x'
    rw [hU, hU, hU, hU]
    have a1 : Int.natAbs (((x + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    have a2 : Int.natAbs (((x' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((x + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        Int.natAbs ((x' : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) := by omega
    have a3 : Int.natAbs ((x' : ℤ) - ((x' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    rw [a1, a2, a3]
    rw [show Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ = ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0 from rfl, Multiset.cons_add,
      Multiset.add_cons, Multiset.add_cons, add_zero, Multiset.cons_swap ℓ (Int.natAbs _)]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ),
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂) =
        edgeLengths (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x'
    induction l₁ with
    | nil => exact hs1base l₂ x x'
    | cons c l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c x, hU c x, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons d l' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c d, hU c d, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have hO : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ),
      m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ = l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂ → ¬(u = x ∧ w = x') →
      ∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂ := by
    intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w h hne
    rw [List.append_eq_append_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨as, rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨bs, rfl, h2⟩
    · rcases as with _ | ⟨a₁, _ | ⟨a₂, as'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact absurd ⟨h2.1, h2.2.1⟩ hne
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨m₁, a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨m₁, as' ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
    · rcases bs with _ | ⟨b₁, _ | ⟨b₂, bs'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact absurd ⟨h2.1.symm, h2.2.1.symm⟩ hne
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨l₁ ++ [x, a, b], m₂, by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: bs', m₂, by simp⟩
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) u w →
      ¬ (u = x ∧ w = x') → ¬ (u = x' ∧ w = x) → Adj (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) u w := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x' a b u w hA h1 h2
    obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := hA
    · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w hm.symm h1
      exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
    · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b w u hm.symm (fun h => h2 ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
  
  have hs3 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b z : ℕ), IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) z →
      IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) z := by
    intro l₁ l₂ x x' a b z h
    have e1 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).head? := by
      cases l₁ <;> simp
    have e2 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).getLast? := by
      simp only [List.getLast?_append_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
    unfold IsEnd at *
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact h
  
  have hs4 : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), Adj q x x' → ∃ q' : List ℕ,
      q'.Perm ((x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: q) ∧
      edgeLengths q' = edgeLengths q + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      Adj q' (x + ℓ) (x' + ℓ) ∧
      (∀ u w, Adj q u w → ¬(u = x ∧ w = x') → ¬(u = x' ∧ w = x) → Adj q' u w) ∧
      (∀ z, IsEnd q z → IsEnd q' z) := by
    intro q x x' hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · refine ⟨l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ x x',
        ⟨l₁ ++ [x], x' :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩,
        fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ x x' _ _ u w h1 h2 h3,
        fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ x x' _ _ z hz⟩
      have e : l₁ ++ x :: (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂ =
          (l₁ ++ [x]) ++ (x + ℓ) :: (x' + ℓ) :: x' :: l₂ := by simp
      have e' : l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [x]) ++ x' :: l₂ := by simp

    (fun i hi => hK₂ _ (hS₁ _ (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i' hi' => by omega))
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hE₄, -, -⟩ := top_attach (y - k)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement:

    b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → k + 2 ≤ b → b + k + 1 ≤ c → y - k + 2 ≤ c →

      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c))

            ([0, 1] ++ (List.map (fun x => 2 + (d + 1) + x) (List.range (r + 1))))) :=

            0 :: 1 :: (List.map (fun x => 2 + (d + 1) + x) (List.range (r + 1))).reverse).map
            (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))

            0 :: 1 :: (List.map (fun x => 2 + (d + 1) + x) (List.range (r + 1))).reverse).tail.map

            List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]

        · intro i h1 h2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hb hc hb2 hc2 hk2 hbk hdisj
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -, hQs, hQ0, -⟩ := path_II (y - k + 1) 1 le_rfl (by omega)
  have e1 : y - k + 1 - 2 = y - k - 1 := by omega
  have e2 : y - k + 1 - 1 = y - k := by omega
  rw [e1, e2] at hQ
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ :=
    top_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 1) ((b - 1) / 2) _ Q (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hQ
      (fun i hi => hQs _ (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, -, hE2⟩ :=
    top_pairs y (y - k + 1 + 2 * ((b - 1) / 2)) (c / 2) _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega) hp₁ (by
        intro i hi
        by_cases hx : y - k + 1 + 2 * ((b - 1) / 2) - y + 2 * i ≤ y - k - 1
        · apply hK1 _ (hQs _ (by omega) (by omega))
          intro i' hi'
          omega
        · have hm : (y - k) % 2 = 1 := by
            rcases hdisj with h | h
            · omega
            · exact h
          obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, y - k + 1 + 2 * ((b - 1) / 2) - y + 2 * i =
              y - k + 1 + 2 * j :=
            ⟨(y - k + 1 + 2 * ((b - 1) / 2) - y + 2 * i - (y - k + 1)) / 2, by omega⟩
          rw [hj]
          exact hN1 j (by omega))
  
  have hv : y - k + 1 + 2 * ((b - 1) / 2) + 2 * (c / 2) = y - k - 1 + b + c + 1 := by omega
  have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - k - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * ((b - 1) / 2)) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * (c / 2)) y =
      prescribedLengths y k (y - k - 1) b c := by
    have h1 : 2 * ((b - 1) / 2) = b - 1 := by omega
    have h2 : 2 * (c / 2) = c := by omega
    have h3 : Multiset.replicate b (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (b - 1) (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [h1, h2]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [h3]
    abel
  rw [hv, hL] at hp₂
  exact ⟨y - k - 1, by omega, p₂, hp₂, Or.inl (hE2 0 (hE1 0 hQ0))⟩
