proof.tactics:
by
  
  have top_attach : ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v - ℓ) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' v ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ v - ℓ → IsEnd p' x) := by
    have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
        Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
      intro x a t; rfl
    have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
      intro l a b
      induction l with
      | nil =>
        rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
        rfl
      | cons x l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
          have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) = edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
        | cons y l' =>
          have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
          have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
              edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
    intro ℓ v L p hℓ hℓv hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    unfold IsVertexPerm at hq
    have hnat1 : Int.natAbs (((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    have hnat2 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    unfold IsEnd at hend
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨v :: (v - ℓ) :: t, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold IsVertexPerm
        rw [List.range_succ]
        exact (hq.cons v).trans (List.perm_append_singleton v _).symm
      · rw [s1, hM, hnat1, Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
      · rintro x ⟨l₁, l₂, hx | hx⟩
        · exact ⟨v :: l₁, l₂, Or.inl (by rw [hx]; rfl)⟩
        · exact ⟨v :: l₁, l₂, Or.inr (by rw [hx]; rfl)⟩
      · intro x hx hne
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · simp at hx
          omega
        · right
          rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]
          exact hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      have e : t ++ [v - ℓ, v] = (t ++ [v - ℓ]) ++ [v] := by simp
      refine ⟨t ++ [v - ℓ, v], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold IsVertexPerm
        rw [e, List.range_succ]
        exact hq.append_right [v]
      · rw [s3, hM, hnat2, Multiset.replicate_one]
      · rw [e, List.getLast?_concat]
      · rintro x ⟨l₁, l₂, hx | hx⟩
        · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ [v], Or.inl (by rw [e, hx]; simp)⟩
        · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ [v], Or.inr (by rw [e, hx]; simp)⟩
      · intro x hx hne
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · left
          rw [e, List.head?_append, hx]
          rfl
        · simp at hx
          omega
  intro y k b c hk hyk hb hc hb2 hc2 hb1 hk2 hck
  subst hb1
  obtain ⟨t₂, e2⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = k - 1 := ⟨(k - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₃, e3⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - 1 - k := ⟨(c - 1 - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, hQ0, hQk⟩ := path_II y k hk (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hE1y, hA1, hE1⟩ := top_attach y y _ Q (by omega) le_rfl hQ
    (by rw [Nat.sub_self]; exact hQ0)
  have hE1k : IsEnd p₁ k := hE1 k hQk (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁ (by
      intro i hi
      rw [show y + 1 - y + 2 * i = 2 * i + 1 by omega]
      exact hA1 _ (hQa (2 * i + 1) (by omega)))
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE3, hA3, -⟩ := top_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * t₂) _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
    (by rw [show y + 1 + 2 * t₂ - y = k by omega]; exact hE2 k hE1k)
  
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, -, -, hE4⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 1) t₃ _ p₃
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ (by
      intro i hi
      have hx1 := hQb (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have hx2 := hA1 _ hx1
      have hx3 := hK2 _ hx2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have hx4 := hA3 _ hx3
      rw [show y - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at hx4
      exact hx4)
  have hend := hE4 _ hE3
  
  refine ⟨y - 2, by omega, p₄, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
  · have ev : y + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 1 + 2 * t₃ = y - 2 + 1 + c + 1 := by omega
    have em : Multiset.replicate (y - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) y = prescribedLengths y k (y - 2) 1 c := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have hc' : c = 1 + 2 * t₂ + 1 + 2 * t₃ := by omega
      rw [hc']
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_add]
      abel
    rw [ev, em] at hp₄
    exact hp₄
  · rw [show y - 2 + 1 + c = y + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ by omega]
    exact hend

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → b < y - k → c < y →
    b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → y % 2 = 1 → (y - k) % 2 = 0 → y + 2 ≤ b + c → c ≤ y - k + 2 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c))

signature.name: baseD_OE_FK
signature.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → b < y - k → c < y →
    b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → y % 2 = 1 → (y - k) % 2 = 0 → y + 2 ≤ b + c → c ≤ y - k + 2 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧
      (IsEnd p 0 ∨ IsEnd p (a₀ + b + c))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hb hc hb2 hc2 hy2 hm2 hbc hcm
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α, 2 * α + y + 2 = b + c := ⟨(b + c - y - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β, 2 * β + c = y + 1 := ⟨(y + 1 - c) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ, 2 * γ + 2 = c := ⟨(c - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, r + 2 * α = y - k := ⟨y - k - 2 * α, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQlo, hQhi, hQa, hQb⟩ := path_III (y + 1) r (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hC1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) α _ Q (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hQ (by
      intro i hi
      have h := hQhi (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y - k - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - k - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h
      exact h)
  have hEnd1 : IsEnd p₁ (y - k - 1) := by
    have h := hE1 _ hQa
    rw [show r - 1 + 2 * α = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hZ2, hK2, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * α) _ p₁ (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁ hEnd1
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, -, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * α + 1) β _ p₂ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ (by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := hK1 (y - k - 3 - 2 * i - 2 * α) (hQlo _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1
      rw [show y - k - 3 - 2 * i - 2 * α + 2 * α + 1 = y - k - 2 - 2 * i by omega,
        show y - k - 3 - 2 * i - 2 * α + 2 * α + 2 = y - k - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h2
      exact h2)
  have hEnd3 : IsEnd p₃ (2 * β) := by
    have h := hE3 0 hZ2
    rw [Nat.zero_add] at h
    exact h
  
  have s7 : ∀ w : ℕ, w % 2 = 1 → w + 3 ≤ c → Adj p₃ (w + 2 * β) (w + 2 * β + 1) := by
    intro w hw1 hw2
    have hp1 : Adj p₁ (w - 1) (w - 1 + 1) := by
      by_cases hu : w - 1 < 2 * α
      · have h := hC1 ((w - 1) / 2) (by omega)
        rw [show 2 * ((w - 1) / 2) = w - 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      · have h := hK1 (w - 1 - 2 * α) (hQlo _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        rw [show w - 1 - 2 * α + 2 * α = w - 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
    have hp2 := hK2 _ hp1
    rw [show w - 1 + 1 = w by omega, show w - 1 + 2 = w + 1 by omega] at hp2
    exact hK3 _ hp2 (by intro i hi; omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, -, -, hE4⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * α + 1 + 2 * β) γ _ p₃ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ (by
      intro i hi
      have h := s7 (y - 2 - 2 * i - 2 * β) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y - 2 - 2 * i - 2 * β + 2 * β = y - 2 - 2 * i by omega,
        show y - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h
      exact h)
  have hEnd4 : IsEnd p₄ (y - 1) := by
    have h := hE4 _ hEnd3
    rw [show 2 * β + 2 * γ = y - 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, hZ5, -, -⟩ := bot_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * α + 1 + 2 * β + 2 * γ) _ p₄ (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₄ hEnd4
  
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, p₅, ?_, Or.inl hZ5⟩
  have e1 : y + 1 + 2 * α + 1 + 2 * β + 2 * γ + 1 = y - 1 + b + c + 1 := by omega
  have e2 : Multiset.replicate (y + 1 - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y + 1 - 1) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * α) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * β) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * γ) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y = prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b c := by
    rw [show y + 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega, show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega,
      show b = 2 * α + 1 + 2 * β by omega, show c = 2 * γ + 1 + 1 by omega]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  rw [e1, e2] at hp₅
  exact hp₅

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: path_III
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - 1)) Q ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧ IsEnd Q (j - 1) ∧ IsEnd Q j

signature.name: baseD_OE_FR1
signature.statement:
∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → b < y - k → c < y →
    b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → y % 2 = 1 → (y - k) % 2 = 0 → k + 1 ≤ c →

    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hb hc hb2 hc2 hy2 hm2 hck hdisj
  
  have hAdjIdx : ∀ (L : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (h : i + 1 < L.length),
      Adj L (L[i]'(by omega)) (L[i + 1]'h) := by
    intro L i h
    refine ⟨L.take i, L.drop (i + 2), Or.inl ?_⟩
    have h1 : L.drop i = L[i]'(by omega) :: L.drop (i + 1) := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega)
    have h2 : L.drop (i + 1) = L[i + 1]'h :: L.drop (i + 1 + 1) := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h
    calc L = L.take i ++ L.drop i := (List.take_append_drop i L).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [h1, h2]
  
  have hR1 : ∀ m k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (m + k + 1)
        (Multiset.replicate (m + k - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (m + k) +
          Multiset.replicate 1 m) Q ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, 1 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ m → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, m + 1 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ m + k → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
      IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q m := by
    intro m k hk1 hm1
    obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : List ℕ, Q = [0] ++
        (List.map (fun x => 1 + m + x) (List.range k)).reverse ++
        List.map (fun x => 1 + x) (List.range m) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hlen : Q.length = m + k + 1 := by
      subst hQdef; simp; omega
    have hQ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h : i < Q.length), Q[i] =
        if i = 0 then 0 else if i ≤ k then m + k + 1 - i else i - k := by
      intro i h
      subst hQdef
      simp only [List.getElem_append, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range,
        List.getElem_reverse, List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range,
        List.length_singleton, List.getElem_singleton, List.length_reverse]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    refine ⟨Q, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show List.Perm _ _
      subst hQdef
      rw [show m + k + 1 = 1 + m + k by omega,
        (List.range_add : List.range (1 + m + k) = _),
        (List.range_add : List.range (1 + m) = _), List.range_one,
        List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc]
      exact List.Perm.append_left _
        (((List.reverse_perm _).append_right _).trans List.perm_append_comm)
    · have hl : List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (Q.map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) (Q.tail.map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) =
          (m + k) :: (List.replicate (k - 1) 1 ++ m :: List.replicate (m - 1) 1) := by
        apply List.ext_getElem
        · simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen,
            List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]
          omega
        · intro i h1 h2
          simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen] at h1
          rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_tail,
            hQ, hQ]
          simp only [List.getElem_append, List.getElem_cons, List.getElem_replicate,
            List.length_replicate]
          rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff]
          split_ifs <;> first | contradiction | omega
      have he : edgeLengths Q = ((List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (Q.map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) (Q.tail.map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) : List ℕ) :
            Multiset ℕ) := by
        unfold edgeLengths
        simp only [List.map_eq_flatMap]
        rfl
      rw [he, hl]
      simp only [← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_replicate]
      rw [show m + k - 2 = (k - 1) + (m - 1) by omega, Multiset.replicate_add]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      have h := hAdjIdx Q (k + x) (by rw [hlen]; omega)
      convert h using 2 <;> rw [hQ] <;> split_ifs <;> first | contradiction | omega
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      have h := hAdjIdx Q (m + k - x) (by rw [hlen]; omega)
      have h' : Adj Q (x + 1) x := by
        convert h using 2 <;> rw [hQ] <;> split_ifs <;> first | contradiction | omega
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h''⟩ := h'
      exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h''.symm⟩
    · left
      rw [hQdef]
      simp
    · right
      rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [hlen]; omega), hQ]
      simp only [hlen, Option.some.injEq]
      split_ifs <;> first | contradiction | omega
  
  obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, k = 2 * t + 1 := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ : ∃ t, b = 2 * t + 1 := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t, c = k + 1 + 2 * t := ⟨(c - (k + 1)) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQlo, hQhi, -, hQm⟩ := hR1 (y - k) k hk (by omega)
  rw [show y - k + k = y by omega] at hQ hQhi
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ :=
    top_pairs y (y + 1) t₁ _ Q (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hQ
      (by
        intro i hi
        have h := hQlo (1 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [show y + 1 - y + 2 * i = 1 + 2 * i by omega]
        exact h)
  
  have hS2 : ∀ i : ℕ, i < t₂ →
      Adj p₁ (y + 1 + 2 * t₁ - (y - k) + 2 * i) (y + 1 + 2 * t₁ - (y - k) + 2 * i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, y + 1 + 2 * t₁ - (y - k) + 2 * i = x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hx]
    by_cases hA : y + 1 ≤ x
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, x = y + 1 + 2 * j := ⟨(x - (y + 1)) / 2, by omega⟩
      rw [hj]
      exact hN1 j (by omega)
    · have hQx : Adj Q x (x + 1) := by
        by_cases hxl : x + 1 ≤ y - k
        · exact hQlo x (by omega) hxl
        · exact hQhi x (by omega) (by omega)
      exact hK1 x hQx (fun i' _ => by omega)
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ :=
    top_pairs (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * t₁) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ hS2
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, -, -, hE3⟩ :=
    bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂) t₃ _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
      (by
        intro i hi
        have h := hQhi (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1 _ h (fun i' _ => by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i' _ => by omega)
        rw [show y - 1 - 2 * i = y - 2 - 2 * i + 1 by omega]
        exact h2)
  
  have hEnd : IsEnd p₃ (y - 1) := by
    have h := hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQm))
    rw [show y - k + 2 * t₃ = y - 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, h0, -, -⟩ :=
    bot_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃) _ p₃ (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ hEnd
  refine ⟨y - 2, by omega, p₄, ?_, Or.inl h0⟩
  have e1 : y - 2 + b + c + 1 = y + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ + 1 := by omega
  have e2 : Multiset.replicate (y - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) y +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y = prescribedLengths y k (y - 2) b c := by
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [show b = 1 + 2 * t₂ by omega, show c = 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₃ + 1 by omega]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  rw [e1, ← e2]
  exact hp₄

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k r c hk hyk hr hc hm hce
  
  have fromTop : ∀ (a₀ : ℕ), a₀ ≤ y → y - k ≤ a₀ + r + c → ∀ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + r + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ r c) p →
      IsEnd p 0 → TopPairInv (y - k) (a₀ + r + c + 1) p →
      ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
        IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1)
          (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
        (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
        (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p) := by
    intro a₀ ha₀ hv p hp h0 hTP
    obtain ⟨hq, hAdj, hEnd⟩ := reflect_realization (a₀ + r + c + 1) _ p hp
    have hBP : BotPairInv (y - k) (p.map (fun x => a₀ + r + c + 1 - 1 - x)) := by
      refine ⟨hTP.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩

          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) (y - k) := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [hb, ht₂]
      abel
    rw [hv, hL] at hP₂
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hB, hE⟩ := rfin _ _ P₂ hP₂ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQe0)) (by omega) (by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hj1 : j < t₂
      · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hN2 (t₂ - 1 - j) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hj2 : j < t₂ + t₁
        · have h := hK2 _ (hN1 (t₁ - 1 - (j - t₂)) (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)

        · have h1 := hK1 (y - 2 + (k + 2) + c + 1 - 2 - 2 * j) (hQb _ (by omega) (by omega))

    refine ⟨Q, hQ, hB, ?_⟩
    rwa [show y - 2 + (k + 2) + c + 1 - 1 = y - 2 + (k + 2) + c by omega] at hE
  
  
  have famB : k ≤ c + 1 → c + 3 ≤ y → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (y - 2 + 3 + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 2) 3 c) Q ∧
      BotPairInv (y - k) Q ∧ IsEnd Q (y - 2 + 3 + c) := by
    intro hkc hcy
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = k - 1 := ⟨(k - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c + 1 - k := ⟨(c + 1 - k) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨Q₀, hQ₀, hQa, hQb, hQe0, -⟩ := path_II y k hk (by omega)
    obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ :=
      top_pairs y y t₁ _ Q₀ (by omega) le_rfl (by omega) hQ₀ (by
        intro i hi

    obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ :=
      top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 * t₁) 1 _ P₁ hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hP₁ (by
        intro i hi

        intro i hi

        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega))
    have hv : y + 2 * t₁ + 2 * 1 + 2 * t₃ = y - 2 + 3 + c + 1 := by omega
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) y = prescribedLengths y k (y - 2) 3 c := by
      have hb : Multiset.replicate 3 (y - k) =
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) (y - k) := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]

          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) y := by

        congr 1
        omega
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [hb, hc']

    rw [hv, hL] at hP₃
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hB, hE⟩ := rfin _ _ P₃ hP₃ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQe0))) (by omega) (by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hj1 : j < t₃
      · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hN3 (t₃ - 1 - j) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hj2 : j = t₃
        · have h := hK3 _ (hN2 0 (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)

          · have h1 := hK2 _ (hN1 (t₁ + t₃ - j) (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
            have h2 := hK3 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)

          · have h1 := hK1 (y - 2 + 3 + c + 1 - 2 - 2 * j) (hQb _ (by omega) (by omega))
              (by intro i' hi'; omega)

            have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)

      IsLinearRealization (y - 2 + 1 + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 2) 1 c) Q ∧

    intro hcC
    obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = k - 1 := ⟨(k - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - k - 1 := ⟨(c - k - 1) / 2, by omega⟩

    obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ :=
      top_pairs y (y + 1) t₂ _ P₁ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hP₁ (by
        intro i hi

      bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₂) t₃ _ P₂ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hP₂ (by
        intro i hi

    obtain ⟨P₄, hP₄, hE4, hK4, -⟩ :=

    rw [hv, hL] at hP₄

  have famD : k = 1 → 5 ≤ y → c = y - 1 → ∃ Q : List ℕ,

    intro hk1 hy5 hcy

    obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ :=
      bot_pairs (y - 1) y 1 _ Q₀ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hQ₀ (by
        intro i hi

    obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ :=

    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - 1) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) (y - 1) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
        Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 y =

  rcases (show c + 2 ≤ y - k ∨ (y - k ≤ c ∧ c + 3 ≤ y) ∨ (c = y - 1 ∧ 3 ≤ k) ∨

    · decide

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_bot_pair_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotPairInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotPairInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → r % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

signature.name: baseC_OO
signature.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → r % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

          abel
        · intro x hx

          refine ⟨(List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r)).reverse,
            (List.range x).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + r + y) (List.range m)).reverse,
            Or.inr ?_⟩
          rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
          simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append]
        · intro x hx1 hx2
          obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, x = j + d := ⟨x - j, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = d + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨m - d - 2, by omega⟩
          refine ⟨(List.range j).reverse ++
              (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.map (fun y => d + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r))).reverse,
            (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range d)).reverse, Or.inr ?_⟩
          rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
          simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append, add_assoc]
        · left
          obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
          simp [List.range_succ]
        · right
          have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
          simp [List.getLast?_append, List.getLast?_reverse, List.head?_map, List.head?_range, hm0]
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - 1 := ⟨(c - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, hQj1, -⟩ := path_III (y + 1) (y - k - r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y + 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega, show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega] at hQ
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1) t _ Q
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hQ (by
          intro i hi
          rw [show y + 1 - y + 2 * i = 1 + 2 * i by omega]
          exact hQa _ (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * t) s _ p₁
        hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ (by
          intro i hi
          have h0 := hQb (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
          have h := hK1 _ h0 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          rwa [show y - k - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - k - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h)
      have hEnd2 : IsEnd p₂ (y - k - 1) := by
        have h := hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQj1)
        rwa [show y - k - r + 1 - 1 + 2 * s = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
      obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE30, hK3, -⟩ :=
        bot_attach (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * t + 2 * s) _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ hEnd2
      have hv : y + 1 + 2 * t + 2 * s + 1 = y - 1 + r + c + 1 := by omega
      have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) = prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) r c := by
        have hb' : Multiset.replicate r (y - k) =
            Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) y := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [hb', hc']
        abel
      rw [hv, hL] at hp₃
      refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, p₃, hp₃, hE30, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      by_cases hA : 2 * j + 1 ≤ r
      · have h := hK3 _ (hC2 (j - 1) (by omega))
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h1 := hK1 (2 * j - 1 - r) (hQa _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i hi; omega)
        have h3 := hK3 _ h2
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
    · 
      obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r + c + 1 - (y - k) := ⟨(r + c + 1 - (y - k)) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = y - k - 2 - r := ⟨(y - k - 2 - r) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, -, hQ2⟩ := path_II (y + 2) 2 (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y + 2 - 2 = y by omega] at hQ
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 2) t₁ _ Q (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hQ
        (by
          intro i hi
          rw [show y + 2 - y + 2 * i = 2 + 2 * i by omega]
          exact hQb _ (by omega) (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 2 + 2 * t₁) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
        (by omega) hp₁
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h := hK1 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (hQb _ (by omega) (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          rwa [show y - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h)
      obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hC3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂) s _ p₂ (by omega)
        (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (r - 2 * i) (hQb _ (by omega) (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 (r - 2 * i) h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          rw [show y - k - 2 - 2 * i = r - 2 * i + 2 * t₂ by omega,
            show y - k - 1 - 2 * i = r - 2 * i + 2 * t₂ + 1 by omega]
          exact h2)
      have hEnd : IsEnd p₃ (y - k - 1) := by
        have h := hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQ2))
        rwa [show 2 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * s = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
      obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hE40, hK4, -⟩ :=
        bot_attach (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 2 * s) _ p₃ (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ hEnd
      have hv : y + 2 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 2 * s + 1 = y + r + c + 1 := by omega
      have hL : Multiset.replicate y 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) = prescribedLengths y k y r c := by
        have hb' : Multiset.replicate r (y - k) =
            Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) y +
            Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [hb', hc']
        abel
      rw [hv, hL] at hp₄
      refine ⟨y, le_refl y, by omega, p₄, hp₄, hE40, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      by_cases hA : 2 * j + 1 ≤ r
      · have h := hK4 _ (hC3 (j - 1) (by omega))
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hC : 2 * j + 1 = y - k
        · have h1 := hK1 0 (hQa 0 (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 0 h1 (by intro i hi; omega)
          have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i hi; omega)
          have h4 := hK4 _ h3
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 2 * i = 2 * j - 1 - r := ⟨(2 * j - 1 - r) / 2, by omega⟩
          have h2 := hC2 i (by omega)
          have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h4 := hK4 _ h3
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hva, p, hp, hBE⟩ := key
  obtain ⟨p', hp', hBE', -, -⟩ :=
    grow_bot_end_iter (y - k) (a₀ + r + c + 1) 1 _ p hm2 hva hp hBE
  rw [one_mul] at hp'
  have e1 : a₀ + r + c + 1 + (y - k) = a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1 := by omega
  have e2 : prescribedLengths y k a₀ r c + Multiset.replicate (y - k) (y - k) =
      prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c := by
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  rw [e1, e2] at hp'
  exact ⟨a₀, ha₀, p', hp', Or.inl hBE', Or.inr hBE'⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_bot_end_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

signature.name: baseC_O1
signature.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k r c hk hyk hr hc hm hk2 hr2 hc2
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  have hm2 : 2 ≤ y - k := by omega
  have hnotEven : ¬ Even (y - k) := by
    intro he
    have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
    omega
  
  
  
  have top_attach : ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v - ℓ) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' v ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ v - ℓ → IsEnd p' x) := by
    have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
        Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
      intro x a t; rfl
    have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
      intro l a b
      induction l with
      | nil =>
        rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
        rfl
      | cons x l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
          have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) =
              edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
        | cons y l' =>
          have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
          have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
              edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
    intro ℓ v L p hℓ hv hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    have hadj : ∀ (pre suf : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), Adj p x (x + 1) →
        Adj (pre ++ p ++ suf) x (x + 1) := by
      rintro pre suf x ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inl (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inr (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
    have hab1 : Int.natAbs (((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
      have e : ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ) = -(ℓ : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [e]; simp
    have hab2 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
      have e : (v : ℤ) - ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ℓ : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [e]; simp
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨v :: (v - ℓ) :: t, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        exact (hq.cons v).trans (List.perm_append_singleton v _).symm
      · rw [s1, hM, hab1, Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [v] [] x hx
      · intro x hx hne
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · simp at hx
          omega
        · right
          rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]
          exact hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨t ++ [v - ℓ, v], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        have e : t ++ [v - ℓ, v] = (t ++ [v - ℓ]) ++ [v] := by simp
        rw [e]
        exact hq.append_right [v]
      · rw [s3, hM, hab2, Multiset.replicate_one]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [] [v] x hx
      · intro x hx hne
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · left
          cases t with
          | nil =>
            simp at hx
            omega
          | cons a t => simpa using hx
        · simp at hx
          omega
  
  
  
  have key : ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y - k ≤ a₀ + r + c ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + r + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ r c) p ∧
      BotEndInv (y - k) p := by
    by_cases hreg1 : r = 0 ∨ r + c + 1 ≤ y - k
    · 
      obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, 2 * U = c := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V, 2 * V = r := ⟨r / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨hQ, hQs, hQ0, -⟩ := path_range y (by omega)
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs y y U _ (List.range y) (by omega) le_rfl
        (by omega) hQ
        (by
          intro i hi
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQs (2 * i) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 * U) V _ p₁ hm2 (by omega)
        (by omega) hp₁
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (k + 2 * U + 2 * i) (hQs _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h1 (by omega) (by omega))
      have hv : y + 2 * U + 2 * V = y - 1 + r + c + 1 := by omega
      have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * V) (y - k) = prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) r c := by
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [hU, hV]
        abel
      rw [hv, hL] at hp₂
      refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, p₂, hp₂, hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQ0), ?_,
        fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      have h1 := hK1 (2 * j - 1) (hQs _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h2 := hK2 (2 * j - 1) h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 rfl (by omega)
    push_neg at hreg1
    have hrc : y - k + 1 ≤ r + c := by omega
    by_cases hreg4 : 2 * (y - k) ≤ r + c
    · 
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, 2 * A = c + 1 - (y - k) := ⟨(c + 1 - (y - k)) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B, 2 * B = 2 * (y - k) - 2 - c := ⟨(2 * (y - k) - 2 - c) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, 2 * C = r + c - 2 * (y - k) := ⟨(r + c - 2 * (y - k)) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H, 2 * H + 1 = y - k := ⟨(y - k) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨hQ, hQs, hQ0, hQe⟩ := path_range y (by omega)
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs y y A _ (List.range y) (by omega) le_rfl
        (by omega) hQ
        (by
          intro i hi
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQs (2 * i) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 * A) B _ p₁ hm2 (by omega)
        (by omega) hp₁
        (by
          intro i hi

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: dstar_lift
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (y k a₀ r c : ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y - k ≤ a₀ + r + c →
    IsLinearRealization (a₀ + r + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ r c) p →
    (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ (BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ IsEnd p (a₀ + r + c))) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p' ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p' ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p') ∧
      (IsEnd p' (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p')

informal_problem.statement:

    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 →

      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

subgoal_signatures.name: dstar_lift

    ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p' ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p' ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p') ∧
      (IsEnd p' (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p')

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

signature.name: baseC_O4
signature.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → r < y - k → c < y →
    (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
      (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
      (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k r c hk hyk hr hc hm hk2 hr2 hc2
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have adjs : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have hm2 : 2 ≤ y - k := by omega
  have hnotEven : ¬ Even (y - k) := by
    intro he
    have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
    omega
  
  have low : 2 ≤ c → r + c ≤ y →
      ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ,
        IsLinearRealization (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ (y - k + r) c) p ∧
        (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧
        (IsEnd p (a₀ + (y - k + r) + c) ∨ BotEndInv (y - k) p) := by
    intro hc2' hrc
    have path_III : ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
        IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - 1)) Q ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
        IsEnd Q (j - 1) ∧ IsEnd Q j := by
      intro n j hj hn
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = j + m := ⟨n - j, by omega⟩
      have hm : 1 ≤ m := by omega
      refine ⟨(List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse,
        ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_add]
        exact (List.reverse_perm _).append (List.reverse_perm _)
      · have hlen : ((List.range j).reverse ++
            (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).length = j + m := by simp
        have hQ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h : i < ((List.range j).reverse ++
            (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).length),
            ((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse)[i] =
              if i < j then j - 1 - i else j + m - 1 - (i - j) := by
          intro i h
          by_cases hi : i < j
          · rw [List.getElem_append_left (by simpa using hi)]
            simp [hi] <;> omega
          · rw [List.getElem_append_right (by simpa using hi)]
            simp [hi] <;> omega
        have hl : List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
            (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).map
              (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))
            (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).tail.map
              (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) =
            List.replicate (j - 1) 1 ++ (j + m - 1) :: List.replicate (m - 1) 1 := by
          apply List.ext_getElem
          · simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen,
              List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]
            omega
          · intro i h1 h2
            simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen] at h1
            rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_tail,
              hQ, hQ]
            simp only [List.getElem_append, List.getElem_cons, List.getElem_replicate,
              List.length_replicate]
            rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff]
            split_ifs <;> omega
        have he : edgeLengths ((List.range j).reverse ++
            (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse) =
            ((List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
            (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).map
              (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))
            (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).tail.map
              (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) := by
          unfold edgeLengths
          simp only [List.map_eq_flatMap]
          rfl
        rw [he, hl, show j + m - 2 = (j - 1) + (m - 1) by omega,
          Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_replicate,
          Multiset.coe_replicate, Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
        abel
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, j = x + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨j - x - 2, by omega⟩
        refine ⟨(List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r)).reverse,
          (List.range x).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + r + y) (List.range m)).reverse,
          Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
        simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append]
      · intro x hx1 hx2
        obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, x = j + d := ⟨x - j, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = d + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨m - d - 2, by omega⟩
        refine ⟨(List.range j).reverse ++
            (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.map (fun y => d + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r))).reverse,
          (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range d)).reverse, Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
        simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append, add_assoc]
      · left
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
        simp [List.range_succ]
      · right
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp [List.getLast?_append, List.getLast?_reverse, List.head?_map, List.head?_range, hm0]
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r := ⟨r / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - 2 := ⟨(c - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, -, hQj⟩ := path_III (y + 1) (y - r - c + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show y + 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega, show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega] at hQ
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hC1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) t₁ _ Q hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hQ
      (by
        intro i hi
        have hx : y - k - 2 - 2 * i + 2 ≤ y - r - c + 1 ∨ y - r - c + 1 ≤ y - k - 2 - 2 * i := by
          omega
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQa _ hx) rfl (by omega)
        · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQb _ hx (by omega)) rfl (by omega))
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₁) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega) hp₁
      (by
        intro i hi
        have h1 := hQb (y - 2 - 2 * i - r) (by omega) (by omega)
        have h2 := hK1 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega))
    have hEnd2 : IsEnd p₂ (y - 1) := by
      have h := hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQj)
      rwa [show y - r - c + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ = y - 1 by omega] at h
    obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE30, hK3, -⟩ :=
      bot_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂) _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ hEnd2
    have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₃ := by
      refine ⟨hE30, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      by_cases ha : 2 * j + 2 ≤ c
      · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3 _ (hC2 (j - 1) (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hb : 2 * j + 2 ≤ c + r
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 2 * i = 2 * j - c := ⟨(2 * j - c) / 2, by omega⟩
          have h1 := hC1 i (by omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3 _ h2) (by omega) (by omega)
        · have h0 := hQa (2 * j - c - r) (by omega)
          have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3 _ h2) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hv : y + 1 + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 1 = y - 1 + r + c + 1 := by omega
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
        Multiset.replicate 1 y = prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) r c := by
      have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
          Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [hc', ht₁]
      abel
    rw [hv, hL] at hp₃
    obtain ⟨p', hp', h2, h3⟩ := dstar_lift y k (y - 1) r c p₃ hk hyk (by omega) hp₃ (Or.inl hBE)
    exact ⟨y - 1, by omega, p', hp', h2, h3⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with h0 | hcpos
  · 
    clear low
    subst h0
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r := ⟨r / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨hP0, hS0, hE0, -⟩ := path_range (y - k + 2) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 2) t _ _ hm2 (by omega) (by omega)
      hP0 (by intro i hi; exact hS0 _ (by omega))
    have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₁ := by
      refine ⟨hE1 _ hE0, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK1 _ (hS0 (2 * j - 1) (by omega)) (by intro i hi; omega)) rfl
        (by omega)
    have hv : y - k + 2 + 2 * t = (y - k + 1) + r + 0 + 1 := by omega
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - k + 2 - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) =
        prescribedLengths y k (y - k + 1) r 0 := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [show y - k + 2 - 1 = y - k + 1 by omega, ht, Multiset.replicate_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hv, hL] at hp₁
    obtain ⟨p', hp', h2, h3⟩ :=
      dstar_lift y k (y - k + 1) r 0 p₁ hk hyk (by omega) hp₁ (Or.inl hBE)
    exact ⟨y - k + 1, by omega, p', hp', h2, h3⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, y - k = r + 1 + 4 * q ∨ y - k = r + 3 + 4 * q :=
    ⟨(y - k - 1 - r) / 4, by clear low; omega⟩
  rcases hq with hq | hq
  · by_cases hcq : 2 * q ≤ c
    · 
      clear low
      obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r + 2 * q := ⟨r / 2 + q, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨t₄, ht₄⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - 2 * q := ⟨(c - 2 * q) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨hP0, hS0, hE0, -⟩ := path_range (y + 1) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hC1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) t₃ _ _ hm2 (by omega)
        (by omega) hP0 (by intro i hi; exact hS0 _ (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₃) t₄ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
        (by omega) hp₁
        (by
          intro i hi
          by_cases hx : 2 * t₃ + 1 + 2 * i + 2 ≤ y + 1
          · have h := hK1 _ (hS0 _ hx) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
            exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
          · have h := hC1 (t₃ + i - y / 2) (by omega)
            exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hC3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄) q _ p₂ (by omega)
        (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (hS0 _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 rfl (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hC4, hK4, hE4⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 2 * q) t₃ _
        p₃ hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hp₃
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (y - k - 2 - 2 * i - 2 * q) (hS0 _ (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega))
      have hEnd : IsEnd p₄ (y - k - 1) := by
        have h := hE4 _ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hE0)))
        rwa [show 0 + 2 * q + 2 * t₃ = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
      obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, hE50, hK5, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k)
        (y + 1 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 2 * q + 2 * t₃) _ p₄ (by omega) (by omega) hp₄ hEnd
      have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₅ := by
        refine ⟨hE50, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
        intro j hj1 hj2
        by_cases ha : j ≤ t₃
        · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK5 _ (hC4 (j - 1) (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
        · have h3 := hC3 (j - 1 - t₃) (by omega)
          have h4 := hK4 _ h3 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK5 _ h4) (by omega) (by omega)
      have hv : y + 1 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 2 * q + 2 * t₃ + 1 = y + (y - k + r) + c + 1 := by
        omega
      have hL : Multiset.replicate (y + 1 - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₄) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * q) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) =
          prescribedLengths y k y (y - k + r) c := by
        have hb' : Multiset.replicate (y - k + r) (y - k) =
            Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) +
            Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y =
            Multiset.replicate (2 * t₄) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * q) y := by
          rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega, hb', hc']
        abel
      rw [hv, hL] at hp₅
      exact ⟨y, le_refl y, p₅, hp₅, Or.inl hBE, Or.inr hBE⟩
    · exact low (by clear low; omega) (by clear low; omega)
  · by_cases hcq : 2 * q + 2 ≤ c
    · 
      clear low
      obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r + 2 * q := ⟨r / 2 + q, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨t₄, ht₄⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = c - 2 - 2 * q := ⟨(c - 2 - 2 * q) / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨Q₀, hQ₀, hQa, hQb, -, hQ2⟩ := path_II (y + 2) 2 (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y + 2 - 2 = y by omega] at hQ₀
      obtain ⟨hZ, hZA, hZE⟩ := reflect_realization (y + 2) _ Q₀ hQ₀
      generalize hZdef : Q₀.map (fun x => y + 2 - 1 - x) = Z at hZ hZA hZE
      have hZS : ∀ x, x + 2 ≤ y ∨ x = y → Adj Z x (x + 1) := by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · have h := hZA (y - x) (y - x + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (hQb (y - x) (by omega) (by omega))
          exact adjs _ _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
        · have h := hZA 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQa 0 (by omega)) rfl rfl)
          exact adjs _ _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
      have hZe : IsEnd Z (y - 1) := by
        have h := hZE 2 (by omega) hQ2
        rwa [show y + 2 - 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega] at h
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hC1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2) t₃ _ Z hm2 (by omega)
        (by omega) hZ (by intro i hi; exact hZS _ (Or.inl (by omega)))
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 2 + 2 * t₃) t₄ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
        (by omega) hp₁
        (by
          intro i hi
          by_cases hx : 2 * t₃ + 2 + 2 * i ≤ y
          · have h := hK1 _ (hZS (2 * t₃ + 2 + 2 * i) (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
            exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
          · have h := hC1 (t₃ + i - y / 2) (by omega)
            exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
      have hEnd2 : IsEnd p₂ (y - 1) := hE2 _ (hE1 _ hZe)
      obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE30, hK3, -⟩ :=
        bot_attach y (y + 2 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄) _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ hEnd2
      obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hC4, hK4, hE4⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 2 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 1) q _ p₃
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₃
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (y - 3 - 2 * i) (hZS _ (Or.inl (by omega))) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3 _ h2) (by omega) (by omega))
      obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, hC5, hK5, hE5⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 1 + 2 * q)
        (t₃ + 1) _ p₄ hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hp₄
        (by
          intro i hi
          have h1 := hK1 (y - k - 3 - 2 * q - 2 * i) (hZS _ (Or.inl (by omega)))
            (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          have h3 := hK4 (y - k - 3 - 2 * q - 2 * i + 1) (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3 _ h2) rfl (by omega))
            (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega))
      have hEnd : IsEnd p₅ (y - k - 1) := by
        have h := hE5 _ (hE4 _ hE30)
        rwa [show 0 + 2 * q + 2 * (t₃ + 1) = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
      obtain ⟨p₆, hp₆, hE60, hK6, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k)
        (y + 2 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 1 + 2 * q + 2 * (t₃ + 1)) _ p₅ (by omega) (by omega) hp₅ hEnd
      have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₆ := by
        refine ⟨hE60, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
        intro j hj1 hj2
        by_cases ha : j ≤ t₃ + 1
        · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK6 _ (hC5 (j - 1) (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
        · have h4 := hC4 (j - 2 - t₃) (by omega)
          have h5 := hK5 _ h4 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
          exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK6 _ h5) (by omega) (by omega)
      have hv : y + 2 + 2 * t₃ + 2 * t₄ + 1 + 2 * q + 2 * (t₃ + 1) + 1 =
          y + (y - k + r) + c + 1 := by
        omega
      have hL : Multiset.replicate y 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₄) y +
          Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * q) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * (t₃ + 1)) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) =
          prescribedLengths y k y (y - k + r) c := by

subgoal_signatures.statement:

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:

      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:

    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization

    unfold IsVertexPerm

      intro z hz

    rw [← hedge]

    rw [List.head?_map, List.getLast?_map]

    · right; rw [h]; rfl

  have hm2 : 2 ≤ y - k := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -, hQb, -, hQj⟩ := path_II n j (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [show n - j = y - k by omega] at hQ
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) n t₁ _ Q hm2 (by omega) (by omega) hQ
    (by
      intro i hi
      exact hQb (n - (y - k) + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hN2, -, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (n + 2 * t₁) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁
    (by
      intro i hi
      rw [show y - 1 - 2 * i = y - 2 - 2 * i + 1 by omega]
      by_cases hx : y - 2 - 2 * i + 2 ≤ n
      · exact hK1 _ (hQb _ (by omega) hx) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      · obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ : ∃ i', y - 2 - 2 * i = n + 2 * i' :=
          ⟨(y - 2 - 2 * i - n) / 2, by omega⟩
        rw [hi']
        exact hN1 i' (by omega))
  have hEnd : IsEnd p₂ (y - 1) := by
    have h := hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQj)
    rwa [show j + 2 * t₂ = y - 1 by omega] at h
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE30, hK3, -⟩ :=
    bot_attach y (n + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂) _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ hEnd
  
  have hBE : BotEndInv (y - k) p₃ := by
    refine ⟨hE30, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j' hj1 hj2
      have h := hK3 _ (hN2 (j' - 1) (by omega))
      rw [show 2 * (j' - 1) + 1 = 2 * j' - 1 by omega,
        show 2 * (j' - 1) + 2 = 2 * j' by omega] at h
      exact h
    · intro he
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := he
      omega
  
  have hv : n + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 1 = (y - k) + (y - c) - 2 + (y - k + 0) + c + 1 := by omega
  have hL : Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y = prescribedLengths y k ((y - k) + (y - c) - 2) (y - k + 0) c := by
    have hb' : Multiset.replicate (y - k + 0) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]; congr 1; omega
    have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]; congr 1; omega
    have ha' : n - 2 = (y - k) + (y - c) - 2 := by omega
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hb', hc', ha']
    abel
  rw [hv, hL] at hp₃
  exact ⟨(y - k) + (y - c) - 2, by omega, p₃, hp₃, hBE⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:

    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:

    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k r c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → (y - k) % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 →
    r % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → r + c = y - k → k ≤ r →

      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + r + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ r c) p ∧ BotEndInv (y - k) p

  intro y k r c hk hyk hm hk2 hr2 hc2 hrc hkr
  have hm2 : 2 ≤ y - k := by omega

  obtain ⟨t₄, ht₄⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t = r + c - (y - k) - 2 := ⟨(r + c - (y - k) - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, hQ1, -⟩ := path_III (y + 1) (y - k) (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [show y + 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega, show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega] at hQ
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hE1, hK1, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y + 1) _ Q (by omega) (by omega) hQ hQ1
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 1) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁
    (by
      intro i hi
      have h0 := hQb (y - 3 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h := hK1 _ h0
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hC3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1 + 1 + 2 * t₂) t₃ _ p₂
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
    (by
      intro i hi
      have h0 := hQa (r - 4 - 2 * i) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega))
  have hEnd : IsEnd p₃ (y - k - 1) := by
    have h := hE3 _ (hE2 _ hE1)
    rwa [show 0 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
  
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hE4, hK4, -⟩ :=
    bot_attach (y - k) (y + 1 + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃) _ p₃ (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ hEnd
  
  have hBot4 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ y - k → Adj p₄ (2 * j - 1) (2 * j) := by
    intro j hj1 hj2
    by_cases hA : 2 * j ≤ r - 2
    · have h := hK4 _ (hC3 (j - 1) (by omega))
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 2 * i = 2 * j - r := ⟨(2 * j - r) / 2, by omega⟩
      have h2 := hC2 i (by omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h4 := hK4 _ h3
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hTop4 : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * i + 2 ≤ y → Adj p₄ (y - k + 2 + 2 * i) (y - k + 3 + 2 * i) := by
    intro i hi
    have h0 : Adj Q (1 + 2 * i) (1 + 2 * i + 1) := by
      by_cases hs : 1 + 2 * i + 2 ≤ y - k
      · exact hQa _ hs
      · exact hQb _ (by omega) (by omega)
    have h1 := hK1 _ h0
    have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
    have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
    have h4 := hK4 _ h3
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, -, hK5, hE5⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1 + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ + 1) t₄ _ p₄
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₄
    (by
      intro i hi
      have h := hTop4 i (by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
  have hv : y + 1 + 1 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ + 1 + 2 * t₄ = y - 1 + r + c + 1 := by omega
  have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₄) y =

        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have hc' : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t₄) y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hb', hc']
    abel
  rw [hv, hL] at hp₅
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, p₅, hp₅, hE5 _ hE4, ?_, fun he => absurd he hnotEven⟩
  intro j hj1 hj2
  have h := hBot4 j hj1 hj2
  have h' : Adj p₄ (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := adjc _ _ _ _ _ h rfl (by omega)
  have h5 := hK5 _ h' (by intro i hi; omega)
  exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h5 rfl (by omega)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → y ≤ c → c < 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧ (IsEnd p 0 ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hb hc1 hc2
  have h2y : 2 ≤ y := by omega
  have adj_symm : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have adj_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u w → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' rfl rfl h
    exact h
  
  have liftT : ∀ (a₀ c₀ : ℕ) (q : List ℕ), y ≤ a₀ + b + c₀ + 1 →
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c₀ + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c₀) q →
      TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c₀ + 1) q → IsEnd q 0 → ∀ t : ℕ,
      ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1)
          (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b (c₀ + 2 * t)) p ∧
        TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1) p ∧ IsEnd p 0 := by
    intro a₀ c₀ q hv hq hTPq hEq t
    induction t with
    | zero => exact ⟨q, by simpa using hq, by simpa using hTPq, hEq⟩
    | succ t ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hTP, hE⟩ := ih
      have hslot : ∀ i : ℕ, i < 1 →
          Adj p (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1 - y + 2 * i)
            (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1 - y + 2 * i + 1) := by
        intro i hi
        have h := hTP.2 (y / 2 - 1) (by omega)
        exact adj_symm _ _ _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h)
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hnew, hkeep, hend⟩ :=
        top_pairs y (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1) 1 _ p h2y (by omega) (by omega) hp hslot
      have ev : a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1 + 2 * 1 = a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * (t + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      have eL : prescribedLengths y k a₀ b (c₀ + 2 * t) + Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) y =
          prescribedLengths y k a₀ b (c₀ + 2 * (t + 1)) := by
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [show c₀ + 2 * (t + 1) = (c₀ + 2 * t) + 2 * 1 by omega,
          Multiset.replicate_add (c₀ + 2 * t) (2 * 1) y]
        abel
      rw [ev, eL] at hp'
      refine ⟨p', hp', ⟨hTP.1, ?_⟩, hend 0 hE⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hjpos
      · have h := hnew 0 (by omega)
        exact adj_symm _ _ _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h)
      · have h := hTP.2 (j - 1) (by omega)
        have h1 : Adj p (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1 - 2 * j)
            (a₀ + b + (c₀ + 2 * t) + 1 - 2 * j + 1) :=
          adj_symm _ _ _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h)
        have h2 := hkeep _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adj_symm _ _ _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2)
  have finishPair : ∀ (a₀ c₀ : ℕ) (q : List ℕ), a₀ ≤ y → c₀ ≤ c → c % 2 = c₀ % 2 →
      y ≤ a₀ + b + c₀ + 1 →
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c₀ + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c₀) q →
      TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c₀ + 1) q → IsEnd q 0 →
      ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧ (IsEnd p 0 ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) := by
    intro a₀ c₀ q ha₀ hc₀ hpar hv hq hTPq hEq
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, c = c₀ + 2 * t := ⟨(c - c₀) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hTP, hE⟩ := liftT a₀ c₀ q hv hq hTPq hEq t
    rw [← ht] at hp hTP
    exact ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, Or.inr hTP, Or.inl hE⟩
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with hb2 | hb2 <;>
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one c with hcc | hcc <;>
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one k with hk2 | hk2
