    exact ⟨a₀, ha₀, p, hp, Or.inl hTE, Or.inr hTE⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_E1 y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2
    exact finishPair a₀ 0 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    by_cases hb0 : b = 0
    · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_EO1 y k b hk hyk hy hb hb2 (Or.inr hb0)
      exact finishPair a₀ 1 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
    · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_FCa y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2 (by omega)
      exact finishPair a₀ 7 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_EO1 y k b hk hyk hy hb hb2 (Or.inl hk2)
    exact finishPair a₀ 1 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    by_cases hb1 : b = 1
    · subst hb1
      obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_II2 y k hk hyk hy hk2
      exact finishPair a₀ 0 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
    · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_FBo y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2 (by omega)
      exact finishPair a₀ (y - k - b + 1) q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_K3 y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2
    exact finishPair a₀ (y - k - b) q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_C4s y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2
    exact finishPair a₀ 1 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
  · 
    by_cases hb1 : b = 1
    · subst hb1
      obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_G2 y k hk hyk hy hk2
      exact finishPair a₀ 1 q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE
    · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hv, q, hq, hTP, hE⟩ := bBe_G1 y k b hk hyk hy hb hk2 hb2 (by omega)
      exact finishPair a₀ (y - k - b + 1) q ha₀ (by omega) (by omega) hv hq hTP hE

  · obtain ⟨bb, rfl⟩ : ∃ bb, b = bb + (y - k) := ⟨b - (y - k), by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨a₀, c₀, ha₀, hc₀, hce, hv, p, hp, hB, hT⟩ :=
      hbase bb (c % 2) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hB₁, hA₁, -⟩ := grow_bot_end_iter (y - k) (a₀ + bb + c₀ + 1) 1 _ p
      (by omega) (by omega) hp hB
    have hT₁ : TopPairInv y (a₀ + bb + c₀ + 1 + 1 * (y - k)) p₁ := by
      refine ⟨hyEven, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      have h1 := hA₁ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hT.2 j hj)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h1 (by omega) (by omega)
    have ev : a₀ + bb + c₀ + 1 + 1 * (y - k) = a₀ + (bb + (y - k)) + c₀ + 1 := by omega
    have hL : prescribedLengths y k a₀ bb c₀ + Multiset.replicate (1 * (y - k)) (y - k) =
        prescribedLengths y k a₀ (bb + (y - k)) c₀ := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [one_mul, Multiset.replicate_add]
      abel
    rw [ev, hL] at hp₁
    rw [ev] at hT₁
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hB', hT'⟩ := hlift ((c - c₀) / 2) a₀ (bb + (y - k)) c₀ p₁ (by omega) hp₁
      hB₁ hT₁
    have ec : c₀ + 2 * ((c - c₀) / 2) = c := by omega
    rw [ec] at hp' hT'
    exact ⟨a₀, ha₀, p', hp', Or.inl hB', Or.inr hT', Or.inl hB'⟩
  · obtain ⟨a₀, c₀, ha₀, hc₀, hce, hv, p, hp, hB, hT⟩ :=
      hbase b (c % 2) hbo hb2 (by omega)
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hB', hT'⟩ := hlift ((c - c₀) / 2) a₀ b c₀ p (by omega) hp hB hT
    have ec : c₀ + 2 * ((c - c₀) / 2) = c := by omega
    rw [ec] at hp' hT'
    exact ⟨a₀, ha₀, p', hp', Or.inl hB', Or.inr hT', Or.inl hB'⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: grow_bot_end_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + t * ℓ) (L + Multiset.replicate (t * ℓ) ℓ) p' ∧
      BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, ℓ ≤ u → ℓ ≤ w → Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + t * ℓ) (w + t * ℓ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + t * ℓ))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → y - k ≤ b → b < 2 * (y - k) → y ≤ c → c < 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧ (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p)

signature.name: baseAP_M
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → y - k ≤ b → b < 2 * (y - k) → y ≤ c → c < 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧ (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb1 hb2 hc1 hc2
  have adj_symm : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  have hyodd : ¬ Even y := by
    intro he
    have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
    omega
  
  
  
  have liftC : ∀ (b₀ c₀ : ℕ) (p : List ℕ), (y - k) + y ≤ (y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1 →
      IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c₀) p →
      BotPairInv (y - k) p → TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + b₀ + (c₀ + y) + 1)
        (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ (c₀ + y)) p' ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p' ∧
        TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + b₀ + (c₀ + y) + 1) p' := by
    intro b₀ c₀ p hv hp hbp hte
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hte', hA, -⟩ :=
      grow_top_end_iter y ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) 1 _ p (by omega) (by omega) hp hte
    have e1 : (y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1 + 1 * y = (y - 1) + b₀ + (c₀ + y) + 1 := by ring
    have e2 : prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c₀ + Multiset.replicate (1 * y) y =
        prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ (c₀ + y) := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [one_mul, Multiset.replicate_add]
      abel
    rw [e1, e2] at hp'
    rw [e1] at hte'
    refine ⟨p', hp', ⟨hbp.1, fun j hj => hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hbp.2 j hj)⟩, hte'⟩
  
  
  
  have stepB : ∀ (b₀ c₀ : ℕ), (y - k) + y ≤ (y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 2 →
      (∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1)
        (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c₀) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧
        TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p) →
      (∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (b₀ + 2) + c₀ + 1)
        (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (b₀ + 2) c₀) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧
        TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (b₀ + 2) + c₀ + 1) p) := by
    rintro b₀ c₀ hv ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hnew, hkeep, hend⟩ :=
      bot_pairs (y - k) ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) 1 _ p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp
        (fun i hi => adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hbp.2 ((y - k - 2) / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
    have e1 : (y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1 + 2 * 1 = (y - 1) + (b₀ + 2) + c₀ + 1 := by ring
    have e2 : prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c₀ + Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) (y - k) =
        prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (b₀ + 2) c₀ := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [Multiset.replicate_add]
      abel
    rw [e1, e2] at hp'
    refine ⟨p', hp', ⟨hbp.1, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h0 | hpos
      · subst h0
        exact hnew 0 (by omega)
      · have h := hkeep (2 * (j - 1)) (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hbp.2 (j - 1) (by omega)) rfl (by omega))
          (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · exact endc _ _ _ (hend _ hte.1) (by omega)
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      have h0 := adj_symm _ _ _ (hte.2.1 j hj1 hj2)
      have h := hkeep ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1 - 1 - 2 * j)
        (adjc _ _ _ _ _ h0 rfl (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adj_symm _ _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
    · intro he
      exact absurd he hyodd
  
  
  
  have fin : ∀ (b₀ c₀ : ℕ) (p : List ℕ), b₀ ≤ b → b₀ % 2 = b % 2 → (c₀ = c ∨ c₀ + y = c) →
      (y - k) + y ≤ (y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1 →
      IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c₀) p →
      BotPairInv (y - k) p → TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + b₀ + c₀ + 1) p →
      ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ BotPairInv (y - k) p) ∧ (TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p ∨ TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) ∧ (BotEndInv (y - k) p ∨ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p) := by
    intro b₀ c₀ p hb₀ hpar hc hv hp hbp hte
    have hC : ∃ p₁ : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + b₀ + c + 1)
        (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b₀ c) p₁ ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p₁ ∧
        TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + b₀ + c + 1) p₁ := by
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · rw [← hc]
        exact ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩
      · rw [← hc]
        exact liftC b₀ c₀ p hv hp hbp hte
    have hvc : (y - k) + y ≤ (y - 1) + b₀ + c + 1 := by omega
    have hB : ∀ t : ℕ, ∃ p₂ : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (b₀ + 2 * t) + c + 1)
        (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (b₀ + 2 * t) c) p₂ ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p₂ ∧
        TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (b₀ + 2 * t) + c + 1) p₂ := by
      intro t
      induction t with
      | zero => simpa using hC
      | succ t ih =>
        rw [show b₀ + 2 * (t + 1) = b₀ + 2 * t + 2 by ring]
        exact stepB (b₀ + 2 * t) c (by omega) ih
    obtain ⟨p₂, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hB ((b - b₀) / 2)
    have eb : b₀ + 2 * ((b - b₀) / 2) = b := by omega
    rw [eb] at h1 h3
    exact ⟨y - 1, by omega, p₂, h1, Or.inr h2, Or.inl h3, Or.inr h3⟩
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = y + l := ⟨c - y, by omega⟩
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with hb | hb
  · 
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one l with hl | hl
    · 
      by_cases hlm : l ≤ y - k
      · rcases (show (y - k - l) % 4 = 0 ∨ (y - k - l) % 4 = 2 by omega) with h4 | h4
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famR y k ((y - k - l) / 4) ((y - k) / 2 - (y - k - l) / 4)
            hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famC y k ((y - k - l - 2) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
      · 
        obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famR y k 0 (l / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega)
          (Or.inl rfl) (by omega)
        exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
    · 
      by_cases hlk : l + 2 ≤ k
      · 
        by_cases hl1 : l = 1
        · subst hl1
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowC1 y k hk hyk hy hk2
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
        · rcases (show l - 1 + k ≤ y - k - 1 ∨ l - 1 + k = y - k + 1 ∨ y - k + 3 ≤ l - 1 + k by
              omega) with h | h | h
          · obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowCodd y k (l / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega)
            exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
          · obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowCW y k (l / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega)
            exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
          · obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowCV y k (l / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega)
            exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
      · 
        rcases (show (y + (y - k) - l) % 4 = 0 ∨ (y + (y - k) - l) % 4 = 2 by omega) with h4 | h4
        · obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famR y k ((y + (y - k) - l) / 4)
            ((y - k) / 2 - (y + (y - k) - l) / 4)
            hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
        · obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famC y k ((y + (y - k) - l - 2) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2
            (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
  · 
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one l with hl | hl
    · 
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · 
        subst hl0
        obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowD0 y k hk hyk hy hk2
        exact fin (y - k + 1) 0 p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
      · by_cases hlk : l + 1 ≤ k
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := lowDeven y k (l / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega) (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
        · rcases (show (y + (y - k) - l) % 4 = 1 ∨ (y + (y - k) - l) % 4 = 3 by omega)
            with h4 | h4
          · 
            obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famB y k ((y + (y - k) - l - 1) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2
              (by omega)
            exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
          · 
            obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famA y k ((y + (y - k) - l - 3) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2
              (by omega)
            exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
    · 
      by_cases hlm : l + 1 ≤ y - k
      · rcases (show (y - k - l) % 4 = 1 ∨ (y - k - l) % 4 = 3 by omega) with h4 | h4
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famB y k ((y - k - 1 - l) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famA y k ((y - k - 3 - l) / 4) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega)
          exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte
      · 
        obtain ⟨p, hp, hbp, hte⟩ := famIIm y k ((l - (y - k) + 1) / 2) hk hyk hy hk2 (by omega)
        exact fin _ _ p (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega) hp hbp hte

subgoal_signatures.name: famR

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (y k b : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → k % 2 = 0 → b % 2 = 1 →
    ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + 1 + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + 1 + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b 1) q ∧
      TopPairInv y (a₀ + b + 1 + 1) q ∧ IsEnd q 0

      rw [h1]

            if i < d then s + i else i - d := by
        intro i h

          List.length_range]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
      have hl : List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (((List.range d).map (fun i => s + i) ++ List.range s).map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))
          (((List.range d).map (fun i => s + i) ++ List.range s).tail.map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) =
          List.replicate (d - 1) 1 ++ (s + d - 1) :: List.replicate (s - 1) 1 := by
        apply List.ext_getElem
        · simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen,
            List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]
          omega
        · intro i h1 h2
          simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen] at h1
          rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_tail, hQ, hQ]
          simp only [List.getElem_append, List.getElem_cons, List.getElem_replicate,
            List.length_replicate]
          rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff]
          split_ifs <;> omega
      have he : edgeLengths ((List.range d).map (fun i => s + i) ++ List.range s) =
          ((List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (((List.range d).map (fun i => s + i) ++ List.range s).map (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))

        simp only [List.map_eq_flatMap]

      have hS : List.range (x + 2) = List.range x ++ [x, x + 1] := by

      have hS : List.range (e + 2) = List.range e ++ [e, e + 1] := by

      rw [hR, hS]
      simp [List.append_assoc, add_assoc]
    · left
      obtain ⟨d', rfl⟩ : ∃ d', d = d' + 1 := ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩

      simp

  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, y - k = 2 * t + 1 + s := ⟨y - k - (2 * t + 1), by omega⟩

    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →

      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

by
  
  have sF2_sum : ∀ μ κ : ℕ, 1 ≤ κ → κ + 1 ≤ μ → sf2S μ κ = μ - 1 - κ := by
    intro μ κ hκ hμ
    have hK : 0 < 2 * κ := by omega
    have herm : ∀ a, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (2 * κ), (a + t) / (2 * κ) = a := by
      intro a
      induction a with
      | zero =>
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro t ht
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at ht
        rw [Nat.zero_add]
        exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt ht

        have h1 := Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun t => (a + t) / (2 * κ)) (2 * κ)

        have h3 : (a + 2 * κ) / (2 * κ) = (a + 0) / (2 * κ) + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.add_div_right _ hK]

        have h4 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (2 * κ), (a + 1 + t) / (2 * κ) =

        rw [h4]
        omega
    have hL : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ), ((List.range n).map f).sum = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, f x := by
      intro n f
      induction n with

      | succ n ih =>
        rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
        simp
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, μ = a + κ + 1 := ⟨μ - κ - 1, by omega⟩
    unfold sf2S
    rw [hL, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

    have r2 := Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun t => (a + t) / (2 * κ)) κ

    apply swap
    by_cases h1 : i ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * κ - 1
    · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ : ∃ x, i = x + 2 * μ + κ := ⟨i - 2 * μ - κ, by omega⟩
      have hx : x < κ := by omega
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hAdjR x hx _ _ (sF2_round_adj μ κ x).1) (by ring) (by ring)
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, i = r + 2 * μ + 2 * κ := ⟨i - 2 * μ - 2 * κ, by omega⟩
      by_cases h2 : r = μ - 1
      · refine ⟨(List.range κ).flatMap (sf2Round μ κ) ++ [2 * κ, 2 * (μ + κ), 2 * (2 * μ + κ)],
          [2 * (2 * μ + κ) - 1, 2 * μ - 1], Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [show 2 * (r + 2 * μ + 2 * κ) + 1 = 2 * (3 * μ + 2 * κ) - 1 by omega,
          show 2 * (r + 2 * μ + 2 * κ) + 2 = 2 * (3 * μ + 2 * κ) by omega]
        simp [seedF2List, sf2Tail]
      · by_cases h3 : r < κ
        · exact hAdjR r h3 _ _ (sF2_round_adj μ κ r).2.1
        · obtain ⟨x, hx, ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ | ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩⟩ :=
            sF2_rcover μ κ r hκ (by omega) (by omega)
          · exact hAdjR x hx _ _ ((sF2_round_adj μ κ x).2.2.2.1 i' hi').2
          · exact hAdjR x hx _ _ ((sF2_round_adj μ κ x).2.2.2.2 i' hi').2
  exact ⟨seedF2List μ κ, ⟨hperm, hedges⟩, hbot, htop⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 4 ≤ ℓ → ℓ % 2 = 0 → ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧ BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 2) (x + 3))

signature.name: plus2_bot
signature.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 4 ≤ ℓ → ℓ % 2 = 0 → ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p → BotEndInv ℓ p → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧ BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 2) (x + 3))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ v L p h4 hℓ2 hv hp hBE
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
      (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hE1 : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  
  have el_split : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) =
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ [a]) + (Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l₂)) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ a b
    induction l₁ with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hE1, zero_add]
    | cons c l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c a, hU c a, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons d l' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c d, hU c d, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have el_reverse : ∀ q : List ℕ, edgeLengths q.reverse = edgeLengths q := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a r ih =>
      cases r with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b r' =>
        have e1 : (a :: b :: r').reverse = r'.reverse ++ b :: a :: [] := by simp
        have e2 : r'.reverse ++ [b] = (b :: r').reverse := by simp
        have n : Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) = Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by omega
        rw [e1, el_split, e2, ih, hU a b, hE1, Multiset.add_cons, add_zero, n]
  
  have el_map : ∀ q : List ℕ, edgeLengths (q.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2)) = edgeLengths q := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a r ih =>
      cases r with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b r' =>
        simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU, hU, ih]
        congr 1
        omega
  
  have hO : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (a b u w : ℕ),
      m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ →
      (∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ [a] = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂) ∨
      (∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, b :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂) ∨ (u = a ∧ w = b) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b u w h
    rw [List.append_eq_append_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨as, rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨bs, rfl, h2⟩
    · rcases as with _ | ⟨a₁, _ | ⟨a₂, as'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h2.1, h2.2.1⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inl ⟨m₁, [], by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inl ⟨m₁, as' ++ [a], by simp⟩
    · rcases bs with _ | ⟨b₁, _ | ⟨b₂, bs'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h2.1.symm, h2.2.1.symm⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨[], m₂, by simp⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨b :: bs', m₂, by simp⟩)
  have adj_split : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) u w →
      Adj (l₁ ++ [a]) u w ∨ Adj (b :: l₂) u w ∨ (u = a ∧ w = b) ∨ (u = b ∧ w = a) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ a b u w hA
    obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := hA
    · rcases hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b u w hm.symm with ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl h⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
    · rcases hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b w u hm.symm with ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr h⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩))
  
  have adj_app : ∀ (P X R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj X u w → Adj (P ++ X ++ R) u w := by
    intro P X R u w hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · exact ⟨P ++ l₁, l₂ ++ R, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨P ++ l₁, l₂ ++ R, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
  have adj_rev : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj X u w → Adj X.reverse u w := by
    intro X u w hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  have adj_map : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj X u w →
      Adj (X.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2)) (u + 2) (w + 2) := by
    intro X u w hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · exact ⟨l₁.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), l₂.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), l₂.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), Or.inr (by simp)⟩
  
  have hrep : Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ = ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0 := rfl
  have hlast : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (a : ℕ), (X ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
    intro X a
    simp
  
  have hconsI : ∀ A B : List ℕ, ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (0 :: 1 :: ((2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]))) ∧
      edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths ((2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) +
        Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some 0 ∧ p'.getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) ∧ Adj p' 1 2 ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj ((2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) u w →
        ¬(u = ℓ - 1 ∧ w = ℓ) → ¬(u = ℓ ∧ w = ℓ - 1) → Adj p' u w := by
    intro A B
    refine ⟨0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])), ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : 0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          0 :: ((ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) ++ 1 :: (2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1]))) := by simp
      have e2 : (2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) =
          (2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) ++ (ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) := by simp
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact List.Perm.cons 0 (List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons 1 List.perm_append_comm))
    · rw [hU 0 ℓ, show ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          (ℓ :: B) ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: (2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) from rfl, el_split, hU 1 2,
        el_split (2 :: A) (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) (ℓ - 1) ℓ]
      have n1 : Int.natAbs ((ℓ : ℤ) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n2 : Int.natAbs (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n3 : Int.natAbs (((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have n4 : Int.natAbs ((ℓ : ℤ) - ((ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [n1, n2, n3, n4, hrep]
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · rw [show 0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          (0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: A)) ++ [ℓ - 1] by simp]
      exact hlast _ _
    · exact ⟨0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]), A ++ [ℓ - 1], Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · intro u w h hn1 hn2
      rcases adj_split (2 :: A) (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) (ℓ - 1) ℓ u w h with hX | hY | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have e : 0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
            (0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1, 1])) ++ ((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ - 1]) ++ [] := by simp
        rw [e]
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w hX
      · have e : 0 :: ℓ :: (B ++ (ℓ + 1) :: 1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
            [0] ++ (ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) ++ (1 :: 2 :: (A ++ [ℓ - 1])) := by simp
        rw [e]
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w hY
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn1
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn2
  
  have hconsII : ∀ A B : List ℕ, ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (0 :: 1 :: ((2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]))) ∧
      edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths ((2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) +
        Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some 0 ∧ p'.getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) ∧ Adj p' 1 2 ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj ((2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) u w →
        ¬(u = ℓ - 1 ∧ w = ℓ) → ¬(u = ℓ ∧ w = ℓ - 1) → Adj p' u w := by
    intro A B
    refine ⟨0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])),
      ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : 0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          0 :: (((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ]).reverse ++ 1 :: ((ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])).reverse) := by
        simp
      have e2 : (2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) =
          ((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ]) ++ ((ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) := by simp
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact List.Perm.cons 0 (List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons 1
        ((List.reverse_perm _).append (List.reverse_perm _))))
    · rw [hU 0 ℓ, show ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          (ℓ :: A.reverse) ++ 2 :: 1 :: ((ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) from rfl,
        el_split, hU 1 (ℓ + 1),
        show (ℓ :: A.reverse) ++ [2] = ((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ]).reverse by simp,
        show (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1]) = ((ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])).reverse by simp,
        el_reverse, el_reverse, el_split (2 :: A) (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) ℓ (ℓ - 1)]
      have n1 : Int.natAbs ((ℓ : ℤ) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n2 : Int.natAbs (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have n3 : Int.natAbs (((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n4 : Int.natAbs (((ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (ℓ : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [n1, n2, n3, n4, hrep]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · rw [show 0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
          (0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: B.reverse)) ++ [ℓ - 1] by simp]
      exact hlast _ _
    · exact ⟨0 :: ℓ :: A.reverse, (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1]), Or.inr (by simp)⟩
    · intro u w h hn1 hn2
      rcases adj_split (2 :: A) (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) ℓ (ℓ - 1) u w h with hX | hY | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have e : 0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
            [0] ++ ((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ]).reverse ++ (1 :: ((ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])).reverse) := by
          simp
        rw [e]
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w (adj_rev _ u w hX)
      · have e : 0 :: ℓ :: (A.reverse ++ 2 :: 1 :: (ℓ + 1) :: (B.reverse ++ [ℓ - 1])) =
            (0 :: ((2 :: A) ++ [ℓ]).reverse ++ [1]) ++ ((ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])).reverse ++ [] := by
          simp
        rw [e]
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w (adj_rev _ u w hY)
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn2
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn1
  have hcons : ∀ Q : List ℕ, (∃ A B : List ℕ, Q = (2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) ∨
      Q = (2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1])) → ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (0 :: 1 :: Q) ∧ edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths Q + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some 0 ∧ p'.getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) ∧ Adj p' 1 2 ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj Q u w → ¬(u = ℓ - 1 ∧ w = ℓ) → ¬(u = ℓ ∧ w = ℓ - 1) → Adj p' u w := by
    rintro Q ⟨A, B, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact hconsI A B
    · exact hconsII A B
  
  have peel : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (α β : ℕ), (l₁ ++ α :: β :: l₂).head? = some 0 →
      (l₁ ++ α :: β :: l₂).getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) → α ≠ 0 → β ≠ ℓ - 1 →
      ∃ l₁' l₂' : List ℕ, l₁ = 0 :: l₁' ∧ l₂ = l₂' ++ [ℓ - 1] := by
    intro l₁ l₂ α β hh hl hα hβ
    have h1 : ∃ l₁' : List ℕ, l₁ = 0 :: l₁' := by
      cases l₁ with
      | nil => simp at hh; exact absurd hh hα
      | cons c l => simp at hh; exact ⟨l, by rw [hh]⟩
    have h2 : ∃ l₂' : List ℕ, l₂ = l₂' ++ [ℓ - 1] := by
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat l₂ with rfl | ⟨L', b, rfl⟩
      · rw [show l₁ ++ α :: β :: [] = (l₁ ++ [α]) ++ [β] by simp, hlast] at hl
        exact absurd (Option.some.inj hl) hβ
      · rw [show l₁ ++ α :: β :: L'.concat b = (l₁ ++ α :: β :: L') ++ [b] by simp, hlast] at hl
        exact ⟨L', by rw [← Option.some.inj hl]; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨l₁', h1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨l₂', h2⟩ := h2
    exact ⟨l₁', l₂', h1, h2⟩
  have hR : List.range (v + 2) = 0 :: 1 :: (List.range v).map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2) := by
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.range_succ_eq_map]
    simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  
  have core : ∀ q : List ℕ, q.Perm (List.range v) → edgeLengths q = L → q.head? = some 0 →
      q.getLast? = some (ℓ - 1) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ → Adj q (2 * j - 1) (2 * j)) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧
        BotEndInv ℓ p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, ℓ ≤ x → Adj q x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 2) (x + 3)) := by
    intro q hperm hel hh hl hpairs
    have hcut : Adj q (ℓ - 3) (ℓ - 2) := by
      have h := hpairs (ℓ / 2 - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show 2 * (ℓ / 2 - 1) - 1 = ℓ - 3 by omega, show 2 * (ℓ / 2 - 1) = ℓ - 2 by omega] at h
      exact h
    have e1 : ℓ - 3 + 2 = ℓ - 1 := by omega
    have e2 : ℓ - 2 + 2 = ℓ := by omega
    have e3 : ℓ - 1 + 2 = ℓ + 1 := by omega
    have hshape : ∃ A B : List ℕ,
        q.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2) = (2 :: A) ++ (ℓ - 1) :: ℓ :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) ∨
        q.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2) = (2 :: A) ++ ℓ :: (ℓ - 1) :: (B ++ [ℓ + 1]) := by
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := hcut
      · obtain ⟨l₁', l₂', rfl, rfl⟩ := peel l₁ l₂ (ℓ - 3) (ℓ - 2) (h ▸ hh) (h ▸ hl)
          (by omega) (by omega)
        refine ⟨l₁'.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), l₂'.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), Or.inl ?_⟩
        rw [h]
        simp [e1, e2, e3]
      · obtain ⟨l₁', l₂', rfl, rfl⟩ := peel l₁ l₂ (ℓ - 2) (ℓ - 3) (h ▸ hh) (h ▸ hl)
          (by omega) (by omega)
        refine ⟨l₁'.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), l₂'.map (fun x : ℕ => x + 2), Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [h]
        simp [e1, e2, e3]
    obtain ⟨p', hP, hE, hH, hL, h12, hT⟩ := hcons _ hshape
    refine ⟨p', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨Or.inl hH, ?_, fun _ => Or.inr hL⟩, ?_⟩
    · show p'.Perm (List.range (v + 2))
      rw [hR]
      exact hP.trans (List.Perm.cons 0 (List.Perm.cons 1 (List.Perm.map _ hperm)))
    · rw [hE, el_map, hel]
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j 2 with hj | hj
      · have hj' : j = 1 := by omega
        subst hj'
        exact h12
      · have h := adj_map _ _ _ (hpairs (j - 1) (by omega) (by omega))
        rw [show 2 * (j - 1) - 1 + 2 = 2 * j - 1 by omega,
          show 2 * (j - 1) + 2 = 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact hT _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro x hx hA
      have h := adj_map _ _ _ hA
      rw [show x + 1 + 2 = x + 3 by omega] at h
      exact hT _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)

    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have adjPos : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (i u w : ℕ), l.drop i = u :: w :: l.drop (i + 2) → Adj l u w := by
    intro l i u w h
    refine ⟨l.take i, l.drop (i + 2), Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [← h, List.take_append_drop]
  have hhead : ∀ (l R : List ℕ), l ≠ [] → (l ++ R).head? = l.head? := by
    intro l R h
    cases l with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h
    | cons x xs => rfl
  have htake : ∀ (l l' : List ℕ), l.head? = l'.head? → l.take 1 = l'.take 1 := by
    intro l l' h
    cases l <;> cases l' <;> simp_all
  have fsplit : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (n : ℕ) (R : List ℕ),
      (List.range (n + 1)).flatMap f ++ R = (List.range n).flatMap f ++ (f n ++ R) := by
    intro f n R
    rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.append_assoc]
    simp
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
      (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hE1 : ∀ c : ℕ, edgeLengths [c] = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  have famE : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (M : Multiset ℕ), (∀ j, f j ≠ []) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), R.head? = (f (j + 1)).head? →
        edgeLengths (f j ++ R) = M + edgeLengths R) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), R.head? = (f n).head? →
        edgeLengths ((List.range n).flatMap f ++ R) = n • M + edgeLengths R := by
    intro f M hne hblk n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro R _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro R hR
      rw [fsplit, ih (f n ++ R) (hhead _ _ (hne n)), hblk n R hR, succ_nsmul, add_assoc]
  have famA : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (n : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), (∀ j, f j ≠ []) →
      R.head? = (f n).head? →
      ∀ (j u w : ℕ), j < n → Adj (f j ++ (f (j + 1)).take 1) u w →
        Adj ((List.range n).flatMap f ++ R) u w := by
    intro f n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro R _ _ j u w hj; omega
    | succ n ih =>
      intro R hne hR j u w hj hA
      rw [fsplit]
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with h | h
      · exact ih (f n ++ R) hne (hhead _ _ (hne n)) j u w h hA
      · subst h
        apply adjR
        rw [htake _ _ hR.symm] at hA
        rw [← List.take_append_drop 1 R, ← List.append_assoc]
        exact adjL _ _ _ _ hA
  have headFam : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (n : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), (∀ j, f j ≠ []) →
      R.head? = (f n).head? → ((List.range n).flatMap f ++ R).head? = (f 0).head? := by
    intro f n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro R _ hR; simpa using hR
    | succ n ih => intro R hne hR; rw [fsplit]; exact ih _ hne (hhead _ _ (hne n))
  have nodupFam : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (n : ℕ), (∀ j, j < n → (f j).Nodup) →
      (∀ i j, i < j → j < n → ∀ x ∈ f i, ∀ z ∈ f j, x ≠ z) →
      ((List.range n).flatMap f).Nodup := by
    intro f n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _ _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h1 h2
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.nodup_append]
      refine ⟨ih (fun j hj => h1 j (by omega)) (fun i j hij hj => h2 i j hij (by omega)),
        by simpa using h1 n (by omega), ?_⟩
      intro x hx z hz
      simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hx⟩ := hx
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil] at hz
      exact h2 i n hi (by omega) x hx z hz
  have lenFam : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (c n : ℕ), (∀ j, (f j).length = c) →
      ((List.range n).flatMap f).length = n * c := by
    intro f c n hc
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, hc]
      ring
  have permOf : ∀ (v : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), l.Nodup → l.length = v → (∀ x ∈ l, x < v) →
      IsVertexPerm v l := by
    intro v l hn hl hb
    unfold IsVertexPerm
    have hs : l ⊆ List.range v := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mpr (hb x hx)
    exact (List.subperm_of_subset hn hs).perm_of_length_le (by simp [hl])
  
  
  
  intro y k hk hyk hy3 hy hk2
  obtain ⟨κ, rfl⟩ : ∃ κ, k = 2 * κ := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, y = 2 * a + 4 * κ := ⟨y / 2 - 2 * κ, by omega⟩
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := by omega
  have haκ : a ≤ κ := by omega
  have e1 : 2 * (2 * a + 4 * κ) + (2 * a + 4 * κ - 2 * κ) + 1 = 6 * a + 10 * κ + 1 := by omega
  have e2 : 2 * a + 4 * κ - 2 * κ = 2 * a + 2 * κ := by omega
  rw [e1, e2]
  
  
  
  have hQne : ∀ j, seedF3cQ a κ j ≠ [] := fun j => by simp [seedF3cQ]
  have hTne : ∀ b, seedF3cT a κ b ≠ [] := fun b => by simp [seedF3cT]
  have hHeadW : (seedF3cZ a κ ++ ((List.range (a - 1)).flatMap (seedF3cT a κ) ++
      seedF3cH a κ)).head? = (seedF3cQ a κ (κ - a)).head? := by
    simp only [seedF3cZ, seedF3cQ, List.cons_append, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
    omega
  have hHeadH : (seedF3cH a κ).head? = (seedF3cT a κ (a - 1)).head? := by
    simp only [seedF3cH, seedF3cT, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
    omega
  have hHeadTH : ((List.range (a - 1)).flatMap (seedF3cT a κ) ++ seedF3cH a κ).head? =
      some (2 * a + 4 * κ + 2) := by
    rw [headFam _ _ _ hTne hHeadH]
    simp only [seedF3cT, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
    omega
  
  
  
  have blkQ : ∀ (j : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), R.head? = (seedF3cQ a κ (j + 1)).head? →
      edgeLengths (seedF3cQ a κ j ++ R) =
        ((2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ
          (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0) + edgeLengths R := by
    intro j R hR
    cases R with
    | nil => simp [seedF3cQ] at hR
    | cons x R' =>
      simp only [seedF3cQ, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hR
      subst hR
      simp only [seedF3cQ, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, hU, Multiset.cons_add, zero_add]
      iterate 10 refine congrArg₂ Multiset.cons (by omega) ?_
      rfl
  have blkT : ∀ (b : ℕ) (R : List ℕ), R.head? = (seedF3cT a κ (b + 1)).head? →
      edgeLengths (seedF3cT a κ b ++ R) =
        ((2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ
          1 ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ
          (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 0) + edgeLengths R := by
    intro b R hR
    cases R with
    | nil => simp [seedF3cT] at hR
    | cons x R' =>
      simp only [seedF3cT, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hR
      subst hR
      simp only [seedF3cT, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, hU, Multiset.cons_add, zero_add]
      iterate 16 refine congrArg₂ Multiset.cons (by omega) ?_
      rfl
  have blkZ : ∀ (R : List ℕ), R.head? = some (2 * a + 4 * κ + 2) →
      edgeLengths (seedF3cZ a κ ++ R) =
        ((2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ
          (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 0) + edgeLengths R := by
    intro R hR
    cases R with
    | nil => simp at hR
    | cons x R' =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hR
      subst hR
      simp only [seedF3cZ, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, hU, Multiset.cons_add, zero_add]
      iterate 9 refine congrArg₂ Multiset.cons (by omega) ?_
      rfl
  have edgeH : edgeLengths (seedF3cH a κ) =
      ((2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ (2*a+4*κ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (2*a+2*κ) ::ₘ 0) := by
    simp only [seedF3cH, hU, hE1]
    iterate 7 refine congrArg₂ Multiset.cons (by omega) ?_
    rfl
  have hEdges : edgeLengths (seedF3cPath a κ) =
      prescribedLengths (2 * a + 4 * κ) (2 * κ) (2 * a + 4 * κ - 1) (2 * a + 2 * κ + 1)
        (2 * a + 4 * κ) := by
    unfold seedF3cPath
    rw [famE _ _ hQne blkQ (κ - a) _ hHeadW, blkZ _ hHeadTH,
      famE _ _ hTne blkT (a - 1) _ hHeadH, edgeH]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [Multiset.ext]
    intro z
    simp only [Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_nsmul, Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.count_zero,
      Multiset.count_replicate]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  
  
  
  have hNodup : (seedF3cPath a κ).Nodup := by
    unfold seedF3cPath
    rw [List.nodup_append, List.nodup_append, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨?_, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply nodupFam
      · intro j hj
        simp [seedF3cQ] <;> omega
      · intro i j hij hj x hx z hz
        simp only [seedF3cQ, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hz
        omega
    · simp [seedF3cZ] <;> omega
    · apply nodupFam
      · intro j hj
        simp [seedF3cT] <;> omega
      · intro i j hij hj x hx z hz
        simp only [seedF3cT, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hz
        omega
    · simp [seedF3cH] <;> omega
    · intro x hx z hz
      simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, seedF3cT, seedF3cH, List.mem_cons,
        List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hz
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hx⟩ := hx
      omega
    · intro x hx z hz
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, seedF3cZ, seedF3cT, seedF3cH,
        List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hz
      rcases hz with ⟨b, hb, hz⟩ | hz <;> omega
    · intro x hx z hz
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, seedF3cQ, seedF3cZ, seedF3cT,
        seedF3cH, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx hz
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hx⟩ := hx
      rcases hz with hz | ⟨b, hb, hz⟩ | hz <;> omega
  have hLen : (seedF3cPath a κ).length = 6 * a + 10 * κ + 1 := by
    unfold seedF3cPath
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_append, List.length_append,
      lenFam _ 10 _ (fun j => rfl), lenFam _ 16 _ (fun b => rfl)]
    simp only [seedF3cZ, seedF3cH, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hBound : ∀ x ∈ seedF3cPath a κ, x < 6 * a + 10 * κ + 1 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [seedF3cPath, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, seedF3cQ, seedF3cZ,
      seedF3cT, seedF3cH, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨j, hj, hx⟩ | hx | ⟨b, hb, hx⟩ | hx <;> omega
  
  
  
  have liftQ : ∀ (j u w : ℕ), j < κ - a →
      Adj (seedF3cQ a κ j ++ (seedF3cQ a κ (j + 1)).take 1) u w → Adj (seedF3cPath a κ) u w := by
    intro j u w hj h
    unfold seedF3cPath
    exact famA _ _ _ hQne hHeadW j u w hj h
  have liftT : ∀ (b u w : ℕ), b < a - 1 →
      Adj (seedF3cT a κ b ++ (seedF3cT a κ (b + 1)).take 1) u w → Adj (seedF3cPath a κ) u w := by
    intro b u w hb h
    unfold seedF3cPath
    exact adjR _ _ _ _ (adjR _ _ _ _ (famA _ _ _ hTne hHeadH b u w hb h))
  have liftZ : ∀ (u w : ℕ), Adj (seedF3cZ a κ) u w → Adj (seedF3cPath a κ) u w := by
    intro u w h
    unfold seedF3cPath
    exact adjR _ _ _ _ (adjL _ _ _ _ h)
  have liftH : ∀ (u w : ℕ), Adj (seedF3cH a κ) u w → Adj (seedF3cPath a κ) u w := by
    intro u w h
    unfold seedF3cPath
    exact adjR _ _ _ _ (adjR _ _ _ _ (adjR _ _ _ _ h))
  have hBot : BotPairInv (2 * a + 2 * κ) (seedF3cPath a κ) := by
    refine ⟨⟨a + κ, by ring⟩, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    rcases (show j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ (2 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ a) ∨ (a + 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ κ) ∨ (κ + 1 ≤ j) by omega)
      with h | h | h | h | h
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftH _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cH a κ) 2 0 1 rfl)) (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftZ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cZ a κ) 7 3 2 rfl)) (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftT (j - 2) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cT a κ (j - 2)) 14 (2 * (j - 2) + 5) (2 * (j - 2) + 4) rfl)))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftQ (j - a - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cQ a κ (j - a - 1)) 4 (2 * (j - a - 1) + 2 * a + 2)
          (2 * (j - a - 1) + 2 * a + 3) rfl)))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftT (j - κ - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cT a κ (j - κ - 1)) 1 (2 * (j - κ - 1) + 2 * κ + 2)
          (2 * (j - κ - 1) + 2 * κ + 3) rfl)))
        (by omega)
  have hHead : (seedF3cPath a κ).head? = some (4 * a + 6 * κ + 1) := by
    unfold seedF3cPath
    rw [headFam _ _ _ hQne hHeadW]
    simp only [seedF3cQ, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
    omega
  have hLast : (seedF3cPath a κ).getLast? = some (6 * a + 10 * κ) := by
    unfold seedF3cPath
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc, List.getLast?_append]
    rfl
  have hTop : TopEndInv (2 * a + 4 * κ) (6 * a + 10 * κ + 1) (seedF3cPath a κ) := by
    refine ⟨Or.inr (by rw [hLast]; congr 1), ?_, fun _ => Or.inl (by rw [hHead]; congr 1; omega)⟩
    intro j hj1 hj2
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, i = 3 * a + 5 * κ - j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rcases (show (i ≤ a + 4 * κ) ∨ (a + 4 * κ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i + 1 ≤ 2 * a + 4 * κ) ∨
        i = 2 * a + 4 * κ ∨ i = 2 * a + 4 * κ + 1 ∨ (2 * a + 4 * κ + 2 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 3 * a + 4 * κ) ∨
        (3 * a + 4 * κ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 2 * a + 5 * κ) ∨ (2 * a + 5 * κ + 1 ≤ i) by omega)
      with h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftQ (i - 2 * a - 3 * κ - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjPos _ 9 (2 * (i - 2 * a - 3 * κ - 1) + 4 * a + 6 * κ + 2)
          (2 * (i - 2 * a - 3 * κ - 1 + 1) + 4 * a + 6 * κ + 1) rfl))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftT (i - a - 4 * κ - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cT a κ (i - a - 4 * κ - 1)) 6
          (2 * (i - a - 4 * κ - 1) + 2 * a + 8 * κ + 2) (2 * (i - a - 4 * κ - 1) + 2 * a + 8 * κ + 3)
          rfl)))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftH _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cH a κ) 5 (4 * a + 8 * κ + 1) (4 * a + 8 * κ) rfl))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftZ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cZ a κ) 4 (4 * a + 8 * κ + 2) (4 * a + 8 * κ + 3)
        rfl)) (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftT (i - 2 * a - 4 * κ - 2) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cT a κ (i - 2 * a - 4 * κ - 2)) 11
          (2 * (i - 2 * a - 4 * κ - 2) + 4 * a + 8 * κ + 4)
          (2 * (i - 2 * a - 4 * κ - 2) + 4 * a + 8 * κ + 5) rfl)))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftQ (i - 3 * a - 4 * κ - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cQ a κ (i - 3 * a - 4 * κ - 1)) 7
          (2 * (i - 3 * a - 4 * κ - 1) + 6 * a + 8 * κ + 3)
          (2 * (i - 3 * a - 4 * κ - 1) + 6 * a + 8 * κ + 2) rfl)))
        (by omega)
    · exact adjC _ _ _ _ _ (liftT (i - 2 * a - 5 * κ - 1) _ _ (by omega)
        (adjL _ _ _ _ (adjPos (seedF3cT a κ (i - 2 * a - 5 * κ - 1)) 4
          (2 * (i - 2 * a - 5 * κ - 1) + 4 * a + 10 * κ + 3)
          (2 * (i - 2 * a - 5 * κ - 1) + 4 * a + 10 * κ + 2) rfl)))
        (by omega)
  
  
  
  exact ⟨seedF3cPath a κ, ⟨permOf _ _ hNodup hLen hBound, hEdges⟩, hBot, hTop⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 4 ≤ ℓ → ℓ % 2 = 0 → ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p → TopEndInv ℓ v p → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧ TopEndInv ℓ (v + 2) p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ ≤ v → Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1))

signature.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 4 ≤ ℓ → ℓ % 2 = 0 → ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p → TopEndInv ℓ v p → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧ TopEndInv ℓ (v + 2) p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ ≤ v → Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ v L p h4 hℓ2 hv hp hTE
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
      (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hE1 : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  have el_split : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) =
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ [a]) + (Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l₂)) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ a b
    induction l₁ with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hE1, zero_add]
    | cons c l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c a, hU c a, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons d l' =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [hU c d, hU c d, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  have el_reverse : ∀ q : List ℕ, edgeLengths q.reverse = edgeLengths q := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a r ih =>
      cases r with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b r' =>
        have e1 : (a :: b :: r').reverse = r'.reverse ++ b :: a :: [] := by simp
        have e2 : r'.reverse ++ [b] = (b :: r').reverse := by simp
        have n : Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) = Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by omega
        rw [e1, el_split, e2, ih, hU a b, hE1, Multiset.add_cons, add_zero, n]
  have hO : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (a b u w : ℕ),
      m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ →
      (∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ [a] = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂) ∨
      (∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, b :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂) ∨ (u = a ∧ w = b) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b u w h
    rw [List.append_eq_append_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨as, rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨bs, rfl, h2⟩
    · rcases as with _ | ⟨a₁, _ | ⟨a₂, as'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h2.1, h2.2.1⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inl ⟨m₁, [], by simp⟩
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inl ⟨m₁, as' ++ [a], by simp⟩
    · rcases bs with _ | ⟨b₁, _ | ⟨b₂, bs'⟩⟩
      · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h2.1.symm, h2.2.1.symm⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨[], m₂, by simp⟩)
      · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨b :: bs', m₂, by simp⟩)
  have adj_split : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂) u w →
      Adj (l₁ ++ [a]) u w ∨ Adj (b :: l₂) u w ∨ (u = a ∧ w = b) ∨ (u = b ∧ w = a) := by
    intro l₁ l₂ a b u w hA
    obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := hA
    · rcases hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b u w hm.symm with ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl h⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
    · rcases hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b w u hm.symm with ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | ⟨n₁, n₂, h⟩ | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr h⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩))
  have adj_app : ∀ (P X R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj X u w → Adj (P ++ X ++ R) u w := by
    intro P X R u w hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · exact ⟨P ++ l₁, l₂ ++ R, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨P ++ l₁, l₂ ++ R, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
  have adj_rev : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj X u w → Adj X.reverse u w := by
    intro X u w hA
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
    · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  have hrep : Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ = ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0 := rfl
  have hlast : ∀ (X : List ℕ) (a : ℕ), (X ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
    intro X a
    simp
  
  have hconsI : ∀ (e a b t : ℕ) (A B : List ℕ), a = e + 1 → b = e + 2 → v = e + ℓ →
      t + 1 = v → ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (((e :: A) ++ a :: b :: (B ++ [t])) ++ [v, v + 1]) ∧
      edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths ((e :: A) ++ a :: b :: (B ++ [t])) +
        Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some b ∧ p'.getLast? = some (v + 1) ∧ Adj p' v t ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj ((e :: A) ++ a :: b :: (B ++ [t])) u w →
        ¬(u = a ∧ w = b) → ¬(u = b ∧ w = a) → Adj p' u w := by
    intro e a b t A B ha hb hve ht
    refine ⟨b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])), ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.perm_iff_count]
      intro x
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]
      omega
    · rw [show b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) =
          (b :: B) ++ t :: v :: (e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) from rfl,
        el_split (b :: B) (e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) t v, hU v e,
        show e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1]) = (e :: A) ++ a :: (v + 1) :: [] from rfl,
        el_split (e :: A) [] a (v + 1), hE1,
        el_split (e :: A) (B ++ [t]) a b]
      have n1 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - (t : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have n2 : Int.natAbs ((e : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n3 : Int.natAbs (((v + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n4 : Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [n1, n2, n3, n4, hrep]
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · rw [show b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) =
          (b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a]))) ++ [v + 1] by simp]
      exact hlast _ _
    · exact ⟨b :: B, e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1]), Or.inr (by simp)⟩
    · intro u w h hn1 hn2
      rcases adj_split (e :: A) (B ++ [t]) a b u w h with hX | hY | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have e' : b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) =
            (b :: (B ++ [t, v])) ++ ((e :: A) ++ [a]) ++ [v + 1] := by simp
        rw [e']
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w hX
      · have e' : b :: (B ++ t :: v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) =
            [] ++ (b :: (B ++ [t])) ++ (v :: e :: (A ++ [a, v + 1])) := by simp
        rw [e']
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w hY
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn1
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn2
  
  have hconsII : ∀ (e a b t : ℕ) (A B : List ℕ), a = e + 1 → b = e + 2 → v = e + ℓ →
      t + 1 = v → ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (((e :: A) ++ b :: a :: (B ++ [t])) ++ [v, v + 1]) ∧
      edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths ((e :: A) ++ b :: a :: (B ++ [t])) +
        Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some b ∧ p'.getLast? = some (v + 1) ∧ Adj p' v t ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj ((e :: A) ++ b :: a :: (B ++ [t])) u w →
        ¬(u = a ∧ w = b) → ¬(u = b ∧ w = a) → Adj p' u w := by
    intro e a b t A B ha hb hve ht
    refine ⟨b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])), ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.perm_iff_count]
      intro x
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil, List.count_reverse]
      omega
    · rw [show b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) =
          (b :: A.reverse) ++ e :: v :: (t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) from rfl,
        el_split (b :: A.reverse) (t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) e v, hU v t,
        show t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1]) = (t :: B.reverse) ++ a :: (v + 1) :: [] from rfl,
        el_split (t :: B.reverse) [] a (v + 1), hE1,
        show (b :: A.reverse) ++ [e] = ((e :: A) ++ [b]).reverse by simp,
        show (t :: B.reverse) ++ [a] = (a :: (B ++ [t])).reverse by simp,
        el_reverse, el_reverse, el_split (e :: A) (B ++ [t]) b a]
      have n1 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - (e : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n2 : Int.natAbs ((t : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have n3 : Int.natAbs (((v + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have n4 : Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [n1, n2, n3, n4, hrep]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · rw [show b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) =
          (b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a]))) ++ [v + 1] by simp]
      exact hlast _ _
    · exact ⟨b :: (A.reverse ++ [e]), B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1], Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · intro u w h hn1 hn2
      rcases adj_split (e :: A) (B ++ [t]) b a u w h with hX | hY | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have e' : b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) =
            [] ++ ((e :: A) ++ [b]).reverse ++ (v :: ((a :: (B ++ [t])).reverse ++ [v + 1])) := by
          simp
        rw [e']
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w (adj_rev _ u w hX)
      · have e' : b :: (A.reverse ++ e :: v :: t :: (B.reverse ++ [a, v + 1])) =
            (((e :: A) ++ [b]).reverse ++ [v]) ++ (a :: (B ++ [t])).reverse ++ [v + 1] := by
          simp
        rw [e']
        exact adj_app _ _ _ u w (adj_rev _ u w hY)
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn2
      · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hn1
  have hcons : ∀ Q : List ℕ, (∃ A B : List ℕ,
      Q = ((v - ℓ) :: A) ++ (v - ℓ + 1) :: (v - ℓ + 2) :: (B ++ [v - 1]) ∨
      Q = ((v - ℓ) :: A) ++ (v - ℓ + 2) :: (v - ℓ + 1) :: (B ++ [v - 1])) → ∃ p' : List ℕ,
      p'.Perm (Q ++ [v, v + 1]) ∧ edgeLengths p' = edgeLengths Q + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
      p'.head? = some (v - ℓ + 2) ∧ p'.getLast? = some (v + 1) ∧ Adj p' v (v - 1) ∧
      ∀ u w : ℕ, Adj Q u w → ¬(u = v - ℓ + 1 ∧ w = v - ℓ + 2) →
        ¬(u = v - ℓ + 2 ∧ w = v - ℓ + 1) → Adj p' u w := by
    rintro Q ⟨A, B, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact hconsI (v - ℓ) (v - ℓ + 1) (v - ℓ + 2) (v - 1) A B rfl rfl (by omega) (by omega)
    · exact hconsII (v - ℓ) (v - ℓ + 1) (v - ℓ + 2) (v - 1) A B rfl rfl (by omega) (by omega)
  
  have peel : ∀ (e t : ℕ) (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (α β : ℕ), (l₁ ++ α :: β :: l₂).head? = some e →
      (l₁ ++ α :: β :: l₂).getLast? = some t → α ≠ e → β ≠ t →
      ∃ l₁' l₂' : List ℕ, l₁ = e :: l₁' ∧ l₂ = l₂' ++ [t] := by
    intro e t l₁ l₂ α β hh hl hα hβ
    have h1 : ∃ l₁' : List ℕ, l₁ = e :: l₁' := by
      cases l₁ with
      | nil => simp at hh; exact absurd hh hα
      | cons c l => simp at hh; exact ⟨l, by rw [hh]⟩
    have h2 : ∃ l₂' : List ℕ, l₂ = l₂' ++ [t] := by
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat l₂ with rfl | ⟨L', b, rfl⟩
      · rw [show l₁ ++ α :: β :: [] = (l₁ ++ [α]) ++ [β] by simp, hlast] at hl
        exact absurd (Option.some.inj hl) hβ
      · rw [show l₁ ++ α :: β :: L'.concat b = (l₁ ++ α :: β :: L') ++ [b] by simp, hlast] at hl
        exact ⟨L', by rw [← Option.some.inj hl]; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨l₁', h1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨l₂', h2⟩ := h2
    exact ⟨l₁', l₂', h1, h2⟩
  have hR : List.range (v + 2) = List.range v ++ [v, v + 1] := by
    rw [show v + 2 = v + 1 + 1 from rfl, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
    simp
  
  have core : ∀ q : List ℕ, q.Perm (List.range v) → edgeLengths q = L →
      q.head? = some (v - ℓ) → q.getLast? = some (v - 1) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j + 1 ≤ ℓ → Adj q (v - 2 * j) (v - 1 - 2 * j)) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ) p' ∧
        TopEndInv ℓ (v + 2) p' ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x + ℓ ≤ v → Adj q x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) := by
    intro q hperm hel hh hl hpairs
    have hcut : Adj q (v - ℓ + 2) (v - ℓ + 1) := by
      have h := hpairs (ℓ / 2 - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show v - 2 * (ℓ / 2 - 1) = v - ℓ + 2 by omega,
        show v - 1 - 2 * (ℓ / 2 - 1) = v - ℓ + 1 by omega] at h
      exact h
    have hshape : ∃ A B : List ℕ,
        q = ((v - ℓ) :: A) ++ (v - ℓ + 1) :: (v - ℓ + 2) :: (B ++ [v - 1]) ∨
        q = ((v - ℓ) :: A) ++ (v - ℓ + 2) :: (v - ℓ + 1) :: (B ++ [v - 1]) := by
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := hcut
      · obtain ⟨l₁', l₂', rfl, rfl⟩ := peel (v - ℓ) (v - 1) l₁ l₂ (v - ℓ + 2) (v - ℓ + 1)
          (h ▸ hh) (h ▸ hl) (by omega) (by omega)
        exact ⟨l₁', l₂', Or.inr h⟩
      · obtain ⟨l₁', l₂', rfl, rfl⟩ := peel (v - ℓ) (v - 1) l₁ l₂ (v - ℓ + 1) (v - ℓ + 2)
          (h ▸ hh) (h ▸ hl) (by omega) (by omega)
        exact ⟨l₁', l₂', Or.inl h⟩
    obtain ⟨p', hP, hE, hH, hL, hvt, hT⟩ := hcons q hshape
    refine ⟨p', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show p'.Perm (List.range (v + 2))
      rw [hR]
      exact hP.trans (hperm.append_right _)
    · rw [hE, hel]
    · right
      rw [show v + 2 - 1 = v + 1 by omega]
      exact hL
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j 2 with hj | hj
      · have hj' : j = 1 := by omega
        subst hj'
        rw [show v + 2 - 2 * 1 = v by omega, show v + 2 - 1 - 2 * 1 = v - 1 by omega]
        exact hvt
      · have h := hpairs (j - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [show v - 2 * (j - 1) = v + 2 - 2 * j by omega,
          show v - 1 - 2 * (j - 1) = v + 2 - 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact hT _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro _
      left
      rw [show v + 2 - ℓ = v - ℓ + 2 by omega]
      exact hH
    · intro x hx hA
      exact hT _ _ hA (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨h0, hpairs, hev⟩ := hTE
  have hend := hev (Nat.even_iff.mpr hℓ2)
  unfold IsEnd at h0 hend
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> rcases hend with he | he
  · have := Option.some.inj (h0.symm.trans he)
    omega
  · obtain ⟨p', h1, h2, h3⟩ := core p.reverse ((List.reverse_perm p).trans hp.1)
      (by rw [el_reverse]; exact hp.2) (by rw [List.head?_reverse]; exact he)
      (by rw [List.getLast?_reverse]; exact h0)
      (fun j hj1 hj2 => adj_rev _ _ _ (hpairs j hj1 hj2))
    exact ⟨p', h1, h2, fun x hx hA => h3 x hx (adj_rev _ _ _ hA)⟩
  · exact core p hp.1 hp.2 he h0 hpairs
  · have := Option.some.inj (h0.symm.trans he)
    omega

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

  · exact bEE_cm1 y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 h6 hb2'

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization

  intro y k hk hyk hy hk2

    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩

    rintro p x x' h rfl

    intro x a t; rfl

      | nil => rfl

        have e' : (b :: t').map (· + 1) = (b + 1) :: t'.map (· + 1) := rfl

    intro l a b
