            edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have ones1 : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        Adj p' 0 1 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) := by
    intro v L p hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    have hperm0 : (0 :: p.map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + 1)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      exact (hq.map _).cons 0
    have hadj : ∀ (pre suf : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), Adj p x (x + 1) →
        Adj (pre ++ p.map (· + 1) ++ suf) (x + 1) (x + 2) := by
      rintro pre suf x ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · refine ⟨pre ++ l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1) ++ suf, Or.inl ?_⟩
        rw [h]; simp
      · refine ⟨pre ++ l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1) ++ suf, Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [h]; simp
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl,
        ⟨[], t.map (· + 1), Or.inl rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · have e : (0 :: t).map (· + 1) = (0 + 1) :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e2 := s2 (0 :: t)
        rw [e] at e2
        have hM1 : L + Multiset.replicate 1 1 = 1 ::ₘ L := by
          rw [Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
        rw [e, s1, e2, hM, hM1]
        congr 1
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [0] [] x hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨(t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0],
        ⟨(List.perm_append_singleton 0 _).trans hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp),
        ⟨t.map (· + 1), [], Or.inr (by simp)⟩, ?_⟩
      · have e : (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0] = t.map (· + 1) ++ [0 + 1, 0] := by simp
        have e2 : t.map (· + 1) ++ [0 + 1] = (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) := by simp
        rw [e, s3, e2, s2, hM, Multiset.replicate_one]
        congr 2
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [] [0] x hx
  
  have ones : ∀ (s v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + s) (L + Multiset.replicate s 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x < s → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + s) (x + s + 1)) := by
    intro s v L p hp he
    induction s with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, he, fun x hx => absurd hx (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
        fun x hx => by simpa using hx⟩
    | succ s ih =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe, hqa, hqk⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'e, hq'0, hq'k⟩ := ones1 _ _ q hq hqe
      refine ⟨q', ?_, hq'e, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have e1 : v + s + 1 = v + (s + 1) := by ring
        have e2 : L + Multiset.replicate s 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 =
            L + Multiset.replicate (s + 1) 1 := by
          rw [Multiset.replicate_add, add_assoc]
        rw [e1, e2] at hq'
        exact hq'
      · intro x hx
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h0 | hpos
        · subst h0; exact hq'0
        · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hq'k (x - 1) (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hqa (x - 1) (by omega)) rfl
            (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
      · intro x hx
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hq'k _ (hqk x hx)) (by omega) (by omega)
  
  have hrun : ∀ (n a : ℕ), edgeLengths (List.range' a (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
      Multiset.replicate n 1 + {a + n} + {1} := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a
      show edgeLengths [a, 0, 1] = _
      rw [s1, s1, s0]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a
      have e : List.range' a (n + 1 + 1) ++ [0, 1] =
          a :: (a + 1) :: (List.range' (a + 1 + 1) n ++ [0, 1]) := by
        rw [List.range'_succ, List.range'_succ]; rfl
      have e' : List.range' (a + 1) (n + 1) ++ [0, 1] =
          (a + 1) :: (List.range' (a + 1 + 1) n ++ [0, 1]) := by
        rw [List.range'_succ]; rfl
      rw [e, s1, ← e', ih (a + 1)]
      have h1 : Int.natAbs (((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [h1, Multiset.replicate_succ, show a + 1 + n = a + (n + 1) by ring, Multiset.cons_add,
        Multiset.cons_add]
  have seed : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (n + 5)
      (Multiset.replicate (n + 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 2 (n + 2)) Q ∧ Adj Q 0 1 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ n + 2 → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧ Adj Q (n + 3) (n + 4) ∧ IsEnd Q 1 := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨[n + 3, n + 4] ++ (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold IsVertexPerm
      have hr : List.range (n + 5) = ([0, 1] ++ List.range' 2 (n + 1)) ++ [n + 3, n + 4] := by
        rw [List.range_eq_range', show n + 5 = 2 + (n + 1) + 2 by ring,
          ← List.range'_append_1 (s := 0) (m := 2 + (n + 1)) (n := 2),
          ← List.range'_append_1 (s := 0) (m := 2) (n := n + 1)]
        simp [List.range'_succ]
        omega
      rw [hr]
      exact List.perm_append_comm.trans (List.perm_append_comm.append_right _)
    · show edgeLengths ((n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1])) = _
      have eR : List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1] = 2 :: (List.range' (2 + 1) n ++ [0, 1]) := by
        rw [List.range'_succ]; rfl
      rw [s1, eR, s1, ← eR, hrun n 2]
      have h1 : Int.natAbs (((n + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have h2 : Int.natAbs (((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = n + 2 := by omega
      rw [h1, h2, show 2 + n = n + 2 by ring]
      have hr1 : Multiset.replicate (n + 2) 1 = {1} + ({1} + Multiset.replicate n 1) := by
        rw [Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.singleton_add,
          Multiset.singleton_add]
      have hr2 : Multiset.replicate 2 (n + 2) = {n + 2} + {n + 2} := by
        rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.replicate_one,
          Multiset.singleton_add]
      rw [← Multiset.singleton_add, ← Multiset.singleton_add, hr1, hr2]
      abel
    · exact ⟨[n + 3, n + 4] ++ List.range' 2 (n + 1), [], Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = 2 + i := ⟨x - 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, n = i + 1 + j := ⟨n - i - 1, by omega⟩
      have hR : List.range' 2 (n + 1) =
          List.range' 2 i ++ (2 + i) :: (2 + i + 1) :: List.range' (2 + i + 1 + 1) j := by
        rw [hj, show i + 1 + j + 1 = i + (j + 1 + 1) by ring, ← List.range'_append_1,
          List.range'_succ, List.range'_succ]
      refine ⟨[n + 3, n + 4] ++ List.range' 2 i, List.range' (2 + i + 1 + 1) j ++ [0, 1],
        Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [hR]
      simp
    · exact ⟨[], List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · right
      rw [show [n + 3, n + 4] ++ (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
          ([n + 3, n + 4] ++ List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0]) ++ [1] by simp,
        List.getLast?_concat]
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, y - k = 2 * t + 2 := ⟨(y - k - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨Q3, hQ3, hQ3a, hQ3b, hQ3c, hQ3e⟩ := seed (2 * t)
  obtain ⟨Q2, hQ2, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs (2 * t + 2) (2 * t + 5) t _ Q3 (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hQ3
    (fun i hi => adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQ3b (2 * t - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  have hQ2b : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → x ≤ 2 * t → Adj Q2 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases hx : x < 2 * t
    · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hN2 (x / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h := hK2 0 hQ3a (by intro i hi; omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  have hQ2c : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → 2 * t + 3 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 * t + 3 → Adj Q2 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    have h0 : Adj Q3 (x - 2 * t) (x - 2 * t + 1) := by
      by_cases hx : x - 2 * t ≤ 2 * t + 1
      · exact hQ3b _ (by omega) (by omega)
      · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ hQ3c (by omega) (by omega)
    have h := hK2 _ h0 (by intro i hi; omega)
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  have hQ2e : IsEnd Q2 (2 * t + 2 - 1) := endc _ _ _ (hE2 1 hQ3e) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨Q1, hQ1, hE1, hK1, -⟩ := bot_attach (2 * t + 2) (2 * t + 5 + 2 * t) _ Q2 (by omega)
    (by omega) hQ2 hQ2e
  have hQ1b : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → x ≤ 2 * t + 1 → Adj Q1 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK1 _ (hQ2b (x - 1) (by omega) (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hQ1c : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → 2 * t + 4 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 * t + 4 → Adj Q1 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK1 _ (hQ2c (x - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))) (by omega)
      (by omega)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hE, hP, hK⟩ := ones (k - 1) _ _ Q1 hQ1 hE1
  have hQb : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → x + 2 ≤ y → Adj Q x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases hx : x < k - 1
    · exact hP x hx
    · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK _ (hQ1b (x - (k - 1)) (by omega) (by omega))) (by omega)
        (by omega)
  have hQc : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 * j + 2 ≤ y - k →
      Adj Q (4 * t + 3 + k - 2 * j) (4 * t + 4 + k - 2 * j) := by
    intro j hj
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK _ (hQ1c (4 * t + 4 - 2 * j) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)))
      (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨hp, hA5, hE5⟩ := reflect_realization (2 * t + 5 + 2 * t + 1 + (k - 1)) _ Q hQ
  generalize Q.map (fun x => 2 * t + 5 + 2 * t + 1 + (k - 1) - 1 - x) = p at hp hA5 hE5
  have hv : (y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 0 + 1 = 2 * t + 5 + 2 * t + 1 + (k - 1) := by omega
  have hL : prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k + 1) 0 =
      Multiset.replicate (2 * t + 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 2 (2 * t + 2) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (2 * t + 2) + Multiset.replicate 1 (2 * t + 2) +
        Multiset.replicate (k - 1) 1 := by
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [ht, show y - 1 = 2 * t + 2 + (k - 1) by omega, show 2 * t + 2 + 1 = 2 + 2 * t + 1 by ring,
      Multiset.replicate_add (2 * t + 2) (k - 1) 1,
      Multiset.replicate_add (2 + 2 * t) 1 (2 * t + 2),
      Multiset.replicate_add 2 (2 * t) (2 * t + 2), Multiset.replicate_zero]
    abel
  rw [hv, hL]
  refine ⟨p, hp, ⟨Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    have h := adj_symm _ _ _ (hA5 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hQc j hj))
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  · exact endc _ _ _ (hE5 0 (by omega) hE) (by omega)
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    have h := hA5 _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hQb (2 * j - 1) (by omega) (by omega))
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  · intro he
    have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
    omega

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k t : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 1 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ k → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 2 * t + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k + 1) (2 * t)) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 2 * t + 1) p

signature.name: lowDeven
signature.statement: ∀ (y k t : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 1 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ k → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 2 * t + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k + 1) (2 * t)) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 2 * t + 1) p

by

    fun A B u w => ⟨A, B, Or.inl rfl⟩
  have adjMid : ∀ (A : List ℕ) (a u w : ℕ) (B : List ℕ), Adj (A ++ a :: u :: w :: B) u w :=

        econs' (2 * (t + m) + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * (t + m) + 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * (t + m) + 1) c' 1 _ (by omega)]
      rw [show 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 1 + 1 by ring, rs (2 * m + 1), rs (2 * m + 1), rs (2 * m),
        rs (2 * m)]
      abel
  have ZA : ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : List ℕ) (i : ℕ), i < m →
      Adj (ldvZR μ t m ++ T) (2 * (t + i)) (2 * (t + i) + 1) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro T i hi; omega
    | succ m ih =>
      intro T i hi
      rw [Zsucc, List.append_assoc]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i m with h | h
      · exact ih _ i h
      · obtain rfl : i = m := by omega
        simp only [ldvBlock, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        exact adjMid _ _ _ _ _
  have ZB : ∀ (m c' : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), c' = 2 * μ + 2 * (t + m) → ∀ i, i < m →
      Adj (ldvZR μ t m ++ c' :: T) (2 * μ + 2 * (t + i) + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * (t + i) + 2) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro c' T _ i hi; omega
    | succ m ih =>
      intro c' T hc i hi
      rw [Zsucc, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [ldvBlock, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i m with h | h
      · exact ih (2 * μ + 2 * (t + m)) _ rfl i h
      · obtain rfl : i = m := by omega
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (adjMid3 (ldvZR μ t i) _ _ _ _ _ T) rfl (by omega)
  have Zhead : ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∃ T', ldvZR μ t m ++ T = (2 * μ + 2 * t) :: T' := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro T h; omega
    | succ m ih =>
      intro T _
      rw [Zsucc, List.append_assoc]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h0 | hm
      · subst h0
        simp [ldvZR, ldvBlock]
      · exact ih _ hm
  have Zmem : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ z ∈ ldvBlock μ (t + i), z ∈ ldvZR μ t n :=
    fun i hi z hz => List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, hz⟩
  
  
  
  have Usucc : ∀ r, ldvUnits μ κ (r + 1) = ldvUnit μ κ r ++ ldvUnits μ κ r := by
    intro r
    simp [ldvUnits, List.range_succ]
  have Uhead : ∀ (r : ℕ) (X : List ℕ), ∃ T',
      ldvUnits μ κ r ++ (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) :: X = (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * r + 2) :: T' := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro X; exact ⟨X, by simp [ldvUnits]⟩
    | succ r ih =>
      intro X
      rw [Usucc, List.append_assoc]
      refine ⟨(ldvUnit μ κ r).tail ++ (ldvUnits μ κ r ++ (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) :: X), ?_⟩
      simp only [ldvUnit, List.cons_append, List.tail_cons]
      congr 1
  have UE : ∀ (r : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (ldvUnits μ κ r ++ (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) :: X) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) (2 * μ) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) +
        edgeLengths ((4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) :: X) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro X; simp [ldvUnits]
    | succ r ih =>
      intro X
      rw [Usucc, List.append_assoc]
      obtain ⟨T', hT'⟩ := Uhead r X
      rw [hT']
      simp only [ldvUnit, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [econs' (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * r + 4) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * r + 3) 1 _ (by omega),
        econs' (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * r + 3) (2 * μ + 2 * r + 2) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * r + 2) (4 * μ + 2 * r + 2) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (4 * μ + 2 * r + 2) (4 * μ + 2 * r + 1) 1 _ (by omega),
        econs' (4 * μ + 2 * r + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * r + 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * r + 1) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * r + 2) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) _ (by omega),
        ← hT', ih]
      rw [show 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 by ring, rs (2 * r + 1), rs (2 * r + 1), rs (2 * r + 1),
        rs (2 * r), rs (2 * r), rs (2 * r)]
      abel
  have UA : ∀ (r : ℕ) (T : List ℕ) (i : ℕ), i < r →
      Adj (ldvUnits μ κ r ++ T) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * i + 4) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * i + 3) ∧
      Adj (ldvUnits μ κ r ++ T) (4 * μ + 2 * i + 2) (4 * μ + 2 * i + 1) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro T i hi; omega
    | succ r ih =>
      intro T i hi
      rw [Usucc, List.append_assoc]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i r with h | h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih T i h
        exact ⟨adjL h1, adjL h2⟩
      · obtain rfl : i = r := by omega
        simp only [ldvUnit, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        exact ⟨adjHere [] _ _ _, adjMid3 [] _ _ _ _ _ _⟩
  have Umem : ∀ i, i < s → ∀ z ∈ ldvUnit μ κ i, z ∈ ldvUnits μ κ s :=
    fun i hi z hz => List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨i, List.mem_reverse.2 (List.mem_range.2 hi), hz⟩
  
  
  
  have Rsucc : ∀ c M, ldvRun c (M + 1) = ldvRun c M ++ [c - M] := by
    intro c M
    simp [ldvRun, List.range_succ]
  have RE : ∀ c M, M ≤ c → edgeLengths (ldvRun c (M + 1)) = Multiset.replicate M 1 := by
    intro c M
    induction M with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Rsucc]; simp [ldvRun, esing]
    | succ M ih =>
      intro h
      rw [Rsucc, Rsucc, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, G, ← Rsucc, ih (by omega),
        econs' (c - M) (c - (M + 1)) 1 _ (by omega), esing, rs]
      simp
  have Rhead : ∀ c M, ∃ R', ldvRun c (M + 1) = c :: R' := by
    intro c M
    induction M with
    | zero => exact ⟨[], by simp [ldvRun]⟩
    | succ M ih =>
      obtain ⟨R', h⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨R' ++ [c - (M + 1)], by rw [Rsucc, h]; rfl⟩
  have RA : ∀ c M i, i + 1 < M → Adj (ldvRun c M) (c - i) (c - (i + 1)) := by
    intro c M i hi
    obtain ⟨A, B, h⟩ := rsplit M i hi
    unfold ldvRun
    rw [h, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_cons]
    exact adjHere _ _ _ _
  have Rmem : ∀ c M i, i < M → c - i ∈ ldvRun c M :=
    fun c M i hi => List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩
  have RgE : ∀ m, edgeLengths (List.range (m + 1)) = Multiset.replicate m 1 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => rw [List.range_one, esing]; simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.range_succ, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, G,
        ← List.range_succ, ih, econs' m (m + 1) 1 _ (by omega), esing, rs]
      simp
  have RgA : ∀ m a, a + 1 < m → Adj (List.range m) a (a + 1) := by
    intro m a h
    obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := rsplit m a h
    rw [hAB]
    exact adjHere A B _ _
  
  
  
  have liftZ : ∀ u w, Adj (ldvZR μ t n ++ (4 * μ :: 2 * μ :: (List.range (2 * t) ++
      (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1))))) u w →
      Adj (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)) u w := by
    intro u w h
    unfold ldvList
    exact adjCons h
  have liftY : ∀ u w, Adj (List.range (2 * t) ++
      (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1))) u w →
      Adj (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)) u w := by
    intro u w h
    unfold ldvList
    exact adjCons (adjL (adjCons (adjCons h)))
  have liftW : ∀ u w, Adj (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1)) u w →
      Adj (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)) u w := by
    intro u w h
    exact liftY u w (adjL (adjCons h))
  have memZ : ∀ z, z ∈ ldvZR μ t n → z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    unfold ldvList
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_left _ hz)
  have memY : ∀ z, z ∈ List.range (2 * t) → z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    unfold ldvList
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
      (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_left _ hz))))
  have memW : ∀ z, z ∈ ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1) →
      z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    unfold ldvList
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
      (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)))))
  have memH : 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 1 ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    unfold ldvList; simp
  have mem4 : 4 * μ ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    unfold ldvList; simp
  have mem2 : 2 * μ ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    unfold ldvList; simp
  have memb : 2 * μ + 2 * t - 1 ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    unfold ldvList; simp
  have memZb : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ z ∈ ldvBlock μ (t + i), z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) :=
    fun i hi z hz => memZ z (Zmem i hi z hz)
  have memUu : ∀ i, i < s → ∀ z ∈ ldvUnit μ κ i, z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) :=
    fun i hi z hz => memW z (List.mem_append_left _ (Umem i hi z hz))
  have memRr : ∀ i, i < N + 1 → 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 - i ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) :=
    fun i hi => memW _ (List.mem_append_right _ (Rmem _ _ i hi))
  have cv : ∀ z x : ℕ, z ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) → z = x → x ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) :=
    fun z x h e => e ▸ h
  
  
  
  have Zlen : ∀ m, (ldvZR μ t m).length = 4 * m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [ldvZR]
    | succ m ih => rw [Zsucc, List.length_append, ih]; simp [ldvBlock]; ring
  have Ulen : ∀ r, (ldvUnits μ κ r).length = 6 * r := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => simp [ldvUnits]
    | succ r ih => rw [Usucc, List.length_append, ih]; simp [ldvUnit]; ring
  have hlen : (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)).length = 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2 := by
    unfold ldvList
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, Zlen, Ulen, ldvRun, List.length_map,
      List.length_range]
    omega
  have cover : ∀ x, x < 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2 → x ∈ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨q, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ q, x = 2 * q ∨ x = 2 * q + 1 := ⟨x / 2, by omega⟩
    · by_cases c1 : q < t
      · exact memY _ (List.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      by_cases c2 : q < μ
      · exact cv (2 * (t + (q - t))) _ (memZb (q - t) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvBlock])) (by omega)
      by_cases c3 : q = μ
      · exact cv _ _ mem2 (by omega)
      by_cases c4 : q ≤ μ + s
      · exact cv (2 * μ + 2 * (q - μ - 1) + 2) _
          (memUu (q - μ - 1) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      by_cases c5 : q < 2 * μ
      · exact cv (2 * μ + 2 * (t + (q - μ - t))) _
          (memZb (q - μ - t) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvBlock])) (by omega)
      by_cases c6 : q = 2 * μ
      · exact cv _ _ mem4 (by omega)
      by_cases c7 : q ≤ 2 * μ + s
      · exact cv (4 * μ + 2 * (q - 2 * μ - 1) + 2) _
          (memUu (q - 2 * μ - 1) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      by_cases c8 : q ≤ 2 * μ + κ + 1
      · exact cv _ _ (memRr (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 - 2 * q) (by omega)) (by omega)
      by_cases c9 : q ≤ 2 * μ + κ + t
      · exact cv (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * (q - 2 * μ - κ - 2) + 4) _
          (memUu (q - 2 * μ - κ - 2) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      omega
    · by_cases c1 : q < t
      · exact memY _ (List.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      by_cases c2 : q < μ
      · exact cv (2 * (t + (q - t)) + 1) _ (memZb (q - t) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvBlock]))
          (by omega)
      by_cases c3 : q < μ + s
      · exact cv (2 * μ + 2 * (q - μ) + 1) _
          (memUu (q - μ) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      by_cases c4 : q = μ + s
      · exact cv _ _ memb (by omega)
      by_cases c5 : q < 2 * μ
      · exact cv (2 * μ + 2 * (t + (q - μ - t)) + 1) _
          (memZb (q - μ - t) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvBlock])) (by omega)
      by_cases c6 : q < 2 * μ + s
      · exact cv (4 * μ + 2 * (q - 2 * μ) + 1) _
          (memUu (q - 2 * μ) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      by_cases c7 : q ≤ 2 * μ + κ
      · exact cv _ _ (memRr (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 1 - 2 * q) (by omega)) (by omega)
      by_cases c8 : q < 2 * μ + κ + t
      · exact cv (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * (q - 2 * μ - κ - 1) + 3) _
          (memUu (q - 2 * μ - κ - 1) (by omega) _ (by simp [ldvUnit])) (by omega)
      by_cases c9 : q = 2 * μ + κ + t
      · exact cv _ _ memH (by omega)
      omega
  have hperm : (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)).Perm (List.range (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2)) := by
    have hsub : List.range (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2) ⊆ ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1) :=
      fun x hx => cover x (List.mem_range.1 hx)
    have h1 := List.subperm_of_subset List.nodup_range hsub
    exact (h1.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm
  
  
  
  have hedges : edgeLengths (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)) =
      {2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1} + (Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (2 * μ) + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 +
        ({2 * μ} + ({2 * μ} + ((Multiset.replicate (2 * s + 1) 1 + {2 * μ}) +
          ({2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1} + (Multiset.replicate (2 * s) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (2 * μ) +
            Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) + Multiset.replicate N 1)))))) := by
    obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := Rhead (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) N
    obtain ⟨T1, hT1⟩ := Uhead s R'
    have hEW : edgeLengths (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1)) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * s) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (2 * μ) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) + Multiset.replicate N 1 := by
      rw [hR', UE s R', ← hR', RE _ N (by omega)]
    have hEbW : edgeLengths ((2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) ::
        (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1))) =
        {2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1} + edgeLengths (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1)) := by
      rw [hR', hT1, econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * s + 2) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) _
        (by omega)]
    have hRb : edgeLengths (List.range (2 * t) ++ [2 * μ + 2 * t - 1]) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * s + 1) 1 + {2 * μ} := by
      have h2t : List.range (2 * t) = List.range (2 * s + 1) ++ [2 * s + 1] := by
        rw [show 2 * t = 2 * s + 1 + 1 by omega, List.range_succ]
      rw [h2t, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, G, ← List.range_succ, RgE,
        econs' (2 * s + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega), esing, add_zero]
    obtain ⟨R0, hR0⟩ : ∃ R0, List.range (2 * t) = 0 :: R0 :=
      ⟨_, by rw [show 2 * t = 2 * s + 1 + 1 by omega, List.range_succ_eq_map]⟩
    have hE2 : ∀ W : List ℕ, edgeLengths (2 * μ :: (List.range (2 * t) ++ (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: W)) =
        {2 * μ} + edgeLengths (List.range (2 * t) ++ (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: W) := by
      intro W
      rw [hR0, List.cons_append, econs' (2 * μ) 0 (2 * μ) _ (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨T0, hT0⟩ := Zhead n (4 * μ :: 2 * μ :: (List.range (2 * t) ++
      (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1)))) hn1
    have hE1 : edgeLengths (ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1)) = {2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1} +
        edgeLengths (ldvZR μ t n ++ (4 * μ :: 2 * μ :: (List.range (2 * t) ++
          (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) :: (ldvUnits μ κ s ++ ldvRun (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1))))) := by
      unfold ldvList
      rw [hT0, econs' (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t) (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) _ (by omega)]
    rw [hE1, ZE n (4 * μ) _ (by omega), econs' (4 * μ) (2 * μ) (2 * μ) _ (by omega), hE2, G, hRb,
      hEbW, hEW]
  
  
  
  rw [show (y - 1) + (y - k + 1) + 2 * t + 1 = 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2 by omega]
  refine ⟨ldvList μ κ t n s (N + 1), ⟨hperm, ?_⟩, ⟨Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hedges, show y - 1 = 2 * n + (2 * s + 1) + 2 * s + N by omega,
      show y - k + 1 = 2 * n + 2 * s + 1 + 1 + 1 by omega, show y - k = 2 * μ by omega,
      show 2 * t = 2 * s + 1 + 1 by omega, hμ]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_add, Multiset.replicate_one]
    abel
  · 
    intro j hj
    by_cases hjt : j < t
    · exact liftY _ _ (adjR (RgA (2 * t) (2 * j) (by omega)))
    · exact liftZ _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (ZA n _ (j - t) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  · 
    left
    unfold ldvList
    rw [show 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2 - 1 = 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 1 by omega]
    rfl
  · 
    intro j hj1 hj2
    by_cases c1 : j ≤ s
    · exact liftW _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (UA s _ (s - j) (by omega)).1 (by omega) (by omega))
    by_cases c2 : j ≤ κ + 1
    · exact liftW _ _ (adjL (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (RA (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (N + 1) (2 * j - 2 * t)
        (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)))
    by_cases c3 : j ≤ κ + t
    · exact liftW _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (UA s _ (κ + t - j) (by omega)).2 (by omega) (by omega))
    · exact liftZ _ _ (adjsymm _ _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (ZB n (4 * μ) _ (by omega) (μ + κ - j)
        (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)))
  · 
    intro he
    have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
    omega

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k) + 1 + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k) 1) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k) + 1 + 1) p

signature.statement: ∀ (y k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k) + 1 + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k) 1) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k) + 1 + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k hk hyk hy hk2
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have adjsymm : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have endc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, 2 * μ = y - k := ⟨(y - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hR, hRa, -, hRe⟩ := path_range y (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P1, hP1, hP10, hK1, -⟩ := bot_attach y y _ _ (by omega) le_rfl hR hRe
  
  obtain ⟨hQ, hQA, hQE⟩ := reflect_realization (y + 1) _ P1 hP1
  have hQadj : ∀ z : ℕ, z + 2 ≤ y → Adj (P1.map (fun x => y + 1 - 1 - x)) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := hK1 (y - 2 - z) (hRa (y - 2 - z) (by omega))
    have h2 := hQA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h1

  have hQend : IsEnd (P1.map (fun x => y + 1 - 1 - x)) y :=
    endc _ _ _ (hQE 0 (by omega) hP10) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hB, hK, hE⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) μ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    hQ (by
      intro i hi

  have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * μ) (y - k) = prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k) 1 := by
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hμ]
    abel
  rw [show (y - 1) + (y - k) + 1 + 1 = y + 1 + 2 * μ by omega, ← hL]
  refine ⟨P, hP, ⟨Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega), fun j hj => hB j (by omega)⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k t : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 1 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ k → 2 * t + 1 + k ≤ y - k → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k) + (2 * t + 1) + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k) (2 * t + 1)) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k) + (2 * t + 1) + 1) p

signature.name: lowCodd
signature.statement: ∀ (y k t : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 1 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ k → 2 * t + 1 + k ≤ y - k → ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization ((y - 1) + (y - k) + (2 * t + 1) + 1) (prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (y - k) (2 * t + 1)) p ∧ BotPairInv (y - k) p ∧ TopEndInv y ((y - 1) + (y - k) + (2 * t + 1) + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have T1 : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: l) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - c) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: l) := fun c d l => rfl
  have E1 : ∀ c : ℕ, edgeLengths [c] = 0 := fun c => rfl
  have T2 : ∀ (l₁ : List ℕ) (c : ℕ) (l₂ : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (l₁ ++ c :: l₂) = edgeLengths (l₁ ++ [c]) + edgeLengths (c :: l₂) := by
    intro l₁ c l₂
    induction l₁ with
    | nil => rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, E1, zero_add]
    | cons d l₁ ih =>
      cases l₁ with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
        rw [T1, T1, E1, Multiset.cons_add, zero_add]
      | cons e l₁ =>
        simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
        rw [T1, T1, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have adjc : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj l u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj l u' w' := by
    rintro l u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have swap : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj l w u := by
    rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have adjL : ∀ (p l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj (p ++ l) u w := by
    rintro p l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨p ++ l₁, l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨p ++ l₁, l₂, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
  have adjR : ∀ (l q : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj (l ++ q) u w := by
    rintro l q u w ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ q, Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ q, Or.inr (by simp)⟩
  have adjAt : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ u :: w :: l₂) u w :=
    fun l₁ l₂ u w => ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl rfl⟩
  have adjMem : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → u ∈ l ∧ w ∈ l := by
    rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ <;> simp
  have consEq : ∀ (x x' : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), x = x' → x :: r = x' :: r := by
    rintro x x' r rfl
    rfl
  
  have GC : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℕ) (B : Multiset ℕ), (∀ i, ∃ r, f i = h i :: r) →
      (∀ i, edgeLengths (f i ++ [h (i + 1)]) = B) → ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths ((List.range n).flatMap f ++ h n :: X) = n • B + edgeLengths (h n :: X) ∧
      (∃ r, (List.range n).flatMap f ++ h n :: X = h 0 :: r) ∧
      (∀ i, i < n → ∀ u w, Adj (f i ++ [h (i + 1)]) u w →
        Adj ((List.range n).flatMap f ++ h n :: X) u w) := by
    intro f h B hf hB n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro X
      exact ⟨by simp, ⟨X, by simp⟩, fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro X
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hf n
      have eq : (List.range (n + 1)).flatMap f ++ h (n + 1) :: X =
          (List.range n).flatMap f ++ h n :: (r ++ h (n + 1) :: X) := by
        rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.append_assoc, hr,
          List.cons_append]
      obtain ⟨e, hd, ad⟩ := ih (r ++ h (n + 1) :: X)
      rw [eq]
      refine ⟨?_, hd, ?_⟩
      · rw [e, show h n :: (r ++ h (n + 1) :: X) = (h n :: r) ++ h (n + 1) :: X from rfl, T2, ← hr,
          hB, succ_nsmul, add_assoc]
      · intro i hi u w hadj
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i n with h' | h'
        · exact ad i h' u w hadj
        · have hin : i = n := by omega
          rw [hin] at hadj
          have e' : (List.range n).flatMap f ++ h n :: (r ++ h (n + 1) :: X) =
              (List.range n).flatMap f ++ ((f n ++ [h (n + 1)]) ++ X) := by
            rw [hr]; simp
          rw [e']
          exact adjL _ _ u w (adjR _ _ u w hadj)
  have LC : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (c : ℕ), (∀ i, (f i).length = c) → ∀ n,

    intro f c hc n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.length_append, ih, hc]
      ring
  
  intro y k t hk hyk hy hk2 ht h1 h2

  rw [hv]

    · simp only [Madd, add_zero]
    all_goals omega

    · simp only [Madd, add_zero]
    all_goals omega
  have hBR0 : ∀ i, edgeLengths ([k + i] ++ [k + (i + 1)]) = lcoM m k 1 0 0 := by

  have hBRR : ∀ i, edgeLengths ([2 * m + 2 * t + i] ++ [2 * m + 2 * t + (i + 1)]) =

  obtain ⟨e6, ⟨r6, hr6⟩, ad6⟩ := GRR (2 * a) []

lowCodd.definitions:
def lcoZ1 (m t i : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  [2 * t + 2 * i + 1, m + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1, m + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 2]

def lcoZ2 (m k t i : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  [m + k + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1, k + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1, k + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, m + k + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2]

def lcoU (m k i : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  [2 * m + 2 * i, m + 2 * i, 2 * m + k + 2 * i, 2 * m + k + 2 * i + 1, m + k + 2 * i + 1, m + k + 2 * i,
    2 * i, 2 * i + 1, m + 2 * i + 1, 2 * m + 2 * i + 1]

def lcoS6 (m t a : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (2 * a)).flatMap (fun i => [2 * m + 2 * t + i]) ++ [2 * m + 2 * t + 2 * a]

def lcoS5 (m k t a : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range t).flatMap (lcoU m k) ++ lcoS6 m t a

def lcoS4 (m k t a b : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range b).flatMap (lcoZ2 m k t) ++ lcoS5 m k t a

def lcoS3 (m k t a b : ℕ) : List ℕ := (k + 2 * t) :: (m + k + 2 * t) :: lcoS4 m k t a b

def lcoS2 (m k t a b : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range (2 * t)).flatMap (fun i => [k + i]) ++ lcoS3 m k t a b

def lcoS1 (m k t a b : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range a).flatMap (lcoZ1 m t) ++ lcoS2 m k t a b

def lcoList (m k t a b : ℕ) : List ℕ := [2 * m + k + 2 * t, m + 2 * t, 2 * t] ++ lcoS1 m k t a b

def lcoM (m k x y z : ℕ) : Multiset ℕ :=
  Multiset.replicate x 1 + Multiset.replicate y m + Multiset.replicate z (m + k)

  · 
    left
    unfold lcvPath
    rw [show 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 2 - 1 = 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * t + 1 by omega]
    rfl
  · 
    intro j hj1 hj2
    by_cases c1 : j + 1 ≤ t
    · rcases lt_trichotomy (t - 1 - j) a with h | h | h
      · exact liftG1 _ _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ (UA 0 a _ (t - 1 - j) h).1 (by omega) (by omega))
      · exact liftR7 _ _ (adjL (adjc _ _ _ _ _
          (adjHere [] [2 * μ + 2 * a + 2] (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * a + 4) (4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2 * a + 3))
          (by omega) (by omega)))

    by_cases c3 : j ≤ κ + t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro v s E hs hE hlen hdeg hleaf hconn
  classical
  
  have nd3 : ∀ (L l : List ℕ) (a x : ℕ), (L ++ a :: x :: a :: l).Nodup → False := by
    intro L l a x h
    have h2 := (List.nodup_cons.mp ((List.nodup_append.mp h).2.1)).1
    exact h2 (by simp)
  
  have bound : ∀ q : List ℕ, q.Nodup → (∀ x ∈ q, x < v) → q.length ≤ v := by
    intro q hnd hlt
    have hsub : q ⊆ List.range v := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mpr (hlt x hx)
    have := (List.Nodup.subperm hnd hsub).length_le
    simpa using this
  have extd : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (x w : ℕ), q.getLast? = some s → q.Nodup → (∀ y ∈ q, y < v) →
      (∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), q = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E)) →
      q.head? = some x → ((x, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, x) ∈ E) → w ∉ q →
      (w :: q).getLast? = some s ∧ (w :: q).Nodup ∧ (∀ y ∈ w :: q, y < v) ∧
      (∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), w :: q = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E)) := by
    intro q x w hl hnd hlt hc hx hxw hw
    cases q with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons b r =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hx
      subst hx
      refine ⟨?_, List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hw, hnd⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact hl
      · intro y hy
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
        · rcases hxw with h | h
          · exact (hE _ h).2
          · have := hE _ h
            simp only at this
            omega
        · exact hlt y hy
      · intro l₁ l₂ a c h
        cases l₁ with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
          exact hxw.symm
        | cons d l₁' =>
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl, h⟩ := h
          exact hc l₁' l₂ a c h
  have C : ∀ (d : ℕ) (q : List ℕ), q.getLast? = some s → q.Nodup → (∀ y ∈ q, y < v) →
      (∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), q = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E)) →
      v ≤ q.length + d →
      ∃ q' : List ℕ, q'.getLast? = some s ∧ q'.Nodup ∧ (∀ x ∈ q', x < v) ∧
        (∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), q' = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E)) ∧
        (∀ x w : ℕ, q'.head? = some x → ((x, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, x) ∈ E) → w ∈ q') := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro q hl hnd hlt hc hv
      refine ⟨q, hl, hnd, hlt, hc, ?_⟩
      intro x w hx hxw
      by_contra hw
      obtain ⟨-, hnd', hlt', -⟩ := extd q x w hl hnd hlt hc hx hxw hw
      have := bound _ hnd' hlt'
      simp only [List.length_cons] at this
      omega
    | succ d ih =>
      intro q hl hnd hlt hc hv
      by_cases hH : ∀ x w : ℕ, q.head? = some x → ((x, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, x) ∈ E) → w ∈ q
      · exact ⟨q, hl, hnd, hlt, hc, hH⟩
      · push_neg at hH
        obtain ⟨x, w, hx, hxw, hw⟩ := hH
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := extd q x w hl hnd hlt hc hx hxw hw
        exact ih (w :: q) h1 h2 h3 h4 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
  obtain ⟨q, hl, hnd, hlt, hc, hh⟩ := C v [s] rfl (List.nodup_singleton s)
    (by intro y hy; simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hy; omega)
    (by
      intro l₁ l₂ a b h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp at this <;> omega)
    (by simp)
  
  have closed : ∀ x ∈ q, ∀ w, ((x, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, x) ∈ E) → w ∈ q := by
    intro x hx w hxw
    by_contra hw
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hx
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' l₁ with rfl | ⟨L, a, rfl⟩
    · exact hw (hh x w (by simp) hxw)
    · have hax : (x, a) ∈ E ∨ (a, x) ∈ E := (hc L l₂ a x (by simp)).symm
      have haq : a ∈ (L ++ [a]) ++ x :: l₂ := by simp
      cases l₂ with
      | nil =>
        have hxs : x = s := by
          simp at hl
          omega
        subst hxs
        have := hleaf a w hax hxw
        subst this
        exact hw haq
      | cons b l₂' =>
        have hxb : (x, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, x) ∈ E := hc (L ++ [a]) l₂' x b (by simp)
        have hbq : b ∈ (L ++ [a]) ++ x :: b :: l₂' := by simp
        rcases hdeg x a w b hax hxw hxb with h | h | h
        · subst h; exact hw haq
        · subst h
          exact nd3 L l₂' a x (by simpa using hnd)
        · subst h; exact hw hbq
  have cover : ∀ x : ℕ, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ => (a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E) s x → x ∈ q := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx with
    | refl =>
      obtain ⟨ys, hys⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp hl
      rw [hys]; simp
    | tail _ hab ih => exact closed _ ih _ hab
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < v → x ∈ q := fun x hx => cover x (hconn x hx)
  have hperm : q.Perm (List.range v) := (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd List.nodup_range).mpr
    (fun a => ⟨fun h => List.mem_range.mpr (hlt a h), fun h => hcov a (List.mem_range.mp h)⟩)
  have hql : q.length = E.length + 1 := by rw [hperm.length_eq, List.length_range]; omega
  
  have ends : ∀ x, x ∈ q → (∀ a b : ℕ, ((x, a) ∈ E ∨ (a, x) ∈ E) → ((x, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, x) ∈ E) → a = b) →
      IsEnd q x := by
    intro x hx hl1
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hx
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' l₁ with rfl | ⟨L, a, rfl⟩
    · left; simp
    · cases l₂ with
      | nil => right; simp
      | cons b l₂' =>
        exfalso
        have hax := (hc L (b :: l₂') a x (by simp)).symm
        have hxb := hc (L ++ [a]) l₂' x b (by simp)
        have := hl1 a b hax hxb
        subst this
        exact nd3 L l₂' a x (by simpa using hnd)
  
  have D1 : ∀ (r : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), (a, b) ∈ r.zip r.tail → ∃ l₁ l₂, r = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | nil => intro a b h; simp at h
    | cons c r ih =>
      intro a b h
      cases r with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons d r' =>
        simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | h
        · exact ⟨[], r', rfl⟩
        · obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h'⟩ := ih a b h
          exact ⟨c :: l₁, l₂, by rw [h']; rfl⟩
  have D3 : ∀ r : List ℕ, r.Nodup →
      ((r.zip r.tail).map (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => (min e.1 e.2, max e.1 e.2))).Nodup := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons c r ih =>
      intro hnd'
      cases r with
      | nil => simp
      | cons d r' =>
        have hnd2 := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd'
        simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons]
        refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ih hnd2.2⟩
        intro hmem
        obtain ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, he, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
        have h1 : e1 ∈ d :: r' := (List.of_mem_zip he).1
        have h2 : e2 ∈ d :: r' := List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.of_mem_zip he).2
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
        obtain ⟨heq1, heq2⟩ := heq
        have hc' : c = e1 ∨ c = e2 := by omega
        rcases hc' with rfl | rfl
        · exact hnd2.1 h1
        · exact hnd2.1 h2
  have D6 : ∀ r : List ℕ, edgeLengths r =
      ((((r.zip r.tail).map (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => (min e.1 e.2, max e.1 e.2))).map
        (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => e.2 - e.1) : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | nil => simp [edgeLengths]
    | cons c r ih =>
      cases r with
      | nil => simp [edgeLengths]
      | cons d r' =>
        have e1 : edgeLengths (c :: d :: r') =
            Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r') := by
          simp [edgeLengths]
        have e2 : Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = max c d - min c d := by omega
        rw [e1, ih, e2]
        simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons, Multiset.cons_coe]
  set P := (q.zip q.tail).map (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => (min e.1 e.2, max e.1 e.2)) with hP
  have D2 : P ⊆ E := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, hq⟩ := D1 q a b hab
    rcases hc l₁ l₂ a b hq with h | h
    · have := (hE _ h).1
      simp only at this
      have e : (min a b, max a b) = (a, b) := by
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; constructor <;> omega
      simp only
      rw [e]; exact h
    · have := (hE _ h).1
      simp only at this
      have e : (min a b, max a b) = (b, a) := by
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; constructor <;> omega
      simp only
      rw [e]; exact h
  have D4 : P.length = E.length := by
    rw [hP, List.length_map, List.length_zip, List.length_tail]
    omega
  have D5 : P.Perm E := (List.Nodup.subperm (D3 q hnd) D2).perm_of_length_le (le_of_eq D4.symm)
  have hL : edgeLengths q = ((E.map (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => e.2 - e.1) : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) := by
    rw [D6 q]
    exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.mpr (D5.map _)
  have hA : ∀ e ∈ E, Adj q e.1 e.2 := by
    intro e he
    have heP : e ∈ P := D5.symm.subset he
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp heP
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, hq⟩ := D1 q a b hab
    simp only
    rcases le_total a b with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]; exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl hq⟩
    · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]; exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr hq⟩
  exact ⟨q, ⟨hperm, hL⟩, hA, fun x hx hx1 => ends x (hcov x hx) hx1⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro μ κ hκ hμ E hE
  have main : ∀ R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, (∀ a b : ℕ, R a b → R b a) →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r < 2 * μ + κ → R (2 * r + 1) (2 * r + 2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1)) →
      R 0 (2 * μ) → R (2 * μ) (4 * μ) → R (4 * μ) (6 * μ) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 2) (2 * i + 2 * μ + 2 * κ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 2 * κ + 2) (2 * i + 2 * μ + 2 * κ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < μ - 2 * κ - 1 → R (2 * i + 4 * κ + 2) (2 * i + 2 * μ + 4 * κ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < μ - 2 * κ - 1 → R (2 * i + 2 * μ + 4 * κ + 2) (2 * i + 4 * μ + 4 * κ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 2 * μ + 2) (2 * i + 4 * μ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 4 * μ + 2) (2 * i + 6 * μ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (2 * i + 6 * μ + 2 * κ + 2)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < μ → R (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < μ + κ - 1 → R (2 * i + 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 2) (2 * i + 4 * μ + 2 * κ + 3)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < κ → R (2 * i + 2 * μ + 1) (2 * i + 2 * μ + 2)) →
      ∀ x : ℕ, x < 6 * μ + 4 * κ + 1 → Relation.ReflTransGen R (6 * μ + 4 * κ) x := by
    intro R hR hFB hL1 hL2 hL3 hFC1 hFC2 hFS1 hFS2 hFS3 hFS4 hFP hFV1 hFV2 hFD
    have rc : ∀ u w u' w' : ℕ, R u w → u = u' → w = w' → R u' w' := by
      rintro u w _ _ h rfl rfl; exact h
    have rs : ∀ u w u' w' : ℕ, R u w → w = u' → u = w' → R u' w' := by
      rintro u w _ _ h rfl rfl; exact hR _ _ h
    have cv : ∀ a b c d : ℕ, Relation.ReflTransGen R a b → a = c → b = d →
        Relation.ReflTransGen R c d := by
      rintro a b _ _ h rfl rfl; exact h
    have sy : ∀ a b : ℕ, Relation.ReflTransGen R a b → Relation.ReflTransGen R b a :=
      fun a b h => Relation.ReflTransGen.symmetric (fun x y hxy => hR x y hxy) h
    have hh : ∀ a b c : ℕ, R a b → Relation.ReflTransGen R b c → Relation.ReflTransGen R a c :=
      fun a b c h1 h2 => Relation.ReflTransGen.head h1 h2
    have sg : ∀ a b : ℕ, R a b → Relation.ReflTransGen R a b :=
      fun a b h => Relation.ReflTransGen.single h
    
    have line : ∀ q j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ κ → κ * q + j ≤ μ + κ → κ * q + j ≠ μ →
        Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * (κ * q + j)) (2 * j) := by
      intro q
      induction q using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | _ q ih =>
        intro j hj1 hj2 hb1 hb2
        rcases (show q = 0 ∨ q = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ q by omega) with rfl | rfl | hq
        · exact cv (2 * j) (2 * j) _ _ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (by simp) rfl
        · rw [Nat.mul_one]
          refine hh _ (2 * j + 2 * μ + 2 * κ) _
            (rc _ _ _ _ (hFC2 (j - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          exact sg _ _ (rs _ _ _ _ (hFC1 (j - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
        · obtain ⟨q₁, rfl⟩ : ∃ q₁, q = q₁ + 2 := ⟨q - 2, by omega⟩
          have e2 : κ * (q₁ + 2) = κ * q₁ + 2 * κ := by ring
          rw [e2] at hb1 hb2 ⊢
          have hih := ih q₁ (by omega) j hj1 hj2 (by omega) (by omega)
          have h1 : Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j))
              (2 * (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j) + 4 * μ) := by
            rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hb2 with hlt | hgt
            · refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j) + 2 * μ) _
                (rc _ _ _ _ (hFS1 (κ * q₁ + j - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
              exact sg _ _ (rc _ _ _ _ (hFS2 (κ * q₁ + j - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
            · refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j) + 2 * μ) _
                (rc _ _ _ _ (hFS3 (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j - μ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega)
                  (by omega)) ?_
              exact sg _ _ (rc _ _ _ _ (hFS4 (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j - μ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega)
                (by omega))
          refine h1.trans ?_
          refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + 2 * κ + j) + 4 * μ + 1) _
            (rc _ _ _ _ (hFV2 (κ * q₁ + κ + j - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + κ + j + μ) + 1) _
            (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB (κ * q₁ + κ + j + μ) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + j) + 1) _
            (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB (κ * q₁ + j) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (2 * (κ * q₁ + j)) _
            (rs _ _ _ _ (hFV1 (κ * q₁ + j) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          exact hih
    
    have zH : ∀ n : ℕ, μ + 1 + n ≤ μ + κ →
        Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * (μ + 1 + n)) (2 * μ + 2) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro _; exact cv _ _ _ _ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl rfl (by ring)

        have ih' := ih (by omega)

          refine hh _ (4 * μ + 2 * n + 2 * κ + 3) _

          refine hh _ (4 * μ + 2 * n + 2 * κ + 2) _

          refine hh _ (6 * μ + 2 * n + 2 * κ + 2) _
            (rc _ _ _ _ (hFP n (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (6 * μ + 2 * n + 2 * κ + 3) _
            (rc _ _ _ _ (hFV2 (μ + n) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (4 * μ + 2 * n + 3) _
            (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB (2 * μ + n + 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          refine hh _ (2 * (μ + n + 1 - κ) + 1) _
            (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB (μ + n + 1 - κ) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
          exact sg _ _ (rs _ _ _ _ (hFV1 (μ + n + 1 - κ) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))

        have hz2 := Nat.mod_lt (μ + n) (show κ > 0 by omega)

          rw [e3] at hz1

    have hbot : ∀ β : ℕ, 1 ≤ β → β ≤ μ + κ → β ≠ μ →

      rw [hq1, hs1] at hm1

          (by rw [e4]; omega)

        refine (sy _ _ l2).trans ?_

    have T0 : Relation.ReflTransGen R 0 (2 * μ + 2) := by
      refine hh _ (2 * μ) _ hL1 ?_
      refine hh _ (4 * μ) _ hL2 ?_
      refine hh _ (6 * μ) _ hL3 ?_
      refine hh _ (6 * μ + 1) _
        (rc _ _ _ _ (hFV2 (μ - κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_

    have T2 : Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * μ) (2 * μ + 2) := hh _ 0 _ (hR _ _ hL1) T0
    have T4 : Relation.ReflTransGen R (4 * μ) (2 * μ + 2) := hh _ (2 * μ) _ (hR _ _ hL2) T2

      refine hh _ (4 * μ + 4 * κ + 1) _
        (rc _ _ _ _ (hFV2 (κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      refine hh _ (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1) _
        (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB (μ + κ) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      refine hh _ 1 _ (rs _ _ _ _ (hFB 0 (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_

    have Bv : ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 * μ + 2 * κ → Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * r + 1) (2 * μ + 2) := by
      intro r
      induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with

        intro hr

        · exact hh _ (2 * r) _ (rs _ _ _ _ (hFV1 r (by omega)) rfl rfl)

    have F1 : ∀ i : ℕ, μ + 2 * κ + 1 ≤ i → i ≤ 2 * μ - 1 →
        Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * i) (2 * μ + 2) := by
      intro i h1 h2

        (rs _ _ _ _ (hFS1 (i - μ - 2 * κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
        (hbot (i - μ) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    have F3 : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * μ + 1 ≤ i → i ≤ 2 * μ + κ →

      intro i h1 h2
      exact hh _ (2 * (i - μ)) _
        (rs _ _ _ _ (hFS3 (i - 2 * μ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))

    have FV : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * μ + κ + 1 ≤ i → i ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * κ →
        Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * i) (2 * μ + 2) := by
      intro i h1 h2
      exact hh _ (2 * i + 1) _
        (rc _ _ _ _ (hFV2 (i - 2 * μ - κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))

    have Av : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 3 * μ + 2 * κ → Relation.ReflTransGen R (2 * i) (2 * μ + 2) := by
      intro i hi
      rcases (show i = 0 ∨ (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ μ + κ ∧ i ≠ μ) ∨ i = μ ∨

          (2 * μ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 2 * μ + κ) ∨ (2 * μ + κ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * κ) ∨
          (2 * μ + 2 * κ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 3 * μ - 1) ∨ i = 3 * μ ∨
          (3 * μ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 3 * μ + κ) ∨ (3 * μ + κ + 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 3 * μ + 2 * κ) by omega)
        with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
      · exact cv _ _ _ _ T0 (by omega) rfl
      · exact hbot i h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2
      · exact cv _ _ _ _ T2 (by omega) rfl
      · exact hh _ (2 * (i - μ - κ)) _
          (rs _ _ _ _ (hFC1 (i - μ - κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
          (hbot (i - μ - κ) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
      · exact F1 i h.1 h.2

      · exact FV i h.1 h.2
      · exact hh _ (2 * (i - μ)) _
          (rs _ _ _ _ (hFS2 (i - 2 * μ - 2 * κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
          (F1 (i - μ) (by omega) (by omega))
      · exact cv _ _ _ _ T6 (by omega) rfl
      · exact hh _ (2 * (i - μ)) _
          (rs _ _ _ _ (hFS4 (i - 3 * μ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
          (F3 (i - μ) (by omega) (by omega))
      · exact hh _ (2 * (i - μ)) _
          (rs _ _ _ _ (hFP (i - 3 * μ - κ - 1) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))

    intro x hx
    have hT : Relation.ReflTransGen R x (2 * μ + 2) := by

    exact (top.trans T0).trans (sy _ _ hT)
  subst hE

by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hb2 hc
  subst hc
  
  have hadj : ∀ (P : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (h : i + 1 < P.length), Adj P P[i] P[i + 1] := by
    intro P i h
    refine ⟨P.take i, P.drop (i + 2), Or.inl ?_⟩
    have e1 : P.drop i = P[i] :: P[i + 1] :: P.drop (i + 2) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega), List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h]

    rintro P u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩

    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  
  have seed : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ P : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (k + 3 + d + 4)
        (Multiset.replicate (k + 3 + d) 1 + Multiset.replicate 3 (d + 3)) P ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + 1 ≤ k → Adj P x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, k + 3 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ k + 3 + d → Adj P x (x + 1)) ∧

    intro d
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ i, f i =
        if i < k + 1 then i else if i < k + d + 2 then k + d + 3 - (i - (k + 1))
        else if i = k + d + 2 then k + d + 6 else if i = k + d + 3 then k + d + 5
        else if i = k + d + 4 then k + d + 4 else if i = k + d + 5 then k + 1 else k + 2 :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩

        if i = k ∨ i = k + d + 1 ∨ i = k + d + 4 then d + 3 else 1 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    
    have hv1 : ∀ i, i < k + 1 → f i = i := by
      intro i h1; rw [hf]; split_ifs <;> omega
    have hv2 : ∀ i, k + 1 ≤ i → i < k + d + 2 → f i = k + d + 3 - (i - (k + 1)) := by

      intro i h1

    obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : List ℕ, P = List.range (k + 1) ++

        [k + d + 6, k + d + 5, k + d + 4, k + 1, k + 2] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hlen : P.length = k + d + 7 := by

      intro i h

        List.length_map, List.length_append, List.getElem_cons, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    refine ⟨P, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      show P.Perm (List.range (k + 3 + d + 4))
      have hnd : P.Nodup := by

  (List.range (2 * r + 1)).map (fun i => y + 4 * r + 3 - i) ++

  (List.range r).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y (y - k) i) ++

      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (adjR _ (6 * μ) (6 * μ - 1) h) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h := (infix_mapRange (fun i => 6 * μ - 2 - i) (2 * μ - 1) (2 * j - 4) (by omega)).trans hRun
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (adjF _ _ _ h) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h : Adj (lcwA μ) (6 * μ - 2 - (2 * μ - 2)) (4 * μ - 1) := by
        refine ⟨[6 * μ + 1] ++ lcwZ μ 1 (μ - 2) ++
          (List.range (2 * μ - 2)).map (fun i => 6 * μ - 2 - i),
          [6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ, 2 * μ + 1, 1, 0, 2 * μ], Or.inl ?_⟩
        unfold lcwA
        rw [show 2 * μ - 1 = (2 * μ - 2) + 1 by omega, List.range_succ, List.map_append]
        simp [List.append_assoc]
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h : [2 * μ + 2 * 1 + 2 * (2 * μ - 1 - j) + 1, 2 * μ + 2 * 1 + 2 * (2 * μ - 1 - j) + 2]
          <:+: lcwA μ :=
        List.IsInfix.trans ⟨[], [2 * 1 + 2 * (2 * μ - 1 - j) + 2, 2 * 1 + 2 * (2 * μ - 1 - j) + 3],
          rfl⟩ (hblk (2 * μ - 1 - j) (by omega))
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (adjR _ _ _ h) (by omega) (by omega)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → (lcwB μ t).Perm (List.range (6 * μ + 2))

signature.name: lcwB_perm
signature.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → (lcwB μ t).Perm (List.range (6 * μ + 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro μ t ht hμ
  have hZlen : ∀ n : ℕ, (lcwZ μ t n).length = 4 * n + 3 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [lcwZ]
    | succ n ih =>
      simp only [lcwZ, List.length_append, List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append,
        List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil] at ih ⊢
      omega
  have hUslen : ∀ n : ℕ, (lcwUs μ t n).length = 6 * n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [lcwUs]
    | succ n ih =>
      simp only [lcwUs, List.range_succ, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons,
        List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons,
        List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, List.length_append, lcwUnit, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil] at ih ⊢
      omega
  have hZmem : ∀ n x : ℕ, (2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * t + 2 * n + 1) ∨
      (2 * μ + 2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n) → x ∈ lcwZ μ t n := by
    intro n x h
    unfold lcwZ
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · by_cases hx : x ≤ 2 * t + 1
      · apply List.mem_append_left
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      · apply List.mem_append_right
        refine List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨(x - 2 * t - 2) / 2, List.mem_range.2 (by omega), ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
    · by_cases hx : x = 2 * μ + 2 * t
      · apply List.mem_append_left
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      · apply List.mem_append_right
        refine List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨(x - 2 * μ - 2 * t - 1) / 2, List.mem_range.2 (by omega), ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
  have hUsmem : ∀ n x j : ℕ, j < n → x ∈ lcwUnit μ t (j + 1) → x ∈ lcwUs μ t n := by
    intro n x j hj hx
    unfold lcwUs
    exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨j, List.mem_reverse.2 (List.mem_range.2 hj), hx⟩
  have hlen : (lcwB μ t).length = 6 * μ + 2 := by
    simp only [lcwB, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_map,
      List.length_range, hZlen, hUslen]
    omega
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < 6 * μ + 2 → x ∈ lcwB μ t := by
    intro x hx
    have hB1 : x = 6 * μ + 1 → x ∈ [6 * μ + 1] := by
      intro h
      simp [h]
    have hZ : (2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * μ - 1) ∨ (2 * μ + 2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 4 * μ - 2) →
        x ∈ lcwZ μ t (μ - t - 1) := by
      intro h
      apply hZmem
      omega
    have hR : 4 * μ + 2 * t - 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 6 * μ - 2 * t →
        x ∈ (List.range (2 * μ + 2 - 4 * t)).map (fun i => 6 * μ - 2 * t - i) := by
      intro h
      exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨6 * μ - 2 * t - x, List.mem_range.2 (by omega), by omega⟩
    have hB4 : x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 1 ∨ x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 2 ∨ x = 4 * μ + 2 * t - 2 ∨
        x = 4 * μ + 2 * t - 3 ∨ x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 3 →
        x ∈ [2 * μ + 2 * t - 1, 2 * μ + 2 * t - 2, 4 * μ + 2 * t - 2, 4 * μ + 2 * t - 3,
          2 * μ + 2 * t - 3] := by
      intro h
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      exact h
    have hUs : (2 * μ + 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * t - 4) ∨ (4 * μ + 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 4 * μ + 2 * t - 4) ∨
        (6 * μ + 3 - 2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 6 * μ - 2) → x ∈ lcwUs μ t (t - 2) := by
      intro h
      rcases h with h | h | h
      · refine hUsmem (t - 2) x ((x - 2 * μ - 1) / 2) (by omega) ?_
        simp only [lcwUnit, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      · refine hUsmem (t - 2) x ((x - 4 * μ - 1) / 2) (by omega) ?_
        simp only [lcwUnit, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      · refine hUsmem (t - 2) x ((x - (6 * μ + 3 - 2 * t)) / 2) (by omega) ?_
        simp only [lcwUnit, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
    have hB6 : x = 6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t ∨ x = 6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t ∨ x = 2 * μ →
        x ∈ [6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t, 6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t, 2 * μ] := by
      intro h
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      exact h
    have hB7 : x < 2 * t → x ∈ List.range (2 * t) := fun h => List.mem_range.2 h
    have hB8 : x = 4 * μ ∨ x = 4 * μ - 1 ∨ x = 6 * μ - 1 ∨ x = 6 * μ →
        x ∈ [4 * μ, 4 * μ - 1, 6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ] := by
      intro h
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      exact h
    simp only [lcwB, List.mem_append]
    rcases (show x = 6 * μ + 1 ∨
        ((2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * μ - 1) ∨ (2 * μ + 2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 4 * μ - 2)) ∨
        (4 * μ + 2 * t - 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 6 * μ - 2 * t) ∨
        (x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 1 ∨ x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 2 ∨ x = 4 * μ + 2 * t - 2 ∨
          x = 4 * μ + 2 * t - 3 ∨ x = 2 * μ + 2 * t - 3) ∨
        ((2 * μ + 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * μ + 2 * t - 4) ∨ (4 * μ + 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 4 * μ + 2 * t - 4) ∨
          (6 * μ + 3 - 2 * t ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 6 * μ - 2)) ∨
        (x = 6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t ∨ x = 6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t ∨ x = 2 * μ) ∨
        x < 2 * t ∨
        (x = 4 * μ ∨ x = 4 * μ - 1 ∨ x = 6 * μ - 1 ∨ x = 6 * μ) by omega)
      with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (hB1 h)))))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hZ h)))))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hR h))))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hB4 h)))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hUs h))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hB6 h)))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (hB7 h))
    · exact Or.inr (hB8 h)
  have hsub : List.range (6 * μ + 2) ⊆ lcwB μ t := fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.1 hx)
  exact ((List.subperm_of_subset List.nodup_range hsub).perm_of_length_le
    (by rw [List.length_range, hlen])).symm

informal_problem.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → edgeLengths (lcwB μ t) = Multiset.replicate (4 * μ - 2 * t) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * μ) (2 * μ) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t + 1) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t)

signature.name: lcwB_edges
signature.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → edgeLengths (lcwB μ t) = Multiset.replicate (4 * μ - 2 * t) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * μ) (2 * μ) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t + 1) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro μ t ht hμ
  have econs : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =
      Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l) := fun a b l => rfl
  have esing : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := fun a => rfl
  have econs' : ∀ (a b d : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), (a = b + d ∨ b = a + d) →
      edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) = {d} + edgeLengths (b :: l) := by
    intro a b d l h
    have hd : Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) = d := by omega
    rw [econs, hd, Multiset.singleton_add]
  have ehead2 : ∀ (a b d : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), (a = b + d ∨ b = a + d) → L.head? = some b →
      edgeLengths (a :: L) = {d} + edgeLengths L := by
    intro a b d L hd h
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons c L =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      exact econs' a c d L hd
  have rs : ∀ (m a : ℕ), Multiset.replicate (m + 1) a = Multiset.replicate m a + {a} := by
    intro m a
    rw [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add, add_comm]
  
  have Zsucc : ∀ t n, lcwZ μ t (n + 1) = lcwZ μ t n ++ [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 1,
      2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 2, 2 * t + 2 * n + 2, 2 * t + 2 * n + 3] := by
    intro t n
    simp [lcwZ, List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append]
  have Zhead : ∀ (t n : ℕ) (X : List ℕ), (lcwZ μ t n ++ X).head? = some (2 * μ + 2 * t) := by
    intro t n X
    simp [lcwZ]
  have ZE : ∀ (t n : ℕ) (X : List ℕ), edgeLengths (lcwZ μ t n ++ X) =
      Multiset.replicate (2 * n + 1) (2 * μ) + Multiset.replicate (2 * n + 1) 1 +
        edgeLengths ((2 * t + 2 * n + 1) :: X) := by
    intro t n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro X
      simp only [lcwZ, List.range_zero, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, List.cons_append,
        List.nil_append]
      rw [econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t) (2 * t) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * t) (2 * t + 1) 1 _ (by omega)]
      simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add, Multiset.replicate_one]
      abel
    | succ n ih =>
      intro X
      rw [Zsucc, List.append_assoc, ih]
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [econs' (2 * t + 2 * n + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 2) 1 _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * n + 2) (2 * t + 2 * n + 2) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (2 * t + 2 * n + 2) (2 * t + 2 * n + 3) 1 _ (by omega)]
      rw [show 2 * t + 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = 2 * t + 2 * n + 3 by ring]
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = 2 * n + 1 + 1 + 1 by ring, rs (2 * n + 1 + 1), rs (2 * n + 1),
        rs (2 * n + 1 + 1), rs (2 * n + 1)]
      abel
  
  have Rhead : ∀ (s N : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      ((List.range (N + 1)).map (fun i => s - i) ++ X).head? = some s := by
    intro s N X
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
    simp
  have RE : ∀ (s N : ℕ) (X : List ℕ), N ≤ s →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (N + 1)).map (fun i => s - i) ++ X) =
        Multiset.replicate N 1 + edgeLengths ((s - N) :: X) := by
    intro s N
    induction N with
    | zero => intro X _; simp
    | succ N ih =>
      intro X h
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.append_assoc,
        List.singleton_append, ih _ (by omega),
        econs' (s - N) (s - (N + 1)) 1 _ (by omega), rs]
      abel
  
  have Ahead : ∀ (M : ℕ) (X : List ℕ), (List.range (M + 1) ++ X).head? = some 0 := by
    intro M X
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
    simp
  have AE : ∀ (M : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (List.range (M + 1) ++ X) = Multiset.replicate M 1 + edgeLengths (M :: X) := by
    intro M
    induction M with
    | zero => intro X; simp
    | succ M ih =>
      intro X
      rw [List.range_succ, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, ih,
        econs' M (M + 1) 1 _ (by omega), rs]
      abel
  
  have Usucc : ∀ n, lcwUs μ t (n + 1) = lcwUnit μ t (n + 1) ++ lcwUs μ t n := by
    intro n
    simp [lcwUs, List.range_succ]
  have Uhead : ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      (lcwUs μ t n ++ (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t) :: X).head? = some (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t + 2 * n) := by
    intro n X
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [lcwUs]
    | succ m =>
      rw [Usucc, List.append_assoc]
      simp [lcwUnit]
  have UE : ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : List ℕ),
      edgeLengths (lcwUs μ t n ++ (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t) :: X) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (2 * μ) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) +
          edgeLengths ((6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t) :: X) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro X; simp [lcwUs]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro X
      rw [Usucc, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [lcwUnit, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [econs' (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t + 2 * (n + 1)) (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t + 2 * (n + 1)) 1 _
          (by omega),
        econs' (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t + 2 * (n + 1)) (2 * μ + 2 * (n + 1)) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _
          (by omega),
        econs' (2 * μ + 2 * (n + 1)) (4 * μ + 2 * (n + 1)) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        econs' (4 * μ + 2 * (n + 1)) (4 * μ + 2 * (n + 1) - 1) 1 _ (by omega),
        econs' (4 * μ + 2 * (n + 1) - 1) (2 * μ + 2 * (n + 1) - 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
        ehead2 (2 * μ + 2 * (n + 1) - 1) (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t + 2 * n) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _
          (by omega) (Uhead n X), ih]
      rw [Multiset.ext]
      intro x
      simp only [Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate, Multiset.count_singleton]
      split_ifs <;> omega
  
  unfold lcwB
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, 2 * μ + 2 - 4 * t = N + 1 := ⟨2 * μ + 1 - 4 * t, by omega⟩
  rw [hN, show List.range (2 * t) = List.range ((2 * t - 1) + 1) by congr 1; omega]
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  rw [ehead2 (6 * μ + 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _ (by omega) (Zhead _ _ _), ZE,
    ehead2 (2 * t + 2 * (μ - t - 1) + 1) (6 * μ - 2 * t) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _ (by omega)
      (Rhead _ _ _),
    RE _ _ _ (by omega),
    econs' (6 * μ - 2 * t - N) (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
    econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t - 1) (2 * μ + 2 * t - 2) 1 _ (by omega),
    econs' (2 * μ + 2 * t - 2) (4 * μ + 2 * t - 2) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
    econs' (4 * μ + 2 * t - 2) (4 * μ + 2 * t - 3) 1 _ (by omega),
    econs' (4 * μ + 2 * t - 3) (2 * μ + 2 * t - 3) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
    ehead2 (2 * μ + 2 * t - 3) (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t + 2 * (t - 2)) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _
      (by omega) (Uhead _ _),
    UE,
    econs' (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t) (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) 1 _ (by omega),
    econs' (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) (2 * μ) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _ (by omega),
    ehead2 (2 * μ) 0 (2 * μ) _ (by omega) (Ahead _ _), AE,
    econs' (2 * t - 1) (4 * μ) (4 * μ + 1 - 2 * t) _ (by omega),
    econs' (4 * μ) (4 * μ - 1) 1 _ (by omega),
    econs' (4 * μ - 1) (6 * μ - 1) (2 * μ) _ (by omega),
    econs' (6 * μ - 1) (6 * μ) 1 _ (by omega), esing]
  rw [Multiset.ext]
  intro x
  simp only [Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate, Multiset.count_singleton,
    Multiset.count_zero]
  split_ifs <;> omega

informal_problem.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → (∀ j : ℕ, j < μ → Adj (lcwB μ t) (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) ∧ IsEnd (lcwB μ t) (6 * μ + 1) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + t ≤ 2 * μ → Adj (lcwB μ t) (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * j) (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * j))

signature.name: lcwB_windows
signature.statement: ∀ μ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 2 * t + 1 ≤ μ → (∀ j : ℕ, j < μ → Adj (lcwB μ t) (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) ∧ IsEnd (lcwB μ t) (6 * μ + 1) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + t ≤ 2 * μ → Adj (lcwB μ t) (6 * μ + 2 - 2 * j) (6 * μ + 1 - 2 * j))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro μ t ht hμ
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have s1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), ([u, w] <:+: p ∨ [w, u] <:+: p) → Adj p u w := by
    rintro p u w (⟨s, r, h⟩ | ⟨s, r, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨s, r, Or.inl (by rw [← h]; simp)⟩
    · exact ⟨s, r, Or.inr (by rw [← h]; simp)⟩
  have s2 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (a : ℕ), a ∈ l → f a <:+: l.flatMap f := by
    intro l f a ha
    induction l with
    | nil => simp at ha
    | cons b l ih =>
      rw [List.flatMap_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | h
      · exact (List.prefix_append _ _).isInfix
      · exact (ih h).trans (List.suffix_append _ _).isInfix
  have s3 : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (N a : ℕ), a + 2 ≤ N → [f a, f (a + 1)] <:+: (List.range N).map f := by
    intro f N a h
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, N = a + (2 + r) := ⟨N - a - 2, by omega⟩
    have h2 : List.range 2 = [0, 1] := rfl
    rw [List.range_add, List.range_add, h2]
    refine ⟨(List.range a).map f, (List.range r).map (fun x => f (a + (2 + x))), ?_⟩
    simp [Function.comp_def]
  have pre : ∀ l₁ l₂ l₃ : List ℕ, l₁ <:+: l₂ → l₁ <:+: l₂ ++ l₃ :=
    fun _ _ l₃ h => h.trans (List.prefix_append _ l₃).isInfix
  have hB8 : [4 * μ, 4 * μ - 1, 6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ] <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact (List.suffix_append _ _).isInfix
  have hB7 : List.range (2 * t) <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact List.infix_append _ _ _
  have hB6 : [6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t, 6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t, 2 * μ] <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact pre _ _ _ (List.infix_append _ _ _)
  have hUs : lcwUs μ t (t - 2) <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (List.infix_append _ _ _))
  have hB4 : [2 * μ + 2 * t - 1, 2 * μ + 2 * t - 2, 4 * μ + 2 * t - 2, 4 * μ + 2 * t - 3,
      2 * μ + 2 * t - 3] <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (List.infix_append _ _ _)))
  have hRun : (List.range (2 * μ + 2 - 4 * t)).map (fun i => 6 * μ - 2 * t - i) <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB; exact pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (pre _ _ _ (List.infix_append _ _ _))))
  have hZ : lcwZ μ t (μ - t - 1) <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    unfold lcwB

  have hZh : [2 * μ + 2 * t, 2 * t, 2 * t + 1] <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    refine List.IsInfix.trans ?_ hZ
    unfold lcwZ; exact (List.prefix_append _ _).isInfix
  have hF : (List.range (μ - t - 1)).flatMap (fun i => [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1,
      2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 3]) <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    refine List.IsInfix.trans ?_ hZ

  have hg : ∀ i : ℕ, i < μ - t - 1 → [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1,
      2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 3] <:+: lcwB μ t := by
    intro i hi
    exact (s2 (List.range (μ - t - 1)) (fun i => [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 1,
      2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 2, 2 * t + 2 * i + 3]) i

    intro i hi

  · intro j hj

  · left
    simp [lcwB]
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    rcases (show j = 1 ∨ (2 ≤ j ∧ j + 1 ≤ t) ∨ j = t ∨ (t + 1 ≤ j ∧ j + t ≤ μ + 1) ∨

    · 
      have h1 : [6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ] <:+: lcwB μ t :=
        (show [6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ] <:+: [4 * μ, 4 * μ - 1, 6 * μ - 1, 6 * μ] from
          ⟨[4 * μ, 4 * μ - 1], [], rfl⟩).trans hB8
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (s1 _ (6 * μ) (6 * μ - 1) (Or.inr h1)) (by omega) (by omega)

      have h1 : [6 * μ + 2 - 2 * t + 2 * (t - j - 1 + 1), 6 * μ + 1 - 2 * t + 2 * (t - j - 1 + 1)]

          4 * μ + 2 * t - 2, 4 * μ + 2 * t - 3, 2 * μ + 2 * t - 3] from
          ⟨[2 * μ + 2 * t - 1, 2 * μ + 2 * t - 2], [2 * μ + 2 * t - 3], rfl⟩).trans hB4

    · 
      have h1 : [4 * μ + 2 * (μ - j + 1), 4 * μ + 2 * (μ - j + 1) - 1] <:+: lcwB μ t :=
        (show [4 * μ + 2 * (μ - j + 1), 4 * μ + 2 * (μ - j + 1) - 1] <:+:

      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (s1 _ _ _ (Or.inl h1)) (by omega) (by omega)

      have h1 : [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * (2 * μ - t - j) + 1, 2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * (2 * μ - t - j) + 2]

          <:+: [2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * (2 * μ - t - j) + 1, 2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * (2 * μ - t - j) + 2,

      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (s1 _ (2 * μ + 2 * t + 2 * (2 * μ - t - j) + 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → (b + c + 1 ≤ y - k ∨ b = 0) → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 h1
  obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ : ∃ B, b = 2 * B := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨hR, hS, h0, -⟩ := path_range y (by omega)
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, -, hK₁, hE₁⟩ := top_pairs y y C _ (List.range y) (by omega) le_rfl
    (by omega) hR (fun i hi => by
      rw [show y - y + 2 * i = 2 * i by omega]
      exact hS _ (by omega))
  obtain ⟨p, hp, -, hK₂, hE₂⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 * C) B _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁ (fun i hi => by
      rw [show y + 2 * C - (y - k) + 2 * i = k + 2 * C + 2 * i by omega]
      exact hK₁ _ (hS _ (by omega)) (fun i' hi' => by omega))
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show y - 1 + 2 * B + 2 * C + 1 = y + 2 * C + 2 * B by omega]
    have hM : prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (2 * B) (2 * C) =
        Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * C) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      rw [add_right_comm]
    rw [hM]
    exact hp
  · refine ⟨hE₂ 0 (hE₁ 0 h0), fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · have h := hK₂ (2 * j - 1) (hK₁ (2 * j - 1) (hS _ (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega))
        (fun i hi => by omega)
      rw [show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j by omega] at h
      exact h
    · exfalso
      rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
      omega

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)
