proof.tactics:
by
  have adj_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u w → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' rfl rfl h
    exact h
  have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
    intro x a t; rfl
  have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
  have s2 : ∀ p : List ℕ, edgeLengths (p.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths p := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b t' =>
        have e : (a :: b :: t').map (· + 1) = (a + 1) :: (b :: t').map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e' : (b :: t').map (· + 1) = (b + 1) :: t'.map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [e, e', s1, ← e', ih, s1]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring_nf
  have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
      edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
    intro l a b
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
      rfl
    | cons x l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
        have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) = edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons y l' =>
        have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
        have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
            edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
  
  have one1 : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        Adj p' 0 1 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) := by
    intro v L p hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    have hperm0 : (0 :: p.map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + 1)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      exact (hq.map _).cons 0
    have hadj : ∀ (pre suf : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), Adj p x (x + 1) →
        Adj (pre ++ p.map (· + 1) ++ suf) (x + 1) (x + 2) := by
      rintro pre suf x ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · refine ⟨pre ++ l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1) ++ suf, Or.inl ?_⟩
        rw [h]; simp
      · refine ⟨pre ++ l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1) ++ suf, Or.inr ?_⟩
        rw [h]; simp
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl,
        ⟨[], t.map (· + 1), Or.inl (by simp)⟩, ?_⟩
      · have e : (0 :: t).map (· + 1) = 1 :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e2 := s2 (0 :: t)
        rw [e] at e2
        rw [e, s1, e2, hM, Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add] <;> rfl
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [0] [] x hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨(t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0],
        ⟨(List.perm_append_singleton 0 _).trans hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp),
        ⟨t.map (· + 1), [], Or.inr (by simp)⟩, ?_⟩
      · have e : (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0] = t.map (· + 1) ++ [1, 0] := by simp
        have e2 : t.map (· + 1) ++ [1] = (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) := by simp
        rw [e, s3, e2, s2, hM, Multiset.replicate_one] <;> rfl
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [] [0] x hx
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hcm hb2'
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, b = 2 * t + 2 := ⟨b / 2 - 1, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q0, hR0, hA0, hB0, hE0, -⟩ := path_II y k (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨Q1, hR1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs y y C _ Q0 (by omega) le_rfl (by omega) hR0
    (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (hB0 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)))
  have hEnd : IsEnd Q1 (y - k - 1) := by
    have h := hE1 0 hE0
    rw [show 0 + 2 * C = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨Q2, hR2, hE2z, hK2, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y + 2 * C) _ Q1 (by omega) (by omega)
    hR1 hEnd
  
  obtain ⟨Q2a, hR2a, hE2a, hN2a, hK2a⟩ := one1 _ _ Q2 hR2 hE2z
  obtain ⟨Q3, hR3, hE3z, -, hK3b⟩ := one1 _ _ Q2a hR2a hE2a
  have hS3 : Adj Q3 1 2 := hK3b 0 hN2a
  have hK3 : ∀ x : ℕ, Adj Q2 x (x + 1) → Adj Q3 (x + 2) (x + 3) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hK2a x hx
    have h2 := hK3b (x + 1) (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h1)
    exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2
  
  obtain ⟨Q4, hR4, -, hK4, hE4⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 * C + 1 + 1 + 1) t _ Q3
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR3 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := hB0 (k + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1
      have h3 := hK3 _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h2)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h3)
  refine ⟨y, le_rfl, by omega, Q4, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hV : y + (2 * t + 2) + 2 * C + 1 = y + 2 * C + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 * t := by omega
    rw [hV]
    refine ⟨hR4.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hR4.2]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have h1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 = Multiset.replicate (y - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have h2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * t + 2) (y - k) = Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [h1, h2]
    abel
  · refine ⟨hE4 0 hE3z, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)⟩
    have key : Adj Q3 (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := by
      by_cases hj : j = 1
      · exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) hS3
      by_cases hlo : 2 * j - 1 ≤ y - k
      · have h1 := hN1 (j - 2) (by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1
        have h3 := hK3 _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h2)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h3
      · have h0 := hA0 (2 * j - 1 - 2 * C - 3) (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1
        have h3 := hK3 _ (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h2)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h3
    have h4 := hK4 _ key (fun i hi => by omega)
    exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h4

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →

signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → y - k + 1 ≤ c → c + 3 ≤ y → y ≤ b + c + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have bot_ones : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + r) (x + r + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ 0 → IsEnd p' (x + r)) := by
    have eCC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =
        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l) := by
      intro a b l
      simp [edgeLengths]
    have eS : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := by
      intro a
      simp [edgeLengths]
    have eSnoc : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) := by
      intro a b l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [eCC, eS]
      | cons c l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, eCC, eS]
          exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
        | cons d l =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC, Multiset.cons_swap]
    have eRev : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths l.reverse = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b l =>
          have h1 : (a :: b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b, a] := by simp
          have h2 : (b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b] := by simp
          rw [h1, eSnoc, ← h2, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          rw [← Int.natAbs_neg]
          congr 1
          ring
    have eMap : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths (l.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp [eS]
        | cons b l =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring_nf
    have adjRev : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj l.reverse u w := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    have adjShift : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w →
        Adj (0 :: l.map (· + 1)) (u + 1) (w + 1) := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
    have gLast : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), l.getLast? = some x →
        (0 :: l.map (· + 1)).getLast? = some (x + 1) := by
      intro l x h
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons a l =>
        have e : (a + 1) :: List.map (fun x => x + 1) l = (a :: l).map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [List.map_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons, e, List.getLast?_map, h]
        rfl
    have H : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
        p.head? = some 0 →
        ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧
          p'.head? = some 0 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
          (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + r) (w + r)) ∧
          (∀ x : ℕ, p.getLast? = some x → p'.getLast? = some (x + r)) := by
      intro r v L p hp hh
      induction r with
      | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, hh, fun x hx => by omega,
          fun u w h => by simpa using h, fun x hx => by simpa using hx⟩
      | succ r ih =>
        obtain ⟨p', ⟨hperm, hlen⟩, hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, p' = 0 :: t := by
          cases p' with
          | nil => simp at hh'
          | cons a t => simp at hh'; exact ⟨t, by rw [hh']⟩
        refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + r + 1))
          rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
          exact (List.Perm.map (· + 1) hperm).cons 0
        · have e : (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)) = 0 :: 1 :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
          have e' : (1 :: t.map (· + 1)) = (0 :: t).map (· + 1) := rfl
          rw [e, eCC, e', eMap, hlen, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.add_cons]
          rfl
        · intro x hx
          rcases x with _ | x
          · exact ⟨[], (t.map (· + 1)), Or.inl (by simp)⟩
          · exact adjShift _ _ _ (hO x (by omega))
        · intro u w h
          exact adjShift _ _ _ (hA u w h)
        · intro x hx
          have h := gLast _ _ (hL x hx)
          rw [show x + (r + 1) = x + r + 1 by omega]
          exact h
    intro r v L p hv hp h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p hp h0
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ hx
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
      · exact Or.inr (hL x hx)
    · have hpr : IsLinearRealization v L p.reverse :=
        ⟨List.Perm.trans (List.reverse_perm p) hp.1, by rw [eRev]; exact hp.2⟩
      have hh : p.reverse.head? = some 0 := by rw [List.head?_reverse]; exact h0
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p.reverse hpr hh
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ (adjRev _ _ _ hx)
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact Or.inr (hL x (by rw [List.getLast?_reverse]; exact hx))
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
  have adjeq : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endeq : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 h4 hc3 h5
  obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ : ∃ B, b = 2 * B := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, c + 2 * d + 1 = y := ⟨(y - 1 - c) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, y = 4 * d + 3 + 2 * T := ⟨(y - 4 * d - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hR0, hS0, hE0, hE0'⟩ := path_range (y - 2 * d) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P1, hR1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y - 2 * d) B _ (List.range (y - 2 * d))
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR0 (fun i hi => hS0 _ (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨P2, hR2, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y - 2 * d + 2 * B) d _ P1
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR1 (fun i hi =>
      adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hN1 (d - 1 - i) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  have hP2e : IsEnd P2 (y - 1) := endeq _ _ _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hE0')) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨P3, hR3, hE3a, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_attach y (y - 2 * d + 2 * B + 2 * d) _ P2
    (by omega) (by omega) hR2 hP2e
  have hP3e : IsEnd P3 (2 * d + 1) :=
    endeq _ _ _ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hE0)) (by omega)) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P4, hR4, -, hO4, hK4, hE4⟩ := bot_ones (2 * d + 1)
    (y - 2 * d + 2 * B + 2 * d + 1) _ P3 (by omega) hR3 hE3a
  have heven4 : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → x ≤ 4 * d → Adj P4 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases hx : x < 2 * d + 1
    · exact hO4 x hx
    · have h2 := hC2 ((x - 2 * d - 2) / 2) (by omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2
      have h4 := hK4 _ (adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h3 rfl (by omega))
      exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hodd4 : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → 4 * d + 3 ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ y → Adj P4 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    have h1 := hS0 (x - 4 * d - 2) (by omega)
    have h2 := hK1 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
    have h3 := hK2 _ h2 (fun i hi => by omega)
    have h4 := hK3 _ h3
    have h5 := hK4 _ (adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h4 rfl (by omega))
    exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h5 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P5, hR5, hC5, hK5, hE5⟩ := bot_pairs y (y - 2 * d + 2 * B + 2 * d + 1 + (2 * d + 1)) T _ P4
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR4 (fun i hi =>
      adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hodd4 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) rfl (by omega))
  have hP5e : IsEnd P5 (y - 1) :=
    endeq _ _ _ (hE5 _ (hE4 _ hP3e (by omega))) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P6, hR6, hE6a, hK6, -⟩ := bot_attach y
    (y - 2 * d + 2 * B + 2 * d + 1 + (2 * d + 1) + 2 * T) _ P5 (by omega) (by omega) hR5 hP5e
  refine ⟨y, le_rfl, by omega, P6, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : y - 2 * d + 2 * B + 2 * d + 1 + (2 * d + 1) + 2 * T + 1 = y + 2 * B + c + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [e] at hR6
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * d - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * d) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * d + 1) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * T) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y =
        prescribedLengths y k y (2 * B) c := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have e1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 =
          Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * d - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * d + 1) 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have e2 : Multiset.replicate c y =
          Multiset.replicate (2 * d) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * T) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
        simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [e1, e2]
      abel
    rw [hL] at hR6
    exact hR6
  · refine ⟨hE6a, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : 2 * j - 2 < 2 * T
      · have h5 := hC5 (j - 1) (by omega)
        have h6 := hK6 _ h5
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h6 (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h4 := heven4 (2 * j - 2 - 2 * T) (by omega) (by omega)
        have h5 := hK5 _ h4 (fun i hi => by omega)
        have h6 := hK6 _ h5
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h6 (by omega) (by omega)

proof.tactics:
by
  have adj_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u w → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' rfl rfl h
    exact h
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hH1 hH2 hH3
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, y - k = 2 * C + 2 * s + 1 := ⟨(y - k - 1 - 2 * C) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, b = 2 * s + 2 * t + 2 := ⟨(b - 2 * s - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := by omega
  have hsk : 2 * s ≤ k := by omega
  have htC : t + 1 ≤ C := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨Q0, hR0, hA0, hB0, hE0, -⟩ := path_II (y + 2) (k + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨Q1, hR1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 2) C _ Q0 (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hR0
    (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (hB0 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)))
  
  obtain ⟨Q2, hR2, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * C) s _ Q1 (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hR1 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := hA0 (2 * s - 1 - 2 * i) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h1)
  have hEnd : IsEnd Q2 (y - k - 1) := by
    have h := hE2 _ (hE1 0 hE0)
    rw [show 0 + 2 * C + 2 * s = y - k - 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨Q3, hR3, hE3, hK3, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * C + 2 * s) _ Q2 (by omega)

  obtain ⟨Q4, hR4, -, hK4, hE4⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 2 + 2 * C + 2 * s + 1) t _ Q3
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR3 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := hB0 (k + 2 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h3)
  refine ⟨y, le_refl y, by omega, Q4, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hV : y + (2 * s + 2 * t + 2) + 2 * C + 1 = y + 2 + 2 * C + 2 * s + 1 + 2 * t := by omega
    rw [hV]
    refine ⟨hR4.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hR4.2]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have e1 : y + 2 - 2 = y := by omega
    have e2 : y + 2 - (k + 2) = y - k := by omega
    rw [e1, e2]
    have h2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * s + 2 * t + 2) (y - k) = Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [h2]
    abel
  · refine ⟨hE4 _ hE3, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)⟩
    have key : Adj Q2 (2 * j - 2) (2 * j - 2 + 1) := by
      by_cases hW1 : 2 * j - 2 < 2 * s
      · exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hN2 (j - 1) (by omega))
      by_cases hW2 : 2 * j - 2 < 2 * s + 2 * C
      · have h1 := hN1 (j - 1 - s) (by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2
      · have h0 := hA0 (2 * j - 2 - 2 * s - 2 * C) (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2
    have h3 := hK3 _ key
    have h4 := hK4 _ h3 (fun i hi => by omega)
    exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h4

signature.name: bEE_EBk
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → 2 ≤ c → c + 3 ≤ y - k → y ≤ b + c + 3 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have bot_ones : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + r) (x + r + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ 0 → IsEnd p' (x + r)) := by
    have eCC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =
        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l) := by
      intro a b l
      simp [edgeLengths]
    have eS : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := by
      intro a
      simp [edgeLengths]
    have eSnoc : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) := by
      intro a b l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [eCC, eS]
      | cons c l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, eCC, eS]
          exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
        | cons d l =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC, Multiset.cons_swap]
    have eRev : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths l.reverse = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b l =>
          have h1 : (a :: b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b, a] := by simp
          have h2 : (b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b] := by simp
          rw [h1, eSnoc, ← h2, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          rw [← Int.natAbs_neg]
          congr 1
          ring
    have eMap : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths (l.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp [eS]
        | cons b l =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring_nf
    have adjRev : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj l.reverse u w := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    have adjShift : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w →
        Adj (0 :: l.map (· + 1)) (u + 1) (w + 1) := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
    have gLast : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), l.getLast? = some x →
        (0 :: l.map (· + 1)).getLast? = some (x + 1) := by
      intro l x h
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons a l =>
        have e : (a + 1) :: List.map (fun x => x + 1) l = (a :: l).map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [List.map_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons, e, List.getLast?_map, h]
        rfl
    have H : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
        p.head? = some 0 →
        ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧
          p'.head? = some 0 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
          (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + r) (w + r)) ∧
          (∀ x : ℕ, p.getLast? = some x → p'.getLast? = some (x + r)) := by
      intro r v L p hp hh
      induction r with
      | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, hh, fun x hx => by omega,
          fun u w h => by simpa using h, fun x hx => by simpa using hx⟩
      | succ r ih =>
        obtain ⟨p', ⟨hperm, hlen⟩, hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, p' = 0 :: t := by
          cases p' with
          | nil => simp at hh'
          | cons a t => simp at hh'; exact ⟨t, by rw [hh']⟩
        refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + r + 1))
          rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
          exact (List.Perm.map (· + 1) hperm).cons 0
        · have e : (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)) = 0 :: 1 :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
          have e' : (1 :: t.map (· + 1)) = (0 :: t).map (· + 1) := rfl
          rw [e, eCC, e', eMap, hlen, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.add_cons]
          rfl
        · intro x hx
          rcases x with _ | x
          · exact ⟨[], (t.map (· + 1)), Or.inl (by simp)⟩
          · exact adjShift _ _ _ (hO x (by omega))
        · intro u w h
          exact adjShift _ _ _ (hA u w h)
        · intro x hx
          have h := gLast _ _ (hL x hx)
          rw [show x + (r + 1) = x + r + 1 by omega]
          exact h
    intro r v L p hv hp h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p hp h0
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ hx
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
      · exact Or.inr (hL x hx)
    · have hpr : IsLinearRealization v L p.reverse :=
        ⟨List.Perm.trans (List.reverse_perm p) hp.1, by rw [eRev]; exact hp.2⟩
      have hh : p.reverse.head? = some 0 := by rw [List.head?_reverse]; exact h0
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p.reverse hpr hh
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ (adjRev _ _ _ hx)
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact Or.inr (hL x (by rw [List.getLast?_reverse]; exact hx))
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
  have adjeq : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endeq : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hc0 hc3 hbc
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, k = 2 * K := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, y = 2 * M + 1 + k := ⟨(y - 1 - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ : ∃ B, b = 2 * B := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, B + C = M + t := ⟨B + C - M, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, M = C + 1 + s := ⟨M - 1 - C, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q0, hR0, hA0, hB0, hE0, hE0'⟩ := path_II (y - k + 2) 2 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨Q1, hR1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 2) t _ Q0
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR0 (fun i hi =>
      adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hB0 (2 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨Q2, hR2, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y - k + 2 + 2 * t) C _ Q1
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR1 (fun i hi => by
      by_cases hiK : K ≤ i + 1
      · have h0 := hB0 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h1 rfl (by omega)
      · exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hN1 (K - 2 - i) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨Q3, hR3, hN3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 2 + 2 * t + 2 * C) s _ Q2
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR2 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := hB0 (2 * s + 1 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega))
  have hQ3e : IsEnd Q3 (y - k - 1) := endeq _ _ _ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hE0'))) (by omega)
  
  have heven3 : ∀ z : ℕ, z % 2 = 0 → z ≤ 2 * s + 2 * C → Adj Q3 z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz1 hz2
    by_cases hzs : z < 2 * s
    · exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hN3 (z / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · by_cases hzc : z < 2 * s + 2 * C
      · have h2 := hN2 ((z - 2 * s) / 2) (by omega)
        have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h0 := hA0 0 (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
        have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨Q4, hR4, hE4a, hK4, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y - k + 2 + 2 * t + 2 * C + 2 * s) _ Q3
    (by omega) (by omega) hR3 hQ3e
  
  obtain ⟨Q5, hR5, hE5a, hO5, hK5, -⟩ := bot_ones k (y - k + 2 + 2 * t + 2 * C + 2 * s + 1) _ Q4
    (by omega) hR4 hE4a
  refine ⟨y, le_rfl, by omega, Q5, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : y - k + 2 + 2 * t + 2 * C + 2 * s + 1 + k = y + 2 * B + 2 * C + 1 := by omega
    rw [e] at hR5
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - k + 2 - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k + 2 - 2) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * C) y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate k 1 = prescribedLengths y k y (2 * B) (2 * C) := by
      rw [show y - k + 2 - 2 = y - k by omega]
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have e1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 =
          Multiset.replicate (y - k) 1 + Multiset.replicate k 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have e2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) =

          Multiset.replicate (2 * s) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
        simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [e1, e2]
      abel
    rw [hL] at hR5
    exact hR5

      · exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ (hO5 (2 * j - 1) hj) rfl (by omega)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → c + k + 3 ≤ y - k → y - k + 3 ≤ b + c → b + c + 5 ≤ y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

signature.name: bEE_Gband
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → c + k + 3 ≤ y - k → y - k + 3 ≤ b + c → b + c + 5 ≤ y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

by
  
  
  have bot_ones : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →

    have eCC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =

      intro a b l
      simp [edgeLengths]

      intro a

        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) := by
      intro a b l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [eCC, eS]

        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, eCC, eS]

          ring

        | nil => simp [eS]

      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩

      intro r v L p hp hh

        List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r), Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc]
    · 
      intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, x = j + d := ⟨x - j, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = d + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨m - d - 2, by omega⟩

        List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.map (fun y => d + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r)) ++
          List.range j, Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc, add_assoc]
    · 
      right
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [List.range_succ]
      simp
    · 
      left
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [List.head?_append, List.head?_map, List.head?_range, hm0]
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hkc hbc
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, k = 2 * K + 1 := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, y - k = 2 * M := ⟨(y - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B, b = 2 * B := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J, J + 1 = B + C := ⟨B + C - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, j + 2 * J = y := ⟨y - 2 * J, by omega⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q0, hR0, hLo0, hHi0, hEa, -⟩ := seed (y + 1) j (by omega) (by omega)
  have hS : ∀ x : ℕ, x ≤ y - 1 → x ≠ j - 1 → Adj Q0 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    by_cases hx : x + 2 ≤ j

  obtain ⟨Q1, hR1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) B _ Q0 (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hR0
    (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (hS (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)))
  
  obtain ⟨Q2, hR2, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * B) (C - 1) _ Q1 (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hR1 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := hHi0 (y - 2 - 2 * i - 2 * B) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h1)

    · have h1 := hN1 (e - (C - 1)) (by omega)

    have h := hE2 _ (hE1 _ hEa)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → k + 3 ≤ c → y + 3 ≤ b + c → c + 2 ≤ y - k → b + 2 * c + 1 ≤ y + (y - k) → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

by

        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + r) (x + r + 1)) ∧

    have eCC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =

        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) := by
      intro a b l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [eCC, eS]
      | cons c l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, eCC, eS]

          rw [eCC, ih, eCC, Multiset.cons_swap]

          have h2 : (b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b] := by simp

          ring

          ring_nf

      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩

          p'.head? = some 0 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧

      intro r v L p hp hh

      | succ r ih =>

          cases p' with
          | nil => simp at hh'
          | cons a t => simp at hh'; exact ⟨t, by rw [hh']⟩
        refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + r + 1))
          rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
          exact (List.Perm.map (· + 1) hperm).cons 0

      · have h := hA _ _ (adjRev _ _ _ hx)

      · exact Or.inr (hL x (by rw [List.getLast?_reverse]; exact hx))

      unfold prescribedLengths
      have e1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 =
          Multiset.replicate (y - k - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (k + 1) 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have e2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) =
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₀) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * n₁) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * n₃) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
        simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [e1, e2]
      abel
    rw [hL] at hRq
    exact hRq
  · refine ⟨hEq, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : 2 * j - 1 < k + 1
      · have h := hOq (2 * j - 1) hj
        rw [show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact h
      · have h5 := hS5 (j - K - 2) (by omega)
        have h6 := hK6 _ h5
        have h := hKq _ h6
        rw [show 2 * (j - K - 2) + 1 + (k + 1) = 2 * j - 1 by omega,
          show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact h
    · rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
      omega

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → k + 3 ≤ c → y + 3 ≤ b + c → c + 2 ≤ y - k → y + (y - k) + 1 ≤ b + 2 * c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

signature.name: okEE_G2
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 0 → k + 3 ≤ c → y + 3 ≤ b + c → c + 2 ≤ y - k → y + (y - k) + 1 ≤ b + 2 * c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

proof.tactics:
by
  have adj_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u w → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' rfl rfl h
    exact h
  have end_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), x = x' → IsEnd p x → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' rfl h
    exact h
  
  
  
  have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
    intro x a t; rfl
  have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
  have s2 : ∀ p : List ℕ, edgeLengths (p.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths p := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b t' =>
        have e : (a :: b :: t').map (· + 1) = (a + 1) :: (b :: t').map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e' : (b :: t').map (· + 1) = (b + 1) :: t'.map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [e, e', s1, ← e', ih, s1]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring_nf
  have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
      edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
    intro l a b
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
      rfl
    | cons x l ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
        have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) = edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
      | cons y l' =>
        have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
        have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
        have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
            edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
        rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
  have step1 : ∀ (w : ℕ) (Mu : Multiset ℕ) (q : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization w Mu q → IsEnd q 0 →
      ∃ q' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (w + 1) (Mu + {1}) q' ∧ IsEnd q' 0 ∧ Adj q' 0 1 ∧
        (∀ u w' : ℕ, Adj q u w' → Adj q' (u + 1) (w' + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd q x → x ≠ 0 → IsEnd q' (x + 1)) := by
    intro w Mu q hqM hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hqM
    have hM1 : Mu + {1} = 1 ::ₘ Mu := by rw [add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
    have hperm0 : (0 :: q.map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (w + 1)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      exact (hq.map _).cons 0
    have hshift : ∀ u w' : ℕ, Adj q u w' → Adj (q.map (· + 1)) (u + 1) (w' + 1) := by
      rintro u w' ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inl (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inr (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
    unfold IsEnd at hend
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl,
        ⟨[], t.map (· + 1), Or.inl rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have e : (0 :: t).map (· + 1) = (0 + 1) :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
        have e2 := s2 (0 :: t)
        rw [e] at e2
        rw [e, s1, e2, hM, hM1]
        rfl
      · intro u w' hA
        obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, hh⟩ := hshift u w' hA
        refine ⟨0 :: l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
        rcases hh with hh | hh
        · left; rw [hh]; rfl
        · right; rw [hh]; rfl
      · intro x hx hx0
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · simp at hx; omega
        · right
          obtain ⟨ys, hys⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp hx
          rw [hys, List.getLast?_eq_some_iff]
          exact ⟨0 :: List.map (· + 1) ys, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨(t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0],
        ⟨(List.perm_append_singleton 0 _).trans hperm0, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp),
        ⟨t.map (· + 1), [], Or.inr (by simp)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have e : (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) ++ [0] = t.map (· + 1) ++ [1, 0] := by simp
        have e2 : t.map (· + 1) ++ [1] = (t ++ [0]).map (· + 1) := by simp
        rw [e, s3, e2, s2, hM]
        rfl
      · intro u w' hA
        obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, hh⟩ := hshift u w' hA
        refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ [0], ?_⟩
        rcases hh with hh | hh
        · left; rw [hh]; simp
        · right; rw [hh]; simp
      · intro x hx hx0
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · left
          obtain ⟨tl, htl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp hx
          rw [htl]
          simp
        · simp at hx; omega
  have bot_ones : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + r) (x + r + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ 0 → IsEnd p' (x + r)) := by
    intro r v L p hp h0
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, h0, fun x hx => absurd hx (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
        fun x h => h, fun x h _ => h⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hqS, hqA, hqE⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'0, hq'01, hq'A, hq'E⟩ := step1 _ _ q hq hq0
      refine ⟨q', ?_, hq'0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have e : L + Multiset.replicate (n + 1) 1 = L + Multiset.replicate n 1 + {1} := by
          rw [Multiset.replicate_add, Multiset.replicate_one, add_assoc]
        rw [show v + (n + 1) = v + n + 1 by omega, e]
        exact hq'
      · intro x hx
        cases x with
        | zero => exact hq'01
        | succ x => exact hq'A _ _ (hqS x (by omega))
      · intro x hx
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hq'A _ _ (hqA x hx))
      · intro x hx hx0
        exact end_cast _ _ _ (by omega) (hq'E _ (hqE x hx hx0) (by omega))
  
  
  
  have seed : ∀ (M t0 : ℕ), 1 ≤ M → t0 ≤ M → ∃ p : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (2 * M + 2 * t0 + 1) (Multiset.replicate (2 * M - 1) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * t0) (2 * M) + Multiset.replicate 1 (2 * M)) p ∧
      IsEnd p 0 ∧ IsEnd p 1 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ M → Adj p (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, t0 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ M → Adj p (2 * j + 1) (2 * j + 2)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t0 → Adj p (2 * M + 2 * i + 1) (2 * M + 2 * i + 2)) := by
    intro M t0 hM ht0
    obtain ⟨hR, hS, h0, hE⟩ := path_range (2 * M) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨P1, hP1, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (2 * M) (2 * M) t0 _ (List.range (2 * M))
      (by omega) le_rfl (by omega) hR
      (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hS (2 * i) (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨P2, hP2, hZ2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_attach (2 * M) (2 * M + 2 * t0) _ P1 (by omega)
      (by omega) hP1 (hE1 _ hE)
    refine ⟨P2, hP2, hZ2, end_cast _ _ _ (by omega) (hE2 0 (hE1 0 h0) (by omega)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      have h := hK2 _ (hK1 (2 * j - 1) (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (hS (2 * j - 1) (by omega)))
        (fun i hi => by omega))
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      have h := hK2 _ (hK1 (2 * j) (hS _ (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega))
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h
    · intro i hi
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hK2 _ (hN1 i hi))
  
  
  
  have bp3 : ∀ (m y t₁ t₂ t₃ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), m % 2 = 0 → y % 2 = 1 → 3 ≤ y →
      2 ≤ m → m ≤ v → y ≤ v → 2 * (t₁ + t₂) ≤ y → 2 * (t₁ + t₂ + t₃) ≤ m →
      IsLinearRealization v L p →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₁ → Adj p (m - 2 - 2 * i) (m - 1 - 2 * i)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₂ → Adj p (y - 2 - 2 * t₁ - 2 * i) (y - 1 - 2 * t₁ - 2 * i)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₃ → Adj p (m - 2 - 2 * (t₁ + t₂) - 2 * i) (m - 1 - 2 * (t₁ + t₂) - 2 * i)) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃)
        (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) m + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) m) p' ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < t₁ + t₂ + t₃ → Adj p' (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₁ → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ m) →
        (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₂ → x + 2 * t₁ + 2 + 2 * i ≠ y) →
        (∀ i : ℕ, i < t₃ → x + 2 * (t₁ + t₂) + 2 + 2 * i ≠ m) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * (t₁ + t₂ + t₃)) (x + 2 * (t₁ + t₂ + t₃) + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * (t₁ + t₂ + t₃))) := by
    intro m y t₁ t₂ t₃ v L p hm hy hy3 hm2 hmv hyv hT hT3 hp h1 h2 h3
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs m v t₁ L p hm2 hmv (by omega) hp h1
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hN2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs y (v + 2 * t₁) t₂ _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega) hp₁ (fun i hi => by
        have h0 : Adj p (y - 2 - 2 * t₁ - 2 * i) (y - 2 - 2 * t₁ - 2 * i + 1) :=
          adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (h2 i hi)
        have h := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h)
    obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hN3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs m (v + 2 * t₁ + 2 * t₂) t₃ _ p₂ hm2 (by omega)
      (by omega) hp₂ (fun i hi => by
        have h0 : Adj p (m - 2 - 2 * (t₁ + t₂) - 2 * i) (m - 2 - 2 * (t₁ + t₂) - 2 * i + 1) :=
          adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) (h3 i hi)
        have h1' := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
        have h2' := hK2 _ h1' (fun i' hi' => by omega)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2')
    refine ⟨p₃, hp₃, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      by_cases hj3 : j < t₃
      · exact hN3 j hj3
      · by_cases hj2 : j < t₃ + t₂
        · have h := hK3 _ (hN2 (j - t₃) (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
          exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h
        · have h1' := hK2 _ (hN1 (j - t₃ - t₂) (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
          have h2' := hK3 _ h1' (fun i hi => by omega)
          exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h2'
    · intro x hx c1 c2 c3
      have h1' := hK1 x hx c1
      have h2' := hK2 _ h1' (fun i hi => by have := c2 i hi; omega)
      have h3' := hK3 _ h2' (fun i hi => by have := c3 i hi; omega)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h3'
    · intro x hx
      exact end_cast _ _ _ (by omega) (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hx)))
  
  
  
  have tail : ∀ (y k Ct v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 →
      k % 2 = 1 → y - k ≤ v → 2 * y ≤ v + k + 2 → 2 * Ct ≤ y → IsLinearRealization v L p →
      IsEnd p (y - k - 1) → (∀ j : ℕ, 2 * j + 4 ≤ y - k → Adj p (2 * j) (2 * j + 1)) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < Ct → Adj p (v - y + 2 * i) (v - y + 2 * i + 1)) →
      ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1 + (k + 1) + 2 * Ct)
        (L + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (k + 1) 1 +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * Ct) y) q ∧ BotEndInv y q := by
    intro y k Ct v L p hk hyk hy hk2 hv1 hv2 hCt hp hend hev htop
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hZ1, hK1, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) v L p (by omega) hv1 hp hend
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hZ2, hS2, hK2, -⟩ := bot_ones (k + 1) (v + 1) _ p₁ hp₁ hZ1
    obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hK3, hE3⟩ := top_pairs y (v + 1 + (k + 1)) Ct _ p₂ (by omega) (by omega)
      hCt hp₂ (fun i hi => by
        have a1 := hK1 _ (htop i hi)
        have a2 := hK2 (v - y + 2 * i + 1) (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) a1)
        exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) a2)
    refine ⟨q, hq, hE3 _ hZ2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      have key : Adj p₂ (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := by
        by_cases hw : 2 * j - 1 < k + 1
        · exact hS2 _ hw
        · have a1 := hK1 _ (hev ((2 * j - 1 - k - 2) / 2) (by omega))
          have a2 := hK2 (2 * ((2 * j - 1 - k - 2) / 2) + 1) (adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) a1)
          exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) a2
      have h := hK3 _ key (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ rfl (by omega) h
    · intro he
      rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
      omega
  
  
  
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 h1 h2 h3 h4
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y, y = 2 * Y + 1 := ⟨y / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, k = 2 * K + 1 := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, y - k = 2 * M := ⟨(y - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ : ∃ B, b = 2 * B := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, c = 2 * C := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨ny, hny1, hny2⟩ : ∃ ny, 2 * ny + B ≤ Y + M ∧ Y + M ≤ 2 * ny + 1 + B :=
    ⟨(Y + M - B) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ : ∃ t0, t0 + M = B + ny := ⟨B + ny - M, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨Ct, hCt⟩ : ∃ Ct, Ct + ny = C := ⟨C - ny, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, T + t0 = Y := ⟨Y - t0, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1⟩ : ∃ t1, t1 + ny = T := ⟨T - ny, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t3, ht3⟩ : ∃ t3, t3 + T + 1 = M := ⟨M - 1 - T, by omega⟩
  have f1 : K + 1 ≤ t0 := by omega
  have f2 : t0 + 1 ≤ M := by omega
  have f3 : 1 ≤ Ct := by omega
  have f4 : Ct ≤ ny := by omega
  have f5 : ny + 2 ≤ M := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hE0, hE1, hEv, hOd, hU⟩ := seed M t0 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hN, hKc, hE⟩ := bp3 (2 * M) y t1 ny t3 (2 * M + 2 * t0 + 1) _ p₀ (by omega) hy
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₀
    (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hEv (M - 1 - i) (by omega) (by omega)))
    (fun i hi => by
      by_cases hj : Y - 1 - t1 - i + 1 ≤ M
      · exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hOd (Y - 1 - t1 - i) (by omega) hj)
      · exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (hU (Y - 1 - t1 - i - M) (by omega)))
    (fun i hi => adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
      (hEv (M - 1 - T - i) (by omega) (by omega)))
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hbot⟩ := tail y k Ct (2 * M + 2 * t0 + 1 + 2 * t1 + 2 * ny + 2 * t3) _ p₃ hk hyk hy
    hk2 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₃
    (end_cast _ _ _ (by omega) (hE 1 hE1))
    (fun j hj => hN j (by omega))
    (fun i hi => by
      have h := hKc (2 * (t0 - K + i)) (hEv (t0 - K + i) (by omega) (by omega))
        (fun i' hi' => by omega) (fun i' hi' => by omega) (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact adj_cast _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h)
  
  refine ⟨y, le_rfl, by omega, q, ?_, hbot⟩
  have hV : y + 2 * B + 2 * C + 1 =
      2 * M + 2 * t0 + 1 + 2 * t1 + 2 * ny + 2 * t3 + 1 + (k + 1) + 2 * Ct := by omega
  rw [hV]
  refine ⟨hq.1, ?_⟩
  rw [hq.2]
  unfold prescribedLengths
  have r1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 = Multiset.replicate (2 * M - 1) 1 +
      Multiset.replicate (k + 1) 1 := by
    rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have r2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (2 * M) = Multiset.replicate (2 * t0) (2 * M) +
      Multiset.replicate 1 (2 * M) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t1) (2 * M) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * t3) (2 * M) + Multiset.replicate 1 (2 * M) := by
    rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
      ← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have r3 : Multiset.replicate (2 * C) y = Multiset.replicate (2 * ny) y +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * Ct) y := by
    rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hM, r1, r2, r3]
  abel

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → (eoSeed y k r).Perm (List.range (y + 4 * r + 4))

signature.name: eoSeed_perm
signature.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → (eoSeed y k r).Perm (List.range (y + 4 * r + 4))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k r hk hyk hr
  have hblk : ∀ m n : ℕ, ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y m i)).length = 6 * n := by
    intro m n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [eoBlk]
      ring
  have hlen : (eoSeed y k r).length = y + 4 * r + 4 := by
    unfold eoSeed
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, hblk, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hA : ∀ x, y + 2 * r + 3 ≤ x → x < y + 4 * r + 4 →
      x ∈ (List.range (2 * r + 1)).map (fun i => y + 4 * r + 3 - i) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y + 4 * r + 3 - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hB : ∀ x, 2 * r + 3 ≤ x → x ≤ y - k + 2 →
      x ∈ (List.range (y - k - 2 * r)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 3 + i) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (2 * r + 3), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hC : ∀ x, (∃ i, i < r ∧ (x = y - k + 3 + 2 * i ∨ x = 3 + 2 * i ∨ x = y + 3 + 2 * i ∨
      x = y + 4 + 2 * i ∨ x = 4 + 2 * i ∨ x = y - k + 4 + 2 * i)) →
      x ∈ (List.range r).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y (y - k) i) := by
    rintro x ⟨i, hi, h⟩
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, ?_⟩
    unfold eoBlk
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    omega
  have hD : ∀ x, y - k + 2 * r + 3 ≤ x → x ≤ y →
      x ∈ (List.range (k - 2 * r - 2)).map (fun i => y - k + 2 * r + 3 + i) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (y - k + 2 * r + 3), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hE : ∀ x, (x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = 2 ∨ x = y + 2 ∨ x = y + 1) →
      x ∈ ([0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1] : List ℕ) := by
    intro x h
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    omega
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 4 * r + 4 → x ∈ eoSeed y k r := by
    intro x hx
    unfold eoSeed
    simp only [List.mem_append]
    by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2
    · exact Or.inr (hE x (by omega))
    by_cases c2 : x ≤ 2 * r + 2
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hC x ⟨(x - 3) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
    by_cases c3 : x ≤ y - k + 2
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hB x (by omega) c3))))
    by_cases c4 : x ≤ y - k + 2 * r + 2
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hC x ⟨(x - (y - k) - 3) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
    by_cases c5 : x ≤ y
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (hD x (by omega) c5))
    by_cases c6 : x ≤ y + 2
    · exact Or.inr (hE x (by omega))
    by_cases c7 : x ≤ y + 2 * r + 2
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hC x ⟨(x - y - 3) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (hA x (by omega) hx))))
  have hsub : (List.range (y + 4 * r + 4)).Subperm (eoSeed y k r) :=
    List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
  exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → edgeLengths (eoSeed y k r) = prescribedLengths y k y (2 * r) (2 * r + 3)

signature.name: eoSeed_edges
signature.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → edgeLengths (eoSeed y k r) = prescribedLengths y k y (2 * r) (2 * r + 3)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := fun c d t => rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths (c :: L) = Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths L := by
    intro c h L hL
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
      subst hL
      rfl
  have up : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) _ (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), n ≤ a → L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L _ hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hn hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) _ (by omega) (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a - (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have blk : ∀ (y m r : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (m + 3 + 2 * r) →
      edgeLengths ((List.range r).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y m i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) m +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * r) y + edgeLengths L := by
    intro y m r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro L _; simp
    | succ r ih =>
      intro L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.append_assoc]
      rw [ih _ (by simp [eoBlk])]
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, L = (m + 3 + 2 * (r + 1)) :: t := by
        cases L with
        | nil => simp at hL
        | cons d t =>
          simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
          exact ⟨t, by rw [hL]⟩
      simp only [eoBlk, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((3 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((m + 3 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = m := by omega
      have e2 : Int.natAbs (((y + 3 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((3 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y + 4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 3 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have e4 : Int.natAbs (((4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e5 : Int.natAbs (((m + 4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = m := by omega
      have e6 : Int.natAbs (((m + 3 + 2 * (r + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((m + 4 + 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
      rw [show 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  intro y k r hk hyk hr
  have hm : 2 * r + 4 ≤ y - k := by omega
  unfold eoSeed
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rw [show y - k - 2 * r = (y - k - 2 * r - 1) + 1 by omega,
    show k - 2 * r - 2 = (k - 2 * r - 3) + 1 by omega]
  have hZ : edgeLengths [0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1] = 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ y ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0 := by
    rw [hU, hU, hU, hU]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [y + 1] = 0 := rfl
    have e1 : Int.natAbs (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e2 : Int.natAbs (((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    have e4 : Int.natAbs (((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    rw [h0, e1, e2, e3, e4]
  have hBZ := up (y - k + 2 * r + 3) (k - 2 * r - 3) 0 [0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1] rfl
  have eBZ : Int.natAbs (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y - k + 2 * r + 3 + (k - 2 * r - 3) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by
    omega
  rw [eBZ] at hBZ
  have hBlk := blk y (y - k) r
    ((List.range (k - 2 * r - 3 + 1)).map (fun i => y - k + 2 * r + 3 + i) ++ [0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1])
    (by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
      omega)
  have hA := up (2 * r + 3) (y - k - 2 * r - 1) (y - k + 3)
    ((List.range r).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y (y - k) i) ++
      ((List.range (k - 2 * r - 3 + 1)).map (fun i => y - k + 2 * r + 3 + i) ++ [0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1]))
    (by
      cases r with
      | zero =>
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
        simp only [List.range_zero, List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append, List.map_cons,
          List.cons_append, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
        all_goals omega
      | succ r' =>
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, eoBlk, List.cons_append, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
        all_goals omega)
  have eA : Int.natAbs (((y - k + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 * r + 3 + (y - k - 2 * r - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
    omega
  rw [eA] at hA
  have hT := down (y + 4 * r + 3) (2 * r) (2 * r + 3)
    ((List.range (y - k - 2 * r - 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 3 + i) ++
      ((List.range r).flatMap (fun i => eoBlk y (y - k) i) ++
        ((List.range (k - 2 * r - 3 + 1)).map (fun i => y - k + 2 * r + 3 + i) ++
          [0, 1, 2, y + 2, y + 1])))
    (by omega)
    (by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
      all_goals omega)
  have eT : Int.natAbs (((2 * r + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 4 * r + 3 - 2 * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by
    omega
  rw [eT] at hT
  rw [hT, hA, hBlk, hBZ, hZ]
  unfold prescribedLengths
  have ey : Multiset.replicate y 1 = Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 +
      Multiset.replicate (y - k - 2 * r - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 + Multiset.replicate (k - 2 * r - 3) 1 +
      Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
    simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have e3 : Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 3) y = Multiset.replicate (2 * r) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
    simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
  rw [ey, e3]
  simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
  abel

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → IsEnd (eoSeed y k r) (y + 4 * r + 3) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → 4 * r + 4 ≤ x → x ≤ y + 4 * r + 1 → Adj (eoSeed y k r) x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, y - k + 2 * r + 3 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ y → Adj (eoSeed y k r) x (x + 1))

signature.name: eoSeed_slots
signature.statement: ∀ (y k r : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → 2 * r + 3 ≤ k → IsEnd (eoSeed y k r) (y + 4 * r + 3) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → 4 * r + 4 ≤ x → x ≤ y + 4 * r + 1 → Adj (eoSeed y k r) x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, y - k + 2 * r + 3 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ y → Adj (eoSeed y k r) x (x + 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k r hk hyk hy hk2 hr
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_III
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - 1)) Q ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧ IsEnd Q (j - 1) ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: top_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v - ℓ) → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' v ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ v - ℓ → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_hook
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v + 1 → IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v + 1 - ℓ) → ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ + Multiset.replicate 1 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' v ∧ Adj p' v (v + 1) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ v + 1 - ℓ → IsEnd p' x)
