        exact List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)
      · refine ⟨l₁ ++ x' :: (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ x' x,
          ⟨l₁ ++ [x'], x :: l₂, Or.inr (by simp)⟩,
          fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ x' x _ _ u w h1 h3 h2,
          fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ x' x _ _ z hz⟩
        have e : l₁ ++ x' :: (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂ =
            (l₁ ++ [x']) ++ (x' + ℓ) :: (x + ℓ) :: x :: l₂ := by simp
        have e' : l₁ ++ x' :: x :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [x']) ++ x :: l₂ := by simp
        rw [e, e']
        exact (List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)).trans
          (List.Perm.swap _ _ _)
    unfold IsLinearRealization IsVertexPerm at hp
    have key : ∀ i, i ≤ t → ∃ q : List ℕ, q.Nodup ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ q ↔ (z < v ∨ (v ≤ z ∧ z < v + 2 * i))) ∧
        edgeLengths q = L + Multiset.replicate (2 * i) ℓ ∧
        (∀ j, i ≤ j → j < t → Adj q (v - ℓ + 2 * j) (v - ℓ + 2 * j + 1)) ∧
        (∀ j, j < i → Adj q (v + 2 * j) (v + 2 * j + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ j : ℕ, j < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * j) → Adj q x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ z, IsEnd p z → IsEnd q z) := by
      intro i
      induction i with
      | zero =>
        intro _
        refine ⟨p, hp.1.nodup_iff.mpr List.nodup_range, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
          fun x h _ => h, fun z h => h⟩
        · intro z
          rw [hp.1.mem_iff, List.mem_range]
          omega
        · rw [hp.2]
          simp
        · intro j _ hj
          exact hpairs j hj
        · intro j hj
          omega
      | succ i ih =>
        intro hi
        obtain ⟨q, hN, hM, hE, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := ih (by omega)
        obtain ⟨q', hP, hE', hc, hd, he⟩ :=
          hs4 q (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1) (h3 i le_rfl (by omega))
        refine ⟨q', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hP.nodup_iff, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, hN⟩
          · simp only [List.mem_cons, hM]
            omega
          · rw [hM]
            omega
        · intro z
          rw [hP.mem_iff, List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons, hM]
          omega
        · rw [hE', hE, add_assoc, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
            show 2 * i + 2 = 2 * (i + 1) by ring]
        · intro j hj1 hj2
          exact hd _ _ (h3 j (by omega) hj2) (by omega) (by omega)
        · intro j hj
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj | hji
          · exact hd _ _ (h4 j hj) (by omega) (by omega)
          · have e1 : v + 2 * j = v - ℓ + 2 * i + ℓ := by omega
            have e2 : v + 2 * j + 1 = v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1 + ℓ := by omega
            rw [e2, e1]
            exact hc
        · intro x hA hne
          have hx := hne i (by omega)
          exact hd _ _ (h5 x hA hne) (by omega) (by omega)
        · intro z hz
          exact he z (h6 z hz)
    obtain ⟨q, hN, hM, hE, -, h4, h5, h6⟩ := key t le_rfl
    refine ⟨q, ⟨?_, hE⟩, h4, h5, h6⟩
    show q.Perm (List.range (v + 2 * t))
    exact (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hN List.nodup_range).mpr
      (fun z => by rw [hM, List.mem_range]; omega)
  
  have tp : ∀ (ℓ v w t v' : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → w + ℓ = v →
      2 * t ≤ ℓ → v + 2 * t = v' → IsLinearRealization v L p →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (w + 2 * i) (w + 2 * i + 1)) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization v' (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
        (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ w + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x) := by
    intro ℓ v w t v' L p h2 hw h2t hv' hp hpairs
    subst hw
    subst hv'
    have e : w + ℓ - ℓ = w := Nat.add_sub_cancel w ℓ
    obtain ⟨p', h1, h2', h3, h4⟩ := top_pairs ℓ (w + ℓ) t L p h2 (by omega) h2t hp
      (by rw [e]; exact hpairs)
    rw [e] at h3
    exact ⟨p', h1, h2', h3, h4⟩
  
  
  
  have ta : ∀ (ℓ e v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → e + ℓ = v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p e →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧
        IsEnd p' v ∧ Adj p' e v ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) := by
    have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
        Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
      intro x a t; rfl
    have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
      intro l a b
      induction l with
      | nil =>
        rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
        rfl
      | cons x l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
          have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) =
              edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
        | cons y l' =>
          have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
          have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
              edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
    intro ℓ e v L p hℓ hev hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    have hadj : ∀ (pre suf : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), Adj p x (x + 1) →
        Adj (pre ++ p ++ suf) x (x + 1) := by
      rintro pre suf x ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inl (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inr (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
    have hab1 : Int.natAbs ((e : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    have hab2 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - (e : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨v :: e :: t, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl, ⟨[], t, Or.inr rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        exact (hq.cons v).trans (List.perm_append_singleton v _).symm
      · rw [s1, hM, hab1, Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [v] [] x hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨t ++ [e, v], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp), ⟨t, [], Or.inl (by simp)⟩, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        have e' : t ++ [e, v] = (t ++ [e]) ++ [v] := by simp
        rw [e']
        exact hq.append_right [v]
      · rw [s3, hM, hab2, Multiset.replicate_one]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [] [v] x hx
  
  
  
  have path_III : ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - 1)) Q ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
      IsEnd Q (j - 1) ∧ IsEnd Q j := by
    intro n j hj hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = j + m := ⟨n - j, by omega⟩
    have hm : 1 ≤ m := by omega
    refine ⟨(List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse,
      ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      show List.Perm _ _
      rw [List.range_add]
      exact (List.reverse_perm _).append (List.reverse_perm _)
    · 
      have hlen : ((List.range j).reverse ++
          (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).length = j + m := by simp
      have hQ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h : i < ((List.range j).reverse ++
          (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).length),
          ((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse)[i] =
            if i < j then j - 1 - i else j + (m - 1 - (i - j)) := by
        intro i h
        by_cases hi : i < j
        · rw [List.getElem_append_left (by simpa using hi)]
          simp [hi, List.getElem_reverse]
        · rw [List.getElem_append_right (by simpa using hi)]
          simp [hi, List.getElem_reverse]
      have hl : List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).map
            (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))
          (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).tail.map
            (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) =
          List.replicate (j - 1) 1 ++ (j + m - 1) :: List.replicate (m - 1) 1 := by
        apply List.ext_getElem
        · simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen,
            List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]
          omega
        · intro i h1 h2
          simp only [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_tail, hlen] at h1
          rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_tail,
            hQ, hQ]
          simp only [List.getElem_append, List.getElem_cons, List.getElem_replicate,
            List.length_replicate]
          rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff]
          split_ifs <;> omega
      have he : edgeLengths ((List.range j).reverse ++
          (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse) =
          ((List.zipWith (fun (a b : ℤ) => Int.natAbs (b - a))
          (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).map
            (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ)))
          (((List.range j).reverse ++ (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range m)).reverse).tail.map
            (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℤ))) : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) := by
        unfold edgeLengths
        simp only [List.map_eq_flatMap]
        rfl
      rw [he, hl, show j + m - 2 = (j - 1) + (m - 1) by omega,
        Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_replicate,
        Multiset.coe_replicate, Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · 
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, j = x + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨j - x - 2, by omega⟩
      refine ⟨(List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r)).reverse,
        (List.range x).reverse ++
          (List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + r + y) (List.range m)).reverse, Or.inr ?_⟩
      rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append]
    · 
      intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, x = j + d := ⟨x - j, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = d + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨m - d - 2, by omega⟩
      refine ⟨(List.range j).reverse ++
          (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.map (fun y => d + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r))).reverse,
        (List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range d)).reverse, Or.inr ?_⟩
      rw [@List.range_add (d + 1 + 1) r, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append, add_assoc]
    · 
      left
      obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [List.range_succ]
      simp
    · 
      right
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [List.getLast?_append, List.head?_map, List.head?_range, hm0]
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, y - k = m := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s + y + 1 = b + c := ⟨b + c - y - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t + 1 = s := ⟨s / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t + c = y := ⟨(y - c) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t, 2 * t + 1 = c := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQlo, hQhi, -, hQe⟩ := path_III (m + 1) s (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hQ
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN₁, hK₁, hE₁⟩ := tp m (m + 1) 1 t₁ (m + s) _ Q (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hQ (fun i hi => hQlo _ (by omega))
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hE₂, -, hK₂⟩ := ta m s (m + s) _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ (hE₁ _ hQe)
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hE₃, hJ₃, hK₃⟩ := ta 1 (m + s) (m + s + 1) _ p₂ le_rfl rfl hp₂ hE₂
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, hE₄, -, hK₄⟩ := ta 1 (m + s + 1) (m + s + 1 + 1) _ p₃ le_rfl rfl hp₃ hE₃
  have hS : ∀ x : ℕ, s ≤ x → x ≤ m + s → (x + 1 ≤ m ∨ x % 2 = 1) → Adj p₄ x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2 h3
    apply hK₄
    by_cases hxm : x + 1 ≤ m
    · apply hK₃
      apply hK₂
      apply hK₁ x (hQhi x h1 (by omega))
      intro i hi
      omega
    · by_cases hxs : x = m + s
      · subst hxs
        exact hJ₃
      · apply hK₃
        apply hK₂
        have h := hN₁ ((x - m - 1) / 2) (by omega)
        rw [show m + 1 + 2 * ((x - m - 1) / 2) = x by omega] at h
        exact h
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, hN₅, hK₅, hE₅⟩ := tp m (m + s + 1 + 1 + 1) (s + 3) t₂ (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂) _
    p₄ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₄
    (fun i hi => hS _ (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega)))
  obtain ⟨p₆, hp₆, hN₆, hK₆, hE₆⟩ := tp y (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂) (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ - y) t₃
    (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃) _ p₅ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₅
    (fun i hi => hK₅ _ (hS _ (by omega) (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega)))
      (fun i' hi' => by omega))
  obtain ⟨p₇, hp₇, hE₇, -, hK₇⟩ := ta y (m + s + 1 + 1) (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃) _ p₆
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₆ (hE₆ _ (hE₅ _ hE₄))
  refine ⟨m + 1, by omega, by omega, p₇, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcount : m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ + 1 = m + 1 + b + c + 1 := by omega
    rw [hcount] at hp₇
    convert hp₇ using 1
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hm]
    have eA : Multiset.replicate (m + 1) 1 = Multiset.replicate (m + 1 - 2) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have eB : Multiset.replicate b m = Multiset.replicate 1 m + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₁) m +
        Multiset.replicate 1 m + Multiset.replicate (2 * t₂) m := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have eC : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate (2 * t₃) y +
        Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [eA, eB, eC]
    abel
  · rw [show m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 = m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ + 2 * t₃ by omega]
    exact hE₇
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    have hx : Adj p₆ (m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j) (m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j + 1) := by
      by_cases hxv : m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ ≤ m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j
      · have h := hN₆ ((m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j - (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂)) / 2) (by omega)
        rw [show m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂ +
            2 * ((m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j - (m + s + 3 + 2 * t₂)) / 2) =
            m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact h
      · have h := hN₅ ((m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j - (m + s + 1 + 1 + 1)) / 2) (by omega)
        rw [show m + s + 1 + 1 + 1 +
            2 * ((m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j - (m + s + 1 + 1 + 1)) / 2) =
            m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact hK₆ _ h (fun i' hi' => by omega)
    have h := hK₇ _ hx
    rw [show m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j + 1 = m + 1 + b + c + 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  · intro he
    exact absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → c ≤ k → c ≤ b + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → c ≤ k → c ≤ b + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have top_attach1 : ∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v - ℓ) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' v ∧
        Adj p' (v - ℓ) v ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) := by
    have s1 : ∀ (x a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (x :: a :: t) =
        Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - (x : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (a :: t) := by
      intro x a t; rfl
    have s0 : ∀ x : ℕ, edgeLengths [x] = 0 := fun x => rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := by
      intro l a b
      induction l with
      | nil =>
        rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, s1, s0, s0, zero_add]
        rfl
      | cons x l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          have e1 : [x] ++ [a, b] = x :: a :: [b] := rfl
          have e2 : [x] ++ [a] = x :: a :: [] := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (a :: [b]) =
              edgeLengths [a] + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1, ih', s1, Multiset.cons_add]
        | cons y l' =>
          have e1 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a, b] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a, b]) := rfl
          have e2 : (x :: y :: l') ++ [a] = x :: y :: (l' ++ [a]) := rfl
          have ih' : edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a, b])) =
              edgeLengths (y :: (l' ++ [a])) + {Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))} := ih
          rw [e1, e2, s1 x y (l' ++ [a, b]), ih', s1 x y (l' ++ [a]), Multiset.cons_add]
    intro ℓ v L p hℓ hv hpL hend
    obtain ⟨hq, hM⟩ := hpL
    have hadj : ∀ (pre suf : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), Adj p x (x + 1) →
        Adj (pre ++ p ++ suf) x (x + 1) := by
      rintro pre suf x ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inl (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
      · exact ⟨pre ++ l₁, l₂ ++ suf, Or.inr (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
    have hab1 : Int.natAbs (((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
      have e : ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v : ℤ) = -(ℓ : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [e]; simp
    have hab2 : Int.natAbs ((v : ℤ) - ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by
      have e : (v : ℤ) - ((v - ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ℓ : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [e]; simp
    rcases hend with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨v :: (v - ℓ) :: t, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl, ⟨[], t, Or.inr rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        exact (hq.cons v).trans (List.perm_append_singleton v _).symm
      · rw [s1, hM, hab1, Multiset.replicate_one, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [v] [] x hx
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp h
      refine ⟨t ++ [v - ℓ, v], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr (by simp), ⟨t, [], Or.inl rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · show List.Perm _ _
        rw [List.range_succ]
        have e : t ++ [v - ℓ, v] = (t ++ [v - ℓ]) ++ [v] := by simp
        rw [e]
        exact hq.append_right [v]
      · rw [s3, hM, hab2, Multiset.replicate_one]
      · intro x hx
        simpa using hadj [] [v] x hx
  
  
  
  have top_run : ∀ (s v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (v - 1) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + s) (L + Multiset.replicate s 1) p' ∧
        IsEnd p' (v + s - 1) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, v - 1 ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ v + s → Adj p' x (x + 1)) := by
    intro s
    induction s with
    | zero =>
      intro v L p hv hp he
      refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_, fun x h => h, fun x h1 h2 => by omega⟩
      · simpa using hp
      · simpa using he
    | succ s ih =>
      intro v L p hv hp he
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe, hqK, hqN⟩ := ih v L p hv hp he
      obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'e, hq'A, hq'K⟩ := top_attach1 1 (v + s) _ q (le_refl 1) (by omega) hq hqe
      refine ⟨q', ?_, ?_, fun x h => hq'K x (hqK x h), ?_⟩
      · rw [show v + (s + 1) = v + s + 1 by omega, Multiset.replicate_add, ← add_assoc]
        exact hq'
      · rw [show v + (s + 1) - 1 = v + s by omega]
        exact hq'e
      · intro x h1 h2
        by_cases hx : x + 2 ≤ v + s
        · exact hq'K x (hqN x h1 hx)
        · have hx' : x = v + s - 1 := by omega
          subst hx'
          rw [show v + s - 1 + 1 = v + s by omega]
          exact hq'A
  
  
  
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hck hcb
  
  obtain ⟨hR, hRs, hR0, -⟩ := path_range (y - c + 1) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hlow1, hkeep1, hend1⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y - c + 1) (b / 2) _
    (List.range (y - c + 1)) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR (fun i hi => by
      have h := hRs (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega)
      rw [show y - k - 2 - 2 * i + 1 = y - k - 1 - 2 * i by omega] at h
      exact h)
  
  obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hnew2, hkeep2, hend2⟩ := top_pairs y (y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2)) ((c - 1) / 2) _
    p1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp1 (fun i hi => by
      have h := hlow1 ((b + 1 - c) / 2 + i) (by omega)
      rw [show 2 * ((b + 1 - c) / 2 + i) = y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) - y + 2 * i by omega] at h
      exact h)
  
  have hodd2 : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → b ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ y + b → Adj p2 x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    by_cases h' : x + 1 ≤ y - c + b
    · have h := hkeep1 (x - b) (hRs (x - b) (by omega)) (fun i _ => by omega)
      rw [show x - b + 2 * (b / 2) = x by omega] at h
      exact hkeep2 x h (fun i _ => by omega)
    · have h := hnew2 ((x - (y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2))) / 2) (by omega)
      rw [show y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((x - (y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2))) / 2) = x by
        omega] at h
      exact h
  
  obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hE3, -, hK3⟩ := top_attach1 y (y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2)) _
    p2 (by omega) (by omega) hp2 (by
      rw [show y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) - y = 0 + 2 * (b / 2) by omega]
      exact hend2 _ (hend1 0 hR0))
  
  obtain ⟨p4, hp4, hE4, hK4, hN4⟩ := top_run (c - 1)
    (y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) + 1) _ p3 (by omega) hp3 (by
      rw [show y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) + 1 - 1 =
        y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) by omega]
      exact hE3)
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, p4, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show y - 1 + b + c + 1 =
      y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) + 1 + (c - 1) by omega]
    have hM : prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b c =
        Multiset.replicate (y - c + 1 - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * (b / 2)) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * ((c - 1) / 2)) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
          Multiset.replicate (c - 1) 1 := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have ea : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 =
          Multiset.replicate (y - c + 1 - 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate (c - 1) 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have eb : Multiset.replicate b (y - k) = Multiset.replicate (2 * (b / 2)) (y - k) := by
        congr 1
        omega
      have ec : Multiset.replicate c y =
          Multiset.replicate (2 * ((c - 1) / 2)) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [ea, eb, ec]
      abel
    rw [hM]
    exact hp4
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show y - 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 =
        y - c + 1 + 2 * (b / 2) + 2 * ((c - 1) / 2) + 1 + (c - 1) - 1 by omega]
      exact hE4
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x = y + b + c - 1 - 2 * j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have key : Adj p4 x (x + 1) := by
        by_cases h : x + 2 ≤ y + b
        · exact hK4 x (hK3 x (hodd2 x (by omega) (by omega) h))
        · exact hN4 x (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show y - 1 + b + c + 1 - 2 * j = x + 1 by omega,
        show y - 1 + b + c + 1 - 1 - 2 * j = x by omega]
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := key
      · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
    · intro he
      exact absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)

subgoal_signatures.name: path_range
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 1) 1) (List.range n) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ n → Adj (List.range n) x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd (List.range n) 0 ∧ IsEnd (List.range n) (n - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → y - k + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

signature.name: eoP4
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 0 → c % 2 = 1 → y - k + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have bot_pairs : ∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
      IsLinearRealization v L p →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
        (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
          Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t)) := by
    intro ℓ v t L p h2 hv h2t hp hpairs
    have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: r) =
        (Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: r) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have hs1base : ∀ (l₂ : List ℕ) (a a' : ℕ),
        edgeLengths ((a + ℓ) :: a :: a' :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂) =
          edgeLengths ((a + ℓ) :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
      intro l₂ a a'
      rw [hU, hU, hU, hU]
      have a1 : Int.natAbs ((a : ℤ) - ((a + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      have a2 : Int.natAbs (((a' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          Int.natAbs ((a' : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by omega
      have a3 : Int.natAbs (((a' + ℓ : ℕ) : ℤ) - (a' : ℤ)) = ℓ := by omega
      rw [a1, a2, a3]
      rw [show Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ = ℓ ::ₘ ℓ ::ₘ 0 from rfl, Multiset.cons_add,
        Multiset.add_cons, Multiset.add_cons, add_zero, Multiset.cons_swap ℓ (Int.natAbs _)]
    have hs1 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (a a' : ℕ),
        edgeLengths (l₁ ++ (a + ℓ) :: a :: a' :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂) =
          edgeLengths (l₁ ++ (a + ℓ) :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂) + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ := by
      intro l₁ l₂ a a'
      induction l₁ with
      | nil => exact hs1base l₂ a a'
      | cons c l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
          rw [hU c (a + ℓ), hU c (a + ℓ), ih, Multiset.cons_add]
        | cons d l' =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
          rw [hU c d, hU c d, ih, Multiset.cons_add]
    have hO : ∀ (l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ),
        m₁ ++ u :: w :: m₂ = l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂ → ¬(u = x ∧ w = x') →
        ∃ n₁ n₂ : List ℕ, l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂ = n₁ ++ u :: w :: n₂ := by
      intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w h hne
      rw [List.append_eq_append_iff] at h
      rcases h with ⟨as, rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨bs, rfl, h2⟩
      · rcases as with _ | ⟨a₁, _ | ⟨a₂, as'⟩⟩
        · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          exact absurd ⟨h2.1, h2.2.1⟩ hne
        · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
          exact ⟨m₁, a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
        · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
          exact ⟨m₁, as' ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂, by simp⟩
      · rcases bs with _ | ⟨b₁, _ | ⟨b₂, bs'⟩⟩
        · simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          exact absurd ⟨h2.1.symm, h2.2.1.symm⟩ hne
        · simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
          exact ⟨l₁ ++ [x, a, b], m₂, by simp⟩
        · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h2
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h2
          exact ⟨l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: bs', m₂, by simp⟩
    have hs2 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b u w : ℕ), Adj (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) u w →
        ¬ (u = x ∧ w = x') → ¬ (u = x' ∧ w = x) → Adj (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) u w := by
      intro l₁ l₂ x x' a b u w hA h1 h2
      obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm | hm⟩ := hA
      · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b u w hm.symm h1
        exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inl hn⟩
      · obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn⟩ := hO l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ x x' a b w u hm.symm (fun h => h2 ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
        exact ⟨n₁, n₂, Or.inr hn⟩
    have hs3 : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) (x x' a b z : ℕ), IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂) z →
        IsEnd (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂) z := by

      have e1 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).head? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).head? := by
        cases l₁ <;> simp
      have e2 : (l₁ ++ x :: a :: b :: x' :: l₂).getLast? = (l₁ ++ x :: x' :: l₂).getLast? := by
        simp only [List.getLast?_append_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
      unfold IsEnd at *
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact h
    have hs4 : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (a a' : ℕ), Adj q (a + ℓ) (a' + ℓ) → ∃ q' : List ℕ,
        q'.Perm (a :: a' :: q) ∧
        edgeLengths q' = edgeLengths q + Multiset.replicate 2 ℓ ∧
        Adj q' a a' ∧
        (∀ u w, Adj q u w → ¬(u = a + ℓ ∧ w = a' + ℓ) → ¬(u = a' + ℓ ∧ w = a + ℓ) → Adj q' u w) ∧
        (∀ z, IsEnd q z → IsEnd q' z) := by
      intro q a a' hA
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := hA
      · refine ⟨l₁ ++ (a + ℓ) :: a :: a' :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ a a',
          ⟨l₁ ++ [a + ℓ], (a' + ℓ) :: l₂, Or.inl (by simp)⟩,
          fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ (a + ℓ) (a' + ℓ) _ _ u w h1 h2 h3,
          fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ (a + ℓ) (a' + ℓ) _ _ z hz⟩
        have e : l₁ ++ (a + ℓ) :: a :: a' :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂ =
            (l₁ ++ [a + ℓ]) ++ a :: a' :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂ := by simp
        have e' : l₁ ++ (a + ℓ) :: (a' + ℓ) :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [a + ℓ]) ++ (a' + ℓ) :: l₂ := by simp
        rw [e, e']
        exact List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)
      · refine ⟨l₁ ++ (a' + ℓ) :: a' :: a :: (a + ℓ) :: l₂, ?_, hs1 l₁ l₂ a' a,
          ⟨l₁ ++ [a' + ℓ], (a + ℓ) :: l₂, Or.inr (by simp)⟩,
          fun u w h1 h2 h3 => hs2 l₁ l₂ (a' + ℓ) (a + ℓ) _ _ u w h1 h3 h2,
          fun z hz => hs3 l₁ l₂ (a' + ℓ) (a + ℓ) _ _ z hz⟩
        have e : l₁ ++ (a' + ℓ) :: a' :: a :: (a + ℓ) :: l₂ =
            (l₁ ++ [a' + ℓ]) ++ a' :: a :: (a + ℓ) :: l₂ := by simp
        have e' : l₁ ++ (a' + ℓ) :: (a + ℓ) :: l₂ = (l₁ ++ [a' + ℓ]) ++ (a + ℓ) :: l₂ := by simp
        rw [e, e']
        exact (List.perm_middle.trans (List.Perm.cons _ List.perm_middle)).trans
          (List.Perm.swap _ _ _)
    have hSE : ∀ r : List ℕ, edgeLengths (r.map (fun x => x + 2 * t)) = edgeLengths r := by
      intro r
      induction r with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a r ih =>
        cases r with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons b r' =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [hU, hU, ih]
          congr 1
          omega
    have hSA : ∀ (r : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj r u w →
        Adj (r.map (fun x => x + 2 * t)) (u + 2 * t) (w + 2 * t) := by
      intro r u w h
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl | rfl⟩ := h
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (fun x => x + 2 * t), l₂.map (fun x => x + 2 * t), Or.inl (by simp)⟩
      · exact ⟨l₁.map (fun x => x + 2 * t), l₂.map (fun x => x + 2 * t), Or.inr (by simp)⟩
    have hSEnd : ∀ (r : List ℕ) (z : ℕ), IsEnd r z →
        IsEnd (r.map (fun x => x + 2 * t)) (z + 2 * t) := by
      intro r z h
      unfold IsEnd at *
      rw [List.head?_map, List.getLast?_map]
      rcases h with h | h
      · left; rw [h]; rfl
      · right; rw [h]; rfl
    unfold IsLinearRealization IsVertexPerm at hp

          (List.Perm.append_right [v + 1]
            ((List.perm_append_singleton v _).symm.trans (hq.append_right [v])))

    have hperm : S.Perm (List.range (k + r + 5)) := seed_perm k r hk0
    have hedges : edgeLengths S =
        Multiset.replicate (k + r + 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 3 (r + 2) :=
      seed_edges k r hk0 (by omega)
    
    obtain ⟨hend, hK, hC, hB⟩ := seed_slots k r hk0
    have hR : IsLinearRealization (k + r + 5)
        (Multiset.replicate (k + r + 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 3 (r + 2)) S := ⟨hperm, hedges⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, -, hKp, hEp⟩ := top_pairs (r + 2) (k + r + 5) t _ S (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega) hR (fun i hi => by
        rw [show k + r + 5 - (r + 2) + 2 * i = k + 3 + 2 * i by omega]
        exact hB _ (by omega) (by omega))
    refine ⟨k + 2 + r - 1, by omega, by omega, p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show k + 2 + r - 1 + (2 * t + 3) + 0 + 1 = k + r + 5 + 2 * t by omega]
      have hM : prescribedLengths (k + 2 + r) k (k + 2 + r - 1) (2 * t + 3) 0 =
          Multiset.replicate (k + r + 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 3 (r + 2) +
            Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (r + 2) := by
        unfold prescribedLengths
        rw [Multiset.replicate_zero, add_zero, show k + 2 + r - 1 = k + r + 1 by omega,
          show k + 2 + r - k = r + 2 by omega, show 2 * t + 3 = 3 + 2 * t by omega,
          show Multiset.replicate (3 + 2 * t) (r + 2) =
            Multiset.replicate 3 (r + 2) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (r + 2) from
            Multiset.replicate_add _ _ _]
        exact (add_assoc _ _ _).symm
      rw [hM]
      exact hp
    · refine ⟨hEp 0 hend, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
      · have hS : Adj S (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := by
          by_cases h1 : 2 * j - 1 + 2 ≤ k
          · exact hC _ h1
          · by_cases h2 : 2 * j - 1 = k
            · rw [h2]
              exact hK
            · exact hB _ (by omega) (by omega)
        have h := hKp _ hS (fun i hi => by omega)
        rw [show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j by omega] at h
        exact h
      · rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
        omega

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → 2 ≤ c → c + 1 ≤ k → b ≤ c + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

signature.name: okOE_X
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → 2 ≤ c → c + 1 ≤ k → b ≤ c + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hc0 hck hbc
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, b = 2 * r + 1 := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, c = 2 * r + 2 * u := ⟨(c - 2 * r) / 2, by omega⟩
  have hr : 2 * r + 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hm : 2 * r + 2 ≤ y - k := by omega
  
  
  
  have hlenB : ∀ s n : ℕ, ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i))).length = 6 * n := by
    intro s n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [okxU]
      ring
  have hperm : (okxCore y k r).Perm (List.range (y + 4 * r + 2)) := by
    have hlen : (okxCore y k r).length = y + 4 * r + 2 := by
      unfold okxCore
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, hlenB]
      omega
    have hBm : ∀ x, (∃ i, i < r ∧ (x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y ∨
        x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k + 1 ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y + 1 ∨
        x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + 1)) →
        x ∈ (List.range r).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i)) := by
      rintro x ⟨i, hi, h⟩
      rw [List.mem_flatMap]
      refine ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, ?_⟩
      unfold okxU
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      omega
    have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 4 * r + 2 → x ∈ okxCore y k r := by
      intro x hx
      unfold okxCore
      simp only [List.mem_append]
      by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega))))
      by_cases c2 : x ≤ 4 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
      by_cases c3 : x ≤ 2 * r + 1 + k
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (4 * r + 2), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
          by omega⟩))
      by_cases c4 : x ≤ 4 * r + 1 + k
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2 - k) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
      by_cases c5 : x ≤ 2 * r + 1 + y
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨2 * r + 1 + y - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
          by omega⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2 - y) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩)))
    have hsub : (List.range (y + 4 * r + 2)).Subperm (okxCore y k r) :=
      List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
    exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm
  
  
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := fun c d t => rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths (c :: L) = Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths L := by
    intro c h L hL
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
      subst hL
      rfl
  have up : ∀ (a n h e : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = e →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 e + edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h e L hL he
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL, ← he]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h e L hL he
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) 1 _ (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h L hL, he]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h e : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), n ≤ a → L.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = e →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 e + edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h e L _ hL he
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL, ← he]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h e L hn hL he
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) 1 _ (by omega) (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h L hL, he]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have blk : ∀ (s n : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (s + 2 * n) →
      edgeLengths ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i)) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * n) y + edgeLengths L := by
    intro s n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro L _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.append_assoc]
      rw [ih _ (by simp [okxU])]
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, L = (s + 2 * (n + 1)) :: t := by
        cases L with
        | nil => simp at hL
        | cons d t =>
          simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
          exact ⟨t, by rw [hL]⟩
      simp only [okxU, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e2 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + y : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
        omega
      have e3 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      have e4 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          y - k := by omega
      have e5 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by
        omega
      have e6 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have headB : ∀ (n s : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (s + 2 * n) →
      ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i)) ++ L).head? = some s := by
    intro n s L hL
    cases n with
    | zero => simpa using hL
    | succ n =>
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp [okxU]
  have hedges : edgeLengths (okxCore y k r) = prescribedLengths y k y (2 * r + 1) (2 * r) := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, k - 2 * r = d + 1 := ⟨k - 2 * r - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, y - k - 2 * r = N + 1 + 1 := ⟨y - k - 2 * r - 2, by omega⟩
    have hA : List.range (2 * r + 2) = (List.range (2 * r + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 0 + i) := by
      simp
    have hD : (List.range (N + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) =
        (List.range (N + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++ [2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)] := by
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append]
      rfl
    unfold okxCore
    rw [hN, hd, hA, hD]
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    have hT := down (2 * r + 1 + y) N (2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)) 1 [2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)]
      (by omega) rfl (by omega)
    have hDh : ((List.range (N + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)]).head? = some (2 * r + 1 + y) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    have hCC := up (4 * r + 2) d (2 * r + 1 + y) (y - k) _ hDh (by omega)
    have hCh : ((List.range (d + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 2 + i) ++
        ((List.range (N + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)])).head? = some (2 * r + 2 + 2 * r) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
      omega
    have hB := blk (2 * r + 2) r _ hCh
    have hAA := up 0 (2 * r + 1) (2 * r + 2) 1 _ (headB r (2 * r + 2) _ hCh) (by omega)
    rw [hAA, hB, hCC, hT]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [2 * r + 1 + y - (N + 1)] = 0 := rfl
    rw [h0]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have ey : Multiset.replicate y 1 = Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 + Multiset.replicate d 1 + Multiset.replicate N 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have em : Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 1) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [ey, em]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
    abel
  
  
  
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  have J : ∀ (X Y : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), X.getLast? = some a → Y.head? = some b →
      Adj (X ++ Y) a b := by
    intro X Y a b hX hY
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_iff] at hX
    rw [List.head?_eq_some_iff] at hY
    obtain ⟨X', rfl⟩ := hX
    obtain ⟨Y', rfl⟩ := hY
    exact ⟨X', Y', Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  have hE : IsEnd (okxCore y k r) 0 := by
    left
    simp [okxCore, List.head?_range]
  
  have sA : ∀ z, z ≤ 2 * r → Adj (okxCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    unfold okxCore
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    exact F1 _ z _ _ (List.getElem?_range (by omega)) (List.getElem?_range (by omega))
  
  have sC : ∀ z, 4 * r + 2 ≤ z → z + 2 ≤ 2 * r + 2 + k → Adj (okxCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    unfold okxCore
    apply FR; apply FL
    exact RM _ _ (z - (4 * r + 2)) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  
  have sD : ∀ z, 4 * r + k + 2 ≤ z → z ≤ 2 * r + y → Adj (okxCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    unfold okxCore
    apply FL
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (2 * r + y - z) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  
  have sM : ∀ i, i < r →
      Adj (okxCore y k r) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold okxCore
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    apply INF (okxU y k (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i))
    · exact ⟨[2 * r + 2 + 2 * i, 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y],
        [2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y + 1, 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + 1], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
  
  have sJ : ∀ j, j ≤ r → Adj (okxCore y k r) (2 * r + 1 + 2 * j) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * j) := by
    intro j hj
    have hR : List.range r = List.range j ++ (List.range (r - j)).map (fun i => j + i) := by
      rw [← List.range_add]; congr 1; omega
    unfold okxCore
    rw [hR, List.flatMap_append]
    rw [show ∀ (A P Q C D : List ℕ), A ++ (P ++ Q) ++ C ++ D = (A ++ P) ++ (Q ++ C ++ D)
      from fun _ _ _ _ _ => by simp only [List.append_assoc]]
    apply J
    · rcases j with _ | j
      · rw [show 2 * r + 2 = (2 * r + 1) + 1 from rfl, List.range_succ]
        simp
      · rw [@List.range_succ j, List.flatMap_append]
        simp [okxU] <;> omega
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, r - j = s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [hs]
      rcases s with _ | s
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, k - 2 * r = d + 1 := ⟨k - 2 * r - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [hd, @List.range_succ_eq_map d]
        simp <;> omega
      · rw [@List.range_succ_eq_map s]
        simp [okxU]
  have hodd : ∀ z : ℕ, z % 2 = 1 → z + 2 ≤ y → Adj (okxCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz1 hz2
    by_cases c1 : z ≤ 2 * r
    · exact sA z c1
    by_cases c2 : z ≤ 4 * r + 1
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, z = 2 * r + 1 + 2 * j := ⟨(z - 2 * r - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
      have h := sJ j (by omega)
      rw [show 2 * r + 2 + 2 * j = 2 * r + 1 + 2 * j + 1 by omega] at h
      exact h
    by_cases c3 : z ≤ 2 * r + k
    · exact sC z (by omega) (by omega)
    by_cases c4 : z ≤ 4 * r + k + 1
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, z = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k := ⟨(z - 2 * r - 2 - k) / 2, by omega⟩
      exact sM i (by omega)
    · exact sD z (by omega) (by omega)
  
  
  
  have hD : IsLinearRealization (y + 4 * r + 2) (prescribedLengths y k y (2 * r + 1) (2 * r))
      (okxCore y k r) := ⟨hperm, hedges⟩
  have hslot : ∀ i : ℕ, i < u →
      Adj (okxCore y k r) (y + 4 * r + 2 - y + 2 * i) (y + 4 * r + 2 - y + 2 * i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    have h := sC (4 * r + 2 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show y + 4 * r + 2 - y = 4 * r + 2 by omega]
