        Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_replicate,
        Multiset.coe_replicate, Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, j = x + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨j - x - 2, by omega⟩
      refine ⟨List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + r + y) (List.range m) ++ List.range x,
        List.map (fun y => x + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r), Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc]
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, x = j + d := ⟨x - j, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = d + 1 + 1 + r := ⟨m - d - 2, by omega⟩
      refine ⟨List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.range d),
        List.map (fun y => j + y) (List.map (fun y => d + 1 + 1 + y) (List.range r)) ++
          List.range j, Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [List.range_add, List.range_succ, List.range_succ]
      simp [List.append_assoc, add_assoc]
    · right
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [List.range_succ]
      simp
    · left
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [List.head?_append, List.head?_map, List.head?_range, hm0]
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hkc hbc
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, b = 2 * T + 1 := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S, k = 2 * S + 1 := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, c = 2 * S + 2 + 2 * U := ⟨(c - k - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, y - k = 2 * M := ⟨(y - k) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQa, hQb, hQe1, hQe2⟩ := seed (y + 1) (y - k - b) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hQs : ∀ z : ℕ, z + 2 ≤ y + 1 → z + 1 ≠ y - k - b → Adj Q z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    by_cases hz : z + 2 ≤ y - k - b
    · exact hQa z hz
    · exact hQb z (by omega) h1
  
  obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hA1, hK1, hE1⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 1) T _ Q (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hQ (fun i hi =>
      adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hQs (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)) rfl (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hp20, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_attach (y - k) (y + 1 + 2 * T) _ p1 (by omega)
    (by omega) hp1 (endc _ _ _ (hE1 _ hQe2) (by omega))
  have hp2m : IsEnd p2 (y - k - 1) :=
    endc _ _ _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQe1) (by omega)) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hO, hKq, hEq⟩ := bot_ones 1 (y + 1 + 2 * T + 1) _ p2 (by omega) hp2 hp20
  have hqm : IsEnd q (y - k) := endc _ _ _ (hEq _ hp2m (by omega)) (by omega)
  have hTr : ∀ w : ℕ, Adj p1 w (w + 1) → Adj q (w + 2) (w + 2 + 1) := by
    intro w h
    have h2 := hK2 w h
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hKq (w + 1) (adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 rfl (by omega))) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hTQ : ∀ z : ℕ, Adj Q z (z + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < T → z + 2 + 2 * i ≠ y - k) →
      Adj q (z + 2 * T + 2) (z + 2 * T + 2 + 1) := by
    intro z h hside
    exact hTr _ (hK1 z h hside)
  have hEv : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 0 → x + 2 ≤ y - k → Adj q x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases h0 : x = 0
    · subst h0
      exact hO 0 (by omega)
    by_cases hxb : x + 1 ≤ b
    · have h := hTr _ (hA1 ((x - 2) / 2) (by omega))
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h := hTQ (x - b - 1) (hQs _ (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  have hOd : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → b + 2 ≤ x → x ≤ y + b → Adj q x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    have h := hTQ (x - b - 1) (hQs _ (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  
  
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, -, hK1', hE1'⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * T + 1 + 1) U _ q (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hq (fun i hi =>
      adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hOd (b + 2 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hA2, hK2', hE2'⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * T + 1 + 1 + 2 * U) S _ q1
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hq1 (fun i hi =>
      adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK1' (y - 2 - 2 * i) (hOd _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (fun i' hi' => by omega)) rfl (by omega))
  have hq2e : IsEnd q2 (y - 1) := endc _ _ _ (hE2' _ (hE1' _ hqm)) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'0, hK3', -⟩ := bot_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * T + 1 + 1 + 2 * U + 2 * S) _ q2
    (by omega) (by omega) hq2 (endc _ _ _ hq2e (by omega))
  refine ⟨y, le_refl y, by omega, q', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show y + b + c + 1 = y + 1 + 2 * T + 1 + 1 + 2 * U + 2 * S + 1 by omega]
    refine ⟨hq'.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hq'.2]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have h1 : Multiset.replicate y 1 =
        Multiset.replicate (y + 1 - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have h2 : Multiset.replicate b (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * T) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← hT]
    have h3 : Multiset.replicate c y = Multiset.replicate 1 (y + 1 - 1) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * S) y +
        Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [show y + 1 - 1 = y by omega, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
        ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [h1, h2, h3]
    abel
  · refine ⟨hq'0, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)⟩
    have key : Adj q2 (2 * j - 2) (2 * j - 2 + 1) := by
      by_cases hjS : j - 1 < S
      · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hA2 (j - 1) hjS) (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h0 := hEv (2 * j - 2 - 2 * S) (by omega) (by omega)
        have h1 := hK1' _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
        have h2 := hK2' _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega)
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK3' _ key) (by omega) (by omega)

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → y - k ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

signature.name: okOE_Z
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → y - k ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hmc
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  
  have econs : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =
      Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l) := by
    intro a b l
    rfl
  have econs_r : ∀ (a s n : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: (List.range' s (n + 1) ++ t)) =
      Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (List.range' s (n + 1) ++ t) := by
    intro a s n t
    rw [List.range'_succ, List.cons_append, econs]
  have erun : ∀ (n a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (List.range' a (n + 1) ++ t) =
      Multiset.replicate n 1 + edgeLengths ((a + n) :: t) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a t
      simp [List.range'_succ]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a t
      have h1 : List.range' a (n + 1 + 1) ++ t =
          a :: (List.range' (a + 1) (n + 1) ++ t) := by
        rw [List.range'_succ, List.cons_append]
      rw [h1, econs_r, ih (a + 1) t, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.cons_add,
        show a + 1 + n = a + (n + 1) by omega]
      congr 1
      omega
  have rsplit : ∀ (d s e : ℕ), ∃ l₁ l₂ : List ℕ,
      List.range' s (d + (e + 2)) = l₁ ++ (s + d) :: (s + d + 1) :: l₂ := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro s e
      refine ⟨[], List.range' (s + 1 + 1) e, ?_⟩
      rw [show 0 + (e + 2) = e + 1 + 1 by omega]
      simp only [List.range'_succ, List.nil_append, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ d ih =>
      intro s e
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := ih (s + 1) e
      refine ⟨s :: l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
      rw [show d + 1 + (e + 2) = d + (e + 2) + 1 by omega, List.range'_succ, h,
        show s + 1 + d = s + (d + 1) by omega]
      rfl
  
  have seed : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Z : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (k + 2 + n + 3)
      (Multiset.replicate (k + 2 + n) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n + 2) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (k + 2 + n)) Z ∧
      Adj Z (k + 2 + n + 1) (k + 2 + n + 2) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, k + 2 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ k + 2 + n → Adj Z x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x ≤ k → Adj Z x (x + 1)) ∧ IsEnd Z (k + 1) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨(k + 2 + n + 1) :: (k + 2 + n + 2) ::
      (List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1) ++ List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1)), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      unfold IsVertexPerm
      have e1 : List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1) ++ List.range' (0 + (k + 1 + 1)) (n + 1) =
          List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1)) := List.range'_append_1
      have e2 : List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1)) ++ List.range' (0 + (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1))) 2 =
          List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1) + 2) := List.range'_append_1
      have hX : List.range' (0 + (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1))) 2 = [k + 2 + n + 1, k + 2 + n + 2] := by
        rw [show 0 + (k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1)) = k + 2 + n + 1 by omega]
        rfl
      rw [hX] at e2
      rw [show 0 + (k + 1 + 1) = k + 2 by omega] at e1
      rw [List.range_eq_range', show k + 2 + n + 3 = k + 1 + 1 + (n + 1) + 2 by omega, ← e2, ← e1]
      have hP : ((List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1) ++ List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1)) ++
          [k + 2 + n + 1, k + 2 + n + 2]).Perm ((List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1) ++
          List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1)) ++ [k + 2 + n + 1, k + 2 + n + 2]) :=
        List.Perm.append_right _ List.perm_append_comm
      exact (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := [k + 2 + n + 1, k + 2 + n + 2])
        (l₂ := List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1) ++ List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1))).trans hP
    · 
      rw [econs, econs_r, erun n (k + 2),
        ← List.append_nil (List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1)), econs_r, erun (k + 1) 0 []]
      have h1 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have h2 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = n + 2 := by omega
      have h3 : Int.natAbs (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = k + 2 + n := by omega
      have h0 : edgeLengths [0 + (k + 1)] = 0 := rfl
      rw [h1, h2, h3, h0]
      have hrep : Multiset.replicate (k + 2 + n) 1 = Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
          Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate (k + 1) 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [hrep]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add, Multiset.replicate_one, add_zero]
      abel
    · exact ⟨[], _, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := rsplit (x - (k + 2)) (k + 2) (n + 1 - (x - (k + 2)) - 2)
      rw [show x - (k + 2) + (n + 1 - (x - (k + 2)) - 2 + 2) = n + 1 by omega,
        show k + 2 + (x - (k + 2)) = x by omega] at h
      refine ⟨(k + 2 + n + 1) :: (k + 2 + n + 2) :: l₁, l₂ ++ List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1), Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [h]
      simp
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := rsplit x 0 (k - x)
      rw [show x + (k - x + 2) = k + 1 + 1 by omega, show 0 + x = x by omega] at h
      refine ⟨(k + 2 + n + 1) :: (k + 2 + n + 2) :: (List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1) ++ l₁), l₂,
        Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [h]
      simp
    · right
      have hB : List.range' 0 (k + 1 + 1) = List.range' 0 (k + 1) ++ [0 + 1 * (k + 1)] :=
        List.range'_concat
      rw [hB, List.getLast?_eq_some_iff]
      exact ⟨(k + 2 + n + 1) :: (k + 2 + n + 2) ::
        (List.range' (k + 2) (n + 1) ++ List.range' 0 (k + 1)), by simp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ : ∃ T, b = 2 * T + 1 := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨U, rfl⟩ : ∃ U, c = y - k + 2 * U := ⟨(c - (y - k)) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S, y - k = 2 * S + 2 := ⟨(y - k - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZ1, hZ2, hZ3, hZe⟩ := seed (y - k - 2)
  rw [show k + 2 + (y - k - 2) = y by omega, show y - k - 2 + 2 = y - k by omega] at hZ
  rw [show k + 2 + (y - k - 2) = y by omega] at hZ1 hZ2
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hA1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 3) U _ Z (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hZ
    (by
      intro i hi
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hZ3 (3 + 2 * i) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, -, hK2, hE2⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 3 + 2 * U) T _ p₁ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₁
    (by
      intro i hi
      have hx : k + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * i + 1 ≤ y ∨ k + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * i = y + 1 ∨
          y + 3 ≤ k + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * i := by omega
      rcases hx with hx | hx | hx
      · have h := hK1 _ (hZ2 (k + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * i) (by omega) hx) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h := hK1 _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ hZ1 hx.symm (by omega)) (by intro i' hi'; omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h := hA1 ((k + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * i - (y + 3)) / 2) (by omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hA3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * T) S _ p₂ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₂
    (by
      intro i hi
      have h0 := hZ2 (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h2 rfl (by omega))
  have hEnd : IsEnd p₃ (y - 1) := endc _ _ _ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hZe))) (by omega)
  have key : ∀ e : ℕ, e % 2 = 0 → e + 3 ≤ y → Adj p₃ e (e + 1) := by
    intro e he1 he2
    by_cases hlt : e < 2 * S
    · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hA3 (e / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h0 := hZ3 (e - 2 * S) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (by intro i' hi'; omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hKq, -⟩ := bot_attach y (y + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * T + 2 * S) _ p₃ (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₃ hEnd
  have hL : Multiset.replicate y 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * T) (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * S) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y =
      prescribedLengths y k y (2 * T + 1) (y - k + 2 * U) := by
    have hb' : Multiset.replicate (2 * T + 1) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * T) (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have hc' : Multiset.replicate (y - k + 2 * U) y = Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * S) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hb', hc']
    abel
  refine ⟨y, le_refl y, by omega, q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show y + (2 * T + 1) + (y - k + 2 * U) + 1 = y + 3 + 2 * U + 2 * T + 2 * S + 1 by omega,
      ← hL]
    exact hq
  · refine ⟨hq0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj1 hj2
      have h := hKq _ (key (2 * j - 2) (by omega) (by omega))
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro he
      have := Nat.even_iff.mp he
      omega

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → k + 2 ≤ b → y ≤ b + c → 2 * b + c ≤ 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

signature.name: okOE_E2
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 0 → k + 2 ≤ b → y ≤ b + c → 2 * b + c ≤ 2 * y → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ q : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) q ∧ BotEndInv y q

proof.tactics:
by
  have eCC : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (a :: b :: l) =
      Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (b :: l) := by
    intro a b l
    simp [edgeLengths]
  
  have bot_ones : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ v →
      IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p 0 →
      ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + r) (x + r + 1)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x ≠ 0 → IsEnd p' (x + r)) := by
    have eS : ∀ a : ℕ, edgeLengths [a] = 0 := by
      intro a
      simp [edgeLengths]
    have eSnoc : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), edgeLengths (l ++ [a, b]) =
        Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (l ++ [a]) := by
      intro a b l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [eCC, eS]
      | cons c l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, eCC, eS]
          exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
        | cons d l =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC, Multiset.cons_swap]
    have eRev : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths l.reverse = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b l =>
          have h1 : (a :: b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b, a] := by simp
          have h2 : (b :: l).reverse = l.reverse ++ [b] := by simp
          rw [h1, eSnoc, ← h2, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          rw [← Int.natAbs_neg]
          congr 1
          ring
    have eMap : ∀ l : List ℕ, edgeLengths (l.map (· + 1)) = edgeLengths l := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        cases l with
        | nil => simp [eS]
        | cons b l =>
          simp only [List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [eCC, ih, eCC]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring_nf
    have adjRev : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w → Adj l.reverse u w := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨l₂.reverse, l₁.reverse, Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
    have adjShift : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj l u w →
        Adj (0 :: l.map (· + 1)) (u + 1) (w + 1) := by
      rintro l u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inl (by simp [h])⟩
      · exact ⟨0 :: l₁.map (· + 1), l₂.map (· + 1), Or.inr (by simp [h])⟩
    have gLast : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), l.getLast? = some x →
        (0 :: l.map (· + 1)).getLast? = some (x + 1) := by
      intro l x h
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons a l =>
        have e : (a + 1) :: List.map (fun x => x + 1) l = (a :: l).map (· + 1) := rfl
        rw [List.map_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons, e, List.getLast?_map, h]
        rfl
    have H : ∀ (r v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
        p.head? = some 0 →
        ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + r) (L + Multiset.replicate r 1) p' ∧
          p'.head? = some 0 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x < r → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
          (∀ u w : ℕ, Adj p u w → Adj p' (u + r) (w + r)) ∧
          (∀ x : ℕ, p.getLast? = some x → p'.getLast? = some (x + r)) := by
      intro r v L p hp hh
      induction r with
      | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, hh, fun x hx => by omega,
          fun u w h => by simpa using h, fun x hx => by simpa using hx⟩
      | succ r ih =>
        obtain ⟨p', ⟨hperm, hlen⟩, hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, p' = 0 :: t := by
          cases p' with
          | nil => simp at hh'
          | cons a t => simp at hh'; exact ⟨t, by rw [hh']⟩
        refine ⟨0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)).Perm (List.range (v + r + 1))
          rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
          exact (List.Perm.map (· + 1) hperm).cons 0
        · have e : (0 :: (0 :: t).map (· + 1)) = 0 :: 1 :: t.map (· + 1) := rfl
          have e' : (1 :: t.map (· + 1)) = (0 :: t).map (· + 1) := rfl
          rw [e, eCC, e', eMap, hlen, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.add_cons]
          rfl
        · intro x hx
          rcases x with _ | x
          · exact ⟨[], (t.map (· + 1)), Or.inl (by simp)⟩
          · exact adjShift _ _ _ (hO x (by omega))
        · intro u w h
          exact adjShift _ _ _ (hA u w h)
        · intro x hx
          have h := gLast _ _ (hL x hx)
          rw [show x + (r + 1) = x + r + 1 by omega]
          exact h
    intro r v L p hv hp h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p hp h0
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ hx
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
      · exact Or.inr (hL x hx)
    · have hpr : IsLinearRealization v L p.reverse :=
        ⟨List.Perm.trans (List.reverse_perm p) hp.1, by rw [eRev]; exact hp.2⟩
      have hh : p.reverse.head? = some 0 := by rw [List.head?_reverse]; exact h0
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hh', hO, hA, hL⟩ := H r v L p.reverse hpr hh
      refine ⟨p', hp', Or.inl hh', hO, fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA _ _ (adjRev _ _ _ hx)
        rw [show x + 1 + r = x + r + 1 by omega] at h
        exact h
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact Or.inr (hL x (by rw [List.getLast?_reverse]; exact hx))
      · rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
        omega
  
  have seed : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
      IsLinearRealization (m + 3) (Multiset.replicate m 1 + Multiset.replicate 2 m) Q ∧
      Adj Q 0 1 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ m → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
      Adj Q (m + 1) (m + 2) ∧ IsEnd Q 1 ∧ IsEnd Q (m + 1) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 2 := ⟨m - 2, by omega⟩
    have hrun : ∀ (j s : ℕ), edgeLengths (List.range' s (j + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
        Multiset.replicate j 1 + {s + j, 1} := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero =>
        intro s
        show edgeLengths [s, 0, 1] = _
        simp [edgeLengths]
        rfl
      | succ j ih =>
        intro s
        have e1 : List.range' s (j + 1 + 1) ++ [0, 1] =
            s :: (s + 1) :: (List.range' (s + 1 + 1) j ++ [0, 1]) := rfl
        have e2 : (s + 1) :: (List.range' (s + 1 + 1) j ++ [0, 1]) =
            List.range' (s + 1) (j + 1) ++ [0, 1] := rfl
        rw [e1, eCC, e2, ih]
        have h1 : Int.natAbs (((s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (s : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
        rw [h1, show s + 1 + j = s + (j + 1) by omega, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.cons_add]
    refine ⟨(n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show List.Perm _ _
      have hr : List.range (n + 2 + 3) = [0, 1] ++ List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [n + 3, n + 4] := by
        rw [List.range_eq_range']
        rw [show n + 2 + 3 = 2 + (n + 1) + 2 by omega, ← List.range'_append, ← List.range'_append]
        simp only [Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_add]
        rw [show 2 + (n + 1) = n + 3 by omega]
        rfl
      rw [hr]
      have e : (n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
          [n + 3, n + 4] ++ (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) := rfl
      rw [e]
      exact List.perm_append_comm.trans (List.perm_append_comm.append_right _)
    · have e : (n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
          (n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: 2 :: (List.range' 3 n ++ [0, 1]) := rfl
      rw [e, eCC, eCC, show 2 :: (List.range' 3 n ++ [0, 1]) = List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1] from rfl,
        hrun]
      have h1 : Int.natAbs (((n + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have h2 : Int.natAbs (((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((n + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = n + 2 := by omega
      rw [h1, h2]
      clear h1 h2
      ext a
      simp only [Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate,
        Multiset.count_singleton, Multiset.insert_eq_cons]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · exact ⟨(n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: List.range' 2 (n + 1), [], Or.inl (by simp)⟩
    · intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, x = 2 + j := ⟨x - 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, n = j + 1 + d := ⟨n - j - 1, by omega⟩
      refine ⟨(j + 1 + d + 3) :: (j + 1 + d + 4) :: List.range' 2 j,
        List.range' (2 + j + 1 + 1) d ++ [0, 1], Or.inl ?_⟩
      rw [show j + 1 + d + 1 = j + (d + 2) by omega, ← List.range'_append]
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc, Nat.one_mul]
      rfl
    · exact ⟨[], List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · right
      have e : (n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: (List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0, 1]) =
          ((n + 3) :: (n + 4) :: List.range' 2 (n + 1) ++ [0]) ++ [1] := by simp
      rw [e, List.getLast?_append]
      rfl
    · left
      rfl
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hkb hybc h2bc
  have adjc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have endc : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, k = 2 * K + 1 := ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, b = k + 2 + 2 * T := ⟨(b - k - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S, y = b + 2 * S := ⟨(y - b) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, b + c = y + 2 * U := ⟨(b + c - y) / 2, by omega⟩
  have hm2 : (y - k) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hUS : U ≤ S := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQ01, hQrun, hQtop, hQe1, -⟩ := seed (y - k) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hN1, hK1, hE1⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 3) K _ Q (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hQ (fun i hi => by
      have h := hQrun (3 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
  have L1 : ∀ x : ℕ, (x = 0 ∨ (2 ≤ x ∧ x + 2 ≤ y - k ∧ x % 2 = 0) ∨
      (k + 2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ y ∧ x % 2 = 1)) → Adj p₁ x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl | ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    · exact hK1 0 hQ01 (fun i hi => by omega)
    · exact hK1 x (hQrun x h1 (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
    · by_cases hx1 : x + 1 ≤ y - k
      · exact hK1 x (hQrun x (by omega) hx1) (fun i hi => by omega)
      by_cases hx2 : x = y - k + 1
      · subst hx2
        exact hK1 _ (adjc _ _ _ _ _ hQtop rfl (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
      · have h := hN1 ((x - (y - k) - 3) / 2) (by omega)
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hC2, hK2, hE2⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y - k + 3 + 2 * K) T _ p₁ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ (fun i hi => by
      have h := L1 (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩))
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h rfl (by omega))
  have L2a : ∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ y - k → x % 2 = 0 → Adj p₂ x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases hxT : x < 2 * T
    · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hC2 (x / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h0 := L1 (x - 2 * T) (by omega)
      have h := hK2 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  have L2b : ∀ x : ℕ, b ≤ x → x ≤ y + 2 * T → x % 2 = 1 → Adj p₂ x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2 hx3
    have h0 := L1 (x - 2 * T) (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩))
    have h := hK2 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
    exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hC3, hK3, hE3⟩ := bot_pairs y (y - k + 3 + 2 * K + 2 * T) S _ p₂ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ (fun i hi => by
      have h := L2b (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h rfl (by omega))
  have L3 : ∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ y - k + 2 * S → x % 2 = 0 → Adj p₃ x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases hxS : x < 2 * S
    · exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hC3 (x / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have h0 := L2a (x - 2 * S) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h := hK3 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)
  have hE3' : IsEnd p₃ (y - k - 1) :=
    endc _ _ _ (hE3 _ (hE2 _ (hE1 _ hQe1))) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₄, hp₄, -, hK4, hE4⟩ := top_pairs y (y - k + 3 + 2 * K + 2 * T + 2 * S) U _ p₃
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ (fun i hi => by
      have h := L3 (y - k + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega))
  
  have PS : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 * j + 2 ≤ y - k → Adj p₄ (2 * j) (2 * j + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    exact hK4 _ (L3 (2 * j) (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i hi => by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₅, hp₅, hE50, hK5, -⟩ := bot_attach (y - k)
    (y - k + 3 + 2 * K + 2 * T + 2 * S + 2 * U) _ p₄ (by omega) (by omega) hp₄ (hE4 _ hE3')
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hEq, hOq, hKq, -⟩ := bot_ones (k - 1)
    (y - k + 3 + 2 * K + 2 * T + 2 * S + 2 * U + 1) _ p₅ (by omega) hp₅ hE50
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : y - k + 3 + 2 * K + 2 * T + 2 * S + 2 * U + 1 + (k - 1) = y - 1 + b + c + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [e] at hq
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y - k) 1 + Multiset.replicate 2 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * K) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * T) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * S) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (k - 1) 1 =
        prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b c := by
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have e1 : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 =
          Multiset.replicate (y - k) 1 + Multiset.replicate (k - 1) 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have e2 : Multiset.replicate b (y - k) =
          Multiset.replicate 2 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * K) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * T) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
        simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      have e3 : Multiset.replicate c y =
          Multiset.replicate (2 * S) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * U) y := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      abel
    rw [hL] at hq
    exact hq
  · refine ⟨hEq, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : 2 * j - 1 < k - 1
      · have h := hOq (2 * j - 1) hj
        exact adjc _ _ _ _ _ h rfl (by omega)
      · have h4 := PS (j - K - 1) (by omega)
        have h5 : Adj p₅ (2 * (j - K - 1) + 1) (2 * (j - K - 1) + 1 + 1) :=
          adjc _ _ _ _ _ (hK5 _ h4) rfl (by omega)
        have h := hKq _ h5

      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      have e2 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
        omega
      have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      have e4 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  
  have tailE : edgeLengths (bS2Tail y k u w r) =
      Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * w - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 2) (y - k) := by
    unfold bS2Tail
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    rw [show y + 1 - (2 * k + 2 * w) = (y - (2 * k + 2 * w)) + 1 by omega,
      show k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 2) = (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3)) + 1 by omega,
      show k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 1) = (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3)) + 1 + 1 by omega]
    obtain ⟨S8, hS8⟩ : ∃ S8, S8 = (List.range (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1)).map
        (fun i => y + k - (2 * u + 2) - i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hS8]
    have h8 : edgeLengths S8 = Multiset.replicate (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3)) 1 := by
      rw [hS8]; exact down0 _ _ (by omega)
    have hd8 : S8.head? = some (y + k - (2 * u + 2)) := by
      rw [hS8, List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp
    have hd7 : ((List.range (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => k + 2 * r + i) ++
        S8).head? = some (k + 2 * r) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp
    have hd6 : ((List.range r).flatMap (fun i => bS2Lad y k i) ++
        ((List.range (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => k + 2 * r + i) ++
          S8)).head? = some k := by
      rcases r with _ | r
      · simpa using hd7
      · rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp [bS2Lad]
    rw [up (2 * k + 2 * w) (y - (2 * k + 2 * w)) k _ hd6, ladB r _ hd7,
      up (k + 2 * r) (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1) _ S8 hd8, h8]
    have e7 : Int.natAbs (((y + k - (2 * u + 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        ((k + 2 * r + (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by omega
    have e5 : Int.natAbs (((k : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 * k + 2 * w + (y - (2 * k + 2 * w)) : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        y - k := by omega
    rw [e7, e5]
    have ea : Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * w - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) 1 =
        Multiset.replicate (y - (2 * k + 2 * w)) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 +
          Multiset.replicate (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3) + 1) 1 +
          Multiset.replicate (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 3)) 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      all_goals (congr 1; omega)
    have eb : Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 2) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      all_goals (congr 1; omega)
    rw [ea, eb]
    abel
  
  have headE : ∀ L : List ℕ, L.head? = some (2 * k + 2 * w) →
      edgeLengths (bS2Head y k u w ++ L) = Multiset.replicate (k + 2 * w) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1 + 2 * w) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1) y +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro L hL
    unfold bS2Head
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [show List.range (k - 2 * u) = (List.range (k - 2 * u - 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 0 + i) by
      rw [show k - 2 * u - 1 + 1 = k - 2 * u by omega]; simp]
    obtain ⟨S4, hS4⟩ : ∃ S4, S4 = (List.range w).flatMap (fun j => bS2Rung y k j) ++ L :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hS4]
    have h4 : edgeLengths S4 = Multiset.replicate (2 * w) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * w) (y - k) +
        edgeLengths L := by
      rw [hS4]; exact rungB w L hL
    have hd4 : S4.head? = some (2 * k) := by
      rw [hS4]
      rcases w with _ | w
      · simpa using hL
      · rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp [bS2Rung]
    have hd2 : ((List.range u).flatMap (fun i => bS2Unit y k (k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i)) ++
        (k - 1 + y) :: (2 * k - 1) :: S4).head? = some (k - 2 * u - 1 + y) := by
      rcases u with _ | u
      · simp
      · rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp [bS2Unit]
    rw [up 0 (k - 2 * u - 1) _ _ hd2]
    rw [unitB (k - 2 * u - 1) u _ (by simp; omega)]
    rw [hU, hC _ _ _ hd4, h4]
    have eA : Int.natAbs (((k - 2 * u - 1 + y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((0 + (k - 2 * u - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by
      omega
    have eB : Int.natAbs (((2 * k - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k - 1 + y : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by omega
    have eC : Int.natAbs (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 * k - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    rw [eA, eB, eC]
    have ea : Multiset.replicate (k + 2 * w) 1 = Multiset.replicate (k - 2 * u - 1) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * w) 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
      all_goals (congr 1; omega)
    have eb : Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1 + 2 * w) (y - k) = Multiset.replicate (2 * u) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * w) (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add]
    have ec : Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1) y = Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u) y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      all_goals (congr 1; omega)
    rw [ea, eb, ec]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
    abel
  have hE : edgeLengths (bS2List y k u w r) =
      prescribedLengths y k (y + k - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) (2 * u + 3 + 2 * w + 2 * r) (2 * u + 1) := by
    unfold bS2List
    rw [headE _ hT, tailE]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have e1 : Multiset.replicate (y + k - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) 1 =
        Multiset.replicate (k + 2 * w) 1 + Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * w - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) 1 := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have e2 : Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 3 + 2 * w + 2 * r) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1 + 2 * w) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 2) (y - k) := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [e1, e2]
    abel
  have hq : IsLinearRealization (y + k + 2 * w)
      (prescribedLengths y k (y + k - 4 * u - 2 * r - 5) (2 * u + 3 + 2 * w + 2 * r) (2 * u + 1))
      (bS2List y k u w r) := ⟨hP, hE⟩
  have reflR : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
      IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w →
        Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x)) := by
    clear hq hP hE hcov hlen hT h0
    intro v L p hp
    obtain ⟨hperm, hedge⟩ := hp
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ p, x < v := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mp (hperm.mem_iff.mp hx)
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold IsVertexPerm
      refine (hperm.map _).trans ?_
      have hnd : ((List.range v).map (fun x => v - 1 - x)).Nodup := by
        refine List.Nodup.map_on ?_ List.nodup_range
        intro x hx z hz hxz
        rw [List.mem_range] at hx hz
        omega
      have hsub : ((List.range v).map (fun x => v - 1 - x)).Subperm (List.range v) := by
        refine List.Nodup.subperm hnd ?_
        intro z hz
        rw [List.mem_map] at hz
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
        rw [List.mem_range] at hx ⊢
        omega
      exact hsub.perm_of_length_le (by simp)
    · rw [← hedge]
      unfold edgeLengths
      congr 1
      clear hedge hperm
      revert hmem
      induction p with
      | nil => intro _; simp
      | cons a t ih =>
        intro hl
        cases t with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b t' =>
          have ha : a < v := hl a (by simp)
          have hb : b < v := hl b (by simp)
          have ih' := ih (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
          simp only [List.pure_def, List.bind_eq_flatMap, List.flatMap_cons, List.cons_append,
            List.nil_append, List.map_cons, List.tail_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons] at ih' ⊢
          rw [ih']
          congr 1
          show Int.natAbs (((v - 1 - b : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 - a : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
            Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))
          have h1 : ((v - 1 - b : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 - a : ℕ) : ℤ) = -((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by
            omega
          rw [h1, Int.natAbs_neg]
    · intro u' w' _ _ h
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := h
      refine ⟨l₁.map (fun x => v - 1 - x), l₂.map (fun x => v - 1 - x), ?_⟩
      rcases h with h | h
      · left; subst h; simp
      · right; subst h; simp
    · intro x _ h
      unfold IsEnd at h ⊢
      rw [List.head?_map, List.getLast?_map]
      rcases h with h | h
      · left; rw [h]; rfl
      · right; rw [h]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hp, hA, hEnd⟩ := reflR _ _ _ hq
  
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  have J : ∀ (X Y : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), X.getLast? = some a → Y.head? = some b →
      Adj (X ++ Y) a b := by
    intro X Y a b hX hY
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_iff] at hX
    rw [List.head?_eq_some_iff] at hY
    obtain ⟨X', rfl⟩ := hX
    obtain ⟨Y', rfl⟩ := hY
    exact ⟨X', Y', Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  refine ⟨_, hp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := hEnd 0 (by omega) (Or.inl h0)
    rw [Nat.sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    have key : Adj (bS2List y k u w r) (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x = 2 * j - 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hx]
      have hxo : x % 2 = 1 := by omega
      have hxy : x + 2 ≤ y := by omega
      clear hx
      by_cases h1 : x + 1 ≤ k - 2 * u - 1
      · 
        unfold bS2List bS2Head
        apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
        exact F1 _ x x (x + 1) (List.getElem?_range (by omega)) (List.getElem?_range (by omega))
      by_cases h2 : x + 2 ≤ k
      · 
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + 1 := ⟨(x - (k - 2 * u)) / 2, by omega⟩
        have hi : i < u := by omega
        unfold bS2List bS2Head
        apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
        apply INF (bS2Unit y k (k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i))
        · refine ⟨[k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + y, k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + k,
            k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + k + 1, k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + y + 1], [], Or.inl ?_⟩
          unfold bS2Unit
          simp
        · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
      by_cases h3 : x + 1 ≤ k + 2 * r
      · 
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = k + 2 * i := ⟨(x - k) / 2, by omega⟩
        have hi : i < r := by omega
        unfold bS2List bS2Tail
        apply FL; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
        apply INF (bS2Lad y k i)
        · exact ⟨[], [y + 2 * i + 1, y + 2 * i + 2], Or.inl rfl⟩
        · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
      by_cases h4 : x + 2 * u + 3 ≤ 2 * k
      · 
        unfold bS2List bS2Tail
        apply FL; apply FR; apply FL
        exact RM _ _ (x - (k + 2 * r)) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
          (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      by_cases h5 : x + 3 ≤ 2 * k
      · 
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + k :=
          ⟨(x - (2 * k - 2 * u - 1)) / 2, by omega⟩
        have hi : i < u := by omega
        unfold bS2List bS2Head
        apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
        apply INF (bS2Unit y k (k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i))
        · refine ⟨[k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + y], [k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + y + 1,
            k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + 1, k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i + 2], Or.inl ?_⟩
          unfold bS2Unit
          simp
        · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
      by_cases h6 : x + 1 ≤ 2 * k + 2 * w
      · 
        obtain ⟨jj, hjj⟩ : ∃ jj, x + 1 = 2 * k + 2 * jj := ⟨(x + 1 - 2 * k) / 2, by omega⟩
        have hjw : jj ≤ w := by omega
        rw [show x = 2 * k + 2 * jj - 1 by omega, show 2 * k + 2 * jj - 1 + 1 = 2 * k + 2 * jj by omega]
        have hR : List.range w = List.range jj ++ (List.range (w - jj)).map (fun i => jj + i) := by
          rw [← List.range_add]; congr 1; omega
        unfold bS2List bS2Head
        rw [hR, List.flatMap_append]
        rw [show ∀ (A B C P Q T : List ℕ), A ++ B ++ C ++ (P ++ Q) ++ T =
            (A ++ B ++ C ++ P) ++ (Q ++ T) from fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => by simp only [List.append_assoc]]
        apply J
        · rcases jj with _ | jj
          · simp
          · rw [@List.range_succ jj, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton,
              show 2 * k + 2 * (jj + 1) - 1 = 2 * k + 2 * jj + 1 by omega]
            rw [List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ (by simp [bS2Rung]),
              List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ (by simp [bS2Rung])]
            simp [bS2Rung]
        · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, w - jj = s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
          rw [hs]
          rcases s with _ | s
          · simp [hT] <;> omega
          · rw [@List.range_succ_eq_map s]
            simp [bS2Rung]
      · 
        unfold bS2List bS2Tail
        apply FL; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
        exact RM _ _ (x - (2 * k + 2 * w)) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
          (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
    have h := hA _ _ (by omega) (by omega) key
    rw [show y + k + 2 * w - 1 - (2 * j - 1) = y + k + 2 * w - 2 * j by omega,
      show y + k + 2 * w - 1 - (2 * j - 1 + 1) = y + k + 2 * w - 1 - 2 * j by omega] at h
    exact h
  · intro he
    exact absurd (Nat.even_iff.mp he) (by omega)

bko11_S2.definitions:
def bS2Unit (y k x : ℕ) : List ℕ := [x + y, x + k, x + k + 1, x + y + 1, x + 1, x + 2]

def bS2Rung (y k j : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  [2 * k + 2 * j, y + k + 2 * j, y + k + 2 * j + 1, 2 * k + 2 * j + 1]

def bS2Lad (y k i : ℕ) : List ℕ := [k + 2 * i, k + 2 * i + 1, y + 2 * i + 1, y + 2 * i + 2]

def bS2Head (y k u w : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  List.range (k - 2 * u) ++ (List.range u).flatMap (fun i => bS2Unit y k (k - 2 * u - 1 + 2 * i)) ++
    [k - 1 + y, 2 * k - 1] ++ (List.range w).flatMap (fun j => bS2Rung y k j)

def bS2Tail (y k u w r : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (y + 1 - (2 * k + 2 * w))).map (fun i => 2 * k + 2 * w + i) ++
    (List.range r).flatMap (fun i => bS2Lad y k i) ++
    (List.range (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 1))).map (fun i => k + 2 * r + i) ++
    (List.range (k - (2 * u + 2 * r + 2))).map (fun i => y + k - (2 * u + 2) - i)

def bS2List (y k u w r : ℕ) : List ℕ := bS2Head y k u w ++ bS2Tail y k u w r

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 2 ≤ k → y + c + 3 ≤ b + 2 * k → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

    have ey : Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * u - 2) 1 = Multiset.replicate (2 * u) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * w1) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * w2) 1 + Multiset.replicate g 1 + Multiset.replicate d 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have em : Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * w1) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * w2) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have ec : Multiset.replicate (2 * u + 1) y =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * u) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [ey, em, ec]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_one]
    abel
  
  
  
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  have J : ∀ (X Y : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), X.getLast? = some a → Y.head? = some b →
      Adj (X ++ Y) a b := by
    intro X Y a b hX hY
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_iff] at hX
    rw [List.head?_eq_some_iff] at hY
    obtain ⟨X', rfl⟩ := hX
    obtain ⟨Y', rfl⟩ := hY
    exact ⟨X', Y', Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  have hE : IsEnd (bs6List y k u w1 w2) 0 := by
    left
    simp [bs6List]
  have sB : ∀ i, i < u → Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) (2 * i + 1) (2 * i + 1 + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold bs6List
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    apply FL
    apply INF (bs6U y k (2 * i))
    · exact ⟨[2 * i + y, 2 * i + k, 2 * i + k + 1, 2 * i + y + 1], [], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
  have sM : ∀ i, i < u → Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) (2 * i + k) (2 * i + k + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold bs6List
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    apply FL
    apply INF (bs6U y k (2 * i))
    · exact ⟨[2 * i + y], [2 * i + y + 1, 2 * i + 1, 2 * i + 2], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
  have sH : ∀ x, 2 * u + 1 ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ k → Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    unfold bs6List
    apply FR; apply FL
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (k - 2 - x) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  have sG : ∀ x, 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 5 + 2 * w2 ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ y →
      Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    unfold bs6List
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    exact RM _ _ (x - (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 5 + 2 * w2)) _ _ (by omega)
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega)) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  have sI : Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) (2 * u + 1 + (y - k)) (2 * u + 2 + (y - k)) := by
    unfold bs6List
    exact FL _ _ _ _ ⟨[], [], Or.inl rfl⟩
  have sJ1 : ∀ j, j ≤ w1 →
      Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) (2 * u + k + 2 * j) (2 * u + k + 2 * j + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    have hR : List.range w1 = List.range j ++ (List.range (w1 - j)).map (fun i => j + i) := by
      rw [← List.range_add]; congr 1; omega
    unfold bs6List
    rw [hR, List.flatMap_append]
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    apply FL; apply FL
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    apply J
    · rcases j with _ | j
      · simp
      · rw [@List.range_succ j, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton,
          List.getLast?_eq_some_iff]
        refine ⟨[2 * u + y, 2 * u + k] ++
          (List.range j).flatMap (fun i => bs6R y k (2 * u + k + 2 * i)) ++
          [2 * u + k + 2 * j + 1, 2 * u + k + 2 * j + 1 + (y - k),
            2 * u + k + 2 * j + 2 + (y - k)], ?_⟩
        rw [show 2 * u + k + 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * u + k + 2 * j + 2 by ring]
        simp [bs6R]
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, w1 - j = s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [hs]
      rcases s with _ | s
      · simp <;> omega
      · rw [@List.range_succ_eq_map s]
        simp [bs6R] <;> omega
  have sJ2 : ∀ j, j ≤ w2 → Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j)
      (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    have hR : List.range w2 = List.range j ++ (List.range (w2 - j)).map (fun i => j + i) := by
      rw [← List.range_add]; congr 1; omega
    unfold bs6List
    rw [hR, List.flatMap_append]
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    apply FL; apply FL; apply FL; apply FL
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    apply J
    · rcases j with _ | j
      · simp
      · rw [@List.range_succ j, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton,
          List.getLast?_eq_some_iff]
        refine ⟨[2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 1, 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 1 + (y - k),
            2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 2 + (y - k), 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 3 + (y - k),
            2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + (y - k), 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4] ++
          (List.range j).flatMap (fun i => bs6R y k (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * i)) ++
          [2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j + 1, 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j + 1 + (y - k),
            2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j + 2 + (y - k)], ?_⟩
        rw [show 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j + 2 by ring]
        simp [bs6R]
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, w2 - j = s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [hs]
      rcases s with _ | s
      · rw [hg, @List.range_succ_eq_map g]
        simp <;> omega
      · rw [@List.range_succ_eq_map s]
        simp [bs6R] <;> omega
  have hodd : ∀ x : ℕ, x % 2 = 1 → x + 2 ≤ y → Adj (bs6List y k u w1 w2) x (x + 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    by_cases c1 : x + 1 ≤ 2 * u
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = 2 * i + 1 := ⟨x / 2, by omega⟩
      exact sB i (by omega)
    by_cases c2 : x + 2 ≤ k
    · exact sH x (by omega) c2
    by_cases c3 : x + 2 ≤ k + 2 * u
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, x = 2 * i + k := ⟨(x - k) / 2, by omega⟩
      exact sM i (by omega)
    by_cases c4 : x ≤ 2 * u + k + 2 * w1
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, x = 2 * u + k + 2 * j := ⟨(x - 2 * u - k) / 2, by omega⟩
      exact sJ1 j (by omega)
    by_cases c5 : x = 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 2
    · rw [show x + 1 = 2 * u + 2 + (y - k) by omega, show x = 2 * u + 1 + (y - k) by omega]
      exact sI
    by_cases c6 : x ≤ 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * w2
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, x = 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j :=
        ⟨(x - (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4)) / 2, by omega⟩
      exact sJ2 j (by omega)
    · exact sG x (by omega) hx2
  
  
  
  have hq : IsLinearRealization (y + 2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5)
      (prescribedLengths y k (y - 2 * u - 2) (2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5) (2 * u + 1))
      (bs6List y k u w1 w2) := ⟨hperm, hedges⟩
  obtain ⟨hp, hadj, hend⟩ := refl _ _ _ hq
  refine ⟨y - 2 * u - 2, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [show y - 2 * u - 2 + (2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5) + (2 * u + 1) + 1 =
    y + 2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5 by omega]
  refine ⟨_, hp, ?_⟩
  unfold TopEndInv
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := hend 0 (by omega) hE
    rw [Nat.sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    have h := hodd (2 * j - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j by omega] at h
    have h' := hadj _ _ (by omega) (by omega) h
    rw [show y + 2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5 - 1 - (2 * j - 1) =
      y + 2 * u + 2 * w1 + 2 * w2 + 5 - 2 * j by omega] at h'
    exact h'
  · intro he
    rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
    omega

bko11_S6.definitions:
def bs6U (y k x : ℕ) : List ℕ := [x + y, x + k, x + k + 1, x + y + 1, x + 1, x + 2]

def bs6R (y k z : ℕ) : List ℕ := [z + 1, z + 1 + (y - k), z + 2 + (y - k), z + 2]

def bs6List (y k u w1 w2 : ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  [0] ++
  (List.range u).flatMap (fun i => bs6U y k (2 * i)) ++
  [2 * u + y, 2 * u + k] ++
  (List.range w1).flatMap (fun j => bs6R y k (2 * u + k + 2 * j)) ++
  [2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 1, 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 1 + (y - k), 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 2 + (y - k),
    2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 3 + (y - k), 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + (y - k), 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4] ++
  (List.range w2).flatMap (fun j => bs6R y k (2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 4 + 2 * j)) ++
  (List.range (k - 2 * u - 2 * w2 - 4)).map (fun i => 2 * u + k + 2 * w1 + 5 + 2 * w2 + i) ++
  (List.range (k - 2 * u - 1)).map (fun i => k - 1 - i) ++
  [2 * u + 1 + (y - k), 2 * u + 2 + (y - k)]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 2 ≤ k → b + 2 * k = y + c + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 2 ≤ k → b + 2 * k = y + c + 1 → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hI hZ
  
  have refl : ∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
      IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
      (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w →
        Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x)) := by
    intro v L p hp
    obtain ⟨hperm, hedge⟩ := hp
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ p, x < v := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mp (hperm.mem_iff.mp hx)
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold IsVertexPerm
      refine (hperm.map _).trans ?_
      have hnd : ((List.range v).map (fun x => v - 1 - x)).Nodup := by
        refine List.Nodup.map_on ?_ List.nodup_range
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        rw [List.mem_range] at hx hy
        omega
      have hsub : ((List.range v).map (fun x => v - 1 - x)).Subperm (List.range v) := by
        refine List.Nodup.subperm hnd ?_
        intro z hz
        rw [List.mem_map] at hz
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
        rw [List.mem_range] at hx ⊢
        omega
      exact hsub.perm_of_length_le (by simp)
    · rw [← hedge]
      unfold edgeLengths
      congr 1
      clear hedge hperm
      revert hmem
      induction p with
      | nil => intro _; simp
      | cons a t ih =>
        intro hl
        cases t with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b t' =>
          have ha : a < v := hl a (by simp)
          have hb : b < v := hl b (by simp)
          have ih' := ih (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
          simp only [List.pure_def, List.bind_eq_flatMap, List.flatMap_cons, List.cons_append,
            List.nil_append, List.map_cons, List.tail_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons] at ih' ⊢
          rw [ih']
          congr 1
          show Int.natAbs (((v - 1 - b : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 - a : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
            Int.natAbs ((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ))
          have h1 : ((v - 1 - b : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v - 1 - a : ℕ) : ℤ) = -((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by
            omega
          rw [h1, Int.natAbs_neg]
    · intro u w _ _ h
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := h
      refine ⟨l₁.map (fun x => v - 1 - x), l₂.map (fun x => v - 1 - x), ?_⟩
      rcases h with h | h
      · left; subst h; simp
      · right; subst h; simp
    · intro x _ h
      unfold IsEnd at h ⊢
      rw [List.head?_map, List.getLast?_map]
      rcases h with h | h
      · left; rw [h]; rfl
      · right; rw [h]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, c = 2 * u + 1 := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ : ∃ g, k = 2 * u + 2 * g + 3 := ⟨(k - 2 * u - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ : ∃ e, y = 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7 :=
    ⟨(y - 4 * u - 4 * g - 7) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain rfl : b = 2 * u + 2 * e + 3 := by omega
  refine ⟨2 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  have hv : 2 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7 + (2 * u + 2 * e + 3) + (2 * u + 1) + 1 =
      6 * u + 4 * g + 4 * e + 12 := by ring
  rw [hv]
  
  
  
  have hNRlen : ∀ n, ((List.range n).reverse.flatMap (bkZcNR u g e)).length = 4 * n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.reverse_append, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [bkZcNR] <;> omega
  have hMRlen : ∀ n, ((List.range n).reverse.flatMap (bkZcMR u g e)).length = 6 * n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.reverse_append, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [bkZcMR] <;> omega
  have hlen : (bkZcList u g e).length = 6 * u + 4 * g + 4 * e + 12 := by
    unfold bkZcList
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, hNRlen,
      hMRlen, List.length_nil]
    omega
  have cS1 : ∀ x, 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 7 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7 →
      x ∈ (List.range (2 * g + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7 - i) :=
    fun x h1 h2 => List.mem_map.mpr ⟨4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7 - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
      by omega⟩
  have cS5 : ∀ x, 2 * u + 1 ≤ x → x ≤ 2 * u + 2 * g + 4 →
      x ∈ (List.range (2 * g + 4)).map (fun i => 2 * u + 2 * g + 4 - i) :=
    fun x h1 h2 => List.mem_map.mpr ⟨2 * u + 2 * g + 4 - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
      by omega⟩
  have cNR : ∀ x j, j < e → (x = 4 * u + 2 * g + 6 + 2 * j ∨ x = 4 * u + 2 * g + 5 + 2 * j ∨
      x = 6 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 9 + 2 * j ∨ x = 6 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 8 + 2 * j) →
      x ∈ (List.range e).reverse.flatMap (bkZcNR u g e) := by
    intro x j hj h
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨j, List.mem_reverse.mpr (List.mem_range.mpr hj), ?_⟩
    simp only [bkZcNR, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    omega
  have cMR : ∀ x j, j < u → (x = 2 * u + 2 * g + 6 + 2 * j ∨ x = 2 * u + 2 * g + 5 + 2 * j ∨
      x = 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 9 + 2 * j ∨ x = 2 * j + 2 ∨ x = 2 * j + 1 ∨
      x = 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 8 + 2 * j) →
      x ∈ (List.range u).reverse.flatMap (bkZcMR u g e) := by
    intro x j hj h
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨j, List.mem_reverse.mpr (List.mem_range.mpr hj), ?_⟩
    simp only [bkZcMR, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    omega
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < 6 * u + 4 * g + 4 * e + 12 → x ∈ bkZcList u g e := by
    intro x hx
    unfold bkZcList
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    by_cases c0 : x = 0
    · exact Or.inl c0
    right
    by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2 * u
    · have h := cMR x ((x - 1) / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      tauto
    by_cases c2 : x ≤ 2 * u + 2 * g + 4
    · have h := cS5 x (by omega) c2
      tauto
    by_cases c3 : x ≤ 4 * u + 2 * g + 4
    · have h := cMR x ((x - (2 * u + 2 * g + 5)) / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      tauto
    by_cases c4 : x ≤ 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 4
    · have h := cNR x ((x - (4 * u + 2 * g + 5)) / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      tauto
    by_cases c5 : x ≤ 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 6
    · have h : x = 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 5 ∨ x = 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 6 := by omega
      tauto
    by_cases c6 : x ≤ 4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7
    · have h := cS1 x (by omega) c6
      tauto
    by_cases c7 : x ≤ 6 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 7
    · have h := cMR x ((x - (4 * u + 4 * g + 2 * e + 8)) / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      tauto
    by_cases c8 : x ≤ 6 * u + 4 * g + 4 * e + 7

def bkZcNR (u g e j : ℕ) : List ℕ :=

          ((List.range (2 * g + 4)).map (fun i => 2 * u + 2 * g + 4 - i) ++
            [4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 5, 4 * u + 2 * g + 2 * e + 6])))))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → 3 ≤ b → b ≤ c + 2 → c + 2 ≤ k → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p
