signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 1 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → 3 ≤ b → b ≤ c + 2 → c + 2 ≤ k → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ TopEndInv y (a₀ + b + c + 1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hb3 hbc hck
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, b = 2 * r + 3 := ⟨(b - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, c = 2 * r + 1 + 2 * w := ⟨(c - 2 * r - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
  have hr : 2 * r + 3 ≤ k := by omega
  have hw : 2 * r + 2 * w + 3 ≤ k := by omega
  
  
  
  have hlenB : ∀ s n : ℕ, ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i))).length = 6 * n := by
    intro s n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [okxU]
      ring
  have hperm : (bvCore y k r).Perm (List.range (y + 4 * r + 4)) := by
    have hlen : (bvCore y k r).length = y + 4 * r + 4 := by
      unfold bvCore
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, hlenB, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil]
      omega
    have hBm : ∀ x, (∃ i, i < r ∧ (x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y ∨
        x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k + 1 ∨ x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y + 1 ∨
        x = 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + 1)) →
        x ∈ (List.range r).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i)) := by
      rintro x ⟨i, hi, h⟩
      rw [List.mem_flatMap]
      refine ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, ?_⟩
      unfold okxU
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      omega
    have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 4 * r + 4 → x ∈ bvCore y k r := by
      intro x hx
      unfold bvCore
      simp only [List.mem_append]
      by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))))))
      by_cases c2 : x ≤ 4 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr
          (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩))))))
      by_cases c3 : x = 4 * r + 2
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.mpr c3)))))
      by_cases c4 : x ≤ k + 2 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (4 * r + 3), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
          by omega⟩))
      by_cases c5 : x ≤ k + 4 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr
          (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2 - k) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩))))))
      by_cases c6 : x ≤ y - k + 4 * r + 2
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr
          ⟨4 * r + 2 + (y - k) - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩))))
      by_cases c7 : x ≤ y + 2 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨2 * r + 1 + y - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
          by omega⟩)
      by_cases c8 : x ≤ y + 4 * r + 1
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr
          (hBm x ⟨(x - 2 * r - 2 - y) / 2, by omega, by omega⟩))))))
      · refine Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ?_))
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
    have hsub : (List.range (y + 4 * r + 4)).Subperm (bvCore y k r) :=
      List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
    exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm
  
  
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := fun c d t => rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths (c :: L) = Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths L := by
    intro c h L hL
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
      subst hL
      rfl
  have up : ∀ (a n h e : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = e →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 e + edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h e L hL he
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL, ← he]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h e L hL he
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) 1 _ (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h L hL, he]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h e : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), n ≤ a → L.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = e →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 e + edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h e L _ hL he
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL, ← he]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h e L hn hL he
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) 1 _ (by omega) (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h L hL, he]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have blk : ∀ (s n : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (s + 2 * n) →
      edgeLengths ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i)) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * n) y + edgeLengths L := by
    intro s n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro L _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.append_assoc]
      rw [ih _ (by simp [okxU])]
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, L = (s + 2 * (n + 1)) :: t := by
        cases L with
        | nil => simp at hL
        | cons d t =>
          simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
          exact ⟨t, by rw [hL]⟩
      simp only [okxU, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e2 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + y : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
        omega
      have e3 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      have e4 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          y - k := by omega
      have e5 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by
        omega
      have e6 : Int.natAbs (((s + 2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((s + 2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have headB : ∀ (n s : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (s + 2 * n) →
      ((List.range n).flatMap (fun i => okxU y k (s + 2 * i)) ++ L).head? = some s := by
    intro n s L hL
    cases n with
    | zero => simpa using hL
    | succ n =>
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp [okxU]
  have hedges : edgeLengths (bvCore y k r) =
      prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) (2 * r + 3) (2 * r + 1) := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, y - 2 * k + 1 = d + 1 := ⟨y - 2 * k, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, k - 2 * r - 1 = e + 1 + 1 := ⟨k - 2 * r - 3, by omega⟩
    have hA : List.range (2 * r + 2) = (List.range (2 * r + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 0 + i) := by
      simp
    have hS : (List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) =
        (List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++ [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)] := by
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append]
      rfl
    unfold bvCore
    rw [hd, he, hA, hS]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    
    have eS := down (2 * r + 1 + y) e (2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)) 1 [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)]
      (by omega) rfl (by omega)
    have hSh : ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)]).head? = some (2 * r + 1 + y) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    
    have eR := up (4 * r + 3) (e + 1) (2 * r + 1 + y) (y - k) _ hSh (by omega)
    have hRh : ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)])).head? = some (4 * r + 3) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    
    have eT : edgeLengths ((4 * r + 2 + y) :: (4 * r + 3 + y) ::
        ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)]))) =
        1 ::ₘ y ::ₘ edgeLengths ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)])) := by
      rw [hU, hC _ _ _ hRh]
      have t1 : Int.natAbs (((4 * r + 3 + y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((4 * r + 2 + y : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have t2 : Int.natAbs (((4 * r + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((4 * r + 3 + y : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      rw [t1, t2]
    
    have eD := down (4 * r + 2 + (y - k)) d (4 * r + 2 + y) (y - k)
      ((4 * r + 2 + y) :: (4 * r + 3 + y) ::
        ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)]))) (by omega) rfl (by omega)
    have hDh : ((List.range (d + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 2 + (y - k) - i) ++
        ((4 * r + 2 + y) :: (4 * r + 3 + y) ::
        ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)])))).head? = some (4 * r + 2 + (y - k)) := by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    
    have eP := hC (4 * r + 2) _ _ hDh
    have p1 : Int.natAbs (((4 * r + 2 + (y - k) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((4 * r + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
      omega
    rw [p1] at eP
    have hPh : ((4 * r + 2) :: ((List.range (d + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 2 + (y - k) - i) ++
        ((4 * r + 2 + y) :: (4 * r + 3 + y) ::
        ((List.range (e + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 4 * r + 3 + i) ++
        ((List.range (e + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * r + 1 + y - i) ++
        [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)]))))).head? = some (2 * r + 2 + 2 * r) := by
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
      ring
    have eB := blk (2 * r + 2) r _ hPh
    have eA := up 0 (2 * r + 1) (2 * r + 2) 1 _ (headB r (2 * r + 2) _ hPh) (by omega)
    rw [eA, eB, eP, eD, eT, eR, eS]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [2 * r + 1 + y - (e + 1)] = 0 := rfl
    rw [h0]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    have ey : Multiset.replicate (y - 1) 1 = Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 1) 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * r) 1 + Multiset.replicate d 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate (e + 1) 1 + Multiset.replicate e 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have em : Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 3) (y - k) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    have eyy : Multiset.replicate (2 * r + 1) y =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * r) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [ey, em, eyy]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
    abel
  
  
  
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  have J : ∀ (X Y : List ℕ) (a b : ℕ), X.getLast? = some a → Y.head? = some b →
      Adj (X ++ Y) a b := by
    intro X Y a b hX hY
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_iff] at hX
    rw [List.head?_eq_some_iff] at hY
    obtain ⟨X', rfl⟩ := hX
    obtain ⟨Y', rfl⟩ := hY
    exact ⟨X', Y', Or.inl (by simp)⟩
  have hE : IsEnd (bvCore y k r) 0 := by
    left
    simp [bvCore, List.head?_range]
  
  have sA : ∀ z, z ≤ 2 * r → Adj (bvCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz
    unfold bvCore
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    exact F1 _ z _ _ (List.getElem?_range (by omega)) (List.getElem?_range (by omega))
  
  have sR : ∀ z, 4 * r + 3 ≤ z → z + 1 ≤ k + 2 * r + 1 → Adj (bvCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    unfold bvCore
    apply FR; apply FL
    exact RM _ _ (z - (4 * r + 3)) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  
  have sD : ∀ z, k + 4 * r + 2 ≤ z → z ≤ y - k + 4 * r + 1 → Adj (bvCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    unfold bvCore
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (4 * r + 1 + (y - k) - z) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  
  have sS : ∀ z, y - k + 4 * r + 3 ≤ z → z ≤ y + 2 * r → Adj (bvCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z h1 h2
    unfold bvCore
    apply FL
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (2 * r + y - z) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  
  have sM : ∀ i, i < r →
      Adj (bvCore y k r) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + k + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold bvCore
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    apply INF (okxU y k (2 * r + 2 + 2 * i))
    · exact ⟨[2 * r + 2 + 2 * i, 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y],
        [2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + y + 1, 2 * r + 2 + 2 * i + 1], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨i, List.mem_range.2 hi, rfl⟩)
  
  have sJ : ∀ j, j ≤ r → Adj (bvCore y k r) (2 * r + 1 + 2 * j) (2 * r + 2 + 2 * j) := by
    intro j hj
    have hR : List.range r = List.range j ++ (List.range (r - j)).map (fun i => j + i) := by
      rw [← List.range_add]; congr 1; omega
    unfold bvCore
    rw [hR, List.flatMap_append]
    rw [show ∀ (A P Q C D E F G : List ℕ), A ++ (P ++ Q) ++ C ++ D ++ E ++ F ++ G =
        (A ++ P) ++ (Q ++ C ++ D ++ E ++ F ++ G)
      from fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => by simp only [List.append_assoc]]
    apply J
    · rcases j with _ | j
      · rw [show 2 * r + 2 = (2 * r + 1) + 1 from rfl, List.range_succ]
        simp
      · rw [@List.range_succ j, List.flatMap_append]
        simp [okxU] <;> omega
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, r - j = s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [hs]
      rcases s with _ | s
      · simp
        omega
      · rw [@List.range_succ_eq_map s]
        simp [okxU]
  have hodd : ∀ z : ℕ, z % 2 = 1 → z + 2 ≤ y → Adj (bvCore y k r) z (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz1 hz2
    by_cases c1 : z ≤ 2 * r
    · exact sA z c1
    by_cases c2 : z ≤ 4 * r + 1
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, z = 2 * r + 1 + 2 * j := ⟨(z - 2 * r - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
      have h := sJ j (by omega)
      rw [show 2 * r + 2 + 2 * j = 2 * r + 1 + 2 * j + 1 by omega] at h
      exact h
    by_cases c3 : z ≤ k + 2 * r
    · exact sR z (by omega) (by omega)
    by_cases c4 : z ≤ k + 4 * r + 1

    rw [show y - k + 2 - 1 - 0 = y - k + 1 by omega,
      show y - k + 2 - 1 - 1 = y - k by omega] at h
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h | h⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inr h⟩
    · exact ⟨l₁, l₂, Or.inl h⟩
  have hSc : IsEnd (Q.map (fun x => y - k + 2 - 1 - x)) (y - k - 1) := by
    have h := hSE 2 (by omega) hQ2

      have h := hSa (y - k - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega)

    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ (fun i hi => by

    (by omega) (by omega) hp₃ (by
      rw [show y - k + 2 + 2 * t1 + 2 * t2 + 2 * t3 - y = y - k - 1 + 2 * t1 by omega]

  · rw [show y - k + b + c + 1 = y - k + 2 + 2 * t1 + 2 * t2 + 2 * t3 + 1 by omega]

              2 * ((x - (y - k + 2 + 2 * t1 + 2 * t2)) / 2) = x by omega] at h

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k s hk hs hsk hy
  have hU_len : ∀ n : ℕ, ((List.range n).flatMap (okKUnit y k)).length = 6 * n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [okKUnit]
      ring
  have hlen : (okKSeed y k s).length = y + 2 * s + 3 := by
    unfold okKSeed
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, hU_len, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hA : ∀ x, k + 2 * s + 2 ≤ x → x ≤ y →
      x ∈ (List.range (y - k - 2 * s - 1)).map (fun i => y - i) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hB : ∀ x, 2 * s - 1 ≤ x → x ≤ k + 1 →
      x ∈ (List.range (k + 3 - 2 * s)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (2 * s - 1), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hG : ∀ x, (x = y + 2 * s + 2 ∨ x = y + 2 * s + 1 ∨ x = k + 2 * s + 1 ∨ x = k + 2 * s ∨
      x = y + 2 * s ∨ x = y + 2 * s - 1) →
      x ∈ ([y + 2 * s + 2, y + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s, y + 2 * s, y + 2 * s - 1] :
        List ℕ) := by
    intro x h
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    exact h
  have hU : ∀ x, (∃ j, j < s - 1 ∧ (x = y + 1 + 2 * j ∨ x = 1 + 2 * j ∨ x = 2 + 2 * j ∨
      x = y + 2 + 2 * j ∨ x = k + 2 + 2 * j ∨ x = k + 3 + 2 * j)) →
      x ∈ (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k) := by
    rintro x ⟨j, hj, h⟩
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨j, List.mem_range.mpr hj, ?_⟩
    unfold okKUnit
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    exact h
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 2 * s + 3 → x ∈ okKSeed y k s := by
    intro x hx
    unfold okKSeed
    by_cases c0 : x = 0
    · rw [c0]; exact List.mem_cons_self
    apply List.mem_cons_of_mem
    simp only [List.mem_append]
    by_cases c1 : x + 2 ≤ 2 * s
    · obtain ⟨m, hm | hm⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' (x - 1)
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega))⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega)))⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c2 : x ≤ k + 1
    · have h := hB x (by omega) c2
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c3 : x + 1 ≤ k + 2 * s
    · obtain ⟨m, hm | hm⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' (x - k - 2)
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega)))))⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega)))))⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c4 : x ≤ k + 2 * s + 1
    · have h := hG x (by omega)
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c5 : x ≤ y
    · have h := hA x (by omega) c5
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c6 : x + 2 ≤ y + 2 * s
    · obtain ⟨m, hm | hm⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' (x - y - 1)
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inl (by omega)⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
      · have h := hU x ⟨m, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega))))⟩
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    · have h := hG x (by omega)
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
  have hsub : (List.range (y + 2 * s + 3)).Subperm (okKSeed y k s) :=
    List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
  exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm

proof.tactics:
by
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := fun c d t => rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths (c :: L) = Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths L := by
    intro c h L hL
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
      subst hL
      rfl
  have up : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) _ (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), n ≤ a → L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L _ hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hn hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) _ (by omega) (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a - (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  intro y k s hk hs hsk hy
  have hky : k < y := by omega
  have Ucont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some (y + 1 + 2 * n) →
      edgeLengths ((List.range n).flatMap (okKUnit y k) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * n) y + edgeLengths L := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro L _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.append_assoc]
      rw [ih _ (by simp [okKUnit])]
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, L = (y + 1 + 2 * (n + 1)) :: t := by
        cases L with
        | nil => simp at hL
        | cons d t =>
          simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
          exact ⟨t, by rw [hL]⟩
      simp only [okKUnit, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((1 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 1 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e2 : Int.natAbs (((2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
      have e4 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
        omega
      have e5 : Int.natAbs (((k + 3 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      have e6 : Int.natAbs (((y + 1 + 2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 3 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          y - k := by omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have hUnit : ∀ j : ℕ, edgeLengths (okKUnit y k j) = y ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ y ::ₘ (y - k) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0 := by
    intro j
    simp only [okKUnit]
    rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [k + 3 + 2 * j] = 0 := rfl
    have e1 : Int.natAbs (((1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    have e2 : Int.natAbs (((2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    have e4 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
      omega
    have e5 : Int.natAbs (((k + 3 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    rw [h0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5]
  have W : ∀ n : ℕ, edgeLengths ((k + 1) :: (List.range n).flatMap (okKUnit y k)) =
      Multiset.replicate (2 * n) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * n) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * n) y := by
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [List.range_zero, List.flatMap_nil, Nat.mul_zero, Multiset.replicate_zero,
        add_zero]
      rfl
    | succ n =>
      have hh : ((List.range (n + 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k)).head? = some (y + 1) := by
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
        simp [okKUnit]
      rw [hC _ _ _ hh]
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton]
      rw [Ucont n (okKUnit y k n) (by simp [okKUnit]), hUnit n]
      have e0 : Int.natAbs (((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by omega
      rw [e0, show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  
  unfold okKSeed
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rw [show y - k - 2 * s - 1 = (y - k - 2 * s - 2) + 1 by omega,
    show k + 3 - 2 * s = (k + 1 - 2 * s) + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have hB : (List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) =
      (List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) ++ [k + 1] := by
    have e : 2 * s - 1 + (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1) = k + 1 := by omega
    rw [List.range_succ (n := k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)]
    simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [e]
  rw [hB, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  
  have hW := W (s - 1)
  have hBp := up (2 * s - 1) (k + 1 - 2 * s) (k + 1)
    ((k + 1) :: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k)) rfl
  have eBp : Int.natAbs (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 * s - 1 + (k + 1 - 2 * s) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
    omega
  rw [eBp] at hBp
  have hG : edgeLengths ([y + 2 * s + 2, y + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s, y + 2 * s,
      y + 2 * s - 1] ++ ((List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) ++
        ((k + 1) :: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k)))) =
      1 ::ₘ (y - k) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (y - k) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ y ::ₘ
        edgeLengths ((List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) ++
          ((k + 1) :: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k))) := by
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [hU, hU, hU, hU, hU]
    rw [hC (y + 2 * s - 1) (2 * s - 1) _ (by
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp)]
    have e1 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * s + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e2 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
      omega
    have e3 : Int.natAbs (((k + 2 * s : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e4 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * s : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 2 * s : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by omega
    have e5 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * s - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * s : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e6 : Int.natAbs (((2 * s - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 * s - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
  have hT := down y (y - k - 2 * s - 2) (y + 2 * s + 2)
    ([y + 2 * s + 2, y + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s, y + 2 * s,
      y + 2 * s - 1] ++ ((List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) ++
        ((k + 1) :: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k)))) (by omega) (by simp)
  have eT : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 * s + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y - (y - k - 2 * s - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y - k := by
    omega
  rw [eT] at hT
  have h0 : ((List.range (y - k - 2 * s - 2 + 1)).map (fun i => y - i) ++
      ([y + 2 * s + 2, y + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s + 1, k + 2 * s, y + 2 * s,
      y + 2 * s - 1] ++ ((List.range (k + 1 - 2 * s + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * s - 1 + i) ++
        ((k + 1) :: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k))))).head? = some y := by
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
    simp
  rw [hC 0 y _ h0, hT, hG, hBp, hW]
  have ey0 : Int.natAbs (((y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
  rw [ey0]
  unfold prescribedLengths
  have ey : Multiset.replicate (y - 2 * s + 1) 1 = Multiset.replicate (y - k - 2 * s - 2) 1 +
      Multiset.replicate (k + 1 - 2 * s) 1 + Multiset.replicate (2 * (s - 1)) 1 +
      Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
      Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
    simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have em : Multiset.replicate (2 * s + 1) (y - k) = Multiset.replicate (2 * (s - 1)) (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) +
      Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) := by
    simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have e3 : Multiset.replicate (2 * s) y = Multiset.replicate (2 * (s - 1)) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
    simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [ey, em, e3]
  simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
  abel

by

    intro p j u w h1 h2

    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2

    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FC : ∀ (a : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (a :: s) u w := by
    intro a s u w h

  have INF : ∀ (s t : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → s <:+: t → Adj t u w := by
    rintro s t u w h ⟨L, R, rfl⟩
    exact FR _ _ _ _ (FL _ _ _ _ h)
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · left
    rfl
  · intro x h1 h2
    unfold okKSeed
    apply FC; apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (y - 1 - x) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  · unfold okKSeed
    apply FC; apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    exact ⟨[y + 2 * s + 2, y + 2 * s + 1], [y + 2 * s, y + 2 * s - 1], Or.inr rfl⟩
  · intro x h1 h2

    apply FC; apply FR; apply FL
    exact RM _ _ (x - (2 * s - 1)) _ _ (by omega) (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
      (by first | omega | (simp only []; omega))
  · intro j hj
    have hj' : j < s - 1 := by omega
    have hinf : okKUnit y k j <:+: (List.range (s - 1)).flatMap (okKUnit y k) :=
      List.infix_of_mem_flatten (List.mem_map.2 ⟨j, List.mem_range.2 hj', rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold okKSeed
      apply FC; apply FL
      apply INF (okKUnit y k j) _ _ _ _ hinf
      exact ⟨[y + 1 + 2 * j], [y + 2 + 2 * j, k + 2 + 2 * j, k + 3 + 2 * j], Or.inl rfl⟩
    · unfold okKSeed
      apply FC; apply FL
      apply INF (okKUnit y k j) _ _ _ _ hinf

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach

    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 2 = y → 3 ≤ b → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

signature.name: bOO_col
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 2 = y → 3 ≤ b → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hE h3 hcor
  have hk6 : 6 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ : ∃ s, y - k = 2 * s + 3 := ⟨(y - k - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨s₃, hs₃⟩ : ∃ s, k = 2 * s + 2 := ⟨(k - 2) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ s, b = 2 * s + 3 := ⟨(b - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  
  have AC : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have EC : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) =
      Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := fun c d t => rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths (c :: L) = Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) ::ₘ edgeLengths L := by
    intro c h L hL
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hL
      subst hL
      rfl
  have up : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) _ (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ), n ≤ a → L.head? = some h →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ L) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
          edgeLengths L := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h L _ hL
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h L hL]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h L hn hL
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) _ (by omega) (by simp), hC _ h L hL]
      have e1 : Int.natAbs (((a - (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  
  have hlen : (colW4 y k).length = y + 4 := by
    simp only [colW4, List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 4 → x ∈ colW4 y k := by
    intro x hx
    unfold colW4
    simp only [List.mem_append]
    by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2
    · have h : x ∈ ([2, 1, 0] : List ℕ) := by
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      simp only [h, true_or]
    by_cases c2 : x ≤ k
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (k - 2)).map (fun i => 3 + i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - 3, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, or_true]
    by_cases c3 : x ≤ y
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (y - k)).map (fun i => y - i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    · have h : x ∈ ([y + 1, y + 2, y + 3] : List ℕ) := by
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        omega
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
  have hperm : (colW4 y k).Perm (List.range (y + 4)) := by
    have hsub : (List.range (y + 4)).Subperm (colW4 y k) :=
      List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
    exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm
  have hedge : edgeLengths (colW4 y k) = prescribedLengths y k y 1 2 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, y - k = n + 1 := ⟨y - k - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, k - 2 = r + 1 + 1 := ⟨k - 4, by omega⟩
    unfold colW4
    rw [hn, hr, List.range_succ (n := r + 1)]
    simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
      List.nil_append]
    rw [hU, hU]
    rw [hC 0 y _ (by rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp)]
    rw [down y n (y + 1) _ (by omega) (by simp)]
    rw [hU, hU]
    rw [hC (y + 3) 3 _ (by rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]; simp)]
    rw [up 3 r (3 + (r + 1)) [3 + (r + 1)] rfl]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [3 + (r + 1)] = 0 := rfl
    have e1 : Int.natAbs (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by norm_num
    have e2 : Int.natAbs (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by norm_num
    have e3 : Int.natAbs (((y : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    have e4 : Int.natAbs (((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = n + 1 := by omega
    have e5 : Int.natAbs (((y + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e6 : Int.natAbs (((y + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    have e7 : Int.natAbs (((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = y := by omega
    have e8 : Int.natAbs (((3 + (r + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((3 + r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by omega
    rw [h0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, e7, e8]
    unfold prescribedLengths
    rw [hn]
    have ey : Multiset.replicate y 1 = Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate r 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 +
        Multiset.replicate 1 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 1 := by
      simp only [← Multiset.replicate_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    have e2y : Multiset.replicate 2 y = Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate 1 y := by
      rw [← Multiset.replicate_add]
    rw [ey, e2y]
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_one, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
    abel
  have hW : IsLinearRealization (y + 4) (prescribedLengths y k y 1 2) (colW4 y k) :=
    ⟨hperm, hedge⟩
  have hWe : IsEnd (colW4 y k) 2 := by
    left
    simp [colW4]
  have hW01 : Adj (colW4 y k) 0 1 := by
    unfold colW4
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    exact ⟨[2], [], Or.inr rfl⟩
  have hW12 : Adj (colW4 y k) 1 2 := by
    unfold colW4
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FR
    exact ⟨[], [0], Or.inr rfl⟩
  have hWd : ∀ x, k + 1 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ y → Adj (colW4 y k) x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    unfold colW4
    apply FR; apply FR; apply FL
    apply SYM
    exact RM _ _ (y - 1 - x) _ _ (by omega) (by beta_reduce; omega) (by beta_reduce; omega)
  have hWu : ∀ x, 3 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ k → Adj (colW4 y k) x (x + 1) := by
    intro x h1 h2
    unfold colW4
    apply FL
    exact RM _ _ (x - 3) _ _ (by omega) (by beta_reduce; omega) (by beta_reduce; omega)
  
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hc₁, hk₁, he₁⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 4) s₁ _ (colW4 y k) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) hW (by
      intro i hi
      exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hWd (y - 2 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)) rfl (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hc₂, hk₂, he₂⟩ := bot_pairs (y - k) (y + 4 + 2 * s₁) 1 _ p₁ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₁ (by
      intro i hi
      exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hk₁ 1 hW12 (fun i' hi' => by omega)) (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨p₃, hp₃, hc₃, hk₃, he₃⟩ := bot_pairs y (y + 4 + 2 * s₁ + 2 * 1) s₃ _ p₂ (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) hp₂ (by
      intro i hi
      have h0 := hWu (k - 1 - 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hk₁ _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hk₂ _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact AC _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega))
  
  have hend₃ : IsEnd p₃ (y - 1) := EC _ _ _ (he₃ _ (he₂ _ (he₁ _ hWe))) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hqk, -⟩ := bot_attach y (y + 4 + 2 * s₁ + 2 * 1 + 2 * s₃) _ p₃ (by omega)
    (by omega) hp₃ hend₃
  
  obtain ⟨q', hq', -, hk₅, he₅⟩ := top_pairs (y - k) (y + 4 + 2 * s₁ + 2 * 1 + 2 * s₃ + 1) B _ q
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hq (by
      intro i hi
      have h0 := hWd (k + 4 + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hk₁ _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hk₂ _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h3' := hk₃ _ h2 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h4 := hqk _ h3'
      exact AC _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega))
  
  have S1 : ∀ g, g % 2 = 0 → g ≤ 2 * s₁ → Adj p₁ g (g + 1) := by
    intro g hg1 hg2
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge g (2 * s₁) with h | h
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hc₁ (g / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hk₁ 0 hW01 (fun i _ => by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
  have S2 : ∀ f, f % 2 = 0 → f ≤ 2 * s₁ + 2 → Adj p₂ f (f + 1) := by
    intro f hf1 hf2
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f with h | h
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hc₂ 0 (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hk₂ (f - 2) (S1 (f - 2) (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i _ => by omega))
        (by omega) (by omega)
  have S3 : ∀ e, e % 2 = 0 → e ≤ 2 * s₃ + 2 * s₁ + 2 → Adj p₃ e (e + 1) := by
    intro e he1 he2
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge e (2 * s₃) with h | h
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hc₃ (e / 2) (by omega)) (by omega) (by omega)
    · exact AC _ _ _ _ _ (hk₃ (e - 2 * s₃) (S2 _ (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i _ => by omega))
        (by omega) (by omega)
  
  have hsize : y + 4 + 2 * s₁ + 2 * 1 + 2 * s₃ + 1 + 2 * B = y + b + c + 1 := by omega
  have hL : prescribedLengths y k y 1 2 + Multiset.replicate (2 * s₁) y +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * 1) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * s₃) y +
      Multiset.replicate 1 y + Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) =
      prescribedLengths y k y b c := by
    have hb' : b = 1 + 2 * 1 + 2 * B := by omega
    have hc' : c = 2 + 2 * s₁ + 2 * s₃ + 1 := by omega
    rw [hb', hc']
    unfold prescribedLengths
    simp only [Multiset.replicate_add]
    abel
  rw [hsize, hL] at hq'
  refine ⟨y, le_refl _, by omega, q', hq', ?_⟩
  refine ⟨he₅ 0 hq0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj1 hj2
    have h := hqk (2 * j - 2) (S3 _ (by omega) (by omega))
    have h' := hk₅ (2 * j - 1) (AC _ _ _ _ _ h (by omega) (by omega)) (fun i _ => by omega)
    exact AC _ _ _ _ _ h' rfl (by omega)
  · intro he
    rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
    omega

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 4 = y → 3 ≤ b → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

signature.name: bOO_row4
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → c + 4 = y → 3 ≤ b → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  have adj_cast : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u w → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' rfl rfl h
    exact h
  have row4Seed_slots : ∀ (y k : ℕ), 4 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → IsEnd (row4Seed y k) 4 ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, x ≤ 2 → Adj (row4Seed y k) x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, 4 ≤ x → x ≤ k → Adj (row4Seed y k) x (x + 1)) ∧ (∀ x : ℕ, k + 2 ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ y → Adj (row4Seed y k) x (x + 1)) := by
    have run_adj : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n d : ℕ), d + 1 < n →
        ∃ l₁ l₂ : List ℕ, (List.range n).map f = l₁ ++ f d :: f (d + 1) :: l₂ := by
      intro f n d hd
      refine ⟨((List.range n).map f).take d, ((List.range n).map f).drop (d + 2), ?_⟩
      have hl : ((List.range n).map f).length = n := by simp
      have e : ((List.range n).map f).drop d = f d :: f (d + 1) :: ((List.range n).map f).drop (d + 2) := by
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega), List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega)]
        simp
      calc (List.range n).map f = ((List.range n).map f).take d ++ ((List.range n).map f).drop d :=
            (List.take_append_drop d _).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [e]
    intro y k hk hyk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · left
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, k - 2 = n + 1 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
      simp [row4Seed, hn, List.range_succ_eq_map]
    · intro x hx
      interval_cases x
      · exact ⟨(List.range (k - 2)).map (fun i => 4 + i) ++ [y + 1, y + 2, y + 3, 3, 2],
          (List.range (y - k - 1)).map (fun i => y - i), Or.inr (by simp [row4Seed])⟩
      · exact ⟨(List.range (k - 2)).map (fun i => 4 + i) ++ [y + 1, y + 2, y + 3, 3],
          0 :: (List.range (y - k - 1)).map (fun i => y - i), Or.inr (by simp [row4Seed])⟩
      · exact ⟨(List.range (k - 2)).map (fun i => 4 + i) ++ [y + 1, y + 2, y + 3],
          1 :: 0 :: (List.range (y - k - 1)).map (fun i => y - i), Or.inr (by simp [row4Seed])⟩
    · intro x hx1 hx2

∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →

      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

    · by_cases het : e < 2 * s3 + 2 * t
      · have h1 := hN2 ((e - 2 * s3) / 2) (by omega)
        have h2 := hK3 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
        exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h2 (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hek : e < k
        · have h1 := hN1 ((e - 2 * s3 - 2 * t) / 2) (by omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
          have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i hi => by omega)
          exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
        · have h0 := Plow (e - k) (by omega)
          have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i hi => by omega)
          have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i hi => by omega)
          have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i hi => by omega)
          exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h3 (by omega) (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨P4, hR4, hE4a, hK4, -⟩ := bot_attach y (y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3) _ P3
    (by omega) (by omega) hR3 hEy
  
  obtain ⟨P5, hR5, -, hK5, hE5⟩ := top_pairs y (y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3 + 1) T _ P4
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR4 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := Plow (1 + 2 * i) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h4 := hK4 _ h3
      exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨P6, hR6, -, hK6, hE6⟩ := top_pairs (y - k)
    (y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3 + 1 + 2 * T) B _ P5
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hR5 (fun i hi => by
      have h0 := Phigh (k + 1 + 2 * T + 2 * i) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h1 := hK1 _ h0 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h2 := hK2 _ h1 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h3 := hK3 _ h2 (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      have h4 := hK4 _ h3
      have h4' : Adj P4 (y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3 + 1 + 2 * T - (y - k) + 2 * i)
          (y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3 + 1 + 2 * T - (y - k) + 2 * i + 1) :=
        adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
      have h5 := hK5 _ h4' (fun i' hi' => by omega)
      exact h5)
  refine ⟨y - 1, by omega, by omega, P6, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : y + 1 + 2 * s1 + 2 * t + 2 * s3 + 1 + 2 * T + 2 * B = y - 1 + b + c + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [e] at hR6
    have hL : Multiset.replicate (y + 1 - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (y + 1 - (k + 1)) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * s1) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * s3) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
        Multiset.replicate (2 * T) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) =
        prescribedLengths y k (y - 1) b c := by
      rw [show y + 1 - 2 = y - 1 by omega, show y + 1 - (k + 1) = y - k by omega]
      unfold prescribedLengths
      have e2 : Multiset.replicate b (y - k) =
          Multiset.replicate 1 (y - k) + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * B) (y - k) := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, show 1 + 2 * t + 2 * B = b by omega]
      have e3 : Multiset.replicate c y =
          Multiset.replicate (2 * s1) y + Multiset.replicate (2 * s3) y + Multiset.replicate 1 y +
          Multiset.replicate (2 * T) y := by
        rw [← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add, ← Multiset.replicate_add,
          show 2 * s1 + 2 * s3 + 1 + 2 * T = c by omega]
      rw [e2, e3]
      abel
    rw [hL] at hR6
    exact hR6
  · refine ⟨hE6 _ (hE5 _ hE4a), fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · have h3 := heven3 (2 * j - 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h4 := hK4 _ h3
      have h4' : Adj P4 (2 * j - 1) (2 * j - 1 + 1) := adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h4 (by omega) (by omega)
      have h5 := hK5 _ h4' (fun i hi => by omega)
      have h6 := hK6 _ h5 (fun i hi => by omega)
      exact adjeq _ _ _ _ _ h6 rfl (by omega)
    · rw [Nat.even_iff] at he
      omega

subgoal_signatures.name: path_II
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 1 ≤ n → ∃ Q : List ℕ,
    IsLinearRealization n (Multiset.replicate (n - 2) 1 + Multiset.replicate 1 (n - j)) Q ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x + 2 ≤ j → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, j ≤ x → x + 2 ≤ n → Adj Q x (x + 1)) ∧
    IsEnd Q 0 ∧ IsEnd Q j

subgoal_signatures.name: top_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (v - ℓ + 2 * i) (v - ℓ + 2 * i + 1)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (v + 2 * i) (v + 2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x ≠ v - ℓ + 2 * i) → Adj p' x (x + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_pairs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v t : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 2 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v → 2 * t ≤ ℓ →
    IsLinearRealization v L p →
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p (ℓ - 2 - 2 * i) (ℓ - 1 - 2 * i)) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 2 * t) (L + Multiset.replicate (2 * t) ℓ) p' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → Adj p' (2 * i) (2 * i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < t → x + 2 + 2 * i ≠ ℓ) →
        Adj p' (x + 2 * t) (x + 2 * t + 1)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → IsEnd p' (x + 2 * t))

subgoal_signatures.name: bot_attach
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (ℓ v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ v →
    IsLinearRealization v L p → IsEnd p (ℓ - 1) →
    ∃ p' : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (v + 1) (L + Multiset.replicate 1 ℓ) p' ∧ IsEnd p' 0 ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, Adj p x (x + 1) → Adj p' (x + 1) (x + 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, IsEnd p x → x + 1 ≠ ℓ → IsEnd p' (x + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: reflect_realization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (v : ℕ) (L : Multiset ℕ) (p : List ℕ), IsLinearRealization v L p →
    IsLinearRealization v L (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) ∧
    (∀ u w : ℕ, u < v → w < v → Adj p u w → Adj (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - u) (v - 1 - w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℕ, x < v → IsEnd p x → IsEnd (p.map (fun x => v - 1 - x)) (v - 1 - x))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → y + 4 ≤ 2 * b + c → c + 6 ≤ y → y + 1 ≤ b + c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

signature.name: bOO_RL
signature.statement: ∀ (y k b c : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 2 * k < y → y % 2 = 1 → k % 2 = 0 → b < y - k → c < y → b % 2 = 1 → c % 2 = 1 → b + (y - k) + 1 ≤ c → y + 4 ≤ 2 * b + c → c + 6 ≤ y → y + 1 ≤ b + c → ∃ a₀ : ℕ, a₀ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a₀ + b + c + 1 ∧ ∃ p : List ℕ, IsLinearRealization (a₀ + b + c + 1) (prescribedLengths y k a₀ b c) p ∧ BotEndInv y p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y k b c hk hyk hy hk2 hb hc hb2 hc2 hcor h4 h6 hbc
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g, c + 2 + 2 * g = y := ⟨(y - 2 - c) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨L, e, he, hge⟩ : ∃ L e, e ≤ 1 ∧ g + e = 2 * L + 2 :=
    ⟨(g + g % 2 - 2) / 2, g % 2, by omega, by omega⟩
  have hkL : 4 * L + 8 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ : ∃ s, 2 * s + 5 + 2 * L = (y - k) + 2 * e :=
    ⟨((y - k) + 2 * e - 5 - 2 * L) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨s₃, hs₃⟩ : ∃ s, 2 * s + 2 * L + 4 = k := ⟨(k - 2 * L - 4) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, t + e = L + 2 := ⟨L + 2 - e, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B, 2 * B + 2 * g + 3 = b := ⟨(b - 2 * g - 3) / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨n4, hn4⟩ : ∃ n, n + 1 = y - k - 2 * L - 2 := ⟨y - k - 2 * L - 3, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨n6, hn6⟩ : ∃ n, n + 2 = k - 4 * L - 6 := ⟨k - 4 * L - 8, by omega⟩
  
  have AC : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w u' w' : ℕ), Adj p u w → u = u' → w = w' → Adj p u' w' := by
    rintro p u w u' w' h rfl rfl
    exact h
  have EC : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (x x' : ℕ), IsEnd p x → x = x' → IsEnd p x' := by
    rintro p x x' h rfl
    exact h
  have F1 : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (j u w : ℕ), p[j]? = some u → p[j+1]? = some w → Adj p u w := by
    intro p j u w h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hj1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hj2, rfl⟩ := h2
    have h := List.take_append_drop j p
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2] at h
    exact ⟨p.take j, p.drop (j + 1 + 1), Or.inl h.symm⟩
  have FR : ∀ (s R : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (s ++ R) u w := by
    rintro s R u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨l₁, l₂ ++ R, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have FL : ∀ (L s : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj s u w → Adj (L ++ s) u w := by
    rintro L s u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    refine ⟨L ++ l₁, l₂, ?_⟩
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have SYM : ∀ (p : List ℕ) (u w : ℕ), Adj p u w → Adj p w u := by
    rintro p u w ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩
    exact ⟨l₁, l₂, h.symm⟩
  have RM : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i + 1 < n → f i = u → f (i + 1) = w →
      Adj ((List.range n).map f) u w := by
    intro f n i u w hi hu hw
    apply F1 _ i
    · simp [List.getElem?_range (show i < n by omega), hu]
    · simp [List.getElem?_range hi, hw]
  have AF : ∀ (f : ℕ → List ℕ) (n i u w : ℕ), i < n → Adj (f i) u w →
      Adj ((List.range n).flatMap f) u w := by
    intro f n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro i u w hi _
      exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ n ih =>
      intro i u w hi h
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i n with h' | h'
      · exact FR _ _ _ _ (ih i u w h' h)
      · have hin : i = n := by omega
        subst hin
        apply FL
        simpa using h
  have blkA : ∀ a b c d : ℕ, Adj [a, b, c, d] d c := fun a b c d => ⟨[a, b], [], Or.inr rfl⟩
  have blkB : ∀ a b c d : ℕ, Adj [a, b, c, d] b a := fun a b c d => ⟨[], [c, d], Or.inr rfl⟩
  
  have hU : ∀ (c d D : ℕ) (t : List ℕ), Int.natAbs ((d : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = D →
      edgeLengths (c :: d :: t) = D ::ₘ edgeLengths (d :: t) := by
    intro c d D t hD
    rw [← hD]
    rfl
  have hC : ∀ (c h D : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), T.head? = some h → Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = D →
      edgeLengths (c :: T) = D ::ₘ edgeLengths T := by
    intro c h D T hT hD
    cases T with
    | nil => simp at hT
    | cons d t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hT
      subst hT
      exact hU _ _ _ _ hD
  have up : ∀ (a n h D : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), T.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a + n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = D →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a + i) ++ T) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + (D ::ₘ edgeLengths T) := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h D T hT hD
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h D T hT hD]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h D T hT hD
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a + (n + 1)) 1 _ (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h D T hT hD]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have down : ∀ (a n h D : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), n ≤ a → T.head? = some h →
      Int.natAbs ((h : ℤ) - ((a - n : ℕ) : ℤ)) = D →
      edgeLengths ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => a - i) ++ T) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + (D ::ₘ edgeLengths T) := by
    intro a n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h D T _ hT hD
      rw [show List.range (0 + 1) = [0] from rfl]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [hC _ h D T hT hD]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h D T hn hT hD
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.append_assoc]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ih (a - (n + 1)) 1 _ (by omega) (by simp) (by omega), hC _ h D T hT hD]
      rw [Multiset.replicate_succ]
      simp only [← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  have blk : ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), n ≤ L → T.head? = some (y - 2 * n - 1) →
      edgeLengths ((k - 1) :: ((List.range n).flatMap (rlBlk y k) ++ T)) =
        Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate n 1 + Multiset.replicate n (y - k) +
          Multiset.replicate n (y - k) + ((y - k) ::ₘ edgeLengths T) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro T _ hT
      simp only [List.range_zero, List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append]
      rw [hC _ _ (y - k) T hT (by omega)]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro T hn hT
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.append_assoc]
      have hs : [n].flatMap (rlBlk y k) = rlBlk y k n := by simp
      rw [hs, ih (rlBlk y k n ++ T) (by omega) (by simp [rlBlk])]
      simp only [rlBlk, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [hU (y - 2 * n - 1) (y - 2 * n - 2) 1 _ (by omega),
        hU (y - 2 * n - 2) (k - 2 * n - 2) (y - k) _ (by omega),
        hU (k - 2 * n - 2) (k - 2 * n - 3) 1 _ (by omega),
        hC (k - 2 * n - 3) _ (y - k) T hT (by omega)]
      simp only [Multiset.replicate_succ, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
  
  have hlenB : ∀ n, ((List.range n).flatMap (rlBlk y k)).length = 4 * n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append, ih]
      simp [rlBlk]
      ring
  have hlen : (rlSeedW y k L n4 n6).length = y + 2 * L + 6 := by
    simp only [rlSeedW, List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_range, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil, hlenB]
    omega
  have hcov : ∀ x, x < y + 2 * L + 6 → x ∈ rlSeedW y k L n4 n6 := by
    intro x hx
    unfold rlSeedW
    simp only [List.mem_append]
    by_cases c1 : x ≤ 2 * L + 4
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (2 * L + 4 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * L + 4 - i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨2 * L + 4 - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, true_or]
    by_cases c2 : x ≤ k - 2 * L - 2
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (n6 + 1 + 1)).map (fun i => 2 * L + 5 + i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (2 * L + 5), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, or_true]
    by_cases c3 : x ≤ k + 1
    · by_cases c3' : k ≤ x + 1
      · have h : x ∈ ([y, y + 1, k + 1, k, k - 1] : List ℕ) := by
          simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
          omega
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
      · have h : x ∈ (List.range L).flatMap (rlBlk y k) := by
          refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(k - x - 2) / 2, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
          simp only [rlBlk, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
          omega
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c4 : x ≤ y - 2 * L - 1
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (n4 + 1)).map (fun i => y - 2 * L - 1 - i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y - 2 * L - 1 - x, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    by_cases c5 : x ≤ y + 1
    · by_cases c5' : y ≤ x
      · have h : x ∈ ([y, y + 1, k + 1, k, k - 1] : List ℕ) := by
          simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
          omega
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
      · have h : x ∈ (List.range L).flatMap (rlBlk y k) := by
          refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(y - x - 1) / 2, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
          simp only [rlBlk, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
          omega
        simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
    · have h : x ∈ (List.range (2 * L + 3 + 1)).map (fun i => y + 2 + i) :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x - (y + 2), List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      simp only [h, true_or, or_true]
  have hperm : (rlSeedW y k L n4 n6).Perm (List.range (y + 2 * L + 6)) := by
    have hsub : (List.range (y + 2 * L + 6)).Subperm (rlSeedW y k L n4 n6) :=
      List.nodup_range.subperm (fun x hx => hcov x (List.mem_range.mp hx))
    exact (hsub.perm_of_length_le (by rw [hlen, List.length_range])).symm
  have hedge : edgeLengths (rlSeedW y k L n4 n6) = Multiset.replicate y 1 +
      Multiset.replicate (2 * L + 3) (y - k) + Multiset.replicate 2 y := by
    unfold rlSeedW
    rw [List.range_succ (n := n6 + 1)]
    simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
      List.nil_append]
    rw [down (2 * L + 4) (2 * L + 4) y y _ (by omega) (by simp) (by omega)]
    rw [hU _ _ 1 _ (by omega), hU _ _ (y - k) _ (by omega), hU _ _ 1 _ (by omega),
      hU _ _ 1 _ (by omega)]
    have hd : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (T : List ℕ), ((List.range (n + 1)).map f ++ T).head? =
        some (f 0) := by
      intro f n T
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp
    rw [blk L _ le_rfl (by rw [hd]; try simp)]
    rw [down (y - 2 * L - 1) n4 (y + 2) (y - k) _ (by omega) (by rw [hd]; try simp)
      (by omega)]
    rw [up (y + 2) (2 * L + 3) (2 * L + 5) y _ (by rw [hd]; try simp) (by omega)]
    rw [up (2 * L + 5) n6 (2 * L + 5 + (n6 + 1)) 1 _ (by simp) (by omega)]
    have h0 : edgeLengths [2 * L + 5 + (n6 + 1)] = 0 := rfl
    rw [h0]
